`CMakeLists.txt`:

```txt
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if ("${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}" STREQUAL "iOS" OR IOS)
    set(CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES "arm64")
else()
    set(CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES "arm64;x86_64")
endif()
set(CMAKE_CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)

project(earlybuffer VERSION 1.2.2)

file(GLOB_RECURSE SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS src/*.cpp)
add_library(${PROJECT_NAME} SHARED ${SOURCES})

if (NOT DEFINED ENV{GEODE_SDK})
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Unable to find Geode SDK! Please define GEODE_SDK environment variable to point to Geode")
else()
    message(STATUS "Found Geode: $ENV{GEODE_SDK}")
endif()

add_subdirectory($ENV{GEODE_SDK} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/geode)

# GDR / GDR2 replay format (header-only)
set(LIBGDR_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
CPMAddPackage("gh:maxnut/GDReplayFormat#d8d2f0b1193a46cdf47b413dc832616dd052b6a9")
target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} libGDR)

# Win32 file dialogs (PauseActionBridge GetOpenFileNameW / GetSaveFileNameW).
# Must stay WIN32-only — never link comdlg32 (or any dialog lib) on Android/NDK,
# macOS, or iOS. Non-Windows uses SaveDropPaths under the mod save dir instead.
if (WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} comdlg32)
elseif (ANDROID)
    message(STATUS "EarlyBuffer: Android build — no Windows dialog libs (comdlg32)")
endif()

# MSVC batch-compiles TUs and can ICE on some Geode/arc headers; one TU per cl.exe.
if (MSVC)
    set_property(TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTY VS_GLOBAL_UseMultiToolTask false)
    set_property(TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTY VS_GLOBAL_CL_MPCount 1)
endif()

# GeodeBindings GeneratedSource.cpp uses FMOD_* types without including fmod.h.
# On iOS (and sometimes other Clang targets) that fails with "unknown type name FMOD_RESULT".
# Force-include Geode's FMOD headers into GeodeBindings before those TUs compile.
if (TARGET GeodeBindings)
    set(_EB_FMOD_H "$ENV{GEODE_SDK}/loader/include/Geode/fmod/fmod.h")
    if (EXISTS "${_EB_FMOD_H}")
        if (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang|AppleClang|GNU")
            target_compile_options(GeodeBindings PRIVATE "-include${_EB_FMOD_H}")
        elseif (MSVC)
            target_compile_options(GeodeBindings PRIVATE "/FI${_EB_FMOD_H}")
        endif()
        message(STATUS "EarlyBuffer: force-including FMOD headers for GeodeBindings")
    endif()
endif()

setup_geode_mod(${PROJECT_NAME})

```

`CONTRIBUTING.md`:

```md
# Contributing

Thanks for helping with **EarlyBuffer**. Please read the [README](README.md) development / authorship notes: direction and review are human-led; AI may assist drafting. Prefer small, testable PRs.

**Scope note:** **v1.2.1** targets **GD 2.2081** only (last line for that game build). Work for newer GD versions belongs in a dedicated port / major bump — do not mix incompatible bindings into this branch casually.

## Setup

1. Install Geode SDK + CLI; export `GEODE_SDK`.
2. Clone [earlybuffering-gd](https://github.com/ToldByNun/earlybuffering-gd); `geode build --config RelWithDebInfo`.
3. Prefer Windows for day-to-day iteration (matches primary hooks).

## Project layout

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `src/config/` | `StageConfig` — settings cache / presets |
| `src/core/` | Planner, bake, trigger world, scope gate, learning, buffer |
| `src/hooks/` | `$modify` game hooks |
| `src/ui/` | Overlay, pause hub, trajectory, save feedback |
| `src/debug/` | Assist log, LagProbe, PerfTrace, PlanGoldCorpus |
| `mod.json` | Geode metadata + settings UI |
| `docs/assist_reference.md` | Planner / settings contract |

## Adding a setting

1. Add the entry under `settings` in `mod.json` (prefer `bool` / `int` / `float` / `string`+`one-of`).
2. Cache it in `StageConfig::refreshCache()` and expose a getter.
3. `listenForSettingChanges<…>` in `src/main.cpp`.
4. Document the key in `docs/assist_reference.md` and mention it in `changelog.md` if user-facing.
5. Wire behavior in the smallest core/hook file that owns the concern.

## Changing the planner / trigger world

- Contract lives in `docs/assist_reference.md` (lexico, orb window, budgets, buffer SM, trigger bake lifecycle).
- Prefer deterministic tick budgets over wall-clock-only logic.
- Keep bake **main-thread / serial** (`BakeScheduler` / `TriggerWorldBaker::tickSlice`); do not reintroduce worker-pool Cocos use.
- Extend `PlanGoldCorpus`, `TriggerClassify::selfCheck`, `TriggerWorldStore::selfCheck`, and/or `ShadowSimulator::regressionSelfCheck` when you add invariants.
- Platformer must stay assist-off.
- Classes + `#ifndef` guards; **no** project namespaces / anonymous namespaces for new code; prefer `this->` on members.

## PR checklist

- [ ] Builds (`geode build` or CI green)
- [ ] No drive-by renames / unrelated formatting
- [ ] Settings + docs updated together
- [ ] Honest wording for Replay/Brute/Safe Mode / Trigger World if you touch those paths
- [ ] Short PR description: *why*, not only *what*

## Code style

- Match neighboring files (Geode prelude, class-only headers with `#ifndef` guards).
- Avoid committing `build/`, `build_*.txt`, or local save dumps.

## License

By contributing, you agree your changes are licensed under the MIT License (see `LICENSE`).

## Releases

Bump `mod.json` + `CMakeLists.txt` version together. Local staging may live in `releases/` (gitignored). Do not commit that folder.

```

`INSTALL.md`:

```md
# Build & install

## Requirements

- Geometry Dash **2.2081** (this mod line does **not** support other GD versions)
- [Geode](https://geode-sdk.org/) **5.11.1+** (SDK + CLI)
- CMake 3.21+ and a **C++23** toolchain (MSVC on Windows)

Set `GEODE_SDK` to your Geode SDK checkout.

## Quick build (recommended)

```bash
geode build --config RelWithDebInfo
```

The CLI packages and can install the `.geode` into your mods folder.

**Windows-only warning:** A local `geode build` on Windows produces a package that contains **`audesign.earlybuffer.dll` only**. Installing that `.geode` on Android fails with:

> Unable to find platform binary under the name 'audesign.earlybuffer.android64.so'

Always verify Android packages with the package check (below) before copying them to a phone.

## CMake

```bash
cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo
cmake --build build --config RelWithDebInfo
```

Then package with the Geode CLI, or use `setup_geode_mod` output from the build tree.

## Platforms

Local day-to-day development is primarily **Windows**. Official multi-platform binaries can come from GitHub Actions (Windows, macOS, iOS, Android32/64), **or** from a local Android NDK build + merge (this section). You do not need GitHub to ship Android — you need a package that actually contains the Android binary.

## Android (local maintainer path)

Target Geometry Dash **2.2081** + Geode on device. Modern phones need **Android64** (`arm64-v8a`). Older 32-bit devices need **Android32** as well.

### Prerequisites

1. Install the [Android NDK](https://developer.android.com/ndk) (Geode currently pins an NDK **r29** tree) and set **`ANDROID_NDK_ROOT`** permanently to that folder (User or Machine env). A working local path looks like:
   `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Android\Sdk\ndk\29.0.14206865`
   Session-only env vars are lost when the terminal closes — set the User variable or Android builds will fail to configure.
2. On **Windows**, also install **Ninja** (e.g. `scoop install ninja`).
3. Install Geode Android loader binaries for the SDK:

```bash
geode sdk install-binaries -p android64
# Only if you still support 32-bit phones:
geode sdk install-binaries -p android32
```

### Build Android64

```bash
geode build -p android64 --config RelWithDebInfo
# Equivalent:
# geode build --platform android64 --config RelWithDebInfo
```

Default output directory: **`build-android64/`** (Geode CLI). The packaged file is typically:

`build-android64/audesign.earlybuffer.geode`

Inside that zip Geode expects this exact binary name:

**`audesign.earlybuffer.android64.so`**

(mod id + `.android64.so` — do not rename).

Android32 (optional):

```bash
geode build -p android32 --config RelWithDebInfo
# → build-android32/… containing audesign.earlybuffer.android32.so
```

### Package check (required before phone install)

Never copy a Windows-only `build/audesign.earlybuffer.geode` to Android. Run:

```bash
python tools/geode_package_check.py build-android64/audesign.earlybuffer.geode --require android64
```

Exit code **0** = binary present. Exit code **1** = missing (same error Geode shows on device). Exit code **2** = bad/missing zip.

For a multi-platform ship zip (Windows + Android64), require both after merge:

```bash
python tools/geode_package_check.py path/to/merged.geode --require win --require android64
```

### Merge with Windows (required for dual-platform ships)

A phone-only Android64 `.geode` is enough to test on device. A release that also supports Windows needs both binaries in **one** `.geode`.

`geode package merge` **mutates its first argument**. Prefer the wrapper (copies inputs, merges into `--output`, then runs the package check):

```bash
# 1) Windows package
geode build --config RelWithDebInfo
# → build/audesign.earlybuffer.geode  (dll only)

# 2) Android64 package
geode build -p android64 --config RelWithDebInfo
# → build-android64/audesign.earlybuffer.geode  (android64.so)

# 3) Merge + gate (fails if android64.so missing)
python tools/merge_geode_packages.py ^
  --output releases/audesign.earlybuffer.geode ^
  build/audesign.earlybuffer.geode ^
  build-android64/audesign.earlybuffer.geode
```

Phone-only (no Windows `.dll` required):

```bash
python tools/merge_geode_packages.py ^
  --output releases/audesign.earlybuffer-android64.geode ^
  --allow-missing-win ^
  --require android64 ^
  build-android64/audesign.earlybuffer.geode
```

Manual equivalent (easy to get wrong — wrapper preferred):

```bash
copy build\audesign.earlybuffer.geode releases\audesign.earlybuffer.geode
geode package merge releases\audesign.earlybuffer.geode build-android64\audesign.earlybuffer.geode
python tools/geode_package_check.py releases\audesign.earlybuffer.geode --require win --require android64
```

**Never** install or publish until the package check exits **0**. A Windows-only `build/audesign.earlybuffer.geode` will fail `--require android64` on purpose.

### Install on device

Copy the verified `.geode` into the Geode mods folder. On stock Geode Android Launcher that is commonly:

```text
/storage/emulated/0/Android/media/com.geode.launcher/game/geode/mods/
```

Some launchers or forks use a different root — if unsure, use the **Geode mods folder** shown in the launcher / Geode docs for your install. Enable **EarlyBuffer** (`audesign.earlybuffer`) and dependency **geode.node-ids**.

### Edge cases

| Case | What to do |
|------|------------|
| Windows-only `.geode` on phone | Will show the Unknown / missing `android64.so` error — rebuild Android64 or merge |
| 32-bit phone | Also build/merge `android32` (`audesign.earlybuffer.android32.so`) |
| Wrong GD version | This line is **2.2081 only** |
| Package check fails after merge | Do not install; re-merge / re-build the missing platform |
| NDK / Ninja missing | Configure fails before any `.so` is produced — fix env, do not ship the Windows zip as a workaround |

## After install

1. Enable **EarlyBuffer** (`audesign.earlybuffer`) in Geode.
2. Ensure **geode.node-ids** is installed.
3. Prefer **Safe Mode** on for online / rated play.
4. Platformer levels: assist stays off by design.

## Android device smoke checklist

Use a **merged** or android64-checked `.geode` only. Tick each item on a 64-bit phone (GD **2.2081** + Geode):

1. **Package gate (PC)** — `python tools/geode_package_check.py <ship.geode> --require android64` exits 0. For dual ships also `--require win`.
2. **Load** — copy into Geode mods folder; enable EarlyBuffer; **no** `Unable to find platform binary under the name 'audesign.earlybuffer.android64.so'`.
3. **Live assist (touch)** — short classic level (not platformer); Enabled on; Safe Mode on; Assist Mode Live; early jump → Delay or Pass; overlay updates (proves touch → `handleButton`).
4. **Settings without keyboard** — Pause → EB → toggle Enabled / Preset (hotkeys optional).
5. **Config paths** — Export Config → alert shows save-dir path; Import after placing/editing `earlybuffer-config.json` there.
6. **Replay drop** — place one `.gdr` (or `.gdr2` / `.mhr` / `.json` / `.slc`) in `replay-drop/` under the mod save dir → Import Replay succeeds or clear error (not “Windows-only”).
7. **Cold start** — force-stop the app; reopen; mod still loads; PlanGold/load stays WARN-only (no crash). Dev Lab unused stays quiet.
8. **Optional Dev Lab** — if Dev Record Enable is on: Start Recording / Eval Last / Copy Report writes `earlybuffer-dev-report.txt` under the save dir.

If step 2 fails, you installed a Windows-only package — re-merge. If step 3 fails with no overlay and no delay, capture Geode crashlog before changing planner code.

## CI note

Multi-platform CI builds Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. iOS GeodeBindings needs an FMOD force-include (see `CMakeLists.txt`) because codegen emits FMOD stubs without including `fmod.h`. Local Android builds above do not require running CI.

```

`README.md`:

```md
# EarlyBuffer

**Click early. Still live.**

Geode timing assist for Geometry Dash **2.2081**. Jump a little soon — EarlyBuffer holds the press and fires on the first physics tick a shadow sim still calls safe. Assist, not autoplayer. No late-forgiveness (it does not rewind time for late clicks).

| | |
|---|---|
| Mod ID | `audesign.earlybuffer` |
| Version | **1.2.2** |
| Target | GD **2.2081** / Geode **5.11.1+** |
| Platforms | Windows, macOS, iOS, Android (multi-platform `.geode` — must include `android64.so`) |
| License | [MIT](LICENSE) |
| Repository | [ToldByNun/earlybuffering-gd](https://github.com/ToldByNun/earlybuffering-gd) |

> **Last 2.2081 line.** **v1.2.2** still targets Geometry Dash **2.2081** only (Android64 packaging + mobile I/O on top of 1.2.1). Newer GD versions need a separate port / major bump. A Windows-only local build will **not** load on Android — use a merged / checked package (see `INSTALL.md`).

## What it does

- **Live / Hybrid** — plan each click with a shadow physics sim (threat zones, optional orb windows). Hopeless clicks still pass through; your input is never blocked.
- **Replay / BruteForce** — bake click *windows* from an imported macro or a serial main-thread search. These are timing maps, not a live multi-click bot queue.
- **Trigger World Bake** — cache spawn-timed static mover / toggle poses so the shadow sim can collide them instead of treating every mover as unknown (see settings + [`docs/assist_reference.md`](docs/assist_reference.md)).
- **Safe Mode** — when assist is on (or has touched a run), progress / bests / percentage are not saved as legit clears.
- **Scope gates** — platformer hard-off; optional practice / startpos / percent window; up to six float “assist off” percent ranges.
- **Learning** — optional per-level bias / trust (off by default; never changes your tick window; does not self-reinforce from inject “saves”).
- **Self-bake** — optional practice (and normal) recording of vanilla clicks into the bake map (off by default), with idle merge/refine.

Full planner / settings reference: [`docs/assist_reference.md`](docs/assist_reference.md).

## Install

1. Install [Geode](https://geode-sdk.org/) for **GD 2.2081**.
2. Install from the **Geode Index**, or download the **v1.2.2** `.geode` from [Releases](https://github.com/ToldByNun/earlybuffering-gd/releases) (must contain `audesign.earlybuffer.android64.so` for Android).
3. Ensure dependency **geode.node-ids** ≥ v1.23.3 (Geode will prompt).

## Build

```bash
# Requires GEODE_SDK and a C++23 toolchain (MSVC on Windows)
geode build --config RelWithDebInfo
```

Or configure CMake against `$env:GEODE_SDK` / `$GEODE_SDK`. See [`INSTALL.md`](INSTALL.md).

CI builds all platforms via [`.github/workflows/multi-platform.yml`](.github/workflows/multi-platform.yml).

## Settings (quick)

Open Geode → EarlyBuffer → Settings (or pause → **EB**). Highlights:

- **Enabled / Preset / Assist Mode** — master control and Live / Hybrid / Replay / BruteForce
- **Pick Mode** (`assist-pick`) — **Legacy** (default, 1.2.0 feel) vs **New** (exit prediction)
- **Safe Mode / Overlay / Pause UI** — publish-safe defaults; hide chrome when you want a clean pause menu
- **Trigger World Bake** — static mover cache for the shadow sim; optional skip of player-follow dynamics
- **Assist Off Ranges** — six From/To percent slots (`-1` = unused); assist forced off inside those ranges
- **Tick window / orbs / CPS / budgets** — timing and CPU limits (ticks ≠ 60fps frames)
- **Save Feedback** — separate Sound / Color / Counter toggles when a delayed click is injected

Hotkeys are configurable (defaults include F6 preset cycle, Ctrl+Shift+M assist mode, and more).

## Development status

EarlyBuffer **1.2.2** is an **actively maintained** release for **2.2081**: features are still being developed and optimized, and the build is exercised regularly (manual play + automated self-checks on mod load / PlanGold). Treat it as a production assist for this GD version — not a abandoned prototype — while remembering it will not track newer game builds.

## Authorship and AI use

**Product direction is human.** Feature goals, constraints, and iterative review come from the maintainer (Audesign).

**Implementation used AI coding tools** (Cursor and similar) as a drafting aid. **Every line shipped in this release was reviewed by the maintainer**, and behavior is **tested thoroughly and re-tested as features evolve** (playtesting, crash/lag probes, and automated self-checks). AI did not replace ownership, review, or QA.

Bug reports with GD / Geode / platform / steps (and crashlogs when relevant) are welcome.

## Contributing

See [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) for build tips, how to add settings / planner behavior, and PR expectations.

## Support and ethics

- This mod **assists inputs**. Using it on rated / online content may violate community norms or RobTop’s rules — use **Safe Mode**, practice, and your own judgment.
- Discord: [https://discord.gg/QJuTDkmPcf](https://discord.gg/QJuTDkmPcf)
- Issues: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/ToldByNun/earlybuffering-gd/issues). In-mod support text: `support.md`.
- **Changelog:** see [`changelog.md`](changelog.md) — **v1.2.2** Android64 package / mobile I/O; **v1.2.1** miss-assist Pick Mode / Pass-verdict (still GD **2.2081** only).

## Credits

- Maintainer / design / engineering: **Audesign** ([ToldByNun](https://github.com/ToldByNun))
- Built on [Geode](https://geode-sdk.org/) and Geometry Dash bindings
- Replay import uses [GDReplayFormat](https://github.com/maxnut/GDReplayFormat) (libGDR)

# Security

EarlyBuffer is a local Geometry Dash client mod. It does not intentionally open network sockets or exfiltrate save data.

## Reporting

If you find a vulnerability in packaging, CI, or dependency handling, open a private report with the maintainer via GitHub Security Advisories (or a confidential issue contact if advisories are unavailable).

## Player safety

- Prefer **Safe Mode** so assisted runs do not write normal progress.
- Replay import and file pickers run locally; only open files you trust.
- Treat AI-assisted code as needing review; do not assume cryptographic or sandbox guarantees beyond what Geode provides.

`about.md`:

```md
# PLEASE READ THIS

EarlyBuffer was written with a lot of AI-assisted drafting.

**That does not mean it was dumped unreviewed.**

Every line that ships was checked by hand. Behavior was playtested in-game, edge cases were chased down, and the planner / shadow path was exercised until the assist felt right — not “looks fine in a chat window.”

If you are reviewing this for the Geode Index (or as a player who cares how mods are made): treat it as human-directed engineering with AI as a tool, not as an unattended codegen paste.

---

# EarlyBuffer

**Click early. Still live.**

EarlyBuffer is a timing assist for Geometry Dash **2.2081**.
You jump a little soon — the mod holds that press and lands it on the first physics tick a **shadow simulation** still considers safe.

You still play the level. EarlyBuffer does not invent clicks, farm clears, or drive the icon for you. It only decides *when* a press you already made is allowed to land — inside the windows and modes you set.

> **v1.2.2** is the current EarlyBuffer package line for **GD 2.2081** (includes Android64). Newer game builds need a separate port.

---

## What happens on a press

1. You hit Jump (a bit early).
2. A short shadow plan checks hazards, orbs, and — if you baked them — movers / toggles.
3. Safer tick later in your window → **buffer**, fire then.
4. Nothing better → **Pass**. Vanilla click goes through. Hopeless presses are not softlocked forever.
5. Releases work the same idea (ship / wave / short-hops), with one hard rule: **while you still hold Jump, EarlyBuffer never forces a release.** After you let go it may stretch the hold by at most your tick window.

Every Pass / Delay stamps a **Pass-reason / verdict** (overlay + debug). Soft **Hold-Until-Safe** can replan briefly when budget/foresight leaves the click open — never past your Limit, never hangs.

---

## Tick ≠ frame

Physics unit = **tick** (often ~240/s). UI “frames” at 60fps are **not** the same: ~10 display frames ≈ 40 ticks at 240 TPS. Settings `ticks-*` / presets are tick windows — remap before blaming the assist.

---

## Pick Mode (assist-pick)

| Mode | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| **New** (default) | Surviving delays only; **Smart Prediction** picks the delay with the best predicted exit (not fixed mid/latest). |
| **Legacy** | If delay 0 is already safe → Pass now; else **latest** ±k-robust viable (orb band still earliest activation). |

Neither mode waits past your Limit (G1 window-cap).

---

## Modes

- **Live** — plans every press / release from the current state
- **Hybrid** — nearby bake window when it verifies; otherwise Live (foresight / miss-assist)
- **Replay** — click windows from an imported replay bake
- **BruteForce** — windows from a no-replay brute bake

Bakes are **timing maps**, not a bot queue. Intent still comes from you.

Contracts G1–G3, Pass-reason list, Hold-Until-Safe: [`docs/assist_reference.md`](docs/assist_reference.md).

---

## Defaults that matter

- **Safe Mode** on — assisted / enabled runs should not write normal progress for rated or online play
- **Platformer** hard off
- **Auto-Tune** / **Self-Bake** off — no per-level learning or practice recording until you turn them on
- Presets (**Tight → Max**) fill tick windows · F6 cycles · Off kills assist
- Optional Trigger World Bake so movers aren’t invisible to the shadow
- Save Feedback: sound / flash / world `+N` and `8+` when a delay actually fired
- Lag Probe & Perf Trace if you’re hunting hitches

Every important setting has plain-language info text in the mod (what it does, what higher / lower means).

---

## Links

- **Source:** [ToldByNun/earlybuffering-gd](https://github.com/ToldByNun/earlybuffering-gd)
- **Bugs:** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/ToldByNun/earlybuffering-gd/issues)
- **Chat:** [Discord](https://discord.gg/QJuTDkmPcf)

Use Safe Mode. Practice. Don’t drop assisted runs on rated / online like they’re clean.

`changelog.md`:

```md
# Changelog

## Unreleased (working tree)

### Config export / import (full settings)
- **ConfigBundle v2**: exports/imports all **130** portable settings under `{ version, settings }` (not the old ~12-key subset).
- Types: bool/int/float/string, color as `#RRGGBB`, keybinds as Geode strings (`F6`, `Ctrl+Shift+D`, multi via ` | `).
- Import: v1 flat-root still works; merge missing keys; skip bad types; **applying-guard** so preset does not wipe custom ticks / look-ahead.
- Alerts show version / applied|keys / skipped + path. PlanGold: `ConfigBundleKeys` / `ConfigBundleCodec` / `ConfigBundle` round-trip selfCheck.
- Docs: `docs/assist_reference.md` Config export/import section.

### Safe Mode progress gate
- **Safe Mode OFF** now allows percentage / new best / normal complete even when assist delayed a click. Previously `assistTouchedRun` (and enabled→test-mode) always blocked progress regardless of Safe Mode.
- **Safe Mode ON** (default): still blocks when assist is enabled or this attempt was assist-touched.
- `StageConfig::blocksProgressSaves` live-reads `safe-mode` / `enabled` at the gate (pause toggle mid-run cannot stick on a stale cache).

### Beginner defaults
- Preset **Normal**, windows **4/4**, Pick **Legacy**, Assist Mode **Live**, Safe Mode **on**.
- Visuals / debug off by default: overlay, pause bake status, save-feedback sound/color, debug logging, lag probe.
- **Auto-Tune Per Level** and **Self-Bake (Practice)** default **off** (less background CPU / no surprise learning). Existing Geode saves keep the user’s prior values.

### Assist clock / first-click
- Fix hitch poisoning of `m_lastDt` (stuck `simDt≈0.25` → `simTps≈4`, `speedScaleSuspect`) that made opening clicks `pass-hopeless` / useless Delay on Legacy and New. Sane physics samples update EMA both ways; absurd quanta snap planning to nominal 240 TPS.
- Dev Lab sessions on Dump StartPos / Slaughterhouse showed this clock failure on first DOWN.

### Window unit
- Setting **Window Unit**: `Ticks` (default) or `Frames` (60fps). Numbers under Default Window / per-mode overwrite convert to physics ticks (1 frame ≈ 4 ticks @240). Planning always uses ticks.

## v1.2.2

**Android64 package + mobile I/O** (still GD **2.2081** only).

### Packaging
- Release `.geode` includes **`audesign.earlybuffer.android64.so`** (and Windows `.dll` when merged). Windows-only local builds fail on phone with Geode’s missing-binary error.
- Tools: `tools/geode_package_check.py`, `tools/merge_geode_packages.py`. Build/merge + device smoke: `INSTALL.md`. GitHub release notes staging: `releases/v1.2.2.md`.

### Mobile I/O
- Non-Windows **Import Replay** via save-dir `replay-drop/` (newest `.gdr` / `.gdr2` / `.mhr` / `.json` / `.slc`).
- Config Export/Import uses `earlybuffer-config.json` under the mod save dir; alerts show the full path.
- Dev **Copy Report** dual-writes clipboard + `earlybuffer-dev-report.txt`.
- Drop folders created on mod load when possible.

### Android runtime
- PlanGold skips disk DevTrace self-checks on load (in-memory checks remain).
- Planner sim/tick budgets capped on Android (≤ 2000 µs / ≤ 2000 ticks).
- Status overlay top inset increased for notched screens.

### Build
- CMake: `comdlg32` stays Win32-only; Android NDK compile fixes (UTF-8 sources, activated-object map key).

## v1.2.1

**Miss-assist / verdict pass for GD 2.2081** (same final game line as 1.2.0).

- **Pass reasons + overlay** — every Pass/Delay stamps `AssistReason` (`VERDICT` / `PLAN … verdict=`).
- **Pick Mode** (`assist-pick`): **New** (default, exit/outcome prediction) vs **Legacy** (d0 Pass / latest ±k-robust).
- **TravelForesight** + **OpportunityProbe** (G2 no-threat); Wave / spam / UNTRUST soft when orb/pad ahead.
- **Soft Hold-Until-Safe** with cadenced replan (budget caps; never hang past Limit).
- Continuous **idleSafer / ascentUseful** (Ship/Wave); Hybrid bake verify-fail → Live foresight.
- Tick ≠ frame documented; PlanGold self-checks on load.

## v1.2.0

**Final EarlyBuffer release for Geometry Dash 2.2081.** Newer GD builds need a separate port.

### Pause settings (EB)

- Pause stays clean: top-right **EB** opens Geode settings; optional status lines top-left (`show-pause-bake`).
- Side bake/assist button stacks removed — actions live in settings pages.
- Category switcher: **Main → Bake → Ingame → Assist → Visual → Modes → Keys**.
- **Bake** page: Cycle Mode / Import Replay / Bake Map / Brute Bake / Cancel + live status (poll while pause open).
- **Assist** page: Cycle Preset / Reset Learn / Export·Import Cfg above the assist settings rows.
- Re-open EB is a no-op while settings are already open; scroll preserved across Geode rebuilds.

### Save feedback toggles

- Replaced combined `save-feedback` (off/icon/sound/both) with three Visual toggles: **Sound**, **Color** (icon flash), **Counter** (world +N).
- Defaults match old `both` (sound+color on, counter off). Re-check toggles if you previously used off/sound/icon-only.
- **Counter**: hollow ring + `+N` in GD font at the assisted click, colored by frames saved (1–8 palette); stays until death/restart; max 64 markers.

### Trigger World Bake

- Settings: **Trigger World Bake** + **Skip Dynamic** (defaults on).
- Content-keyed cache (`triggers/*.json`): spawn-timed static Move/Rotate/Scale/Toggle keyframes for the shadow sim.
- Budgeted build on enter (`tickSlice`); apply + restore transforms during plan; ready tracks promote from Unknown-on-overlap to Include.
- Player-follow / toggle-orb stay dynamic (Unknown unless optional live probe with skip-dynamic off).
- Lifecycle: loadOrBuild on enter; keep on checkpoint; cancel on death (resume if empty); save on quit/complete.
- Apply perf: near-ghost-first + per-tick object/time caps (far movers hold last pose).
- Settings info texts rewritten for plain-language high/low tradeoffs.

### Perf / Lag Probe

- **Perf Trace** (default off): times assist hot paths; spikes → console + `earlybuffer-perf.log`.
- **Lag Probe** (default on): death/reset/checkpoint episode timings → `earlybuffer-lagprobe.log` (legend included).
- Save-cue console spam gated behind Debug Logging.

### Crash / hitch fixes

- Evacuate shadow+snapshot ghosts from section vectors before `resetLevel` / checkpoint load.
- Safer ghost scrub (no bare `removeObjectFromSection` on null slots); quit detach without extra retains.
- Death path stays lean (no refine / disk on destroyPlayer); self-bake merge/refine amortized on idle ticks.

### Adaptive robust window + latency cost

- Smart settings: **Robust Window (±k)** (`0` = auto from mode/speed/dt variance) and optional **firstDt jitter**.
- `betterCand` ranks by `endX − latencyWeight·delay` after surviveBin; per-mode defaults (Wave 1.0 … Cube 0.25).

### Live bake-prior / smart / learning

- Nearby BakeMap window becomes a Live prefer delay band; early-exit when a robust prefer delay is found.
- `planSequence` scores `d0` using next bake/self-bake follow-up clicks when available.
- Per-spot click-earliness histogram; Laplace modal; decay + gated explore (no Wave/spam ±1 explore when intent would Pass).

### Divergence / UNTRUST

- Outcome tracking into `DivergenceTracker`; Live/Hybrid-live `simUntrusted` → force Pass + overlay hint.
- Soft warn shortens planner `capMul`.

### Self-bake

- **Self-Bake (Practice)** on by default; optional normal-mode; optional refine.
- Vanilla clicks → BakeMap (`method=self`); assist injects never recorded.
- Death/reset merge-only (idle drain); checkpoint/complete/quit may refine when safe.

### Bake verify

- `findNear` prefers matching game mode, then falls back.
- Hybrid/Replay/Brute: one-shot live `verifyDelay` before using a bake window.

### Settings / docs

- Regrouped Geode settings; Trigger World group; Internal for buried keys.
- README / about / support / contributing updated for Index release; repo `earlybuffering-gd`.

## v1.1.0

### Fixes

- **Death-to-nothing:** owned shadow/snapshot players never enter vanilla `destroyPlayer` / `playerDestroyed` (including anticheat). Dying to a ghost body as the killer object is swallowed.
- While simulating, real-player collision is skipped; live collision lists strip owned ghosts; real deaths mid-sim are swallowed (anticheat on real players still passes).
- Active shadow is parked off-level after each sim with wave trail reset; ghost `update` is a no-op unless actively stepping.

### Save feedback

- **Save Feedback** setting: `off` / `icon` / `sound` / `both` (default `both`).
- Per-tick sound cues for +1…+7 delayed ticks; +8+ uses the 8-tick clip (shipped in the mod package under resources).
- Icon flash uses **Save Icon Color** (color picker).

### Project

- Mod logo (`logo.png`) for Geode / Index listing.

## v1.0.0

First public release as **EarlyBuffer** (formerly *frirecracker* / *EarlyGrace*).

### Assist

- Threat-zone Live planner with optional orb activation windows (earliest +/-k-robust; no midpoint)
- Modes: Live, Hybrid, Replay, BruteForce (honest bake windows)
- Buffer lifecycle: Press B fires A then plans B; checkpoint / death / reset clears buffer
- Platformer hard-disable; practice / startpos / percent allow window
- Six float **Assist Off** percent ranges (From/To, `-1` = unused)
- Safe Mode + assistTouchedRun progress gating
- Per-level auto-tune with decay / explore; no trust-up from inject saves
- Runtime TPS for brute bake; serial main-thread BakeScheduler (no Cocos worker threads)
- Sim collision policy (unknown on movers / mode portals); divergence + perf overlay bits
- Pause UI: bake controls, hotkey mirrors, config export/import
- Plan gold / shadow self-check on mod load

### Project

- Mod ID `audesign.earlybuffer`; Geode 5.11.1 / GD 2.2081
- Docs, CI multi-platform workflow, contributing guide

`docs/assist_reference.md`:

```md
# EarlyBuffer Assist Reference

Planner / settings contract for **EarlyBuffer v1.2.1** on Geometry Dash **2.2081** (Geode). Physics unit = tick (measured TPS, often ~240/s). Threat zones use world X. **Last 2.2081 release line** — see repository README.

## Modes (honest)

| Mode | Role |
|------|------|
| Live | Input forgiveness: shadow-plan each click; Delay buffers, Pass = vanilla. |
| Hybrid | Bake window if near + live verify clearsThreat, else Live (+ foresight / miss-assist). |
| Replay | Precomputed click windows from imported macro bake (TAS-like timing map). |
| BruteForce | Precomputed exhaustive safe timings (TAS-like generator). Not a live multi-click bot queue. |

Live/Hybrid never block hopeless clicks. Replay/Brute are precomputed windows, not a live macro injector queue.

## Bake verify (Hybrid / Replay / Brute)

`BakeMap::findNear` prefers `BakedClick.mode == kindOf(player)` within 120px X; falls back to any mode if none match.
Before using a window, `BakeVerifier` runs one `ShadowSimulator::verifyDelay` (d0 zone + runOne at planned delay). Success = clearsThreat and not diedBeforeAction (linked dual checked).

| Mode | Verify fail / past window / missing bake |
|------|------------------------------------------|
| Hybrid | Fall through to **Live** (`TravelForesight` + OpportunityProbe / HUS / idleSafer). Overlay hint `… → live`. No bake Pass verdict. |
| Replay / Brute | Pass with reason: `pass-bake-verify-fail`, `pass-bake-past-latest`, `pass-bake-missing`, `pass-bake-no-window`. |

Early-before-window still buffers until bake earliest (clamped to `limit`).

## Self-bake

Settings (Learning): `auto-tune` (default off), `self-bake` (default off, practice), `self-bake-normal` (default off), `self-bake-refine` (default on when self-bake is enabled).

`SelfBakeRecorder` records vanilla jump inputs (never assist injects). On death / checkpoint / complete / reset, merges into `BakeMap` via `mergeSelfClicks` (`method=self` when empty/self; dedup union; cap 512). **Death and reset never refine** (merge-only — refine on the main thread caused 1–2s freezes). Checkpoint / complete / quit may refine when enabled, start snapshot exists, and assist did not touch the run (`refineSelfWindows`, budget 64 sims). Quit cancels in-flight refine.

## Trigger World Bake

Settings (Trigger World): `trigger-bake` (default on), `trigger-bake-skip-dynamic` (default on).

When enabled, static move/rotate/scale/toggle motion is cached per level content key (`triggers/{fullKey}.json` under the mod save dir). Overlay shows `trigger-world: …`.

**Lifecycle**

| Event | Trigger world |
|-------|----------------|
| Level enter (`onLevelInit`) | `TriggerWorldBaker::loadOrBuild` — load JSON; on miss queue budgeted `tickSlice` build |
| Physics tick | `tickSlice` (~750µs); sim apply uses `attemptStartTick + t` |
| Checkpoint | **Keep** store + baker; reset `attemptTick` only (no rebuild) |
| Death | Cancel in-flight slices (no disk flush); `resetAttempt` **resumes** build if store still empty |
| Complete | `save` if dirty (no clear) |
| Quit | Cancel → `save` if dirty → `clear` |
| `trigger-bake` off | Clear store; no build |

**Sim collision:** ready Static* track + apply this step → `Include`. DynamicFollow targets: skip-dynamic (default) → `UnknownOnOverlap`; skip off → cheap live probe then `Include`. Dual / rotate-follow stay Unknown. **Follow-player never enters static JSON.**

JSON v1: `{ version, key, tps, tracks: [{ uniqueId, objectId, kind, ready, keys: [{ t, x, y, r, sx, sy, a }] }] }`. Caps: 2048 tracks, 8192 keys/track. Baker: spawn-timed StaticMove/Rotate/Scale/Toggle (linear); group-follow / touch / toggle-orb / enter-X skipped.

`ShadowSimulator::beginCapture` snapshots ready Static* (+ dynamic targets for restore). `applyTriggerWorldAtTick` / optional `applyLiveDynamicNear` before collide — **near ghost X first** (~±420), capped (~96 objects / ~350µs); far tracks hold last pose. LagProbe: `eb.triggerBake.load|build|save`, `eb.trigger.capture|apply|restore`, `triggerWorld.checkpoint`.

Classifier: Move/Rotate/Scale/Spawn/Toggle/ToggleOrb/Follow (901/1346/2067/1268/**1049**/**1594**/1347/1585/1817). Camera/pulse/song → `Ignore`. Group-follow → `StaticMove`; player-coupled → `DynamicFollow`; touch → `DynamicOther`.

**Self-check / manual matrix:** `TriggerWorldStore::selfCheck` + `TriggerClassify::selfCheck` run at mod load (and PlanGold). With `debug-logging`, the banner lists edge cases: static corridor, follow-player Unknown, cache-hit 2nd enter, skip-dynamic on, quit mid-build, death/reset LagProbe without `eb.triggerBake.build` inside the death episode.

## Not in scope

- Late-forgiveness (rewind time for late clicks)
- Enabling raw `triggerObject` during live plan (mutates the real level)
- Multi-click injection queue beyond Smart d0 selection
- Perfect spawn-DAG / every 2.2 trigger flavour in the static baker (unknown statics stay DynamicOther / Unknown until supported)

## Pause / settings UI

Pause: optional status lines (`show-pause-bake`) + top-right **EB** (`show-pause-hub`). No side button stacks.

EB opens the normal Geode ModSettingsPopup with a page switcher:

| Page | Contents |
|------|----------|
| Main | Enabled, Preset, Safe Mode, Debug |
| Bake | Native rows (`eb-action`): Import Bake Replay (button = `import` or `{name.ext}`), Cycle Mode, Bake Map, Brute Bake, Cancel |
| Ingame | Overlay, pause status/hub toggles |
| Assist | Action rows (Cycle Preset / Reset Learn / Export·Import) + Scope/Window/Algorithm/Smart/Learning |
| Visual | Trajectory, Save Feedback / Color |
| Modes | Cube…Swing per-mode blocks |
| Keys | Hotkeys + Internal |

Action rows use custom type `custom:eb-action`: same chrome as bool settings (label + info `i`), Geode button on the right instead of a checkbox.

## Config export / import (`ConfigBundle`)

Assist → **Export Config** / **Import Config** (also Win32 file picker; non-Win uses `earlybuffer-config.json` under the Geode mod save dir via `SaveDropPaths`).

### v2 schema

```json
{
  "version": 2,
  "settings": {
    "enabled": true,
    "preset": "Normal",
    "look-ahead-cap": 0,
    "save-icon-color": "#7CFF4A",
    "hotkey-cycle": "F6",
    "hotkey-debug": "Ctrl+Shift+D"
  }
}
```

- **`version`**: `2` (current).
- **`settings`**: all **130** portable Geode keys from `mod.json` (bool / int / float / string / color / keybind). Excludes `title-*` and `custom:eb-action` rows.
- **Color**: `"#RRGGBB"` hex.
- **Keybind**: human string (`"F6"`, `"Ctrl+Shift+D"`); multiple binds joined with `" | "`. JSON string arrays also accepted on import.
- Alerts show `version` / `applied|keys` / `skipped` and the file path.

### v1 compatibility

Older flat files (`{ "version": 1, "preset": "...", "ticks-all": 2, ... }` without nested `settings`) still import: known keys apply, unknown keys ignored.

### Merge semantics

- Missing key → leave the live setting unchanged.
- Wrong JSON type / bad hex / bad keybind → **skip that key** (no `0`/`false` coercion into live settings).
- Import runs under `StageConfig::beginApplying` / `endApplying` so the preset listener does **not** call `applyPresetByName` and wipe custom ticks / look-ahead.
- If `preset` is present, it wins over a mismatched `stage-index`; then `notePresetSynced`.
- PlanGold: `ConfigBundleKeys`, `ConfigBundleCodec`, and `ConfigBundle::selfCheck` (temp-file round-trip + preset/look-ahead-cap guard).

| swallow-hopeless | bool | false | | | Internal — deprecated unused |

## Pseudocode plan()

1. tickBudget from opts (default 4000); if verifyAb then *2
2. modelFor; capture state
3. d0 press baseline -> ThreatZone clusterGapX=50
4. **no-threat Pass (G2)**: baseline did not die, zone invalid, no orb/pad hint → run `OpportunityProbe` (foresight already forces search; else cheap `d=mid` / `d=limit` sims). Pass only if probe empty; else full cand search. Budget starve with no probes → `PassBudget`.
4b. **wave-hazard-proximity Pass**: Wave + hazard AABB within ahead proximity (~70–140px) + no orb/pad → Pass even if a distant ThreatZone exists (avoids phase-shift “assists” in zigzag spam). **`foresightOrbPad` blocks this Pass** (keep searching for the orb). Runs after foresight/orb checks.
4c. After cand eval: **wave-futile-delay Pass** if Wave, no orbIntent, no foresight orb/pad, all surviveBin ≤0 and best endX gain &lt; 8 → Pass. Foresight orb/pad → search further. Skipped when `idleSafer`.
4d. **Continuous idleSafer / ascentUseful**: Ship/Wave/Swing/Ufo — if baseline idle survives better than d0 press (`idleSafer`) and some delay &gt;0 improves survival (`ascentUseful`), force Delay (New outcome / Legacy latest) instead of Pass/hopeless. No forever block if nothing in-window is viable; controller may Soft Hold when both flags set. Wave proximity/futile early-Pass skipped when `idleSafer`.
5. eval delays under tick + sim-budget-us
6. orbIntent: Legacy earliest ±k act; New outcome rank ±k; optional firstDt ±3% jitter
7. else d0 survived -> Pass; else New outcome / Legacy latest ±k-robust
8. New: `planSequence` exit-predict over survivor band (horizon replay; smartDepth≥2 adds multi-jump)
9. budgetHit -> PassBudget (controller may Soft Hold-Until-Safe); linked dual both clear

Lexico (New): orbUseful > surviveBin > surviveTicks > endX−λ·delay. Legacy non-orb: latest ±k-robust. Bins 24/48/96. k from `robust-k` or auto.

## Click intent (spam) v2

`ClickIntentGuard` ring of recent Jump presses per player (P1/P2 independent).

Pass when **density** (wave ≈ 3 / 10 ticks) **and** (**rhythmic** gaps: mean ≤ mode max, low σ, no mid-spam pause) **or** **very dense** (need+2). **Never Pass** for empty ring, a solitary click, or when max gap ≫ local mean (absolute pause vs mode threshold **or** relative outlier). First 1–2 clicks and pause-then-resume → assist allowed.

**Do not Pass** (allow assist) when spatial orb/pad ahead **or** a BakeMap window is nearby. Portal/teleport corridor spam looks rhythmic → Pass unless orb/pad. Gate Pass sets overlay `PASS spam` / `VERDICT pass-spam`.

Continuous modes also Pass release assist during spam. Reset on attempt / quit. Self-check: `ClickIntentGuard::selfCheck`.

## Divergence / UNTRUST

`DivergenceTracker` ring (48): bad if delayed assist died, or orb expected but missed (death or delayed-for-orb). Warn ≥35%/n≥8; UNTRUST ≥45%/n≥12. `pollOutcome` uses real `planDelay`; `onRealDeath` notes pending outcomes. Live/Hybrid-live: `simUntrusted` → hard Pass + overlay `UNTRUST pass` / `PASS untrust` **unless** TravelForesight orb/pad ahead — then soft (allow Delay / Soft Hold). Low-trust spot Pass uses the same orb override. `shouldWarn` soft: `capMul *= 0.85`. `clear()` on attempt reset (and PlanGold `DivergenceTracker::selfCheck`).

## effectTick attribution

`onPhysicsTick` increments `attemptTick`, then `beginRealUpdate` → `PlayerObject::update` → `endRealUpdate`.
CBF / mid-step clicks happen while `m_inRealUpdate` is true (`midStep`).

| Mode class | midStep | between frames | firstDt |
|------------|---------|----------------|---------|
| Continuous (Wave/Ship/Swing/Ufo/Spider) | `attemptTick` | `attemptTick` (never +1) | mid: remainder/`timeWarp`; else full `simDt` |
| Discrete (Cube/Ball/Robot) | `attemptTick` | `attemptTick+1` | same |

Rule: never fold CBF remainder into the tick index — that caused systematic ±1 between mid-step and between-frame presses (wave spam). Helpers: `AssistController::resolveEffectTick` / `effectTickSelfCheck`. Debug: `attrib:` AssistLog line + PerfTrace `attrib` when debug-logging or perf-trace is on.

## Hold / release after assist (7.5)

After a **Delay** press is chosen, the planner probes release-after values `{0,1,2,3,5,8,10,14,18,24,32,40}` (budget ≤8 extra sims) and records:

| Field | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `releaseEarliest`…`releaseLatest` | Safe hold durations (ticks after press) that still clear the threat |
| `releaseAfter` | Preferred release (continuous → earliest; tap → mid-window) |

On inject: if the user still holds, arm `pendingRelease` at preferred; continuous modes may hold until `releaseLatest`, then force release. Early user release inside the window → no inject. **Re-click** while pending → cancel scheduled release and re-plan (second click in the window). Dash `requireHold` keeps release deferred while `m_isDashing`.

Branch releases `{2,5,10,18}` and dash-hold `40` seed the window when they already won viability.

## fireTick vs jumpTick

When arming a Delay press, `planDelay = plan.delay` and `expectedJumpTick = effectTick + jumpTick` (sim-relative).

`resolveFireTick(effectTick, delay, jumpTick, requireOrb)`:

- Non-orb and `jumpTick > delay` → `fireTick = effectTick + jumpTick` (inject when the jump matters, not one frame early).
- Orb / `jumpTick <= delay` → `fireTick = effectTick + delay` (activation window wins; hold covers lag).
- Always clamp to `pressTick + limit`.
- **`dMin`/`dMax` clamp only when `requireOrb`** — incidental activation bands from other cands must not collapse a threat Delay (Legacy and New). Otherwise `planDelay=+4` while `fireTick` snapped to an early orb cand → jump almost now.

`shouldFireBuffered`: fire when `attemptTick >= fireTick`, or on the last tick of the window if `planDelay` is already met (late-fire guard). SaveFeedback `+N` is **physics ticks** held back (`attemptTick - pressTick` at inject), not 60fps display frames (~4 ticks ≈ 1 frame @240tps).

Helpers: `AssistController::resolveFireTick` / `shouldFireBuffered` / `fireTickSelfCheck`.

## Recheck slide safety

Before inject, live recheck may slide `fireTick`. Rules (`acceptRecheckSlide`):

- Plan must be Delay, `delay > 0`, `!budgetHit`, and (`threatCleared` or orb).
- Cap late slides to `oldFire + 2` (non-orb); orb may wait for `dMin`.
- Never past `absMax - robustK` (collapsed margin falls back to `absMax`).
- Clamp to `pressTick + limit`. **Non-orb: reject early slides** (must not undo the planned wait).
- Log `recheck: oldFire→newFire` via AssistLog + PerfTrace.
- CPS / mode-change force-fire: `allowRecheck=false` (inject immediately).

## Pseudocode fireBuffered()

Wait for dMin if requireOrb; up to 2 safe reclamps into [dMin,dMax] (recheck also re-aligns jumpTick); inject; PendingRelease if needed.
Press B while ArmedPress: fire A first, then plan B.

## Buffer states

Idle | ArmedPress | ArmedRelease | PendingRelease
Cancel: death, resetLevel, quit, checkpoint load. Force-fire: mode-change, CPS unlock.

## Smart bake-chain

When `smartDepth > 1` and BakeMap has later clicks: `planSequence` scores each allowed `d0` with a fixed follow-up timeline from the next 1–2 bake/self-bake clicks (same mode; beyond horizon / mode change aborts). Score = survive + reach next X − weak latency. Only `d0` is buffered. No bake follow-ups → prior hypothetical d1 grid.

## Live bake-prior (prefer band)

`PlanOptions.preferDelayMin/Max` from a nearby BakeMap window (delay ticks). Cand order: d0 → **orb window** → prefer±k → rest. Early-exit after prefer margin if a ±k-robust prefer delay is viable (`!budgetHit`) — **suppressed** when orb foresight / orb-window is active so activations outside the prefer band are still evaluated. Final pick: orb activation path before prefer/lexico. Empty / out-of-limit band ignored.

## Adaptive robustK + latency (+ wave spam)

`robust-k` 0 → auto (`ShadowSimulator::autoRobustK`): Wave/Ship/Swing start at 2; speed >1.1 → ≥2, >1.5 → 3; relative dt EMA >0.08 bumps +1 (cap 3). **Wave + spam-dense** (ClickIntentGuard density, even when orb forces assist): keep ≥2; if speed >1.05 → **3**. Fixed 1–3 overrides auto. `robust-jitter`: after pick, re-run with firstDt×0.97/1.03; fail → mark non-viable and re-pick.

`ModeParams.latencyWeight` still softens Wave spam-dense assists (λ ×0.65). New miss-assist pick uses **outcome / exit prediction** (surviveTicks / endX−λ·delay / horizon replay) instead of fixed mid or latest.

**Starter defaults use Normal (ticks-all/wave = 4)** so ±k-robust has room in spam. Tight (2/2) is still available via Preset. With auto k=2..3, a 2-tick window often cannot fit full ±k neighbors — `pickRobust` falls back to earliest viable. Wide/Max use wave 8/8; Max keeps ticks-all=16 but ticks-wave=8 on purpose.

## LevelProfile JSON

key (LevelContentKey fullKey with content rev), modes[Mode].capMul, modes[Mode].spots[bucket].{bias,trust,n,saved,diedAfterAssist,pessimism,histN,earlyHist[17]}

Earliness histogram bins −8…+8 from Pass/postmortem only (never inject saves). Laplace modal → delay offset when histN≥3; else classic bias±2. Bin decay on autosave.

**Histogram ±1 explore gate** (`AssistLearning::allowHistogramExplore`): while `histN < 8`, a ~20% roll may add ±1 to delay — **blocked** for Wave/Ship/Swing, when `ClickIntentGuard` density would Pass, when a bake-prefer band is active, or when `diedAfterAssist > 0` at that spot. Preferred delay offset (non-random) still applies.

## BakeMap JSON

levelKey, rev, tps (runtime-measured for brute), method, sourceReplay, clicks[{nominalFrame,earliest,latest,down,player2,x,mode}]

Bake runs serial on the main thread via BakeScheduler (no worker pool).

## Reentrancy

While simulating: no sounds/achievements/percentage/particles/trigger side-effects; SimCollisionPolicy filter; orb hold-gate.
Safe Mode ON + (enabled or assistTouchedRun) blocks percentage/newbest/test-complete. Safe Mode OFF never blocks progress.

Owned ghosts (shadow + snapshots) never enter vanilla `destroyPlayer` / `playerDestroyed` (incl. anticheatSpike).
Death to an owned ghost as the killer object is swallowed. Real-player deaths are swallowed while
`m_simulating` (anticheat on real players still passes). During sim, `collisionCheckObjects` runs
only for the shadow. Live collision lists strip owned ghosts. Active shadow is parked off-level
after each sim (wave trail reset + `removeObjectFromSection`); ghost `update` is no-op unless actively stepping.
Before `resetLevel` / checkpoint load: `evacuateGhosts` pulls all owned ghosts out of section vectors (avoids `sortSectionVector` AV) and cancels an in-flight bake.

## Constants

clusterGapX=50, windowMarginK=1, tickBudget=4000, sim-budget-us=1500. HUS replan every 3 ticks / ΔX≥8 / foresight edge / rem≤2; caps `husReplanBudgetUs` / `husReplanTickBudget`. Platformer: assist off.

## Miss-assist contracts (v1.2.1)

Physics unit = **tick** (often ~240/s). UI “frames” at 60fps are **not** the same: 10 display frames ≈ 40 ticks at 240 TPS. Settings `ticks-*` / presets are tick windows.

### Guarantees

| Id | Rule |
|----|------|
| G1 Window-Cap | `delay`, `fireTick`, bake/hold ETA never exceed `activeLimit` (`params.ticks`). Ideal timing past the window does not exist for assist — pick best among `0..limit` only. Example: ideal `d=6`, limit `4`, `d=4` viable → Delay ≤4, never wait for 6. |
| G1 Legacy | Setting `assist-pick` = **Legacy** (default): `d0` viable → Pass; else **latest** ±k-robust viable in window (non-orb). Orb band still earliest activation. |
| G1 Prefer (New) | `assist-pick` = **New**: **Delay-viable = sim survives**. d0 survived → Pass; else **exit prediction** ranks survivor delays by horizon outcome (survive / endX−λ·delay / bake-chain). Always runs `planSequence` exit probe. Live `verifyDelay` before arm; refuse lethal Delay → Pass. |
| G2 | `Pass no-threat` only after foresight + `OpportunityProbe` (mid/limit) agree the corridor is empty. Foresight orb/pad or probe activation/bin/endX gain → full search. |
| G3 | Every Pass/Delay sets `AssistReason`; overlay / `VERDICT` / `PLAN … verdict=` logs it. `pass-unknown` is a bug. |
| Soft Hold-Until-Safe | `PassBudget`, or `budgetHit`/`unknown` with foresight/orb opportunity, or continuous `idleSafer`+`ascentUseful` → arm buffer (`holdUntilSafe`). Cadenced replan (every 3 ticks / ΔX≥8 / foresight edge / rem≤2) with reduced caps — never hang: budget exhaust parks at deadline. Delay confirm updates `fireTick`; opportunity clear + safe → inject now; deadline → fire. Overlay `HUS` + `HOLD~`. |
| No lethal assist | Learning never pulls earlier than the plan; recheck slides ≤+2 later (never earlier); only surviving Delays arm; verify-fail → Pass (vanilla). |
| Continuous ascent | Ship/Wave: idle safer than d0 press + later delay helps → Delay/HUS, not Pass. Cube overhead not in this commit (narrow continuous-only). |
| Bake / Hybrid | Hybrid verify-fail / past-latest / missing → Live (no bake Pass). Replay/Brute stamp `pass-bake-*`. Prefer-band early-exit suppressed under orb foresight (`preferBandEarlyExitAllowed`); final pick Orb before Prefer. |

Executable pure fixtures: `MissAssistContracts::selfCheck` (incl. prefer early-exit), `TravelForesight::selfCheck`, `AssistController::holdUntilSafeSelfCheck` (via PlanGold). Self-checks run on mod load (`PlanGoldCorpus`).

### Pass / Delay reasons (G3)

Stable `AssistVerdict::name` tokens (overlay bit in parentheses). `pass-unknown` must not ship.

| Token | Typical cause |
|-------|----------------|
| `pass-no-threat` | Empty corridor after foresight + OpportunityProbe |
| `pass-wave-proximity` / `pass-wave-futile` | Wave spam / no useful delay (blocked by foresight orb) |
| `pass-d0-safe` | Delay 0 already clears (Legacy preference / New best=0) |
| `pass-hopeless` / `pass-budget` | Nothing viable / tick wall; may arm HUS if foresight/ascent |
| `pass-spam` / `pass-untrust` / `pass-low-trust` | Intent / divergence / trust gates (orb foresight softens) |
| `pass-limit-zero` / `pass-debounce` / `pass-cps` / `pass-scope` / `pass-assist-off` / `pass-early-attempt` | Hard off / debounce / CPS / scope |
| `pass-bake-missing` / `pass-bake-no-window` / `pass-bake-past-latest` / `pass-bake-verify-fail` / `pass-bake-in-window` | Replay/Brute bake paths (Hybrid falls through to Live) |
| `delay-orb` / `delay-threat` / `delay-prefer` / `delay-generic` | Buffered Delay |
| `hold-pending` | Soft Hold-Until-Safe (`HOLD~` / `HUS`) |

### TravelForesight

`TravelForesight` replaces the old fixed `(limit+8)*5.5` ahead-X for orb hints. Ahead distance = clamp(`speedMul * (5.5/(1/240)) * (limit+slack)*simDt + 16`, 60…320). Scans **orbs and jump pads**; skips activated / claimed. `ShadowSimulator::spatialOrbHint` and controller spam overrides use the same cone. `PLAN` / `logPlan` emit `foresight=0|1` from `SimPlan.foresightOrbPad`.

### OpportunityProbe (G2)

Before blind `Pass no-threat`, `OpportunityProbe` forces further search when foresight/orb-window/d0-ring hits, or when a cheap sim at `mid=limit/2` or `limit` shows ring activation, higher surviveBin, or endX gain ≥ 8. Orb coast scan length = `limit+slack+4`; if empty, a budget-capped **press-to-reach** scan holds Jump. Fixtures: `OpportunityProbe::selfCheck`.

### Manual playtest matrix

| Scene | Expect (New) | Expect (Legacy) | Notes |
|-------|--------------|-----------------|-------|
| Cube orb, limit 16, press ~10 ticks early | Delay/HOLD/HUS, fire in orb window, SaveFeedback `+N` | Pass if d0 clears without orb-activation path; Delay if orb window forces wait | Debug: `VERDICT delay-*` / `hold-pending` or `PASS d0-safe` |
| Budget starve mid-search + foresight orb | `HUS` → cadenced replan → Delay or deadline fire | Same soft-hold if PassBudget / budget+foresight | Never silent Pass / never hang; LagProbe `eb.hus.replan` |
| Cube spike jump early, d0 would die | Delay toward later ±k-robust ≤limit | Same (latest ±k-robust) | Not earliest-viable edge |
| Empty corridor, single tap | `PASS no-threat`, vanilla now | Same | |
| Wave zigzag spam, no orb | Pass spam / wave-prox — no Delay | Same | Overlay `PASS spam` / `PASS wave-prox` |
| Wave + orb in travel cone | Delay/Hold — wave-prox/futile blocked by foresight | Same | `foresightOrbPad` overrides wave Pass |
| Ship/Wave: idle lives, press-now dies, later delay clears | Delay/HUS (`idleSafer`+`ascent`) | Same | PLAN log `idleSafer=1 ascent=1` |
| Hybrid: bake verify fails near orb | Live foresight plan (Delay/HUS), hint `verify … → live` | Same | No `pass-bake-verify-fail` |
| Replay: past bake latest | Pass `pass-bake-past-latest` | Same | Bake-only |
| Prefer band early + orb outside band | Keep searching; orb activation pick | Same | No prefer early-exit |
| Single early click, empty ring | Reach plan (not spam Pass) | Same | |
| UNTRUST + orb foresight | Soft: Delay/HUS allowed | Same | Hard UNTRUST Pass only without orb |
| Low-trust spot + orb foresight | Soft: plan allowed | Same | Orb overrides trust Pass |
| Dash orb | `requireHold`, no abort while held | Same | |
| Ideal d=6, limit=4, d=4 survives | Delay ≤4 | Delay ≤4 if d0 unsafe; Pass if d0 safe | Never fire at 6 |
| “10 frames” early @60fps into ticks=16 | Usually Pass (outside window) | Same | Remap frames→ticks before blaming assist |
| MH speedhack ≠1 | Delays in sim ticks via AssistClock | Same | |
| Dual linked | Both must clear | Same | |
| Death / respawn | Buffer clear, assist re-attaches | Same | |

Debug: enable **Debug Logging**; look for `PLAN id=… verdict=… delay=… orbIntent=… foresight=…` and `VERDICT …`. No `ASSIST press +N` means the press never armed a buffer.

`src/config/StageConfig.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "StageConfig.hpp"
#include "../core/AssistClock.hpp"
#include "../core/PlatformLimits.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <Geode/loader/SettingV3.hpp>
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace geode::prelude;

static constexpr char const* PRESET_NAMES[] = { "Tight", "Normal", "Wide", "Max", "Off" };

struct PresetDef {
    bool enabled;
    int ticksAll;
    int ticksWave;
    int slack;
    int cap;
};

constexpr PresetDef PRESETS[] = {
    { true,  2,  2, 2, 0 }, // Tight
    { true,  4,  4, 2, 0 }, // Normal
    { true,  8,  8, 2, 0 }, // Wide
    { true, 16,  8, 2, 0 }, // Max
    { false, 0,  0, 2, 0 }, // Off
};

struct ModeIds {
    char const* enable;
    char const* overwrite;
    char const* ticks;
    char const* cap;
    char const* slack;
    char const* latency;
    char const* name;
};

constexpr ModeIds MODE_IDS[] = {
    { "cube-enable",   "cube-overwrite",   "cube-ticks",   "cube-cap",   "cube-slack",   "cube-latency",   "cube"   },
    { "ship-enable",   "ship-overwrite",   "ship-ticks",   "ship-cap",   "ship-slack",   "ship-latency",   "ship"   },
    { "ball-enable",   "ball-overwrite",   "ball-ticks",   "ball-cap",   "ball-slack",   "ball-latency",   "ball"   },
    { "ufo-enable",    "ufo-overwrite",    "ufo-ticks",    "ufo-cap",    "ufo-slack",    "ufo-latency",    "ufo"    },
    { "wave-enable",   "wave-overwrite",   "wave-ticks",   "wave-cap",   "wave-slack",   "wave-latency",   "wave"   },
    { "robot-enable",  "robot-overwrite",  "robot-ticks",  "robot-cap",  "robot-slack",  "robot-latency",  "robot"  },
    { "spider-enable", "spider-overwrite", "spider-ticks", "spider-cap", "spider-slack", "spider-latency", "spider" },
    { "swing-enable",  "swing-overwrite",  "swing-ticks",  "swing-cap",  "swing-slack",  "swing-latency",  "swing"  },
};

// Wave/Ship/Swing prefer earlier clicks; Cube tolerates delay more.
static float defaultLatencyWeight(int modeIndex) {
    static float const kDefaults[] = {
        0.25f, // Cube
        0.75f, // Ship
        0.35f, // Ball
        0.35f, // Ufo
        1.00f, // Wave
        0.40f, // Robot
        0.40f, // Spider
        0.85f, // Swing
    };
    if (modeIndex < 0 || modeIndex >= StageConfig::MODE_COUNT) return 0.25f;
    return kDefaults[modeIndex];
}

StageInfo g_cachedStage{};
std::array<ModeParams, StageConfig::MODE_COUNT> g_cachedModes{};
bool g_cachedDebug = true;
bool g_cachedPerfTrace = true;
bool g_cachedLagProbe = true;
bool g_cachedSafeMode = false;
bool g_cachedShowOverlay = true;
bool g_cachedShowTrajectory = false;
bool g_cachedShowPauseBake = true;
bool g_cachedShowPauseHub = true;
bool g_cachedAssistPress = true;
bool g_cachedAssistRelease = true;
bool g_cachedAssistOrbs = true;
bool g_cachedSwallow = false;
bool g_cachedAutoTune = false;
bool g_cachedSelfBake = false;
bool g_cachedSelfBakeNormal = false;
bool g_cachedSelfBakeRefine = true;
bool g_cachedTriggerBake = true;
bool g_cachedTriggerBakeSkipDynamic = true;
AssistMode g_cachedAssistMode = AssistMode::Hybrid;
bool g_cachedAssistPickLegacy = false;
int g_cachedSimBudgetUs = 1500;
int g_cachedBakeRadius = 0;
int g_cachedCpsLimit = 0;
int g_cachedMinClickIntervalMs = 0;
int g_cachedSmartDepth = 1;
int g_cachedSmartCombos = 48;
int g_cachedSmartHorizon = 0;
int g_cachedRobustK = 0;
bool g_cachedRobustJitter = false;
std::string g_cachedAssistVerify = "off";
int g_cachedTickBudget = 4000;
bool g_cachedAssistOnlyPractice = false;
bool g_cachedAssistStartposOnly = false;
int g_cachedAssistPercentMin = 0;
int g_cachedAssistPercentMax = 100;
std::vector<StageConfig::PercentRange> g_cachedAssistDisableRanges;
bool g_cachedShowPauseAssist = false;
bool g_cachedSaveFeedbackSound = true;
bool g_cachedSaveFeedbackColor = true;
bool g_cachedSaveFeedbackCounter = false;
StageConfig::ColorRgb g_cachedSaveIconColor{};
int g_cachedSlack = 2;
int g_cachedLookAhead = 0;
bool g_cachedWindowUnitFrames = false;
bool g_cacheInitialized = false;
bool g_applying = false;
std::string g_lastSyncedPreset;

static int clampInt(int v, int lo, int hi) {
    return std::max(lo, std::min(hi, v));
}

static int readInt(Mod* mod, char const* id, int fallback) {
    try {
        return static_cast<int>(mod->getSettingValue<int64_t>(id));
    }
    catch (...) {
        return fallback;
    }
}

static bool readBool(Mod* mod, char const* id, bool fallback) {
    try {
        return mod->getSettingValue<bool>(id);
    }
    catch (...) {
        return fallback;
    }
}

static float clampPct(float v) {
    if (!std::isfinite(v)) return 0.f;
    return std::max(0.f, std::min(100.f, v));
}

static float readFloat(Mod* mod, char const* id, float fallback) {
    try {
        return static_cast<float>(mod->getSettingValue<double>(id));
    }
    catch (...) {
        return fallback;
    }
}

static float round2(float v) {
    return std::round(v * 100.f) / 100.f;
}

static void loadAssistOffSlots(Mod* mod, std::vector<StageConfig::PercentRange>& out) {
    out.clear();
    static char const* fromIds[] = {
        "assist-off-1-from", "assist-off-2-from", "assist-off-3-from",
        "assist-off-4-from", "assist-off-5-from", "assist-off-6-from"
    };
    static char const* toIds[] = {
        "assist-off-1-to", "assist-off-2-to", "assist-off-3-to",
        "assist-off-4-to", "assist-off-5-to", "assist-off-6-to"
    };
    static_assert(sizeof(fromIds) / sizeof(fromIds[0]) == StageConfig::ASSIST_OFF_SLOTS);
    for (int i = 0; i < StageConfig::ASSIST_OFF_SLOTS; ++i) {
        float a = readFloat(mod, fromIds[i], -1.f);
        float b = readFloat(mod, toIds[i], -1.f);
        // -1 = unused slot
        if (a < 0.f || b < 0.f) continue;
        a = round2(clampPct(a));
        b = round2(clampPct(b));
        if (a > b) std::swap(a, b);
        out.push_back({ a, b });
    }
}

char const* StageConfig::presetName(int index) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= STAGE_COUNT) return "Off";
    return PRESET_NAMES[index];
}

int StageConfig::presetIndexByName(std::string const& name) {
    for (int i = 0; i < STAGE_COUNT; ++i) {
        if (name == PRESET_NAMES[i]) return i;
    }
    return 0;
}

void StageConfig::refreshCache() {
    auto* mod = Mod::get();
    g_cachedStage.index = clampInt(static_cast<int>(mod->getSettingValue<int64_t>("stage-index")), 0, STAGE_COUNT - 1);
    g_cachedStage.enabled = mod->getSettingValue<bool>("enabled");
    // Wider max when storing display frames (8 frames ≈ 32 ticks @240 TPS).
    g_cachedStage.ticksAll = clampInt(static_cast<int>(mod->getSettingValue<int64_t>("ticks-all")), 0, 48);
    g_cachedStage.ticksWave = clampInt(static_cast<int>(mod->getSettingValue<int64_t>("ticks-wave")), 0, 48);
    try {
        auto unit = mod->getSettingValue<std::string>("window-unit");
        g_cachedWindowUnitFrames = (unit == "Frames");
    }
    catch (...) {
        g_cachedWindowUnitFrames = false;
    }

    g_cachedDebug = mod->getSettingValue<bool>("debug-logging");
    g_cachedPerfTrace = readBool(mod, "perf-trace", false);
    g_cachedLagProbe = readBool(mod, "lag-probe", true);
    g_cachedSafeMode = mod->getSettingValue<bool>("safe-mode");
    g_cachedShowOverlay = mod->getSettingValue<bool>("show-overlay");
    g_cachedShowTrajectory = readBool(mod, "show-trajectory", false);
    g_cachedShowPauseBake = readBool(mod, "show-pause-bake", true);
    g_cachedShowPauseHub = readBool(mod, "show-pause-hub", true);
    g_cachedAssistPress = readBool(mod, "assist-press", true);
    g_cachedAssistRelease = readBool(mod, "assist-release", true);
    g_cachedAssistOrbs = readBool(mod, "assist-orbs", true);
    g_cachedSwallow = readBool(mod, "swallow-hopeless", false);
    g_cachedAutoTune = readBool(mod, "auto-tune", false);
    g_cachedSelfBake = readBool(mod, "self-bake", false);
    g_cachedSelfBakeNormal = readBool(mod, "self-bake-normal", false);
    g_cachedSelfBakeRefine = readBool(mod, "self-bake-refine", true);
    g_cachedTriggerBake = readBool(mod, "trigger-bake", true);
    g_cachedTriggerBakeSkipDynamic = readBool(mod, "trigger-bake-skip-dynamic", true);
    g_cachedSimBudgetUs = clampInt(readInt(mod, "sim-budget-us", 1500), 0, 10000);
    g_cachedBakeRadius = clampInt(readInt(mod, "bake-radius", 0), 0, 128);
    g_cachedCpsLimit = clampInt(readInt(mod, "cps-limit", 0), 0, 40);
    g_cachedMinClickIntervalMs = clampInt(readInt(mod, "min-click-interval-ms", 0), 0, 500);
    g_cachedSmartDepth = clampInt(readInt(mod, "smart-depth", 1), 1, 3);
    g_cachedSmartCombos = clampInt(readInt(mod, "smart-combos", 48), 8, 256);
    g_cachedSmartHorizon = clampInt(readInt(mod, "smart-horizon", 0), 0, 320);
    g_cachedRobustK = clampInt(readInt(mod, "robust-k", 0), 0, 3);
    g_cachedRobustJitter = readBool(mod, "robust-jitter", false);
    g_cachedTickBudget = clampInt(readInt(mod, "tick-budget", 4000), 500, 20000);
    g_cachedAssistOnlyPractice = readBool(mod, "assist-only-practice", false);
    g_cachedAssistStartposOnly = readBool(mod, "assist-startpos-only", false);
    g_cachedAssistPercentMin = clampInt(readInt(mod, "assist-percent-min", 0), 0, 100);
    g_cachedAssistPercentMax = clampInt(readInt(mod, "assist-percent-max", 100), 0, 100);
    if (g_cachedAssistPercentMin > g_cachedAssistPercentMax) {
        std::swap(g_cachedAssistPercentMin, g_cachedAssistPercentMax);
    }
    loadAssistOffSlots(mod, g_cachedAssistDisableRanges);
    g_cachedShowPauseAssist = readBool(mod, "show-pause-assist", false);
    g_cachedSaveFeedbackSound = readBool(mod, "save-feedback-sound", false);
    g_cachedSaveFeedbackColor = readBool(mod, "save-feedback-color", false);
    g_cachedSaveFeedbackCounter = readBool(mod, "save-feedback-counter", false);
    try {
        auto const c = mod->getSettingValue<cocos2d::ccColor3B>("save-icon-color");
        g_cachedSaveIconColor = { c.r, c.g, c.b };
    }
    catch (...) {
        g_cachedSaveIconColor = {};
    }
    try {
        g_cachedAssistVerify = mod->getSettingValue<std::string>("assist-verify");
        if (g_cachedAssistVerify != "ab") g_cachedAssistVerify = "off";
    }
    catch (...) {
        g_cachedAssistVerify = "off";
    }
    g_cachedSlack = clampInt(readInt(mod, "death-slack", 2), 0, 16);
    g_cachedLookAhead = clampInt(readInt(mod, "look-ahead-cap", 0), 0, 240);
    try {
        auto modeStr = mod->getSettingValue<std::string>("assist-mode");
        if (modeStr == "Live") g_cachedAssistMode = AssistMode::Live;
        else if (modeStr == "Replay") g_cachedAssistMode = AssistMode::Replay;
        else if (modeStr == "BruteForce") g_cachedAssistMode = AssistMode::BruteForce;
        else g_cachedAssistMode = AssistMode::Hybrid;
    }
    catch (...) {
        g_cachedAssistMode = AssistMode::Hybrid;
    }
    try {
        auto pickStr = mod->getSettingValue<std::string>("assist-pick");
        g_cachedAssistPickLegacy = (pickStr == "Legacy");
    }
    catch (...) {
        g_cachedAssistPickLegacy = false;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < MODE_COUNT; ++i) {
        auto const& ids = MODE_IDS[i];
        ModeParams p;
        p.enabled = readBool(mod, ids.enable, true);
        p.overwrite = readBool(mod, ids.overwrite, false);
        int const fallbackTicks = (i == static_cast<int>(GameModeKind::Wave))
            ? g_cachedStage.ticksWave
            : g_cachedStage.ticksAll;
        float const latDefault = defaultLatencyWeight(i);
        if (p.overwrite) {
            p.ticks = clampInt(readInt(mod, ids.ticks, fallbackTicks), 0, 48);
            p.cap = clampInt(readInt(mod, ids.cap, 0), 0, 240);
            int slack = readInt(mod, ids.slack, -1);
            p.slack = slack < 0 ? g_cachedSlack : clampInt(slack, 0, 16);
            float lat = readFloat(mod, ids.latency, latDefault);
            p.latencyWeight = std::max(0.f, std::min(2.f, lat));
        }
        else {
            p.ticks = fallbackTicks;
            p.cap = g_cachedLookAhead;
            p.slack = g_cachedSlack;
            p.latencyWeight = latDefault;
        }
        // Settings store window-unit values; planner always wants physics ticks.
        // Use g_cachedWindowUnitFrames directly (avoid ensureCache recursion).
        if (g_cachedWindowUnitFrames && p.ticks > 0) {
            p.ticks = AssistClock::framesToTicks(p.ticks);
        }
        g_cachedModes[static_cast<size_t>(i)] = p;
    }

    if (g_lastSyncedPreset.empty()) {
        try {
            g_lastSyncedPreset = mod->getSettingValue<std::string>("preset");
        }
        catch (...) {
            g_lastSyncedPreset = PRESET_NAMES[g_cachedStage.index];
        }
    }

    g_cacheInitialized = true;
}

void ensureCache() {
    if (!g_cacheInitialized) StageConfig::refreshCache();
}

void StageConfig::notePresetSynced(std::string const& name) {
    g_lastSyncedPreset = name;
}

std::string StageConfig::lastSyncedPreset() {
    ensureCache();
    return g_lastSyncedPreset;
}

StageInfo StageConfig::preset(int index) {
    index = clampInt(index, 0, STAGE_COUNT - 1);
    auto const& def = PRESETS[index];
    StageInfo info;
    info.index = index;
    info.enabled = def.enabled;
    info.ticksAll = def.ticksAll;
    info.ticksWave = def.ticksWave;
    return info;
}

void StageConfig::applyPreset(int index) {
    index = clampInt(index, 0, STAGE_COUNT - 1);
    auto const info = preset(index);
    auto const& def = PRESETS[index];

    g_applying = true;
    g_cachedStage = info;
    g_cachedSlack = def.slack;
    g_cachedLookAhead = def.cap;
    g_cacheInitialized = true;

    auto* mod = Mod::get();
    mod->setSettingValue<int64_t>("stage-index", info.index);
    mod->setSettingValue<std::string>("preset", std::string(PRESET_NAMES[index]));
    mod->setSettingValue<bool>("enabled", info.enabled);
    // Presets are authored in physics ticks; store in the user's window unit.
    int const storeAll = ticksToWindowValue(info.ticksAll);
    int const storeWave = ticksToWindowValue(info.ticksWave);
    g_cachedStage.ticksAll = storeAll;
    g_cachedStage.ticksWave = storeWave;
    mod->setSettingValue<int64_t>("ticks-all", storeAll);
    mod->setSettingValue<int64_t>("ticks-wave", storeWave);
    mod->setSettingValue<int64_t>("death-slack", def.slack);
    mod->setSettingValue<int64_t>("look-ahead-cap", def.cap);
    g_lastSyncedPreset = PRESET_NAMES[index];
    g_applying = false;
    // Rebuild per-mode ticks with window-unit conversion.
    refreshCache();
    g_lastSyncedPreset = PRESET_NAMES[index];
}

void StageConfig::applyPresetByName(std::string const& name) {
    applyPreset(presetIndexByName(name));
}

StageInfo StageConfig::cycleNext() {
    ensureCache();
    int next = g_cachedStage.index + 1;
    if (next >= STAGE_COUNT) next = 0;
    applyPreset(next);
    return g_cachedStage;
}

bool StageConfig::safeMode() {
    // Critical for progress gates: always re-read so pause toggles apply mid-run.
    if (auto* mod = Mod::get()) {
        try {
            g_cachedSafeMode = mod->getSettingValue<bool>("safe-mode");
            g_cacheInitialized = true;
            return g_cachedSafeMode;
        }
        catch (...) {
        }
    }
    ensureCache();
    return g_cachedSafeMode;
}

bool StageConfig::blocksProgressSaves(bool assistTouchedRun) {
    bool safe = true;
    bool enabled = true;
    if (auto* mod = Mod::get()) {
        try {
            safe = mod->getSettingValue<bool>("safe-mode");
            enabled = mod->getSettingValue<bool>("enabled");
            g_cachedSafeMode = safe;
            g_cachedStage.enabled = enabled;
            g_cacheInitialized = true;
        }
        catch (...) {
            ensureCache();
            safe = g_cachedSafeMode;
            enabled = g_cachedStage.enabled;
        }
    }
    else {
        ensureCache();
        safe = g_cachedSafeMode;
        enabled = g_cachedStage.enabled;
    }

    // Safe Mode OFF → never block percentage / bests / normal complete.
    if (!safe) {
        return false;
    }
    return enabled || assistTouchedRun;
}

GameModeKind StageConfig::kindOf(PlayerObject* player) {
    if (!player) return GameModeKind::Cube;
    if (player->m_isDart) return GameModeKind::Wave;
    if (player->m_isShip) return GameModeKind::Ship;
    if (player->m_isBall) return GameModeKind::Ball;
    if (player->m_isBird) return GameModeKind::Ufo;
    if (player->m_isRobot) return GameModeKind::Robot;
    if (player->m_isSpider) return GameModeKind::Spider;
    if (player->m_isSwing) return GameModeKind::Swing;
    return GameModeKind::Cube;
}

char const* StageConfig::kindName(GameModeKind kind) {
    int const i = static_cast<int>(kind);
    if (i < 0 || i >= MODE_COUNT) return "cube";
    return MODE_IDS[i].name;
}

ModeParams StageConfig::paramsFor(GameModeKind kind) {
    ensureCache();
    int const i = static_cast<int>(kind);
    if (i < 0 || i >= MODE_COUNT) return g_cachedModes[0];
    return g_cachedModes[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
}

ModeParams StageConfig::paramsFor(PlayerObject* player) {
    return paramsFor(kindOf(player));
}

std::string StageConfig::stageLabel(StageInfo const& info) {
    if (!info.enabled || info.index >= STAGE_COUNT - 1) return "OFF";
    return fmt::format("{} ({}A/{}W)", presetName(info.index), info.ticksAll, info.ticksWave);
}


```

`src/config/StageConfig.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_CONFIG_STAGECONFIG_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_CONFIG_STAGECONFIG_HPP

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

class PlayerObject;

struct StageInfo {
    int index = 0;       // 0..4 (4 = OFF)
    bool enabled = true;
    int ticksAll = 2;
    int ticksWave = 2;
};

struct ModeParams {
    bool enabled = true;
    bool overwrite = false;
    int ticks = 2;
    int cap = 0;     // 0 = auto
    int slack = 2;
    // betterCand: score = endX − latencyWeight · delay (Wave high, Cube low).
    float latencyWeight = 0.25f;
};

class StageConfig {
public:
    enum class GameModeKind {
        Cube = 0,
        Ship,
        Ball,
        Ufo,
        Wave,
        Robot,
        Spider,
        Swing,
        Count
    };

    enum class AssistMode {
        Live = 0,
        Replay,
        Hybrid,
        BruteForce
    };

    static constexpr int STAGE_COUNT = 5;
    static constexpr int MODE_COUNT = static_cast<int>(GameModeKind::Count);

    static char const* presetName(int index);
    static int presetIndexByName(std::string const& name);

    static void refreshCache();

    static StageInfo fromSettings();
    static StageInfo preset(int index);
    // Fills default ticks / slack / look-ahead. Does NOT touch per-mode overwrites.
    // Only call from F6 cycle or an explicit Preset dropdown change — never on load.
    static void applyPreset(int index);
