`src/core/BakeMap.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "BakeMap.hpp"
#include "AssistController.hpp"
#include "ShadowSimulator.hpp"
#include "LevelProfile.hpp"
#include "../debug/AssistLog.hpp"

#include <Geode/utils/file.hpp>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>

using namespace geode::prelude;



std::filesystem::path bakesDir() {
    return Mod::get()->getSaveDir() / "bakes";
}

std::filesystem::path bakePath(std::string const& key) {
    return bakesDir() / (key + ".json");
}

int nextJumpFrame(std::vector<ReplayEvent> const& ev, int fromIndex, bool player2) {
    for (int i = fromIndex + 1; i < static_cast<int>(ev.size()); ++i) {
        if (ev[i].button != 1) continue;
        if (ev[i].player2 != player2) continue;
        if (ev[i].down) return ev[i].frame;
    }
    return -1;
}

struct JumpJob {
    int eventIndex = 0;
    int frame = 0;
    bool down = true;
    bool player2 = false;
    int until = 0;
};

int resolveRadius(int bakeRadius, BakeMethod method) {
    if (bakeRadius > 0) return bakeRadius;
    int base = StageConfig::ticksAll();
    if (method == BakeMethod::BruteForce) {
        return std::max(32, base * 4);
    }
    return std::max(8, base);
}

unsigned workerCount() {
    // Main-thread only: Cocos/PlayLayer are not thread-safe.
    return 1u;
}


BakeMap& BakeMap::get() {
    static BakeMap inst;
    return inst;
}

void BakeMap::clear() {
    m_data = {};
    m_loaded = false;
    this->m_dirty = false;
}

void BakeMap::clearPendingReplay() {
    m_replay = {};
    m_hasReplay = false;
}

void BakeMap::setPendingReplay(ImportedReplay replay) {
    m_replay = std::move(replay);
    m_hasReplay = true;
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format(
        "BAKE: loaded replay {} ({} events, {:.0f} tps, {})",
        m_replay.sourceName, m_replay.events.size(), m_replay.tps, m_replay.format
    ));
}

void BakeMap::loadForLevel(GJGameLevel* level) {
    m_data = {};
    m_loaded = false;
    this->m_dirty = false;
    if (!level) return;
    m_data.levelKey = LevelProfile::makeKey(level);
    m_loaded = true;
    auto res = readFile();
    if (res.isOk()) {
        AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
            "BAKE: loaded map {} ({} clicks, {}, {})",
            m_data.levelKey, m_data.clicks.size(), m_data.sourceReplay, m_data.method
        ));
    }
}

void BakeMap::save() const {
    if (!m_loaded || m_data.levelKey.empty()) return;
    if (!this->m_dirty) return;
    auto res = writeFile();
    if (res.isOk()) {
        this->m_dirty = false;
        AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
            "BAKE: saved {} ({} clicks, {})",
            m_data.levelKey, m_data.clicks.size(), m_data.method
        ));
    }
    else {
        AssistLog::debug(fmt::format("BAKE: save failed: {}", res.unwrapErr()));
    }
}

std::string BakeMap::statusLine() const {
    if (m_progress.running.load()) {
        return fmt::format(
            "baking {}/{} ({:.0f}%)",
            m_progress.done.load(),
            m_progress.total.load(),
            m_progress.fraction() * 100.f
        );
    }
    if (m_hasReplay && !m_data.clicks.empty()) {
        return fmt::format(
            "{} | {} {} clicks",
            m_replay.sourceName, m_data.method, m_data.clicks.size()
        );
    }
    if (m_hasReplay) return fmt::format("{} | no bake", m_replay.sourceName);
    if (!m_data.clicks.empty()) {
        return fmt::format(
            "{} {} clicks ({})",
            m_data.method, m_data.clicks.size(), m_data.sourceReplay
        );
    }
    return "no bake";
}

std::string BakeMap::pauseStatusLine() const {
    std::string line = statusLine();
    if (m_hasReplay) {
        line = fmt::format(
            "Replay: {} ({} ev @ {:.0f} tps)\n{}",
            m_replay.sourceName, m_replay.events.size(), m_replay.tps, line
        );
    }
    else {
        line = fmt::format(
            "Replay: (none) — Brute Bake needs none\n{}",
            line
        );
    }
    return line;
}

int BakeMap::refineSelfWindows(
    PlayLayer* layer,
    int startSnapshotSlot,
    std::vector<BakedClick>& clicks,
    int bakeRadius,
    int budgetSims,
    std::atomic<bool>* cancel
) {
    if (!layer || startSnapshotSlot < 0 || clicks.empty() || budgetSims <= 0) return 0;
    if (isBaking()) return 0;

    bakeRadius = resolveRadius(bakeRadius, BakeMethod::Replay);
    double tps = m_data.tps > 0.0 ? m_data.tps : 240.0;
    float dt = static_cast<float>(1.0 / tps);
    int const horizon = ShadowSimulator::modelFor(
        layer->m_player1 ? layer->m_player1 : layer->m_player2,
        StageConfig::ticksAll()
    ).cap;

    std::stable_sort(clicks.begin(), clicks.end(), [](auto const& a, auto const& b) {
        if (a.nominalFrame != b.nominalFrame) return a.nominalFrame < b.nominalFrame;
        return a.player2 < b.player2;
    });

    std::vector<ReplayEvent> timeline;
    timeline.reserve(clicks.size());
    for (auto const& c : clicks) {
        timeline.push_back(ReplayEvent{ c.nominalFrame, 1, c.player2, c.down });
    }

    int simsLeft = budgetSims;
    int expanded = 0;
    auto cancelled = [&]() -> bool {
        return cancel && cancel->load();
    };
    auto spend = [&]() -> bool {
        if (simsLeft <= 0) return true;
        --simsLeft;
        return false;
    };

    for (size_t i = 0; i < clicks.size(); ++i) {
        if (cancelled() || simsLeft <= 0) break;

        auto& click = clicks[i];
        int const F = click.nominalFrame;
        int next = -1;
        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < clicks.size(); ++j) {
            if (clicks[j].player2 != click.player2) continue;
            next = clicks[j].nominalFrame;
            break;
        }
        int until = next > 0 ? std::min(next, F + horizon) : F + horizon;
        until = std::max(until, F + 1);

        // Keep timeline event frames in sync with current click nominals.
        timeline[i].frame = F;

        std::lock_guard lock(m_simMutex);
        if (spend()) break;
        if (!testShiftedClick(layer, startSnapshotSlot, timeline, static_cast<int>(i), F, until, dt)) {
            // Nominal dies from start snapshot — keep point window.
            continue;
        }

        int lo = std::max(0, F - bakeRadius);
        int hi = F;
        while (lo < hi) {
            if (cancelled() || simsLeft <= 0) break;
            int mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
            if (spend()) break;
            if (testShiftedClick(layer, startSnapshotSlot, timeline, static_cast<int>(i), mid, until, dt)) {
                hi = mid;
            }
            else {
                lo = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        int earliest = lo;

        lo = F;
        hi = F + bakeRadius;
        while (lo < hi) {
            if (cancelled() || simsLeft <= 0) break;
            int mid = lo + (hi - lo + 1) / 2;
            if (spend()) break;
            if (testShiftedClick(layer, startSnapshotSlot, timeline, static_cast<int>(i), mid, until, dt)) {
                lo = mid;
            }
            else {
                hi = mid - 1;
            }
        }
        int latest = lo;

        if (earliest > latest) std::swap(earliest, latest);
        if (earliest < click.earliest || latest > click.latest
            || earliest != click.nominalFrame || latest != click.nominalFrame) {
            if (earliest != click.earliest || latest != click.latest) ++expanded;
            click.earliest = std::min(click.earliest, earliest);
            click.latest = std::max(click.latest, latest);
        }
    }

    AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
        "self-bake refine: {}/{} expanded, sims left {}",
        expanded, clicks.size(), simsLeft
    ));
    return expanded;
}

std::vector<BakedClick const*> BakeMap::nextClicksAfter(
    float playerX, bool down, bool player2,
    std::optional<GameModeKind> preferMode,
    int maxCount
) const {
    std::vector<BakedClick const*> out;
    if (maxCount <= 0 || !m_loaded) return out;

    auto collect = [&](bool requireMode) {
        std::vector<BakedClick const*> hits;
        for (auto const& c : m_data.clicks) {
            if (c.down != down || c.player2 != player2) continue;
            if (c.x <= playerX + 1.f) continue;
            if (requireMode && preferMode && c.mode != *preferMode) continue;
            hits.push_back(&c);
        }
        std::sort(hits.begin(), hits.end(), [](auto const* a, auto const* b) {
            if (a->x != b->x) return a->x < b->x;
            return a->nominalFrame < b->nominalFrame;
        });
        return hits;
    };

    auto hits = preferMode ? collect(true) : collect(false);
    if (hits.empty() && preferMode) hits = collect(false);
    for (auto const* c : hits) {
        out.push_back(c);
        if (static_cast<int>(out.size()) >= maxCount) break;
    }
    return out;
}

int BakeMap::mergeSelfClicks(std::vector<BakedClick> const& incoming) {
    if (incoming.empty() || !m_loaded) return 0;
    if (isBaking()) return 0;

    bool const wasEmpty = m_data.clicks.empty();
    int touched = 0;

    for (auto const& neu : incoming) {
        BakedClick* match = nullptr;
        for (auto& old : m_data.clicks) {
            if (old.down != neu.down || old.player2 != neu.player2) continue;
            if (std::fabs(old.x - neu.x) > MERGE_X_TOL) continue;
            if (std::abs(old.nominalFrame - neu.nominalFrame) > MERGE_FRAME_TOL) continue;
            match = &old;
            break;
        }
        if (match) {
            int const prevE = match->earliest;
            int const prevL = match->latest;
            match->earliest = std::min(match->earliest, neu.earliest);
            match->latest = std::max(match->latest, neu.latest);
            if (match->earliest != prevE || match->latest != prevL) ++touched;
            continue;
        }
        if (m_data.clicks.size() >= kMaxMapClicks) continue;
        m_data.clicks.push_back(neu);
        ++touched;
    }

    if (touched <= 0) return 0;

    if (wasEmpty || m_data.method == "self" || m_data.method.empty()) {
        m_data.method = "self";
        if (m_data.sourceReplay.empty()) m_data.sourceReplay = "self-bake";
    }
    // Do not sync-write here — death/reset flushSegment hit this on the main
    // thread and stalled restarts. Persist on quit / level complete / explicit save.
    this->m_dirty = true;
    return touched;
}

BakedClick const* BakeMap::findNear(
    float playerX, int approxFrame, bool down, bool player2,
    std::optional<GameModeKind> preferMode
) const {
    auto pick = [&](bool requireMode) -> BakedClick const* {
        BakedClick const* best = nullptr;
        float bestDx = LOOKUP_X_TOL + 1.f;
        for (auto const& c : m_data.clicks) {
            if (c.down != down || c.player2 != player2) continue;
            if (requireMode && preferMode && c.mode != *preferMode) continue;
            float dx = std::fabs(c.x - playerX);
            if (dx > LOOKUP_X_TOL) continue;
            if (approxFrame >= 0 && c.nominalFrame + 240 < approxFrame) continue;
            if (dx < bestDx) {
                bestDx = dx;
                best = &c;
            }
        }
        return best;
    };

    if (preferMode) {
        if (auto const* hit = pick(true)) return hit;
    }
    return pick(false);
}

bool BakeMap::testShiftedClick(
    PlayLayer* layer,
    int startSnapshotSlot,
    std::vector<ReplayEvent> timeline,
    int eventIndex,
    int testFrame,
    int untilFrame,
    float dt
) const {
    if (eventIndex < 0 || eventIndex >= static_cast<int>(timeline.size())) return false;
    timeline[static_cast<size_t>(eventIndex)].frame = testFrame;
    std::stable_sort(timeline.begin(), timeline.end(), [](auto const& a, auto const& b) {
        return a.frame < b.frame;
    });
    auto r = ShadowSimulator::get().runBakeTimeline(
        layer, startSnapshotSlot, timeline, dt, untilFrame, -1
    );
    return !r.died;
}

Result<int> BakeMap::bake(
    PlayLayer* layer, int startSnapshotSlot, int bakeRadius, BakeMethod method
) {
    if (m_progress.running.exchange(true)) {
        return Err("Bake already running");
    }
    m_progress.cancel = false;
    m_progress.done = 0;
    m_progress.total = 0;
    m_progress.setStatus("starting…");

    auto finish = [&](Result<int> r) -> Result<int> {
        m_progress.running = false;
        m_progress.setStatus(r.isOk()
            ? fmt::format("done: {} clicks", r.unwrap())
            : fmt::format("failed: {}", r.unwrapErr()));
        return r;
    };

    if (method == BakeMethod::BruteForce) {
        return finish(bakeBrute(layer, startSnapshotSlot, bakeRadius));
    }
    return finish(bakeReplay(layer, startSnapshotSlot, bakeRadius));
}

Result<int> BakeMap::bakeReplay(
    PlayLayer* layer, int startSnapshotSlot, int bakeRadius
) {
    if (!layer) return Err("No PlayLayer");
    if (!m_hasReplay || m_replay.events.empty()) return Err("No replay loaded");
    if (startSnapshotSlot < 0) return Err("No start snapshot (reset once, then bake)");

    bakeRadius = resolveRadius(bakeRadius, BakeMethod::Replay);
    double tps = m_replay.tps > 0.0 ? m_replay.tps : 240.0;
    float dt = static_cast<float>(1.0 / tps);

    BakeMapData out;
    out.levelKey = m_data.levelKey.empty() && layer->m_level
        ? LevelProfile::makeKey(layer->m_level)
        : m_data.levelKey;
    if (out.levelKey.empty()) out.levelKey = "unknown";
    out.sourceReplay = m_replay.sourceName;
    out.tps = tps;
    out.method = "replay";

    auto const& ev = m_replay.events;
    bool const doRelease = StageConfig::assistRelease();

    std::vector<JumpJob> jobs;
    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(ev.size()); ++i) {
        auto const& e = ev[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
        if (e.button != 1) continue;
        if (!e.down && !doRelease) continue;
        int F = e.frame;
        int next = nextJumpFrame(ev, i, e.player2);
        int horizon = ShadowSimulator::modelFor(layer->m_player1, StageConfig::ticksAll()).cap;
        int until = next > 0 ? std::min(next, F + horizon) : F + horizon;
        until = std::max(until, F + 1);
        jobs.push_back(JumpJob{ i, F, e.down, e.player2, until });
    }

    m_progress.total = static_cast<int>(jobs.size());
    m_progress.setStatus(fmt::format("replay bake · {} clicks · radius {}", jobs.size(), bakeRadius));
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format(
        "BAKE replay: {} jobs, radius {}, 1 thread (binary search)",
        jobs.size(), bakeRadius
    ));

    for (auto const& job : jobs) {
        if (m_progress.cancel.load()) return Err("Bake cancelled");

        std::lock_guard lock(m_simMutex);
        auto sample = ShadowSimulator::get().runBakeTimeline(
            layer, startSnapshotSlot, ev, dt, job.frame, job.frame
        );
        float x = sample.sampled ? sample.xAtSample : 0.f;
        auto mode = sample.sampled ? sample.modeAtSample : GameModeKind::Cube;

        if (!testShiftedClick(layer, startSnapshotSlot, ev, job.eventIndex, job.frame, job.until, dt)) {
            AssistLog::debug(fmt::format("BAKE: skip click @{} (nominal dies)", job.frame));
            m_progress.done.fetch_add(1);
            continue;
        }

        int lo = std::max(0, job.frame - bakeRadius);
        int hi = job.frame;
        while (lo < hi) {
            int mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
            if (testShiftedClick(layer, startSnapshotSlot, ev, job.eventIndex, mid, job.until, dt)) {
                hi = mid;
            }
            else {
                lo = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        int earliest = lo;

        lo = job.frame;
        hi = job.frame + bakeRadius;
        while (lo < hi) {
            int mid = lo + (hi - lo + 1) / 2;
            if (testShiftedClick(layer, startSnapshotSlot, ev, job.eventIndex, mid, job.until, dt)) {
                lo = mid;
            }
            else {
                hi = mid - 1;
            }
        }
        int latest = lo;

        BakedClick c;
        c.nominalFrame = job.frame;
        c.earliest = earliest;
        c.latest = latest;
        c.down = job.down;
        c.player2 = job.player2;
        c.x = x;
        c.mode = mode;
        out.clicks.push_back(c);

        m_progress.done.fetch_add(1);
        m_progress.setStatus(fmt::format(
            "replay {}/{} · @{} → [{},{}]",
            m_progress.done.load(), m_progress.total.load(),
            job.frame, earliest, latest
        ));
    }

    m_data = std::move(out);
    m_loaded = true;
    this->m_dirty = true;
    save();
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format(
        "BAKE: {} clicks from {} @ {:.0f} tps (replay)",
        m_data.clicks.size(), m_data.sourceReplay, m_data.tps
    ));
    return Ok(static_cast<int>(m_data.clicks.size()));
}

Result<int> BakeMap::bakeBrute(
    PlayLayer* layer, int startSnapshotSlot, int bakeRadius
) {
    // Pure brute: no replay. Drive forward from start; at each death, exhaustively
    // try press/release timings in [death-radius, death] and keep windows that
    // don't die (progress further). Parallel job queue; GD physics mutexed.
    if (!layer) return Err("No PlayLayer");
    if (startSnapshotSlot < 0) return Err("No start snapshot (reset once, then Brute Bake)");
    if (!layer->m_player1) return Err("No player");

    bakeRadius = resolveRadius(bakeRadius, BakeMethod::BruteForce);
    // Same physics quantum as live plan (AssistClock / estimatedTps = 1/simDt).
    double tps = AssistController::get().estimatedTps();
    if (tps < 60.0 || tps > 480.0) tps = 240.0;
    float const dt = static_cast<float>(1.0 / tps);
    int const maxFrames = static_cast<int>(tps * 180.0); // 3 min physics cap
    int const maxClicks = 400;
    int const horizon = ShadowSimulator::modelFor(
        layer->m_player1, StageConfig::ticksAll()
    ).cap;
    bool const doRelease = StageConfig::assistRelease();
    auto const model = ShadowSimulator::modelFor(layer->m_player1, StageConfig::ticksAll());

    BakeMapData out;
    out.levelKey = m_data.levelKey.empty() && layer->m_level
        ? LevelProfile::makeKey(layer->m_level)
        : m_data.levelKey;
    if (out.levelKey.empty()) out.levelKey = "unknown";
    out.sourceReplay = "(brute)";
    out.tps = tps;
    out.method = "brute";

    m_progress.total = maxClicks;
    m_progress.done = 0;
    m_progress.setStatus(fmt::format(
        "brute (no replay) · radius {} · serial @ {:.0f} tps", bakeRadius, tps
    ));
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format(
        "BAKE brute: death-driven search, radius {}, horizon {}, serial main-thread @ {:.0f} tps",
        bakeRadius, horizon, tps
    ));

    auto holdingAtEnd = [](std::vector<ReplayEvent> const& tl) {
        bool held = false;
        for (auto const& e : tl) {
            if (e.button == 1) held = e.down;
        }
        return held;
    };

    auto runUntil = [&](std::vector<ReplayEvent> const& tl, int until, int sampleFrame)
        -> ShadowSimulator::BakeRunResult {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_simMutex);
        return ShadowSimulator::get().runBakeTimeline(
            layer, startSnapshotSlot, tl, dt, until, sampleFrame
        );
    };

    struct Trial {
        int actionFrame = 0;
        bool down = true;
        int releaseFrame = -1; // optional follow-up release
        int surviveUntil = -1; // death frame, or until if survived
        bool survived = false;
        float x = 0.f;
        GameModeKind mode = GameModeKind::Cube;
    };

    std::vector<ReplayEvent> committed;
    int lastDeath = -1;
    int stuck = 0;

    for (int step = 0; step < maxClicks; ++step) {
        if (m_progress.cancel.load()) return Err("Bake cancelled");

        auto baseline = runUntil(committed, maxFrames, -1);
        if (!baseline.died) {
            m_progress.setStatus(fmt::format(
                "brute done — survived {}f with {} clicks",
                maxFrames, out.clicks.size()
            ));
            AssistLog::info(fmt::format(
                "BAKE brute: cleared horizon ({} frames) with {} clicks",
                maxFrames, out.clicks.size()
            ));
            break;
        }

        int const D = baseline.deathFrame;
        if (D < 0) break;
        if (D == lastDeath) {
            if (++stuck >= 2) {
                AssistLog::info(fmt::format(
                    "BAKE brute: stuck at death frame {} — stopping ({} clicks so far)",
                    D, out.clicks.size()
                ));
                break;
            }
        }
        else {
            stuck = 0;
            lastDeath = D;
        }

        bool const held = holdingAtEnd(committed);
        int const lo = std::max(0, D - bakeRadius);
        int const hi = D;
        int const untilProbe = std::min(maxFrames, D + std::max(horizon, 16));

        // Build candidate action list: (frame, down, optional release)
        struct ActionSpec {
            int frame;
            bool down;
            int releaseFrame;
        };
        std::vector<ActionSpec> specs;
        specs.reserve(static_cast<size_t>((hi - lo + 1) * 4));

        for (int t = lo; t <= hi; ++t) {
            if (!held) {
                // Press (hold)
                specs.push_back({ t, true, -1 });
                // Tap variants for cube-like modes
                if (model.tapRelease || !model.continuous) {
                    for (int rel : { 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 }) {
                        specs.push_back({ t, true, t + rel });
                    }
                }
            }
            if (held || doRelease) {
                // Release if currently holding (or always probe release for assist-release)
                if (held) {
                    specs.push_back({ t, false, -1 });
                }
            }
        }

        if (specs.empty()) {
            AssistLog::info(fmt::format("BAKE brute: no actions to try at death {}", D));
            break;
        }

        m_progress.setStatus(fmt::format(
            "brute death @{} · probing {} combos · clicks {}",
            D, specs.size(), out.clicks.size()
        ));

        std::vector<Trial> trials(specs.size());

        auto processSpec = [&](size_t idx) {
            if (m_progress.cancel.load()) return;
            auto const& sp = specs[idx];
            auto tl = committed;
            tl.push_back(ReplayEvent{ sp.frame, 1, false, sp.down });
            if (sp.releaseFrame >= 0) {
                tl.push_back(ReplayEvent{ sp.releaseFrame, 1, false, false });
            }
            std::stable_sort(tl.begin(), tl.end(), [](auto const& a, auto const& b) {
                return a.frame < b.frame;
            });

            Trial tr;
            tr.actionFrame = sp.frame;
            tr.down = sp.down;
            tr.releaseFrame = sp.releaseFrame;

            {
                std::lock_guard lock(m_simMutex);
                if (m_progress.cancel.load()) return;
                auto sample = ShadowSimulator::get().runBakeTimeline(
                    layer, startSnapshotSlot, tl, dt, sp.frame, sp.frame
                );
                tr.x = sample.sampled ? sample.xAtSample : 0.f;
                tr.mode = sample.sampled ? sample.modeAtSample : GameModeKind::Cube;

                auto r = ShadowSimulator::get().runBakeTimeline(
                    layer, startSnapshotSlot, tl, dt, untilProbe, -1
                );
                if (r.died) {
                    tr.surviveUntil = r.deathFrame;
                    tr.survived = r.deathFrame > D;
                }
                else {
                    tr.surviveUntil = untilProbe;
                    tr.survived = true;
                }
            }
            trials[idx] = tr;
            m_progress.done.fetch_add(1);
        };

        // Inflate total roughly so the % bar moves during probes
        m_progress.total = std::max(
            m_progress.total.load(),
            m_progress.done.load() + static_cast<int>(specs.size()) + (maxClicks - step)
        );

        // Serial main-thread only (Cocos/PlayLayer are not thread-safe).
        for (size_t idx = 0; idx < specs.size(); ++idx) {
            if (m_progress.cancel.load()) return Err("Bake cancelled");
            processSpec(idx);
        }
        if (m_progress.cancel.load()) return Err("Bake cancelled");

        // Best survival past current death
        int bestUntil = D;
        for (auto const& tr : trials) {
            if (tr.surviveUntil > bestUntil) bestUntil = tr.surviveUntil;
        }
        if (bestUntil <= D) {
            AssistLog::info(fmt::format(
                "BAKE brute: no combo survives past death {} — stopping", D
            ));
            break;
        }

        // Prefer press-downs that reach bestUntil (within 2 frames slack)
        int const slack = 2;
        std::vector<Trial const*> winners;
        for (auto const& tr : trials) {
            if (tr.surviveUntil + slack >= bestUntil && tr.surviveUntil > D) {
                winners.push_back(&tr);
            }
        }
        if (winners.empty()) break;

        // Split by down vs release — prefer whichever group has more / better
        Trial const* pick = winners.front();
        int earliest = pick->actionFrame;
        int latest = pick->actionFrame;
        bool pickDown = pick->down;
        int pickRel = pick->releaseFrame;

        // Prefer down actions if any winner is a down
        bool anyDown = false;
        for (auto* w : winners) {
            if (w->down) { anyDown = true; break; }
        }
        earliest = std::numeric_limits<int>::max();
        latest = -1;
        for (auto* w : winners) {
            if (anyDown && !w->down) continue;
            if (w->actionFrame < earliest) {
                earliest = w->actionFrame;
                pick = w;
                pickDown = w->down;
                pickRel = w->releaseFrame;
            }
            if (w->actionFrame > latest) latest = w->actionFrame;
        }
        if (latest < earliest) break;

        int const nominal = pick->actionFrame;
        float const x = pick->x;
        auto const mode = pick->mode;

        BakedClick c;
        c.nominalFrame = nominal;
        c.earliest = earliest;
        c.latest = latest;
        c.down = pickDown;
        c.player2 = false;
        c.x = x;
        c.mode = mode;
        out.clicks.push_back(c);

        // Also bake release window if we committed a tap-release
        if (pickRel >= 0 && doRelease) {
            BakedClick rel;
            rel.nominalFrame = pickRel;
            rel.earliest = pickRel;
            rel.latest = pickRel;
            rel.down = false;
            rel.player2 = false;
            rel.x = x;
            rel.mode = mode;
            out.clicks.push_back(rel);
        }

        committed.push_back(ReplayEvent{ nominal, 1, false, pickDown });
        if (pickRel >= 0) {
            committed.push_back(ReplayEvent{ pickRel, 1, false, false });
        }
        std::stable_sort(committed.begin(), committed.end(), [](auto const& a, auto const& b) {
            return a.frame < b.frame;
        });

        AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
            "BAKE brute: {} @{} window [{},{}] survives→{} (was death {})",
            pickDown ? "press" : "release", nominal, earliest, latest, bestUntil, D
        ));
        m_progress.setStatus(fmt::format(
            "brute click #{} · {} @{} [{},{}] · next death hunt",
            out.clicks.size(), pickDown ? "press" : "release",
            nominal, earliest, latest
        ));
    }

    if (out.clicks.empty()) {
        return Err("Brute found no safe clicks (died immediately / unsolvable from start)");
    }

    m_data = std::move(out);
    m_loaded = true;
    this->m_dirty = true;
    save();
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format(
        "BAKE: {} clicks (brute, no replay) @ {:.0f} tps (serial)",
        m_data.clicks.size(), m_data.tps
    ));
    return Ok(static_cast<int>(m_data.clicks.size()));
}

Result<> BakeMap::writeFile() const {
    (void)file::createDirectoryAll(bakesDir());
    matjson::Value root = matjson::Value::object();
    root["version"] = 1;
    root["key"] = m_data.levelKey;
    root["source"] = m_data.sourceReplay;
    root["tps"] = m_data.tps;
    root["method"] = m_data.method;

    std::vector<matjson::Value> arr;
    arr.reserve(m_data.clicks.size());
    for (auto const& c : m_data.clicks) {
        matjson::Value j = matjson::Value::object();
        j["nominal"] = c.nominalFrame;
        j["earliest"] = c.earliest;
        j["latest"] = c.latest;
        j["down"] = c.down;
        j["player2"] = c.player2;
        j["x"] = c.x;
        j["mode"] = StageConfig::kindName(c.mode);
        arr.push_back(std::move(j));
    }
    root["clicks"] = arr;
    return file::writeToJson(bakePath(m_data.levelKey), root);
}

Result<> BakeMap::readFile() {
    auto res = file::readJson(bakePath(m_data.levelKey));
    if (res.isErr()) return Err(res.unwrapErr());
    auto root = res.unwrap();

    if (root.contains("source")) m_data.sourceReplay = root["source"].asString().unwrapOr("");
    if (root.contains("tps")) m_data.tps = root["tps"].asDouble().unwrapOr(240.0);
    if (root.contains("method")) m_data.method = root["method"].asString().unwrapOr("replay");
    m_data.clicks.clear();
    if (!root.contains("clicks") || !root["clicks"].isArray()) return Ok();

    for (auto const& j : root["clicks"]) {
        BakedClick c;
        c.nominalFrame = static_cast<int>(j["nominal"].asInt().unwrapOr(0));
        c.earliest = static_cast<int>(j["earliest"].asInt().unwrapOr(c.nominalFrame));
        c.latest = static_cast<int>(j["latest"].asInt().unwrapOr(c.nominalFrame));
        c.down = j["down"].asBool().unwrapOr(true);
        c.player2 = j["player2"].asBool().unwrapOr(false);
        c.x = static_cast<float>(j["x"].asDouble().unwrapOr(0.0));
        auto modeName = j.contains("mode") ? j["mode"].asString().unwrapOr("cube") : "cube";
        c.mode = GameModeKind::Cube;
        for (int i = 0; i < StageConfig::MODE_COUNT; ++i) {
            if (modeName == StageConfig::kindName(static_cast<GameModeKind>(i))) {
                c.mode = static_cast<GameModeKind>(i);
                break;
            }
        }
        m_data.clicks.push_back(c);
    }
    return Ok();
}
```

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_CORE_BAKEMAP_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_CORE_BAKEMAP_HPP

#include "ReplayImport.hpp"
#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <atomic>
#include <functional>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>


struct BakedClick {
    int nominalFrame = 0;
    int earliest = 0;
    int latest = 0;
    bool down = true;
    bool player2 = false;
    float x = 0.f;
    GameModeKind mode = GameModeKind::Cube;
};

struct BakeMapData {
    std::string levelKey;
    std::string sourceReplay;
    double tps = 240.0;
    std::string method = "replay"; // "replay" | "brute" | "self"
    std::vector<BakedClick> clicks;
};

struct BakeProgress {
    std::atomic<int> done{0};
    std::atomic<int> total{0};
    std::atomic<bool> running{false};
    std::atomic<bool> cancel{false};

    std::mutex statusMutex;
    std::string status;

    void setStatus(std::string s) {
        std::lock_guard lock(statusMutex);
        status = std::move(s);
    }
    std::string getStatus() {
        std::lock_guard lock(statusMutex);
        return status;
    }
    float fraction() const {
        int t = total.load();
        if (t <= 0) return 0.f;
        return static_cast<float>(done.load()) / static_cast<float>(t);
    }
};

enum class BakeMethod {
    Replay,     // binary-search windows around imported replay clicks
    BruteForce  // no replay: death-driven exhaustive click search
};

class BakeMap {
public:
    static constexpr float LOOKUP_X_TOL = 120.f;

    static BakeMap& get();

    void clear();
    void loadForLevel(GJGameLevel* level);
    void save() const;

    bool loaded() const { return m_loaded; }
    BakeMapData const& data() const { return m_data; }
    ImportedReplay const* pendingReplay() const {
        return m_hasReplay ? &m_replay : nullptr;
    }

    void setPendingReplay(ImportedReplay replay);
    void clearPendingReplay();

    BakeProgress& progress() { return m_progress; }
    BakeProgress const& progress() const { return m_progress; }
    bool isBaking() const { return m_progress.running.load(); }

    // Offline bake using the current PlayLayer + start snapshot.
    // Replay = binary search; BruteForce = exhaustive + thread pool.
    geode::Result<int> bake(
        PlayLayer* layer,
        int startSnapshotSlot,
        int bakeRadius,
        BakeMethod method = BakeMethod::Replay
    );

    // Prefer clicks whose mode matches preferMode within LOOKUP_X_TOL.
    // If none match, fall back to any mode (legacy maps / missing mode).
    // Pass preferMode=nullopt to skip the mode preference pass entirely.
    BakedClick const* findNear(
        float playerX, int approxFrame, bool down, bool player2,
        std::optional<GameModeKind> preferMode = std::nullopt
    ) const;

    // Next bake/self-bake clicks after playerX (same down/player2; prefer mode).
    // Sorted by ascending x. Used by smart bake-chain (planSequence).
    std::vector<BakedClick const*> nextClicksAfter(
        float playerX, bool down, bool player2,
        std::optional<GameModeKind> preferMode,
        int maxCount
    ) const;

    // Merge self-bake point-windows: dedup by down/player2/near x+frame → union
    // earliest/latest. Sets method="self" when the map was empty or already self.
    // Returns number of clicks added or widened. Cap kMaxMapClicks.
    static constexpr float MERGE_X_TOL = 40.f;
    static constexpr int MERGE_FRAME_TOL = 30;
    static constexpr size_t kMaxMapClicks = 512;
    int mergeSelfClicks(std::vector<BakedClick> const& incoming);

    // Budgeted binary-search earliest/latest around each click (replay-style),
    // using a synthetic timeline from `clicks`. Stops when budgetSims or cancel.
    // Returns number of clicks whose window was expanded. In-place update.
    int refineSelfWindows(
        PlayLayer* layer,
        int startSnapshotSlot,
        std::vector<BakedClick>& clicks,
        int bakeRadius,
        int budgetSims,
        std::atomic<bool>* cancel = nullptr
    );

    std::string statusLine() const;
    std::string pauseStatusLine() const;

private:
    BakeMap() = default;

    geode::Result<> writeFile() const;
    geode::Result<> readFile();

    bool testShiftedClick(
        PlayLayer* layer,
        int startSnapshotSlot,
        std::vector<ReplayEvent> timeline,
        int eventIndex,
        int testFrame,
        int untilFrame,
        float dt
    ) const;

    geode::Result<int> bakeReplay(
        PlayLayer* layer, int startSnapshotSlot, int bakeRadius
    );
    geode::Result<int> bakeBrute(
        PlayLayer* layer, int startSnapshotSlot, int bakeRadius
    );

    BakeMapData m_data;
    ImportedReplay m_replay;
    bool m_hasReplay = false;
    bool m_loaded = false;
    // Set by mergeSelfClicks; cleared by save(). Avoids disk I/O on death flush.
    mutable bool m_dirty = false;
    BakeProgress m_progress;
    mutable std::mutex m_simMutex;
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_CORE_BAKEMAP_HPP
```

`src/core/BakeScheduler.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "BakeScheduler.hpp"
#include "../debug/AssistLog.hpp"
#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
using namespace geode::prelude;

BakeScheduler& BakeScheduler::get() {
    static BakeScheduler inst;
    return inst;
}

bool BakeScheduler::running() const { return m_running || BakeMap::get().isBaking(); }

void BakeScheduler::cancel() {
    BakeMap::get().progress().cancel = true;
}

bool BakeScheduler::start(PlayLayer* layer, int startSlot, int radius, BakeMethod method) {
    if (!layer || running()) return false;
    m_running = true;
    // Main-thread only: queue work via queueInMainThread chain (cooperative).
    auto* pl = layer;
    Loader::get()->queueInMainThread([pl, startSlot, radius, method]() {
        auto res = BakeMap::get().bake(pl, startSlot, radius, method);
        BakeScheduler::get().markFinished();
        if (res.isErr()) {
            AssistLog::info(fmt::format("BAKE failed: {}", res.unwrapErr()));
            FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer", res.unwrapErr().c_str(), "OK")->show();
        } else {
            AssistLog::info(fmt::format("BAKE done: {} windows", res.unwrap()));
            FLAlertLayer::create(
                "EarlyBuffer",
                fmt::format("Bake done — {} windows (main-thread).", res.unwrap()).c_str(),
                "OK"
            )->show();
        }
    });
    return true;
}

void BakeScheduler::tickSlice() {
    // bake() currently runs to completion on the queued main-thread job;
    // cancel is cooperative via BakeMap::progress().cancel.
}

void BakeScheduler::markFinished() {
    m_running = false;
}
```

`src/core/BakeVerifier.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "BakeVerifier.hpp"
#include "ShadowSimulator.hpp"
#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

BakeVerifier::Result BakeVerifier::verify(
    PlayLayer* layer, PlayerObject* player, bool down,
    int delayTicks, int limit, float dt, float firstDt
) {
    Result out;
    if (!layer || !player || limit < 0 || dt <= 0.f) return out;

    PlanOptions opts;
    opts.budgetUs = StageConfig::simBudgetUs();
    // One candidate + optional linked dual — keep a modest tick slice.
    int const full = StageConfig::tickBudgetPerPress();
    opts.tickBudget = full > 0 ? std::min(full, 1200) : 1200;

    auto const r = ShadowSimulator::get().verifyDelay(
        layer, player, down, std::max(0, delayTicks), limit, dt, firstDt, opts
    );
    out.ok = r.ok;
    out.clearsThreat = r.clearsThreat;
    out.diedBeforeAction = r.diedBeforeAction;
    out.budgetHit = r.budgetHit;
    return out;
}
```

```hpp
        bool clearsThreat = false;

        bool budgetHit = false;

        PlayLayer* layer, PlayerObject* player, bool down,

    );
```

```cpp
#include "BufferEventMachine.hpp"

char const* BufferEventMachine::stateName(BufferSmState s) {
    switch (s) {
        case BufferSmState::Idle: return "Idle";
        case BufferSmState::ArmedPress: return "ArmedPress";
        case BufferSmState::ArmedRelease: return "ArmedRelease";
        case BufferSmState::PendingRelease: return "PendingRelease";
    }
    return "?";
}

bool BufferEventMachine::selfCheck() {
    // Transition contract smoke test (logical).
    BufferSmState s = BufferSmState::Idle;
    s = BufferSmState::ArmedPress; // planPress Delay
    // releaseSeen keeps ArmedPress
    // Press B => fire then Idle then maybe re-arm
    s = BufferSmState::Idle;
    s = BufferSmState::PendingRelease;
    s = BufferSmState::Idle;
    (void)s;
    return true;
}
```

```cpp
#include "ClickIntentGuard.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <fmt/format.h>

ClickIntentGuard& ClickIntentGuard::get() {
    static ClickIntentGuard inst;
    return inst;
}

void ClickIntentGuard::reset() {
    this->m_slots[0] = {};
    this->m_slots[1] = {};
}

int ClickIntentGuard::spamWindowTicks(GameModeKind mode) {
    // Physics ticks (~240/s). Wave/ship spam is denser than cube taps.
    switch (mode) {
        case GameModeKind::Wave:  return 10;
        case GameModeKind::Ship:  return 12;
        case GameModeKind::Swing: return 12;
        case GameModeKind::Ufo:   return 14;
        case GameModeKind::Spider:return 14;
        default:                  return 16;
    }
}

int ClickIntentGuard::spamMinCount(GameModeKind mode) {
    switch (mode) {
        case GameModeKind::Wave:  return 3;
        case GameModeKind::Ship:  return 3;
        case GameModeKind::Swing: return 3;
        default:                  return 4;
    }
}

float ClickIntentGuard::spamMaxMeanGap(GameModeKind mode) {
    switch (mode) {
        case GameModeKind::Wave:  return 4.f;
        case GameModeKind::Ship:  return 5.f;
        case GameModeKind::Swing: return 5.f;
        case GameModeKind::Ufo:   return 6.f;
        case GameModeKind::Spider:return 6.f;
        default:                  return 7.f;
    }
}

void ClickIntentGuard::notePress(int playerSlot, int attemptTick, GameModeKind mode) {
    (void)mode;
    if (playerSlot < 0 || playerSlot > 1) return;
    auto& s = this->m_slots[playerSlot];
    s.ticks[s.next] = attemptTick;
    s.next = (s.next + 1) % kRing;
    if (s.count < kRing) ++s.count;
}

bool ClickIntentGuard::evaluateSpam(
    int const* ticks,
    int tickCount,
    int attemptTick,
    GameModeKind mode
) {
    if (!ticks || tickCount <= 0) return false;

    int const window = spamWindowTicks(mode);
    int const need = spamMinCount(mode);
    int const oldest = attemptTick - window;

    int sorted[kRing]{};
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < tickCount && i < kRing; ++i) {
        int const t = ticks[i];
        if (t >= oldest && t <= attemptTick) {
            sorted[n++] = t;
        }
    }
    if (n < need) return false;

    std::sort(sorted, sorted + n);

    // Gaps between consecutive in-window presses.
    int gaps[kRing]{};
    int gapN = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        int const g = sorted[i] - sorted[i - 1];
        if (g < 0) continue;
        gaps[gapN++] = g;
    }

    // Soft density alone is not enough — need rhythmic spam or very dense train.
    // First 2–3 clicks (n == need, few gaps): require tight max gap if measurable.
    bool veryDense = n >= need + 2;

    if (gapN <= 0) {
        // Single sample in window somehow — density already failed or n==1.
        return false;
    }

    float sum = 0.f;
    int maxGap = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < gapN; ++i) {
        sum += static_cast<float>(gaps[i]);
        if (gaps[i] > maxGap) maxGap = gaps[i];
    }
    float const mean = sum / static_cast<float>(gapN);

    float var = 0.f;
    for (int i = 0; i < gapN; ++i) {
        float const d = static_cast<float>(gaps[i]) - mean;
        var += d * d;
    }
    var /= static_cast<float>(gapN);
    float const stddev = std::sqrt(var);

    float const maxMean = spamMaxMeanGap(mode);
    // Pause mid-spam: a gap much larger than the mode threshold → not Pass.
    // Portal/teleport corridor spam still looks regular (short gaps).
    if (maxGap > static_cast<int>(maxMean * 2.5f) + 2) {
        return false;
    }
    // Relative outlier: gap ≫ local mean → solitary resume / burst+pause, never Pass
    // (including veryDense trains that ended with a long idle).
    if (mean > 0.5f && static_cast<float>(maxGap) > mean * 2.0f + 1.f) {
        return false;
    }

    bool const regular =
        mean <= maxMean
        && stddev <= mean * 0.55f + 0.75f;

    return regular || veryDense;
}

bool ClickIntentGuard::shouldPassThrough(
    int playerSlot, int attemptTick, GameModeKind mode
) const {
    return this->shouldPassThrough(playerSlot, attemptTick, mode, false, false);
}

bool ClickIntentGuard::shouldPassThrough(
    int playerSlot,
    int attemptTick,
    GameModeKind mode,
    bool nearOrbOrPad,
    bool nearBakeWindow
) const {
    // Orb train / bake window: density is intentional timing → allow assist.
    if (nearOrbOrPad || nearBakeWindow) return false;

    if (playerSlot < 0 || playerSlot > 1) return false;
    auto const& s = this->m_slots[playerSlot];
    if (s.count <= 0) return false;

    return evaluateSpam(s.ticks, s.count, attemptTick, mode);
}

bool ClickIntentGuard::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += "; ";
        report += name;
    };

    // Wave rhythmic spam: ticks every 3 within window 10 → Pass
    {
        int const t[] = { 100, 103, 106, 109 };
        expect(evaluateSpam(t, 4, 109, GameModeKind::Wave), "wave-regular");
    }
    // Single early click → not spam
    {
        int const t[] = { 100 };
        expect(!evaluateSpam(t, 1, 100, GameModeKind::Wave), "single-click");
    }
    // Two clicks → below min count
    {
        int const t[] = { 100, 103 };
        expect(!evaluateSpam(t, 2, 103, GameModeKind::Wave), "two-clicks");
    }
    // Dense but paused (gap 20) → not Pass
    {
        int const t[] = { 100, 103, 106, 126 };
        expect(!evaluateSpam(t, 4, 126, GameModeKind::Wave), "pause-mid");
    }
    // Gaps ≫ mean inside window (dense train then idle) → never Pass, even if veryDense
    {
        int const t[] = { 112, 113, 114, 115, 116, 121 };
        expect(!evaluateSpam(t, 6, 121, GameModeKind::Wave), "gap-vs-mean");
    }
    // Very dense irregular-ish but count high → Pass
    {
        int const t[] = { 100, 101, 102, 103, 104 };
        expect(evaluateSpam(t, 5, 104, GameModeKind::Wave), "very-dense");
    }
    // Cube needs 4
    {
        int const t[] = { 100, 104, 108 };
        expect(!evaluateSpam(t, 3, 108, GameModeKind::Cube), "cube-need-4");
        int const t4[] = { 100, 104, 108, 112 };
        expect(evaluateSpam(t4, 4, 112, GameModeKind::Cube), "cube-regular-4");
    }
    // Outside window ignored
    {
        int const t[] = { 50, 100, 103, 106 };
        expect(evaluateSpam(t, 4, 106, GameModeKind::Wave), "old-ignored");
    }

    // Empty ring / solitary press → never Pass (early miss-assist must reach plan)
    {
        auto& g = get();
        g.reset();
        expect(!g.shouldPassThrough(0, 50, GameModeKind::Wave), "empty-ring");
        g.notePress(0, 50, GameModeKind::Cube);
        expect(!g.shouldPassThrough(0, 50, GameModeKind::Cube), "one-in-ring");
        g.reset();
    }

    // Context overload: orb / bake force assist-allowed
    {
        auto& g = get();
        g.reset();
        g.notePress(0, 100, GameModeKind::Wave);
        g.notePress(0, 103, GameModeKind::Wave);
        g.notePress(0, 106, GameModeKind::Wave);
        expect(g.shouldPassThrough(0, 106, GameModeKind::Wave), "slot-pass");
        expect(
            !g.shouldPassThrough(0, 106, GameModeKind::Wave, true, false),
            "orb-override"
        );
        expect(
            !g.shouldPassThrough(0, 106, GameModeKind::Wave, false, true),
            "bake-override"
        );
        g.reset();
    }

    // P2 independence
    {
        auto& g = get();
        g.reset();
        g.notePress(1, 200, GameModeKind::Ship);
        g.notePress(1, 204, GameModeKind::Ship);
        g.notePress(1, 208, GameModeKind::Ship);
        expect(g.shouldPassThrough(1, 208, GameModeKind::Ship), "p2-pass");
        expect(!g.shouldPassThrough(0, 208, GameModeKind::Ship), "p1-empty");
        g.reset();
    }

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "ClickIntentGuard selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = fmt::format("ClickIntentGuard {} fails: {}", fails, report);
    return false;
}
```

`src/core/ClickIntentGuard.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_CORE_CLICKINTENTGUARD_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_CORE_CLICKINTENTGUARD_HPP

#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"
#include <string>

// Detects dense / rhythmic click spam (esp. wave corridors) so assist can Pass
// instead of buffering taps that have no real threat target.
// Orb/pad ahead or a nearby bake window → do not Pass (allow assist).
class ClickIntentGuard {
public:
    static ClickIntentGuard& get();

    void reset();

    // Record a real user Jump press (not inject) at attemptTick for player 0/1.
    void notePress(int playerSlot, int attemptTick, GameModeKind mode);

    // Density + interval regularity only (no orb/bake context).
    bool shouldPassThrough(int playerSlot, int attemptTick, GameModeKind mode) const;

    // Same as above, but nearOrbOrPad / nearBakeWindow force assist-allowed (false).
    bool shouldPassThrough(
        int playerSlot,
        int attemptTick,
        GameModeKind mode,
        bool nearOrbOrPad,
        bool nearBakeWindow
    ) const;

    // Pure evaluate for selfCheck / tests (sorted or unsorted ticks OK).
    static bool evaluateSpam(
        int const* ticks,
        int tickCount,
        int attemptTick,
        GameModeKind mode
    );

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

    static int spamWindowTicks(GameModeKind mode);
    static int spamMinCount(GameModeKind mode);
    // Max mean gap (ticks) still counted as rhythmic spam.
    static float spamMaxMeanGap(GameModeKind mode);

private:
    ClickIntentGuard() = default;

    static constexpr int kRing = 12;

    struct Slot {
        int ticks[kRing]{};
        int count = 0;
        int next = 0;
    };

    Slot m_slots[2]{};
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_CORE_CLICKINTENTGUARD_HPP

```

`src/core/ConfigBundle.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "ConfigBundle.hpp"
#include "ConfigBundleCodec.hpp"
#include "ConfigBundleKeys.hpp"
#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"

#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <system_error>
#include <vector>

using namespace geode::prelude;

class ConfigBundleImportState {
public:
    static ConfigBundle::ImportStats& stats() {
        static ConfigBundle::ImportStats s;
        return s;
    }

private:
    ConfigBundleImportState() = default;
};

class ConfigBundleExportState {
public:
    static ConfigBundle::ExportStats& stats() {
        static ConfigBundle::ExportStats s;
        return s;
    }

private:
    ConfigBundleExportState() = default;
};

ConfigBundle::ImportStats ConfigBundle::lastImportStats() {
    return ConfigBundleImportState::stats();
}

ConfigBundle::ExportStats ConfigBundle::lastExportStats() {
    return ConfigBundleExportState::stats();
}

geode::Result<> ConfigBundle::exportTo(std::filesystem::path const& path) {
    auto& stats = ConfigBundleExportState::stats();
    stats = {};
    stats.version = ConfigBundle::kFormatVersion;

    auto* mod = Mod::get();
    if (!mod) {
        return Err("export: mod unavailable");
    }

    matjson::Value settings = matjson::Value::object();
    int written = 0;
    int skipped = 0;

    for (auto const* it = ConfigBundleKeys::begin(); it != ConfigBundleKeys::end(); ++it) {
        auto const& entry = *it;
        try {
            switch (entry.kind) {
                case ConfigBundleKeys::Kind::Bool:
                    settings[entry.key] = mod->getSettingValue<bool>(entry.key);
                    ++written;
                    break;
                case ConfigBundleKeys::Kind::Int:
                    settings[entry.key] = mod->getSettingValue<int64_t>(entry.key);
                    ++written;
                    break;
                case ConfigBundleKeys::Kind::Float:
                    settings[entry.key] = mod->getSettingValue<double>(entry.key);
                    ++written;
                    break;
                case ConfigBundleKeys::Kind::String:
                    settings[entry.key] = mod->getSettingValue<std::string>(entry.key);
                    ++written;
                    break;
                case ConfigBundleKeys::Kind::Color: {
                    auto const color = mod->getSettingValue<cocos2d::ccColor3B>(entry.key);
                    settings[entry.key] = ConfigBundleCodec::colorToHex(color);
                    ++written;
                    break;
                }
                case ConfigBundleKeys::Kind::Keybind: {
                    auto const binds = mod->getSettingValue<std::vector<geode::Keybind>>(entry.key);
                    settings[entry.key] = ConfigBundleCodec::keybindsToString(binds);
                    ++written;
                    break;
                }
                default:
                    ++skipped;
                    break;
            }
        }
        catch (...) {
            // Skip one bad key; continue exporting the rest.
            ++skipped;
        }
    }

    matjson::Value root;
    root["version"] = ConfigBundle::kFormatVersion;
    root["settings"] = settings;

    std::ofstream out(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    if (!out) {
        return Err("export open failed");
    }
    out << root.dump();
    if (!out) {
        return Err("export write failed");
    }

    stats.written = written;
    stats.skipped = skipped;
    return Ok();
}

class ConfigBundleApplyGuard {
public:
    ConfigBundleApplyGuard() {
        StageConfig::beginApplying();
        this->m_active = true;
    }

    ~ConfigBundleApplyGuard() {
        this->release();
    }

    ConfigBundleApplyGuard(ConfigBundleApplyGuard const&) = delete;
    ConfigBundleApplyGuard& operator=(ConfigBundleApplyGuard const&) = delete;

    void release() {
        if (this->m_active) {
            StageConfig::endApplying();
            this->m_active = false;
        }
    }

private:
    bool m_active = false;
};

static bool applyOneSetting(
    Mod* mod,
    ConfigBundleKeys::Entry const& entry,
    matjson::Value const& value,
    int& applied,
    int& skipped
) {
    try {
        switch (entry.kind) {
            case ConfigBundleKeys::Kind::Bool: {
                auto const parsed = value.asBool();
                if (parsed.isErr()) {
                    ++skipped;
                    return false;
                }
                mod->setSettingValue<bool>(entry.key, parsed.unwrap());
                ++applied;
                return true;
            }
            case ConfigBundleKeys::Kind::Int: {
                auto const parsed = value.asInt();
                if (parsed.isErr()) {
                    ++skipped;
                    return false;
                }
                mod->setSettingValue<int64_t>(entry.key, parsed.unwrap());
                ++applied;
                return true;
            }
            case ConfigBundleKeys::Kind::Float: {
                auto const parsed = value.asDouble();
                if (parsed.isErr()) {
                    ++skipped;
                    return false;
                }
                mod->setSettingValue<double>(entry.key, parsed.unwrap());
                ++applied;
                return true;
            }
            case ConfigBundleKeys::Kind::String: {
                auto const parsed = value.asString();
                if (parsed.isErr()) {
                    ++skipped;
                    return false;
                }
                mod->setSettingValue<std::string>(entry.key, std::string(parsed.unwrap()));
                ++applied;
                return true;
            }
            case ConfigBundleKeys::Kind::Color: {
                auto const parsed = value.asString();
                if (parsed.isErr()) {
                    ++skipped;
                    return false;
                }
                cocos2d::ccColor3B color{};
                if (!ConfigBundleCodec::hexToColor(std::string(parsed.unwrap()), color)) {
                    ++skipped;
                    return false;
                }
                mod->setSettingValue<cocos2d::ccColor3B>(entry.key, color);
                ++applied;
                return true;
            }
            case ConfigBundleKeys::Kind::Keybind: {
                std::vector<geode::Keybind> binds;
                if (!ConfigBundleCodec::jsonToKeybinds(value, binds)) {
                    ++skipped;
                    return false;
                }
                mod->setSettingValue<std::vector<geode::Keybind>>(entry.key, binds);
                ++applied;
                return true;
            }
            default:
                ++skipped;
                return false;
        }
    }
    catch (...) {
        ++skipped;
        return false;
    }
}

geode::Result<> ConfigBundle::importFrom(std::filesystem::path const& path) {
    auto& stats = ConfigBundleImportState::stats();
    stats = {};

    std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!in) {
        return Err("import open failed");
    }
    std::string body((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    if (body.empty()) {
        return Err("import empty");
    }

    auto parsed = matjson::parse(body);
    if (parsed.isErr()) {
        return Err("import json");
    }
    matjson::Value root = parsed.unwrap();
    if (!root.isObject()) {
        return Err("import root not object");
    }

    auto* mod = Mod::get();
    if (!mod) {
        return Err("import: mod unavailable");
    }

    // Resolve settings object: v2 nested, or v1 flat root.
    matjson::Value settings = matjson::Value::object();
    int version = 1;
    if (root.contains("version")) {
        auto const ver = root["version"].asInt();
        if (ver.isOk()) {
            version = static_cast<int>(ver.unwrap());
        }
    }

    if (root.contains("settings") && root["settings"].isObject()) {
        settings = root["settings"];
        if (version < 2) {
            version = 2; // nested settings imply v2 shape even if version missing/wrong
        }
    }
    else {
        // v1 flat: copy only known portable keys from root (ignore unknown / "version").
        version = 1;
        for (auto const* it = ConfigBundleKeys::begin(); it != ConfigBundleKeys::end(); ++it) {
            if (root.contains(it->key)) {
                settings[it->key] = root[it->key];
            }
        }
    }

    stats.version = version;
    int applied = 0;
    int skipped = 0;

    {
        ConfigBundleApplyGuard guard;

        for (auto const* it = ConfigBundleKeys::begin(); it != ConfigBundleKeys::end(); ++it) {
            if (!settings.contains(it->key)) {
                continue; // merge: leave live value
            }
            applyOneSetting(mod, *it, settings[it->key], applied, skipped);
        }

        // Preset wins over a mismatched stage-index from the file.
        if (settings.contains("preset")) {
            auto const presetParsed = settings["preset"].asString();
            if (presetParsed.isOk()) {
                std::string const presetName(presetParsed.unwrap());
                int const idx = StageConfig::presetIndexByName(presetName);
                try {
                    mod->setSettingValue<int64_t>("stage-index", idx);
                    mod->setSettingValue<std::string>("preset", presetName);
                }
                catch (...) {
                    ++skipped;
                }
                StageConfig::notePresetSynced(presetName);
            }
        }

        guard.release();
    }

    StageConfig::refreshCache();

    stats.applied = applied;
    stats.skipped = skipped;
    return Ok();
}

bool ConfigBundle::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (!ok) {
            ++fails;
            report += std::string("FAIL ") + name + "; ";
        }
    };

    expect(ConfigBundle::kFormatVersion == 2, "format-v2");
    expect(ConfigBundleKeys::count() == 130, "keys-130");

    auto* mod = Mod::get();
    if (!mod) {
        if (fails == 0) {
            report = "ConfigBundle selfCheck OK (no mod — structural only)";
            return true;
        }
        report = std::string("ConfigBundle selfCheck fails: ") + report;
        return false;
    }

    std::filesystem::path tmp;
    try {
        tmp = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() / "earlybuffer-config-selfcheck.json";
    }
    catch (...) {
        expect(false, "temp-path");
        report = std::string("ConfigBundle selfCheck fails: ") + report;
        return false;
    }

    // Snapshot values we will mutate, then always restore.
    int64_t snapCap = 0;
    int64_t snapTicks = 0;
    int64_t snapStage = 0;
    std::string snapPreset;
    try {
        snapCap = mod->getSettingValue<int64_t>("look-ahead-cap");
        snapTicks = mod->getSettingValue<int64_t>("ticks-all");
        snapStage = mod->getSettingValue<int64_t>("stage-index");
        snapPreset = mod->getSettingValue<std::string>("preset");
    }
    catch (...) {
        expect(false, "snapshot");
        report = std::string("ConfigBundle selfCheck fails: ") + report;
        return false;
    }

    auto restore = [&]() {
        ConfigBundleApplyGuard guard;
        try {
            mod->setSettingValue<int64_t>("look-ahead-cap", snapCap);
            mod->setSettingValue<int64_t>("ticks-all", snapTicks);
            mod->setSettingValue<int64_t>("stage-index", snapStage);
            mod->setSettingValue<std::string>("preset", snapPreset);
            StageConfig::notePresetSynced(snapPreset);
        }
        catch (...) {
        }
        guard.release();
        StageConfig::refreshCache();
        std::error_code ec;
        std::filesystem::remove(tmp, ec);
    };

    // --- Export → mutate → import round-trip ---
    {
        StageConfig::beginApplying();
        try {
            mod->setSettingValue<int64_t>("look-ahead-cap", 42);
            mod->setSettingValue<int64_t>("ticks-all", 7);
        }
        catch (...) {
            StageConfig::endApplying();
            restore();
            expect(false, "seed-roundtrip");
            report = std::string("ConfigBundle selfCheck fails: ") + report;
            return false;
        }
        StageConfig::endApplying();
        StageConfig::refreshCache();

        auto const exp = ConfigBundle::exportTo(tmp);
        expect(exp.isOk(), "export-ok");
        if (exp.isOk()) {
            auto const es = ConfigBundle::lastExportStats();
            expect(es.version == 2, "export-stats-v2");
            expect(es.written >= 120, "export-stats-written");
        }

        StageConfig::beginApplying();
        try {
            mod->setSettingValue<int64_t>("look-ahead-cap", 0);
            mod->setSettingValue<int64_t>("ticks-all", 1);
        }
        catch (...) {
        }
        StageConfig::endApplying();
        StageConfig::refreshCache();

        auto const imp = ConfigBundle::importFrom(tmp);
        expect(imp.isOk(), "import-roundtrip-ok");
        if (imp.isOk()) {
            auto const is = ConfigBundle::lastImportStats();
            expect(is.version == 2, "import-stats-v2");
            expect(is.applied > 0, "import-stats-applied");
            try {
                expect(mod->getSettingValue<int64_t>("look-ahead-cap") == 42, "roundtrip-cap");
                expect(mod->getSettingValue<int64_t>("ticks-all") == 7, "roundtrip-ticks");
            }
            catch (...) {
                expect(false, "roundtrip-read");
            }
        }
    }

    // --- Preset + custom look-ahead must not be wiped by applyPreset listener ---
    {
        std::ofstream out(tmp, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        expect(static_cast<bool>(out), "preset-guard-write");
        if (out) {
            // preset Tight would normally rewrite look-ahead-cap via applyPreset;
            // import must keep sentinel 77 under applying-guard.
            out << R"({
  "version": 2,
  "settings": {
    "preset": "Tight",
    "stage-index": 0,
    "look-ahead-cap": 77,
    "ticks-all": 11
  }
})";
            out.close();

            auto const imp = ConfigBundle::importFrom(tmp);
            expect(imp.isOk(), "preset-guard-import");
            if (imp.isOk()) {
                try {
                    expect(
                        mod->getSettingValue<int64_t>("look-ahead-cap") == 77,
                        "preset-guard-cap"
                    );
                    expect(
                        mod->getSettingValue<int64_t>("ticks-all") == 11,
                        "preset-guard-ticks"
                    );
                    expect(
                        mod->getSettingValue<std::string>("preset") == "Tight",
                        "preset-guard-preset"
                    );
                }
                catch (...) {
                    expect(false, "preset-guard-read");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // --- v1 flat root still applies known keys ---
    {
        std::ofstream out(tmp, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        if (out) {
            out << R"({"version":1,"look-ahead-cap":55,"ticks-all":3,"preset":"Normal"})";
            out.close();
            auto const imp = ConfigBundle::importFrom(tmp);
            expect(imp.isOk(), "v1-import");
            if (imp.isOk()) {
                auto const is = ConfigBundle::lastImportStats();
                expect(is.version == 1, "v1-stats-version");
                try {
                    expect(mod->getSettingValue<int64_t>("look-ahead-cap") == 55, "v1-cap");
                    expect(mod->getSettingValue<std::string>("preset") == "Normal", "v1-preset");
                }
                catch (...) {
                    expect(false, "v1-read");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    restore();

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "ConfigBundle selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("ConfigBundle selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_CORE_CONFIGBUNDLE_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_CORE_CONFIGBUNDLE_HPP

#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>

// Portable settings JSON. v2 = { "version": 2, "settings": { ... } }.
// Import also accepts v1 flat root (legacy keys at top level).
class ConfigBundle {
public:
    static constexpr int kFormatVersion = 2;

    struct ImportStats {
        int version = 0;
        int applied = 0;
        int skipped = 0;
    };

    struct ExportStats {
        int version = 0;
        int written = 0;
        int skipped = 0;
    };

    static geode::Result<> exportTo(std::filesystem::path const& path);
    static geode::Result<> importFrom(std::filesystem::path const& path);

    // Filled by the last successful importFrom / exportTo (zeros if never run).
    static ImportStats lastImportStats();
    static ExportStats lastExportStats();

    // Temp-file export→import + preset/look-ahead-cap guard. Restores prior values.
    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    ConfigBundle() = default;
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_CORE_CONFIGBUNDLE_HPP
```

`src/core/ConfigBundleCodec.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "ConfigBundleCodec.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

void ConfigBundleCodec::trimInPlace(std::string& s) {
    while (!s.empty() && (s.front() == ' ' || s.front() == '\t')) {
        s.erase(s.begin());
    }
    while (!s.empty() && (s.back() == ' ' || s.back() == '\t')) {
        s.pop_back();
    }
}

std::string ConfigBundleCodec::colorToHex(cocos2d::ccColor3B color) {
    char buf[8];
    std::snprintf(
        buf,
        sizeof(buf),
        "#%02X%02X%02X",
        static_cast<unsigned>(color.r),
        static_cast<unsigned>(color.g),
        static_cast<unsigned>(color.b)
    );
    return std::string(buf);
}

int ConfigBundleCodec::hexNibble(char c) {
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return c - '0';
    if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') return 10 + (c - 'a');
    if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') return 10 + (c - 'A');
    return -1;
}

bool ConfigBundleCodec::hexToColor(std::string const& hex, cocos2d::ccColor3B& out) {
    std::string_view s = hex;
    if (!s.empty() && s.front() == '#') {
        s.remove_prefix(1);
    }
    if (s.size() != 6) {
        return false;
    }
    int nibbles[6];
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
        nibbles[i] = ConfigBundleCodec::hexNibble(s[static_cast<size_t>(i)]);
        if (nibbles[i] < 0) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    out.r = static_cast<uint8_t>((nibbles[0] << 4) | nibbles[1]);
    out.g = static_cast<uint8_t>((nibbles[2] << 4) | nibbles[3]);
    out.b = static_cast<uint8_t>((nibbles[4] << 4) | nibbles[5]);
    return true;
}

std::string ConfigBundleCodec::keybindsToString(std::vector<geode::Keybind> const& binds) {
    if (binds.empty()) {
        return std::string();
    }
    std::string out = binds.front().toString();
    for (size_t i = 1; i < binds.size(); ++i) {
        out += " | ";
        out += binds[i].toString();
    }
    return out;
}

bool ConfigBundleCodec::stringToKeybinds(std::string const& text, std::vector<geode::Keybind>& out) {
    out.clear();
    std::string const& src = text;
    if (src.empty()) {
        return false;
    }

    size_t start = 0;
    while (start <= src.size()) {
        size_t const sep = src.find(" | ", start);
        std::string piece = (sep == std::string::npos)
            ? src.substr(start)
            : src.substr(start, sep - start);
        ConfigBundleCodec::trimInPlace(piece);
        if (!piece.empty()) {
            auto parsed = geode::Keybind::fromString(piece);
            if (parsed.isErr()) {
                out.clear();
                return false;
            }
            out.push_back(parsed.unwrap());
        }
        if (sep == std::string::npos) {
            break;
        }
        start = sep + 3;
    }

    return !out.empty();
}

bool ConfigBundleCodec::jsonToKeybinds(matjson::Value const& value, std::vector<geode::Keybind>& out) {
    out.clear();

    // Portable string form: "F6" or "Ctrl+Shift+D | Alt+F6"
    auto asStr = value.asString();
    if (asStr.isOk()) {
        return ConfigBundleCodec::stringToKeybinds(std::string(asStr.unwrap()), out);
    }

    // JSON array of strings (optional multi-bind form).
    if (value.isArray()) {
        auto const& arr = value.asArray().unwrap();
        for (auto const& item : arr) {
            auto piece = item.asString();
            if (piece.isErr()) {
                out.clear();
                return false;
            }
            std::string s(piece.unwrap());
            ConfigBundleCodec::trimInPlace(s);
            if (s.empty()) {
                continue;
            }
            auto parsed = geode::Keybind::fromString(s);
            if (parsed.isErr()) {
                out.clear();
                return false;
            }
            out.push_back(parsed.unwrap());
        }
        return !out.empty();
    }

    return false;
}

bool ConfigBundleCodec::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (!ok) {
            ++fails;
            report += std::string("FAIL ") + name + "; ";
        }
    };

    cocos2d::ccColor3B const sample{ 0x7C, 0xFF, 0x4A };
    std::string const hex = ConfigBundleCodec::colorToHex(sample);
    expect(hex == "#7CFF4A", "color-to-hex");

    cocos2d::ccColor3B back{};
    expect(ConfigBundleCodec::hexToColor(hex, back), "hex-to-color");
    expect(back.r == sample.r && back.g == sample.g && back.b == sample.b, "roundtrip");

    cocos2d::ccColor3B lower{};
    expect(ConfigBundleCodec::hexToColor("#7cff4a", lower), "hex-lower");
    expect(lower.r == sample.r && lower.g == sample.g && lower.b == sample.b, "hex-lower-rgb");

    cocos2d::ccColor3B noHash{};
    expect(ConfigBundleCodec::hexToColor("7CFF4A", noHash), "hex-no-hash");
    expect(noHash.r == sample.r, "hex-no-hash-r");

    cocos2d::ccColor3B junk{};
    expect(!ConfigBundleCodec::hexToColor("#GG0000", junk), "hex-bad-digit");
    expect(!ConfigBundleCodec::hexToColor("#FFF", junk), "hex-short");
    expect(!ConfigBundleCodec::hexToColor("", junk), "hex-empty");

    // Keybind string round-trip (Geode Keybind::fromString / toString).
    {
        auto one = geode::Keybind::fromString("F6");
        expect(one.isOk(), "kb-parse-f6");
        if (one.isOk()) {
            std::vector<geode::Keybind> binds{ one.unwrap() };
            std::string const s = ConfigBundleCodec::keybindsToString(binds);
            expect(!s.empty(), "kb-to-string-nonempty");
            std::vector<geode::Keybind> backBinds;
            expect(ConfigBundleCodec::stringToKeybinds(s, backBinds), "kb-from-string");
            expect(backBinds.size() == 1 && backBinds[0] == binds[0], "kb-roundtrip");
        }

        auto combo = geode::Keybind::fromString("Ctrl+Shift+D");
        expect(combo.isOk(), "kb-parse-combo");
        if (combo.isOk() && one.isOk()) {
            geode::Keybind const kbA = one.unwrap();
            geode::Keybind const kbB = combo.unwrap();
            std::vector<geode::Keybind> multi{ kbA, kbB };
            std::string const joined = ConfigBundleCodec::keybindsToString(multi);
            expect(joined.find(" | ") != std::string::npos, "kb-multi-sep");
            std::vector<geode::Keybind> backMulti;
            expect(ConfigBundleCodec::stringToKeybinds(joined, backMulti), "kb-multi-parse");
            expect(backMulti.size() == 2, "kb-multi-count");
        }

        std::vector<geode::Keybind> emptyOut;
        expect(!ConfigBundleCodec::stringToKeybinds("", emptyOut), "kb-empty-fail");
        std::vector<geode::Keybind> bad;
        expect(!ConfigBundleCodec::stringToKeybinds("NotARealKey!!!", bad), "kb-bad-fail");

        auto arrParsed = matjson::parse(R"(["F6","Ctrl+Shift+D"])");
        if (arrParsed.isOk()) {
            std::vector<geode::Keybind> fromArr;
            expect(ConfigBundleCodec::jsonToKeybinds(arrParsed.unwrap(), fromArr), "kb-json-array");
            expect(fromArr.size() == 2, "kb-json-array-count");
        }
        else {
            expect(false, "kb-json-array-parse");
        }

        auto strParsed = matjson::parse(R"("Ctrl+Shift+M")");
        if (strParsed.isOk()) {
            std::vector<geode::Keybind> fromStr;
            expect(ConfigBundleCodec::jsonToKeybinds(strParsed.unwrap(), fromStr), "kb-json-string");
            expect(fromStr.size() == 1, "kb-json-string-count");
        }
        else {
            expect(false, "kb-json-string-parse");
        }
    }

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "ConfigBundleCodec selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("ConfigBundleCodec selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

`src/core/ConfigBundleCodec.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_CORE_CONFIGBUNDLECODEC_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_CORE_CONFIGBUNDLECODEC_HPP

#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>

// Encode/decode helpers for ConfigBundle JSON (color hex + keybind strings).
class ConfigBundleCodec {
public:
    // "#RRGGBB" (uppercase hex).
    static std::string colorToHex(cocos2d::ccColor3B color);

    // Accepts "#RRGGBB" / "#rrggbb" (optional leading '#'). false on bad length/digits.
    static bool hexToColor(std::string const& hex, cocos2d::ccColor3B& out);

    // Geode keybind settings are vector<Keybind>. Portable JSON uses a string
    // (one bind) or "bind1 | bind2" for multiples — same human form as mod.json defaults.
    static std::string keybindsToString(std::vector<geode::Keybind> const& binds);
    static bool stringToKeybinds(std::string const& text, std::vector<geode::Keybind>& out);

    // Import helper: string, or JSON array of strings. false → leave setting unchanged.
    static bool jsonToKeybinds(matjson::Value const& value, std::vector<geode::Keybind>& out);

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    ConfigBundleCodec() = default;

    static int hexNibble(char c);
    static void trimInPlace(std::string& s);
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_CORE_CONFIGBUNDLECODEC_HPP
```

```cpp
ConfigBundleKeys::Entry const* ConfigBundleKeys::begin() {
    return ConfigBundleKeysTable::kEntries;
}

ConfigBundleKeys::Entry const* ConfigBundleKeys::end() {
    return ConfigBundleKeysTable::kEntries + ConfigBundleKeysTable::kEntryCount;
}

int ConfigBundleKeys::count() {
    return ConfigBundleKeysTable::kEntryCount;
}

ConfigBundleKeys::Entry const* ConfigBundleKeys::find(char const* key) {
    if (!key) {
        return nullptr;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < ConfigBundleKeysTable::kEntryCount; ++i) {
        if (std::strcmp(ConfigBundleKeysTable::kEntries[i].key, key) == 0) {
            return &ConfigBundleKeysTable::kEntries[i];
        }
    }
    return nullptr;
}

bool ConfigBundleKeys::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (!ok) {
            ++fails;
            report += std::string("FAIL ") + name + "; ";
        }
    };

    expect(ConfigBundleKeysTable::kEntryCount == 130, "count-130");
    expect(
        ConfigBundleKeys::count() == ConfigBundleKeysTable::kEntryCount,
        "count-api"
    );
    expect(
        static_cast<int>(ConfigBundleKeys::end() - ConfigBundleKeys::begin())
            == ConfigBundleKeysTable::kEntryCount,
        "begin-end"
    );

    std::unordered_set<std::string> seen;
    int kindBool = 0;
    int kindInt = 0;
    int kindFloat = 0;
    int kindString = 0;
    int kindColor = 0;
    int kindKeybind = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ConfigBundleKeysTable::kEntryCount; ++i) {
        auto const& e = ConfigBundleKeysTable::kEntries[i];
        expect(e.key != nullptr && e.key[0] != '\0', "nonempty-key");
        bool const inserted = seen.insert(std::string(e.key)).second;
        expect(inserted, "unique");
        switch (e.kind) {
            case Kind::Bool:
                ++kindBool;
                break;
            case Kind::Int:
                ++kindInt;
                break;
            case Kind::Float:
                ++kindFloat;
                break;
            case Kind::String:
                ++kindString;
                break;
            case Kind::Color:
                ++kindColor;
                break;
            case Kind::Keybind:
                ++kindKeybind;
                break;
            default:
                expect(false, "kind-valid");
                break;
        }
    }
    expect(
        static_cast<int>(seen.size()) == ConfigBundleKeysTable::kEntryCount,
        "unique-count"
    );
    expect(kindBool == 51, "kind-bool-51");
    expect(kindInt == 45, "kind-int-45");
    expect(kindFloat == 20, "kind-float-20");
    expect(kindString == 7, "kind-string-7");
    expect(kindColor == 1, "kind-color-1");
    expect(kindKeybind == 6, "kind-keybind-6");

    auto const* enabled = ConfigBundleKeys::find("enabled");
    expect(enabled != nullptr, "find-enabled");
    expect(enabled && enabled->kind == Kind::Bool, "find-enabled-bool");
    auto const* color = ConfigBundleKeys::find("save-icon-color");
    expect(color && color->kind == Kind::Color, "find-color");
    auto const* hotkey = ConfigBundleKeys::find("hotkey-cycle");
    expect(hotkey && hotkey->kind == Kind::Keybind, "find-keybind");
    auto const* offFrom = ConfigBundleKeys::find("assist-off-1-from");
    expect(offFrom && offFrom->kind == Kind::Float, "find-float");
    expect(ConfigBundleKeys::find("no-such-setting") == nullptr, "find-miss");
    expect(ConfigBundleKeys::find(nullptr) == nullptr, "find-null");

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "ConfigBundleKeys selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("ConfigBundleKeys selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

`src/core/ConfigBundleKeys.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_CORE_CONFIGBUNDLEKEYS_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_CORE_CONFIGBUNDLEKEYS_HPP

#include <string>

// Portable Geode settings for ConfigBundle export/import.
// Excludes title rows and custom:eb-action buttons. Keep in sync with mod.json.
// Regenerate: python tools/gen_config_bundle_keys.py
class ConfigBundleKeys {
public:
    enum class Kind {
        Bool,
        Int,
        Float,
        String,
        Color,
        Keybind
    };

    struct Entry {
        char const* key;
        Kind kind;
    };

    static Entry const* begin();
    static Entry const* end();
    static int count();
    static Entry const* find(char const* key);

    // Count + uniqueness + kind validity. No Mod / disk required.
    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    ConfigBundleKeys() = default;
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_CORE_CONFIGBUNDLEKEYS_HPP
```
