`src/core/DecisionLog.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "DecisionLog.hpp"


void DecisionLog::clear() {
    m_entries.clear();
}

DecisionEntry& DecisionLog::push(DecisionEntry entry) {
    if (static_cast<int>(m_entries.size()) >= CAPACITY) {
        m_entries.erase(m_entries.begin());
    }
    m_entries.push_back(std::move(entry));
    return m_entries.back();
}

DecisionEntry* DecisionLog::latest() {
    return m_entries.empty() ? nullptr : &m_entries.back();
}

DecisionEntry const* DecisionLog::latest() const {
    return m_entries.empty() ? nullptr : &m_entries.back();
}

void DecisionLog::noteInput(int tick, bool down) {
    for (auto& e : m_entries) {
        if (e.resolved) continue;
        e.timeline.push_back(InputEvent{ tick, down });
    }
}

DecisionEntry* DecisionLog::findForDeath(int tick) {
    for (auto it = m_entries.rbegin(); it != m_entries.rend(); ++it) {
        if (it->resolved) continue;
        if (tick < it->tick) continue;
        if (tick - it->tick > it->horizon + it->limit + 8) continue;
        return &(*it);
    }
    return nullptr;
}
```

`src/core/DecisionLog.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_CORE_DECISIONLOG_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_CORE_DECISIONLOG_HPP

#include "ShadowSimulator.hpp"
#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <vector>
#include <optional>


struct DecisionEntry {
    int tick = 0;                 // effect / decision tick
    float x = 0.f;
    GameModeKind mode = GameModeKind::Cube;
    bool down = true;             // press vs release
    int delay = 0;                // planned delay (0 if Pass)
    int limit = 0;
    int firstDeathTick = -1;
    PlanAction action = PlanAction::Pass;
    bool nowIsSafe = false;
    int snapshotSlot = -1;
    int horizon = 48;             // ticks after decision to consider for survive/death
    bool resolved = false;        // survival / pessimism already applied
    bool assisted = false;        // Delay was chosen (or would have been)

    std::vector<InputEvent> timeline; // absolute ticks from decision onward
};

class DecisionLog {
public:
    static constexpr int CAPACITY = ShadowSimulator::SNAPSHOT_SLOTS;

    void clear();
    DecisionEntry& push(DecisionEntry entry);
    DecisionEntry* latest();
    DecisionEntry const* latest() const;

    // Append an input to the latest open decision's timeline (and any still open).
    void noteInput(int tick, bool down);

    // Iterate mutable entries (newest last).
    std::vector<DecisionEntry>& entries() { return m_entries; }
    std::vector<DecisionEntry> const& entries() const { return m_entries; }

    // Most recent unresolved decision whose window still covers `tick`.
    DecisionEntry* findForDeath(int tick);

private:
    std::vector<DecisionEntry> m_entries;
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_CORE_DECISIONLOG_HPP
```

`src/core/DivergenceTracker.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "DivergenceTracker.hpp"
#include <fmt/format.h>

DivergenceTracker& DivergenceTracker::get() {
    static DivergenceTracker inst;
    return inst;
}

void DivergenceTracker::note(bool planDelay, bool died, bool expectOrb, bool gotOrb) {
    // Bad: delayed assist still died, or orb expected but missed (death, or we
    // delayed for the orb and never hit it).
    bool bad = false;
    if (planDelay && died) bad = true;
    if (expectOrb && !gotOrb && (died || planDelay)) bad = true;
    m_bad[m_i] = bad;
    m_i = (m_i + 1) % N;
    if (m_count < N) ++m_count;
    if (mismatchRate() >= 0.45f && m_count >= 12) m_untrusted = true;
}

float DivergenceTracker::mismatchRate() const {
    if (m_count <= 0) return 0.f;
    int b = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < m_count; ++i) if (m_bad[i]) ++b;
    return static_cast<float>(b) / static_cast<float>(m_count);
}

bool DivergenceTracker::shouldWarn() const {
    return mismatchRate() >= 0.35f && m_count >= 8;
}

void DivergenceTracker::clear() {
    m_i = 0; m_count = 0; m_untrusted = false;
}

std::string DivergenceTracker::overlayBit() const {
    if (!shouldWarn() && !m_untrusted) return {};
    return fmt::format(
        "{}div{:.0f}%",
        m_untrusted ? "UNTRUST " : "WARN ",
        mismatchRate() * 100.f
    );
}

bool DivergenceTracker::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += "; ";
        report += name;
    };

    auto& d = get();
    d.clear();
    expect(!d.simUntrusted(), "fresh-clear");
    expect(d.mismatchRate() == 0.f, "fresh-rate");
    expect(!d.shouldWarn(), "fresh-warn");

    // 12 delayed deaths → UNTRUST (≥45% / n≥12).
    for (int i = 0; i < 12; ++i) {
        d.note(true, true, false, false);
    }
    expect(d.simUntrusted(), "untrust-after-12");
    expect(d.shouldWarn(), "warn-after-12");

    d.clear();
    expect(!d.simUntrusted(), "clear-resets-untrust");
    expect(d.mismatchRate() == 0.f, "clear-resets-rate");
    expect(!d.shouldWarn(), "clear-resets-warn");

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "DivergenceTracker selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = fmt::format("DivergenceTracker {} fails: {}", fails, report);
    return false;
}
```

`src/core/LevelContentKey.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "LevelContentKey.hpp"
#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace geode::prelude;

static uint64_t fnv1a(std::string const& s) {
    uint64_t h = 14695981039346656037ull;
    for (unsigned char c : s) {
        h ^= c;
        h *= 1099511628211ull;
    }
    return h;
}

std::string LevelContentKey::contentRev(GJGameLevel* level) {
    if (!level) return "0";
    std::string body;
    try {
        // gd::string -> std::string explicitly (Android STL rejects mixed +)
        body = std::string(level->m_levelString);
    }
    catch (...) {
        body.clear();
    }
    if (body.empty()) {
        try {
            body = fmt::format("{}{}", std::string(level->m_levelName), level->m_levelLength);
        }
        catch (...) {
            body = "empty";
        }
    }
    return fmt::format("{:x}", fnv1a(body));
}

std::string LevelContentKey::makeKey(GJGameLevel* level) {
    if (!level) return "unknown";
    if (level->m_levelID > 0) return fmt::format("id_{}", static_cast<int>(level->m_levelID));
    std::string name;
    try {
        name = std::string(level->m_levelName);
    }
    catch (...) {
        name = "ed";
    }
    return fmt::format("ed_{:x}", fnv1a(name));
}

std::string LevelContentKey::fullKey(GJGameLevel* level) {
    return fmt::format("{}_rev_{}", makeKey(level), contentRev(level));
}
```

`src/core/LevelProfile.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "LevelProfile.hpp"
#include "AssistLearning.hpp"
#include "LevelContentKey.hpp"
#include "../debug/AssistLog.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <Geode/utils/file.hpp>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>

using namespace geode::prelude;



static float clamp01f(float v, float lo, float hi) {
    return std::max(lo, std::min(hi, v));
}

static std::filesystem::path levelsDir() {
    return Mod::get()->getSaveDir() / "levels";
}

static std::filesystem::path profilePath(std::string const& key) {
    return levelsDir() / (key + ".json");
}



LevelProfile& LevelProfile::get() {
    static LevelProfile inst;
    return inst;
}

int LevelProfile::spotBucket(float x) {
    if (!std::isfinite(x)) return 0;
    return static_cast<int>(std::floor(x / SPOT_SIZE)) * static_cast<int>(SPOT_SIZE);
}

std::string LevelProfile::makeKey(GJGameLevel* level) {
    return LevelContentKey::fullKey(level);
}

void LevelProfile::clear() {
    m_key.clear();
    m_loaded = false;
    m_dirty = false;
    m_deathsSinceSave = 0;
    for (auto& m : m_modes) {
        m.capMul = 1.f;
        m.spots.clear();
    }
}

int LevelProfile::spotCount() const {
    int n = 0;
    for (auto const& m : m_modes) n += static_cast<int>(m.spots.size());
    return n;
}

ModeLearn& LevelProfile::mode(GameModeKind kind) {
    int i = static_cast<int>(kind);
    if (i < 0 || i >= StageConfig::MODE_COUNT) i = 0;
    return m_modes[i];
}

ModeLearn const* LevelProfile::tryMode(GameModeKind kind) const {
    int i = static_cast<int>(kind);
    if (i < 0 || i >= StageConfig::MODE_COUNT) return nullptr;
    return &m_modes[i];
}

SpotStats& LevelProfile::spot(GameModeKind kind, float x) {
    int const bucket = spotBucket(x);
    return mode(kind).spots[bucket];
}

SpotStats const* LevelProfile::trySpot(GameModeKind kind, float x) const {
    auto* m = tryMode(kind);
    if (!m) return nullptr;
    auto it = m->spots.find(spotBucket(x));
    if (it == m->spots.end()) return nullptr;
    return &it->second;
}

float LevelProfile::capMul(GameModeKind kind) const {
    auto* m = tryMode(kind);
    return m ? m->capMul : 1.f;
}

void LevelProfile::setCapMul(GameModeKind kind, float mul) {
    mode(kind).capMul = clamp01f(mul, 0.5f, 2.f);
    m_dirty = true;
}

SpotStats LevelProfile::overlaySpot(GameModeKind kind, float x) const {
    if (auto* s = trySpot(kind, x)) return *s;
    return {};
}

void LevelProfile::recomputeCapMul(GameModeKind kind) {
    auto& m = mode(kind);
    if (m.spots.empty()) {
        m.capMul = 1.f;
        return;
    }
    int pess = 0;
    int total = 0;
    for (auto const& [_, s] : m.spots) {
        pess += s.pessimism;
        total += std::max(1, s.n);
    }
    // Many false "you'll die" predictions → shorten horizon.
    float rate = static_cast<float>(pess) / static_cast<float>(total);
    if (rate > 0.25f) m.capMul = clamp01f(0.6f, 0.5f, 2.f);
    else if (rate < 0.05f && total >= 20) m.capMul = clamp01f(1.2f, 0.5f, 2.f);
    else m.capMul = clamp01f(m.capMul, 0.5f, 2.f);
}

void LevelProfile::noteBias(GameModeKind kind, float x, float delta, char const* reason) {
    auto& s = spot(kind, x);
    s.bias = clamp01f(s.bias + delta, -2.f, 2.f);
    s.n += 1;
    m_dirty = true;
    AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
        "LEARN: spot {} bias {:+.1f} ({})",
        spotBucket(x), s.bias, reason ? reason : ""
    ));
}

void LevelProfile::noteTrust(GameModeKind kind, float x, float factor, char const* reason) {
    auto& s = spot(kind, x);
    s.trust = clamp01f(s.trust * factor, 0.f, 1.f);
    s.n += 1;
    m_dirty = true;
    AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
        "LEARN: spot {} trust {:.2f} ({})",
        spotBucket(x), s.trust, reason ? reason : ""
    ));
}

void LevelProfile::noteTrustUp(GameModeKind kind, float x, float amount, char const* reason) {
    auto& s = spot(kind, x);
    s.trust = clamp01f(s.trust + amount, 0.f, 1.f);
    m_dirty = true;
    if (reason) {
        AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
            "LEARN: spot {} trust {:.2f} ({})",
            spotBucket(x), s.trust, reason
        ));
    }
}

void LevelProfile::notePessimism(GameModeKind kind, float x) {
    auto& s = spot(kind, x);
    s.pessimism += 1;
    s.n += 1;
    if (s.pessimism >= 3) {
        // Local: shorten look-ahead via mode capMul
        mode(kind).capMul = 0.6f;
    }
    recomputeCapMul(kind);
    m_dirty = true;
    AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
        "LEARN: spot {} pessimism {} (sim said die, lived)",
        spotBucket(x), s.pessimism
    ));
}

void LevelProfile::noteSaved(GameModeKind kind, float x) {
    auto& s = spot(kind, x);
    s.saved += 1;
    // Never reinforce trust from assist-inject "saves" (self-reinforcing loop).
    if (AssistLearning::allowTrustUpFromAssistInject()) {
        noteTrustUp(kind, x, 0.1f, "survived horizon");
    }
}

void LevelProfile::noteDiedAfterAssist(GameModeKind kind, float x) {
    auto& s = spot(kind, x);
    s.diedAfterAssist += 1;
    s.n += 1;
    m_dirty = true;
}

void LevelProfile::noteEarliness(GameModeKind kind, float x, int offset, char const* reason) {
    auto& s = spot(kind, x);
    int const clamped = std::max(-SpotStats::HIST_RADIUS, std::min(SpotStats::HIST_RADIUS, offset));
    int const bin = clamped + SpotStats::HIST_RADIUS;
    s.earlyHist[static_cast<size_t>(bin)] += 1.f;
    s.histN += 1;
    m_dirty = true;
    AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
        "LEARN: spot {} earliness {:+d} histN={} ({})",
        spotBucket(x), clamped, s.histN, reason ? reason : ""
    ));
}

int LevelProfile::preferredDelayOffset(GameModeKind kind, float x) const {
    auto const* s = trySpot(kind, x);
    if (!s || s->histN < 3) {
        if (!s) return 0;
        // Fall back to classic ±2 bias.
        if (s->bias >= 0.f) return static_cast<int>(std::lround(s->bias));
        return static_cast<int>(std::lround(s->bias));
    }
    int bestBin = SpotStats::HIST_RADIUS;
    float bestW = -1.f;
    for (int i = 0; i < SpotStats::HIST_BINS; ++i) {
        float const w = s->earlyHist[static_cast<size_t>(i)] + 1.f; // Laplace
        if (w > bestW) {
            bestW = w;
            bestBin = i;
        }
    }
    return bestBin - SpotStats::HIST_RADIUS;
}

void LevelProfile::decayHistograms() {
    for (auto& m : m_modes) {
        for (auto& [_, s] : m.spots) {
            for (float& w : s.earlyHist) w *= 0.95f;
        }
    }
    m_dirty = true;
}

void LevelProfile::maybeAutosave() {
    ++m_deathsSinceSave;
    if (m_deathsSinceSave >= 5) {
        m_deathsSinceSave = 0;
        decayHistograms();
        // Do not sync-write during destroyPlayer — quit / complete persist.
        // m_dirty is already set by note* / decayHistograms.
    }
}

void LevelProfile::loadForLevel(GJGameLevel* level) {
    clear();
    m_key = makeKey(level);
    m_loaded = true;
    auto res = readFile();
    if (res.isErr()) {
        AssistLog::debug(fmt::format("LEARN: no profile for {} (fresh)", m_key));
    }
    else {
        AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
            "LEARN: loaded {} ({} spots)", m_key, spotCount()
        ));
    }
}

void LevelProfile::resetCurrent() {
    if (!m_loaded) return;
    for (auto& m : m_modes) {
        m.capMul = 1.f;
        m.spots.clear();
    }
    m_dirty = true;
    save();
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format("LEARN: reset profile {}", m_key));
}

void LevelProfile::save() {
    if (!m_loaded || m_key.empty()) return;
    if (!m_dirty) return;
    auto res = writeFile();
    if (res.isOk()) {
        m_dirty = false;
        AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
            "LEARN: profile saved ({} spots)", spotCount()
        ));
    }
    else {
        AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
            "LEARN: save failed: {}", res.unwrapErr()
        ));
    }
}

Result<> LevelProfile::writeFile() const {
    auto dir = levelsDir();
    (void)file::createDirectoryAll(dir);

    matjson::Value root = matjson::Value::object();
    root["key"] = m_key;
    root["version"] = 1;

    matjson::Value modes = matjson::Value::object();
    for (int i = 0; i < StageConfig::MODE_COUNT; ++i) {
        auto const kind = static_cast<GameModeKind>(i);
        auto const& m = m_modes[i];
        if (m.spots.empty() && std::abs(m.capMul - 1.f) < 0.01f) continue;

        matjson::Value mj = matjson::Value::object();
        mj["capMul"] = m.capMul;
        matjson::Value spots = matjson::Value::object();
        for (auto const& [bucket, s] : m.spots) {
            matjson::Value sj = matjson::Value::object();
            sj["bias"] = s.bias;
            sj["trust"] = s.trust;
            sj["pessimism"] = s.pessimism;
            sj["n"] = s.n;
            sj["saved"] = s.saved;
            sj["diedAfterAssist"] = s.diedAfterAssist;
            sj["histN"] = s.histN;
            if (s.histN > 0) {
                std::vector<matjson::Value> hist;
                hist.reserve(SpotStats::HIST_BINS);
                for (float w : s.earlyHist) hist.push_back(w);
                sj["earlyHist"] = hist;
            }
            spots[std::to_string(bucket)] = sj;
        }
        mj["spots"] = spots;
        modes[StageConfig::kindName(kind)] = mj;
    }
    root["modes"] = modes;

    auto path = profilePath(m_key);
    return file::writeToJson(path, root);
}

Result<> LevelProfile::readFile() {
    auto path = profilePath(m_key);
    auto res = file::readJson(path);
    if (res.isErr()) return Err(res.unwrapErr());

    auto root = res.unwrap();
    if (!root.contains("modes") || !root["modes"].isObject()) return Ok();

    auto& modes = root["modes"];
    for (int i = 0; i < StageConfig::MODE_COUNT; ++i) {
        auto const* name = StageConfig::kindName(static_cast<GameModeKind>(i));
        if (!modes.contains(name)) continue;
        auto& mj = modes[name];
        auto& m = m_modes[i];
        if (mj.contains("capMul")) {
            m.capMul = clamp01f(static_cast<float>(mj["capMul"].asDouble().unwrapOr(1.0)), 0.5f, 2.f);
        }
        if (mj.contains("spots") && mj["spots"].isObject()) {
            for (auto const& [k, sj] : mj["spots"]) {
                int bucket = 0;
                try { bucket = std::stoi(k); }
                catch (...) { continue; }
                SpotStats s;
                if (sj.contains("bias")) s.bias = clamp01f(static_cast<float>(sj["bias"].asDouble().unwrapOr(0.0)), -2.f, 2.f);
                if (sj.contains("trust")) s.trust = clamp01f(static_cast<float>(sj["trust"].asDouble().unwrapOr(1.0)), 0.f, 1.f);
                if (sj.contains("pessimism")) s.pessimism = static_cast<int>(sj["pessimism"].asInt().unwrapOr(0));
                if (sj.contains("n")) s.n = static_cast<int>(sj["n"].asInt().unwrapOr(0));
                if (sj.contains("saved")) s.saved = static_cast<int>(sj["saved"].asInt().unwrapOr(0));
                if (sj.contains("diedAfterAssist")) s.diedAfterAssist = static_cast<int>(sj["diedAfterAssist"].asInt().unwrapOr(0));
                if (sj.contains("histN")) s.histN = static_cast<int>(sj["histN"].asInt().unwrapOr(0));
                if (sj.contains("earlyHist") && sj["earlyHist"].isArray()) {
                    size_t bi = 0;
                    for (auto const& cell : sj["earlyHist"]) {
                        if (bi >= SpotStats::HIST_BINS) break;
                        s.earlyHist[bi] = static_cast<float>(cell.asDouble().unwrapOr(0.0));
                        ++bi;
                    }
                }
                m.spots[bucket] = s;
            }
        }
    }
    m_dirty = false;
    return Ok();
}
```

`src/core/LevelProfile.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_CORE_LEVELPROFILE_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_CORE_LEVELPROFILE_HPP

#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>


struct SpotStats {
    static constexpr int HIST_RADIUS = 8;                 // bins cover [-8, +8]
    static constexpr int HIST_BINS = HIST_RADIUS * 2 + 1; // 17

    float bias = 0.f;       // [-2, +2], applied as round(bias) on Delay
    float trust = 1.f;      // [0, 1]
    int pessimism = 0;
    int n = 0;
    int saved = 0;
    int diedAfterAssist = 0;
    // Click-earliness histogram (vanilla/Pass/postmortem only; never inject saves).
    // Bin i stores weight for offset (i - HIST_RADIUS) ticks.
    std::array<float, HIST_BINS> earlyHist{};
    int histN = 0;
};

struct ModeLearn {
    float capMul = 1.f;     // [0.5, 2.0]
    std::unordered_map<int, SpotStats> spots; // key = x-bucket
};

// Per-level learned assist tuning. Window (ticks) is NEVER touched.
class LevelProfile {
public:
    static constexpr float SPOT_SIZE = 90.f; // ~3 blocks
    static constexpr float TRUST_PASS_THRESHOLD = 0.35f;
    static constexpr int TRUST_PASS_MIN_N = 4;

    static LevelProfile& get();

    void loadForLevel(GJGameLevel* level);
    void save();
    void resetCurrent();
    void clear();

    bool loaded() const { return m_loaded; }
    std::string const& key() const { return m_key; }
    int spotCount() const;

    static int spotBucket(float x);
    static std::string makeKey(GJGameLevel* level);

    SpotStats& spot(GameModeKind kind, float x);
    SpotStats const* trySpot(GameModeKind kind, float x) const;
    float capMul(GameModeKind kind) const;
    void setCapMul(GameModeKind kind, float mul);

    // Learning updates
    void noteBias(GameModeKind kind, float x, float delta, char const* reason);
    void noteTrust(GameModeKind kind, float x, float factor, char const* reason);
    void noteTrustUp(GameModeKind kind, float x, float amount, char const* reason);
    void notePessimism(GameModeKind kind, float x);
    void noteSaved(GameModeKind kind, float x);
    void noteDiedAfterAssist(GameModeKind kind, float x);

    // Earliness offset in ticks (−HIST_RADIUS…+HIST_RADIUS). Laplace-smoothed modal
    // used as delay bias when histN is large enough; empty hist → fall back to bias.
    void noteEarliness(GameModeKind kind, float x, int offset, char const* reason);
    int preferredDelayOffset(GameModeKind kind, float x) const;
    void decayHistograms(); // exponential bin decay (autosave)

    void maybeAutosave(); // every 5 deaths
    void markDirty() { m_dirty = true; }

    // Overlay helpers
    SpotStats overlaySpot(GameModeKind kind, float x) const;

private:
    LevelProfile() = default;

    ModeLearn& mode(GameModeKind kind);
    ModeLearn const* tryMode(GameModeKind kind) const;
    void recomputeCapMul(GameModeKind kind);
    geode::Result<> writeFile() const;
    geode::Result<> readFile();

    std::string m_key;
    bool m_loaded = false;
    bool m_dirty = false;
    int m_deathsSinceSave = 0;
    ModeLearn m_modes[StageConfig::MODE_COUNT];
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_CORE_LEVELPROFILE_HPP

```

`src/core/MissAssistContracts.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "MissAssistContracts.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

int MissAssistContracts::clampDelayToWindow(int delay, int limit) {
    if (limit <= 0) return 0;
    if (delay < 0) return 0;
    if (delay > limit) return limit;
    return delay;
}

int MissAssistContracts::fireDeadline(int pressTick, int limit) {
    int const lim = std::max(0, limit);
    if (pressTick > 0x7fffffff - lim) return 0x7fffffff;
    return pressTick + lim;
}

MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction MissAssistContracts::legacyExpect(
    bool d0Viable, int earliestViableDelay
) {
    if (d0Viable) return MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Pass;
    if (earliestViableDelay > 0) return MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Delay;
    return MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Pass;
}

int MissAssistContracts::legacyDelay(
    bool d0Viable, int earliestViableDelay, int limit
) {
    if (d0Viable) return 0;
    if (earliestViableDelay <= 0) return 0;
    return MissAssistContracts::clampDelayToWindow(earliestViableDelay, limit);
}

MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction MissAssistContracts::newExpect(
    int bestInWindow, int limit
) {
    int const d = MissAssistContracts::clampDelayToWindow(bestInWindow, limit);
    if (d > 0) return MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Delay;
    return MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Pass;
}

int MissAssistContracts::newDelay(int bestInWindow, int limit) {
    return MissAssistContracts::clampDelayToWindow(bestInWindow, limit);
}

bool MissAssistContracts::preferBandEarlyExitAllowed(
    bool orbAssist, bool orbHintFound, bool spatialHint, bool foresightOrbPad
) {
    if (!orbAssist) return true;
    if (orbHintFound || spatialHint || foresightOrbPad) return false;
    return true;
}

// Table mirrors docs/assist_reference.md "Miss-assist contracts".
// idealOutside may exceed limit — assist must still clamp.
static MissAssistContracts::EarlyPressCase const s_cases[] = {
    {
        "early10-limit16-d0-safe-better10",
        16, 10, 10, true, 10,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Pass, 0,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Delay, 10,
        AssistReason::PassD0Safe
    },
    {
        "ideal6-limit4-best4",
        4, 6, 4, false, 4,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Delay, 4,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Delay, 4,
        AssistReason::None
    },
    {
        "ideal6-limit4-d0-safe-best4",
        4, 6, 4, true, 4,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Pass, 0,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Delay, 4,
        AssistReason::PassD0Safe
    },
    {
        "empty-corridor",
        16, 0, 0, true, -1,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Pass, 0,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Pass, 0,
        AssistReason::PassNoThreat
    },
    {
        "spike-d0-dies-earliest8",
        16, 8, 8, false, 8,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Delay, 8,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Delay, 8,
        AssistReason::None
    },
    {
        "hopeless-in-window",
        8, 20, 0, false, -1,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Pass, 0,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Pass, 0,
        AssistReason::PassHopeless
    },
    {
        "ten-display-frames-outside-limit16",
        16, 40, 0, true, -1,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Pass, 0,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Pass, 0,
        AssistReason::PassNoThreat
    },
    {
        "orb-activation-best12-d0-safe",
        16, 12, 12, true, 12,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Pass, 0,
        MissAssistContracts::ExpectAction::Delay, 12,
        AssistReason::PassD0Safe
    },
};

static int const s_caseCount =
    static_cast<int>(sizeof(s_cases) / sizeof(s_cases[0]));

int MissAssistContracts::caseCount() {
    return s_caseCount;
}

MissAssistContracts::EarlyPressCase const& MissAssistContracts::caseAt(int index) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= s_caseCount) {
        return s_cases[0];
    }
    return s_cases[index];
}

bool MissAssistContracts::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* label) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += ", ";
        report += label;
    };

    expect(MissAssistContracts::clampDelayToWindow(6, 4) == 4, "clamp-6-to-4");
    expect(MissAssistContracts::clampDelayToWindow(3, 4) == 3, "clamp-3-in-4");
    expect(MissAssistContracts::clampDelayToWindow(0, 4) == 0, "clamp-0");
    expect(MissAssistContracts::clampDelayToWindow(-2, 4) == 0, "clamp-neg");
    expect(MissAssistContracts::clampDelayToWindow(8, 0) == 0, "clamp-limit0");
    expect(MissAssistContracts::clampDelayToWindow(8, -1) == 0, "clamp-limit-neg");
    expect(MissAssistContracts::clampDelayToWindow(16, 16) == 16, "clamp-eq");

    expect(MissAssistContracts::fireDeadline(100, 16) == 116, "deadline-116");
    expect(MissAssistContracts::fireDeadline(0, 8) == 8, "deadline-8");
    expect(MissAssistContracts::fireDeadline(50, 0) == 50, "deadline-limit0");

    expect(
        MissAssistContracts::legacyExpect(true, 10) == ExpectAction::Pass,
        "legacy-d0-pass"
    );
    expect(
        MissAssistContracts::legacyDelay(true, 10, 16) == 0,
        "legacy-d0-delay0"
    );
    expect(
        MissAssistContracts::legacyExpect(false, 8) == ExpectAction::Delay,
        "legacy-earliest-delay"
    );
    expect(
        MissAssistContracts::legacyDelay(false, 8, 16) == 8,
        "legacy-earliest-8"
    );
    expect(
        MissAssistContracts::legacyDelay(false, 20, 16) == 16,
        "legacy-clamp-20-to-16"
    );
    expect(
        MissAssistContracts::legacyExpect(false, -1) == ExpectAction::Pass,
        "legacy-hopeless-pass"
    );

    expect(
        MissAssistContracts::newExpect(10, 16) == ExpectAction::Delay,
        "new-best10"
    );
    expect(MissAssistContracts::newDelay(10, 16) == 10, "new-delay10");
    expect(
        MissAssistContracts::newExpect(0, 16) == ExpectAction::Pass,
        "new-best0-pass"
    );
    expect(MissAssistContracts::newDelay(6, 4) == 4, "new-clamp-6-to-4");
    expect(
        MissAssistContracts::newExpect(6, 4) == ExpectAction::Delay,
        "new-clamped-still-delay"
    );

    // Legacy-only helper: New pick never early-exits (wired in plan()).
    expect(
        MissAssistContracts::preferBandEarlyExitAllowed(false, true, true, true),
        "prefer-exit-no-orb-assist"
    );
    expect(
        MissAssistContracts::preferBandEarlyExitAllowed(true, false, false, false),
        "prefer-exit-orb-idle"
    );
    expect(
        !MissAssistContracts::preferBandEarlyExitAllowed(true, true, false, false),
        "prefer-exit-block-hint"
    );
    expect(
        !MissAssistContracts::preferBandEarlyExitAllowed(true, false, true, false),
        "prefer-exit-block-spatial"
    );
    expect(
        !MissAssistContracts::preferBandEarlyExitAllowed(true, false, false, true),
        "prefer-exit-block-foresight"
    );

    expect(MissAssistContracts::caseCount() >= 6, "case-count");
    for (int i = 0; i < MissAssistContracts::caseCount(); ++i) {
        auto const& c = MissAssistContracts::caseAt(i);
        expect(c.name != nullptr && c.name[0] != '\0', "case-name");
        expect(c.limit >= 0, "case-limit");

        int const newD = MissAssistContracts::newDelay(c.bestInWindow, c.limit);
        expect(newD <= c.limit, "case-new-leq-limit");
        expect(newD == c.newDelayExpect, "case-new-delay");
        expect(
            MissAssistContracts::newExpect(c.bestInWindow, c.limit) == c.newAction,
            "case-new-action"
        );

        int const legD = MissAssistContracts::legacyDelay(
            c.d0Viable, c.earliestViable, c.limit
        );
        expect(legD <= c.limit, "case-legacy-leq-limit");
        expect(legD == c.legacyDelayExpect, "case-legacy-delay");
        expect(
            MissAssistContracts::legacyExpect(c.d0Viable, c.earliestViable)
                == c.legacyAction,
            "case-legacy-action"
        );

        expect(
            MissAssistContracts::fireDeadline(0, c.limit) == c.limit,
            "case-deadline"
        );

        if (c.passReasonHint != AssistReason::None) {
            expect(AssistVerdict::isKnown(c.passReasonHint), "case-reason-known");
            if (c.legacyAction == ExpectAction::Pass
                || c.newAction == ExpectAction::Pass) {
                expect(AssistVerdict::isPass(c.passReasonHint), "case-reason-pass");
            }
        }
    }

    expect(
        MissAssistContracts::newDelay(6, 4) == 4
            && MissAssistContracts::legacyDelay(false, 6, 4) == 4,
        "g1-never-beyond-window"
    );

    {
        auto const& c = MissAssistContracts::caseAt(0);
        expect(
            c.legacyAction == ExpectAction::Pass
                && c.newAction == ExpectAction::Delay
                && c.newDelayExpect == 10,
            "early10-new-vs-legacy"
        );
    }

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "MissAssistContracts selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("MissAssistContracts selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

`src/core/MissAssistContracts.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef MISS_ASSIST_CONTRACTS_HPP
#define MISS_ASSIST_CONTRACTS_HPP

#include "AssistVerdict.hpp"

#include <string>

// Pure logic contracts for early-press / miss-assist (no PlayLayer).
// PlanGold + future pick modes (Legacy vs New) share these fixtures.
class MissAssistContracts {
public:
    enum class PickMode {
        Legacy,
        New
    };

    enum class ExpectAction {
        Pass,
        Delay
    };

    // G1 hard window cap: result always in [0, limit]. limit <= 0 → 0.
    static int clampDelayToWindow(int delay, int limit);

    // Absolute fire deadline: pressTick + limit (limit <= 0 → pressTick).
    static int fireDeadline(int pressTick, int limit);

    // Legacy (1.2.0 feel): d0 viable → Pass. Else earliest viable in window.
    // earliestViableDelay: -1 = none; if >= 0 must already be intended in-window.
    static ExpectAction legacyExpect(bool d0Viable, int earliestViableDelay);
    static int legacyDelay(bool d0Viable, int earliestViableDelay, int limit);

    // New (prefer-delay): bestInWindow already picked among 0..limit (0 = Pass now).
    static ExpectAction newExpect(int bestInWindow, int limit);
    static int newDelay(int bestInWindow, int limit);

    // Prefer-band early-exit (C10): allowed only when orb foresight/window is idle.
    // When orbAssist && (orbHint|spatial|foresight), keep searching past prefer so
    // activations outside the bake prefer band are still evaluated (Orb before Prefer).
    static bool preferBandEarlyExitAllowed(
        bool orbAssist, bool orbHintFound, bool spatialHint, bool foresightOrbPad
    );

    // One synthetic early-press row for table-driven selfCheck / docs.
    struct EarlyPressCase {
        char const* name = "";
        int limit = 0;
        int idealOutside = 0;       // "true" best may lie past window (informational)
        int bestInWindow = 0;       // best viable among 0..limit (New pick input)
        bool d0Viable = false;
        int earliestViable = -1;    // Legacy earliest viable (-1 none)
        ExpectAction legacyAction = ExpectAction::Pass;
        int legacyDelayExpect = 0;
        ExpectAction newAction = ExpectAction::Pass;
        int newDelayExpect = 0;
        AssistReason passReasonHint = AssistReason::None; // docs / overlay mapping
    };

    static int caseCount();
    static EarlyPressCase const& caseAt(int index);

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    MissAssistContracts() = default;
};

#endif // MISS_ASSIST_CONTRACTS_HPP

```

`src/core/OpportunityProbe.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "OpportunityProbe.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

int OpportunityProbe::midDelay(int limit) {
    if (limit <= 0) return 0;
    int mid = limit / 2;
    if (mid < 1) mid = 1;
    if (mid > limit) mid = limit;
    return mid;
}

int OpportunityProbe::orbScanTicks(int limit, int slack) {
    int const lim = std::max(0, limit);
    int const sl = std::max(0, slack);
    return std::max(lim + sl + 4, lim + 1);
}

int OpportunityProbe::pressReachScanTicks(int limit, int slack) {
    int const base = OpportunityProbe::orbScanTicks(limit, slack);
    return std::min(base, OpportunityProbe::kMaxPressReachExtraTicks);
}

bool OpportunityProbe::sampleShowsOpportunity(
    Sample const& baseline, Sample const& probe
) {
    if (probe.diedBeforeAction) return false;
    if (probe.activatedRing && !baseline.activatedRing) return true;
    if (probe.surviveBin > baseline.surviveBin) return true;
    float const gain = probe.endX - baseline.endX;
    if (gain >= OpportunityProbe::kEndXGain) return true;
    return false;
}

bool OpportunityProbe::shouldSearchFurther(
    bool foresightOrbPad,
    bool orbWindowFound,
    bool d0ActivatedRing,
    Sample const& baseline,
    Sample const* probes,
    int probeCount
) {
    if (foresightOrbPad) return true;
    if (orbWindowFound) return true;
    if (d0ActivatedRing) return true;
    if (!probes || probeCount <= 0) return false;
    for (int i = 0; i < probeCount; ++i) {
        if (OpportunityProbe::sampleShowsOpportunity(baseline, probes[i])) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

bool OpportunityProbe::allowPassNoThreat(
    bool foresightOrbPad,
    bool orbWindowFound,
    bool d0ActivatedRing,
    Sample const& baseline,
    Sample const* probes,
    int probeCount
) {
    return !OpportunityProbe::shouldSearchFurther(
        foresightOrbPad,
        orbWindowFound,
        d0ActivatedRing,
        baseline,
        probes,
        probeCount
    );
}

bool OpportunityProbe::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* label) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += ", ";
        report += label;
    };

    expect(OpportunityProbe::midDelay(16) == 8, "mid-16");
    expect(OpportunityProbe::midDelay(1) == 1, "mid-1");
    expect(OpportunityProbe::midDelay(0) == 0, "mid-0");
    expect(OpportunityProbe::midDelay(5) == 2, "mid-5");

    expect(OpportunityProbe::orbScanTicks(16, 2) == 22, "scan-16-2");
    expect(OpportunityProbe::orbScanTicks(2, 0) == 6, "scan-2-0");
    expect(OpportunityProbe::orbScanTicks(0, 0) == 1, "scan-0");
    expect(
        OpportunityProbe::pressReachScanTicks(64, 8)
            == OpportunityProbe::kMaxPressReachExtraTicks,
        "press-reach-cap"
    );

    Sample base{};
    base.surviveBin = 0;
    base.endX = 100.f;

    Sample betterEnd = base;
    betterEnd.endX = 100.f + OpportunityProbe::kEndXGain;
    expect(
        OpportunityProbe::sampleShowsOpportunity(base, betterEnd),
        "opp-endx"
    );

    Sample tinyEnd = base;
    tinyEnd.endX = 100.f + 3.f;
    expect(
        !OpportunityProbe::sampleShowsOpportunity(base, tinyEnd),
        "opp-endx-small"
    );

    Sample betterBin = base;
    betterBin.surviveBin = 1;
    expect(
        OpportunityProbe::sampleShowsOpportunity(base, betterBin),
        "opp-bin"
    );

    Sample act = base;
    act.activatedRing = true;
    expect(
        OpportunityProbe::sampleShowsOpportunity(base, act),
        "opp-ring"
    );

    Sample died = act;
    died.diedBeforeAction = true;
    expect(
        !OpportunityProbe::sampleShowsOpportunity(base, died),
        "opp-died-before"
    );

    // G2: foresight hit + d0 alive → must search (never PassNoThreat).
    expect(
        OpportunityProbe::shouldSearchFurther(
            true, false, false, base, nullptr, 0
        ),
        "g2-foresight-search"
    );
    expect(
        !OpportunityProbe::allowPassNoThreat(
            true, false, false, base, nullptr, 0
        ),
        "g2-foresight-no-pass"
    );

    expect(
        OpportunityProbe::shouldSearchFurther(
            false, true, false, base, nullptr, 0
        ),
        "g2-orbwin-search"
    );
    expect(
        OpportunityProbe::shouldSearchFurther(
            false, false, true, base, nullptr, 0
        ),
        "g2-d0-ring-search"
    );

    Sample probes[2];
    probes[0] = betterEnd;
    expect(
        OpportunityProbe::shouldSearchFurther(
            false, false, false, base, probes, 1
        ),
        "g2-probe-search"
    );
    expect(
        !OpportunityProbe::allowPassNoThreat(
            false, false, false, base, probes, 1
        ),
        "g2-probe-no-pass"
    );

    Sample emptyProbe = base;
    probes[0] = emptyProbe;
    expect(
        !OpportunityProbe::shouldSearchFurther(
            false, false, false, base, probes, 1
        ),
        "g2-empty-no-search"
    );
    expect(
        OpportunityProbe::allowPassNoThreat(
            false, false, false, base, probes, 1
        ),
        "g2-empty-allow-pass"
    );
    expect(
        OpportunityProbe::allowPassNoThreat(
            false, false, false, base, nullptr, 0
        ),
        "g2-no-probes-allow-pass"
    );

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "OpportunityProbe selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("OpportunityProbe selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

`src/core/OpportunityProbe.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef OPPORTUNITY_PROBE_HPP
#define OPPORTUNITY_PROBE_HPP

#include <string>

// G2 gate before Pass no-threat: foresight or cheap mid/limit probes may
// force a full delay search even when d0 survives with no threat zone.
class OpportunityProbe {
public:
    // Same endX gain idea as wave futile (ShadowSimulator::kFutileEndXGain).
    static constexpr float kEndXGain = 8.f;
    // Min ticks left in budget to attempt one probe runOne-worth of work.
    static constexpr int kMinBudgetForProbe = 24;
    // Cap press-to-reach orb scan extras.
    static constexpr int kMaxPressReachExtraTicks = 48;

    struct Sample {
        bool activatedRing = false;
        bool diedBeforeAction = false;
        int surviveBin = 0;
        float endX = 0.f;
    };

    // Delay for the mid probe (limit/2), clamped to [1, limit].
    static int midDelay(int limit);

    // Orb-window coast scan length: max(limit+slack+4, limit+1).
    static int orbScanTicks(int limit, int slack);

    // Extra press-held scan ticks when coast scan missed (capped).
    static int pressReachScanTicks(int limit, int slack);

    // Probe improves on baseline (activation miss, better bin, or endX gain).
    static bool sampleShowsOpportunity(Sample const& baseline, Sample const& probe);

    // True → do NOT Pass no-threat; continue full cand search.
    // foresightOrbPad / orbWindowFound / d0Activated already force search.
    static bool shouldSearchFurther(
        bool foresightOrbPad,
        bool orbWindowFound,
        bool d0ActivatedRing,
        Sample const& baseline,
        Sample const* probes,
        int probeCount
    );

    // Allow PassNoThreat only when search-further is false.
    static bool allowPassNoThreat(
        bool foresightOrbPad,
        bool orbWindowFound,
        bool d0ActivatedRing,
        Sample const& baseline,
        Sample const* probes,
        int probeCount
    );

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    OpportunityProbe() = default;
};

#endif // OPPORTUNITY_PROBE_HPP
```

`src/core/PlatformLimits.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "PlatformLimits.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <algorithm>

PlatformLimits& PlatformLimits::get() {
    static PlatformLimits inst;
    return inst;
}

bool PlatformLimits::allowLoadDiskSelfCheck() const {
#ifdef GEODE_IS_ANDROID
    (void)this;
    return false;
#else
    (void)this;
    return true;
#endif
}

int PlatformLimits::clampSimBudgetUs(int requestedUs) const {
    (void)this;
    if (requestedUs <= 0) return requestedUs; // 0 = unlimited wall clock
#ifdef GEODE_IS_ANDROID
    return std::min(requestedUs, kAndroidMaxSimBudgetUs);
#else
    return requestedUs;
#endif
}

int PlatformLimits::clampTickBudget(int requestedTicks) const {
    (void)this;
#ifdef GEODE_IS_ANDROID
    if (requestedTicks <= 0) return kAndroidMaxTickBudget;
    return std::min(requestedTicks, kAndroidMaxTickBudget);
#else
    return requestedTicks;
#endif
}

float PlatformLimits::overlayTopInset() const {
    (void)this;
#ifdef GEODE_IS_ANDROID
    return kAndroidOverlayTopInset;
#else
    return kDefaultOverlayTopInset;
#endif
}

float PlatformLimits::overlayLeftInset() const {
    (void)this;
    return kDefaultOverlayLeftInset;
}

bool PlatformLimits::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (!ok) {
            ++fails;
            report += std::string("FAIL ") + name + "; ";
        }
    };

    auto& lim = PlatformLimits::get();
    expect(lim.clampSimBudgetUs(0) == 0, "sim-unlimited");
    expect(lim.clampSimBudgetUs(500) == 500, "sim-below-cap");
    expect(lim.overlayLeftInset() == kDefaultOverlayLeftInset, "overlay-left");
#ifdef GEODE_IS_ANDROID
    expect(!lim.allowLoadDiskSelfCheck(), "android-no-disk-gold");
    expect(lim.clampSimBudgetUs(10000) == kAndroidMaxSimBudgetUs, "sim-cap");
    expect(lim.clampTickBudget(20000) == kAndroidMaxTickBudget, "tick-cap");
    expect(lim.overlayTopInset() == kAndroidOverlayTopInset, "overlay-top-android");
#else
    expect(lim.allowLoadDiskSelfCheck(), "disk-gold-ok");
    expect(lim.clampSimBudgetUs(10000) == 10000, "sim-passthrough");
    expect(lim.clampTickBudget(20000) == 20000, "tick-passthrough");
    expect(lim.overlayTopInset() == kDefaultOverlayTopInset, "overlay-top-desktop");
#endif

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "PlatformLimits selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("PlatformLimits selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

`src/core/PlatformLimits.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_CORE_PLATFORMLIMITS_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_CORE_PLATFORMLIMITS_HPP

#include <string>

// Platform ceilings / load-path policy. Windows/mac/iOS: passthrough.
// Android: tighter planner budgets + no disk PlanGold on mod load.
class PlatformLimits {
public:
    static PlatformLimits& get();

    // When false, DevTraceStore / DevCycleRecorder selfChecks must stay in-memory
    // (no beginSession/flush/reload). Used on Android $on_mod(Loaded).
    bool allowLoadDiskSelfCheck() const;

    // Ceiling for StageConfig::simBudgetUs() (0 = unlimited stays 0).
    int clampSimBudgetUs(int requestedUs) const;

    // Ceiling for StageConfig::tickBudgetPerPress().
    int clampTickBudget(int requestedTicks) const;

    // Status overlay distance from top / left of the win size (points).
    float overlayTopInset() const;
    float overlayLeftInset() const;

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    PlatformLimits() = default;

    static constexpr int kAndroidMaxSimBudgetUs = 2000;
    static constexpr int kAndroidMaxTickBudget = 2000;
    static constexpr float kDefaultOverlayTopInset = 10.f;
    static constexpr float kAndroidOverlayTopInset = 28.f;
    static constexpr float kDefaultOverlayLeftInset = 10.f;
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_CORE_PLATFORMLIMITS_HPP
```

`src/core/ReplayImport.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "ReplayImport.hpp"

#include <gdr/gdr.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <span>

using namespace geode::prelude;



struct EbGdr : gdr::Replay<EbGdr, gdr::Input<>> {
    EbGdr() : Replay("earlybuffer", 1) {}
};

std::string lowerExt(std::filesystem::path const& path) {
    auto e = path.extension().string();
    std::transform(e.begin(), e.end(), e.begin(), [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); });
    return e;
}

std::string fileStemName(std::filesystem::path const& path) {
    return path.filename().string();
}

bool isMhrJsonName(std::filesystem::path const& path) {
    auto name = path.filename().string();
    std::transform(name.begin(), name.end(), name.begin(), [](unsigned char c) {
        return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c));
    });
    return name.ends_with(".mhr.json") || (lowerExt(path) == ".json" && name.find("mhr") != std::string::npos);
}

template <class T>
T readLE(std::ifstream& f) {
    T v{};
    f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&v), sizeof(T));
    return v;
}

template <class T>
T readBE(std::ifstream& f) {
    uint8_t b[sizeof(T)];
    f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(b), sizeof(T));
    T v = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(T); ++i) {
        v = static_cast<T>((v << 8) | b[i]);
    }
    return v;
}


Result<ImportedReplay> ReplayImport::load(std::filesystem::path const& path) {
    if (!std::filesystem::exists(path)) return Err("File not found");

    auto ext = lowerExt(path);
    auto name = path.filename().string();
    std::transform(name.begin(), name.end(), name.begin(), [](unsigned char c) {
        return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c));
    });

    if (ext == ".gdr" || ext == ".gdr2") return loadGdr(path);
    if (name.ends_with(".mhr.json") || isMhrJsonName(path)) return loadMhrJson(path);
    if (ext == ".mhr") {
        // JSON saved as .mhr, or binary HACK magic
        std::ifstream probe(path, std::ios::binary);
        if (!probe) return Err("Failed to open file");
        char head[8]{};
        probe.read(head, 8);
        if (head[0] == '{' || head[0] == '[') return loadMhrJson(path);
        return loadMhrBin(path);
    }
    if (ext == ".slc") return loadSlc(path);
    if (ext == ".json") {
        // Try MHR-shaped JSON, else fail
        auto mhr = loadMhrJson(path);
        if (mhr.isOk()) return mhr;
        return Err("Unsupported .json (expected MegaHack meta/events layout)");
    }

    // Magic sniff
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    char magic[4]{};
    f.read(magic, 4);
    if (std::string_view(magic, 3) == "GDR") return loadGdr(path);
    if (std::string_view(magic, 4) == "SILL") return loadSlc(path);
    if (magic[0] == '{') return loadMhrJson(path);

    return Err(fmt::format("Unsupported replay format: {}", path.filename().string()));
}

Result<ImportedReplay> ReplayImport::loadGdr(std::filesystem::path const& path) {
    auto res = EbGdr::importData(path);
    if (res.isErr()) return Err(res.unwrapErr());

    auto const& r = res.unwrap();
    ImportedReplay out;
    out.tps = r.framerate > 0.0 ? r.framerate : 240.0;
    out.sourceName = fileStemName(path);
    out.format = "gdr2";
    out.events.reserve(r.inputs.size());
    for (auto const& in : r.inputs) {
        ReplayEvent e;
        e.frame = static_cast<int>(in.frame);
        e.button = in.button == 0 ? 1 : static_cast<int>(in.button);
        e.player2 = in.player2;
        e.down = in.down;
        out.events.push_back(e);
    }
    std::stable_sort(out.events.begin(), out.events.end(), [](auto const& a, auto const& b) {
        return a.frame < b.frame;
    });
    return Ok(std::move(out));
}

Result<ImportedReplay> ReplayImport::loadMhrJson(std::filesystem::path const& path) {
    auto jsonRes = file::readJson(path);
    if (jsonRes.isErr()) return Err(jsonRes.unwrapErr());
    auto root = jsonRes.unwrap();

    ImportedReplay out;
    out.sourceName = fileStemName(path);
    out.format = "mhr.json";

    double fps = 240.0;
    if (root.contains("meta") && root["meta"].isObject() && root["meta"].contains("fps")) {
        fps = root["meta"]["fps"].asDouble().unwrapOr(240.0);
    }
    else if (root.contains("fps")) {
        fps = root["fps"].asDouble().unwrapOr(240.0);
    }
    out.tps = fps > 0.0 ? fps : 240.0;

    matjson::Value const* events = nullptr;
    if (root.contains("events") && root["events"].isArray()) events = &root["events"];
    else if (root.contains("inputs") && root["inputs"].isArray()) events = &root["inputs"];
    else return Err("MHR JSON: missing 'events' array");

    for (auto const& ev : *events) {
        if (!ev.isObject()) continue;
        if (!ev.contains("frame")) continue;
        int frame = static_cast<int>(ev["frame"].asInt().unwrapOr(0));
        bool down = false;
        if (ev.contains("down")) down = ev["down"].asBool().unwrapOr(false);
        else if (ev.contains("hold")) down = ev["hold"].asBool().unwrapOr(false);
        else continue;

        bool p2 = false;
        if (ev.contains("p2")) p2 = ev["p2"].asBool().unwrapOr(false);
        else if (ev.contains("player2")) p2 = ev["player2"].asBool().unwrapOr(false);

        int button = 1;
        if (ev.contains("button")) button = static_cast<int>(ev["button"].asInt().unwrapOr(1));

        out.events.push_back(ReplayEvent{ frame, button, p2, down });
    }

    std::stable_sort(out.events.begin(), out.events.end(), [](auto const& a, auto const& b) {
        return a.frame < b.frame;
    });
    if (out.events.empty()) return Err("MHR JSON: no usable events");
    return Ok(std::move(out));
}

Result<ImportedReplay> ReplayImport::loadMhrBin(std::filesystem::path const& path) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) return Err("Failed to open MHR binary");

    // Detect JSON masquerading as .mhr
    {
        auto pos = f.tellg();
        char c = 0;
        f.read(&c, 1);
        f.seekg(pos);
        if (c == '{' || c == '[') return loadMhrJson(path);
    }

    uint32_t magic = readBE<uint32_t>(f);
    if (magic != 0x4841434Bu) { // "HACK"
        return Err(fmt::format("Unknown MHR binary magic {:08x} (export as .mhr.json?)", magic));
    }

    f.seekg(12);
    uint32_t fpsU = readBE<uint32_t>(f);
    ImportedReplay out;
    out.tps = fpsU > 0 ? static_cast<double>(fpsU) : 240.0;
    out.sourceName = fileStemName(path);
    out.format = "mhr";

    f.seekg(28);
    uint32_t num = readBE<uint32_t>(f);
    out.events.reserve(num);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < num; ++i) {
        f.seekg(2, std::ios::cur);
        uint8_t downB = 0, p1B = 0;
        f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&downB), 1);
        f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&p1B), 1);
        uint32_t frame = readBE<uint32_t>(f);
        f.seekg(24, std::ios::cur);
        if (!f) break;
        out.events.push_back(ReplayEvent{
            static_cast<int>(frame),
            1,
            p1B != 0, // p1==0 means player1 in zcb3; p1B==0 → !player2
            downB == 1
        });
        // Fix: zcb3 says p1 = (read == 0); so player2 = !p1 = (p1B != 0). Correct above.
    }

    // Correct player2: p1 true when byte==0 → player2 = (p1B != 0) is wrong.
    // p1 = (byte == 0) → player2 = (byte != 0). Yes that's what we have.
    // Wait zcb3: `let p1 = reader.read_u8()? == 0` then if p1 process p1. So byte 0 = p1, nonzero = p2.
    // player2 = (p1B != 0). Good.

    std::stable_sort(out.events.begin(), out.events.end(), [](auto const& a, auto const& b) {
        return a.frame < b.frame;
    });
    if (out.events.empty()) return Err("MHR binary: no actions");
    return Ok(std::move(out));
}

Result<ImportedReplay> ReplayImport::loadSlc(std::filesystem::path const& path) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) return Err("Failed to open SLC");

    char header[4]{};
    f.read(header, 4);
    if (std::string_view(header, 4) != "SILL") {
        return Err("Unsupported SLC (need v2 SILL header; convert v3 to .gdr2 or re-export)");
    }

    ImportedReplay out;
    out.sourceName = fileStemName(path);
    out.format = "slc";

    double tps = 0.0;
    f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&tps), sizeof(double));
    out.tps = tps > 0.0 ? tps : 240.0;

    uint64_t metaSize = 0;
    f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&metaSize), sizeof(uint64_t));
    if (metaSize > 0) f.seekg(static_cast<std::streamoff>(metaSize), std::ios::cur);

    uint64_t length = 0;
    f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&length), sizeof(uint64_t));
    if (length > 10'000'000) return Err("SLC: absurd input count");

    uint64_t blobCount = 0;
    f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&blobCount), sizeof(uint64_t));
    if (blobCount > 1'000'000) return Err("SLC: absurd blob count");

    struct Blob {
        uint64_t byteSize = 1;
        uint64_t start = 0;
        uint64_t length = 0;
    };
    std::vector<Blob> blobs(blobCount);
    for (auto& b : blobs) {
        f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&b.byteSize), sizeof(uint64_t));
        f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&b.start), sizeof(uint64_t));
        f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&b.length), sizeof(uint64_t));
        if (b.byteSize == 0 || b.byteSize > 8) return Err("SLC: bad blob byte size");
    }

    std::vector<uint64_t> states(length, 0);
    std::vector<double> tpsOverrides(length, 0.0);
    uint64_t frame = 0;
    out.events.reserve(length);

    for (auto const& blob : blobs) {
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < blob.length; ++i) {
            uint64_t idx = blob.start + i;
            if (idx >= length) return Err("SLC: blob index OOB");
            uint64_t state = 0;
            f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&state), static_cast<std::streamsize>(blob.byteSize));
            states[idx] = state;

            uint64_t delta = state >> 5;
            uint8_t type = static_cast<uint8_t>((state & 0b11100) >> 2);
            bool p2 = (state & 2) != 0;
            bool hold = (state & 1) != 0;
            frame += delta;

            if (type == 7) { // TPS
                double ntps = 0.0;
                f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&ntps), sizeof(double));
                if (ntps > 0.0) out.tps = ntps;
                continue;
            }
            if (type == 0 || type >= 4) continue; // Skip / Restart / Death
            // 1 Jump, 2 Left, 3 Right
            out.events.push_back(ReplayEvent{
                static_cast<int>(frame),
                static_cast<int>(type),
                p2,
                hold
            });
        }
    }

    char footer[3]{};
    f.read(footer, 3);
    if (std::string_view(footer, 3) != "EOM") {
        // tolerate missing footer if we got events
        if (out.events.empty()) return Err("SLC: bad footer / empty");
    }

    std::stable_sort(out.events.begin(), out.events.end(), [](auto const& a, auto const& b) {
        return a.frame < b.frame;
    });
    if (out.events.empty()) return Err("SLC: no jump/move inputs");
    return Ok(std::move(out));
}
```

`src/core/SaveDropPaths.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "SaveDropPaths.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <Geode/utils/file.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <system_error>

using namespace geode::prelude;

SaveDropPaths& SaveDropPaths::get() {
    static SaveDropPaths inst;
    return inst;
}

std::filesystem::path SaveDropPaths::rootDir() const {
    auto* mod = Mod::get();
    if (!mod) return std::filesystem::path("earlybuffer-save");
    return mod->getSaveDir();
}

std::filesystem::path SaveDropPaths::replayDropDir() const {
    return this->rootDir() / "replay-drop";
}

std::filesystem::path SaveDropPaths::configPath() const {
    return this->rootDir() / "earlybuffer-config.json";
}

std::filesystem::path SaveDropPaths::reportPath() const {
    return this->rootDir() / "earlybuffer-dev-report.txt";
}

bool SaveDropPaths::ensureDirs(std::string& err) const {
    err.clear();
    auto const root = this->rootDir();
    auto const replay = this->replayDropDir();

    auto rootRes = file::createDirectoryAll(root);
    if (rootRes.isErr()) {
        err = fmt::format("cannot create save dir {}: {}", root.string(), rootRes.unwrapErr());
        return false;
    }
    auto replayRes = file::createDirectoryAll(replay);
    if (replayRes.isErr()) {
        err = fmt::format(
            "cannot create replay drop dir {}: {}",
            replay.string(),
            replayRes.unwrapErr()
        );
        return false;
    }

    std::error_code ec;
    if (!std::filesystem::is_directory(root, ec) || ec) {
        err = fmt::format("save dir missing or not a directory: {}", root.string());
        return false;
    }
    if (!std::filesystem::is_directory(replay, ec) || ec) {
        err = fmt::format("replay drop dir missing or not a directory: {}", replay.string());
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool SaveDropPaths::isReplayExtension(std::filesystem::path const& path) {
    auto ext = path.extension().string();
    for (char& c : ext) {
        c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
    }
    return ext == ".gdr"
        || ext == ".gdr2"
        || ext == ".mhr"
        || ext == ".json"
        || ext == ".slc";
}

std::vector<std::filesystem::path> SaveDropPaths::listReplayCandidates() const {
    std::vector<std::filesystem::path> out;
    auto const dir = this->replayDropDir();
    std::error_code ec;
    if (!std::filesystem::is_directory(dir, ec) || ec) {
        return out;
    }

    for (auto const& entry : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(dir, ec)) {
        if (ec) break;
        if (!entry.is_regular_file(ec) || ec) continue;
        auto const path = entry.path();
        if (!SaveDropPaths::isReplayExtension(path)) continue;
        // Skip zero-byte placeholders — Commit 4 will still surface clear errors.
        auto const sz = entry.file_size(ec);
        if (ec || sz == 0) continue;
        out.push_back(path);
    }

    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end(), [](auto const& a, auto const& b) {
        std::error_code eca;
        std::error_code ecb;
        auto const ta = std::filesystem::last_write_time(a, eca);
        auto const tb = std::filesystem::last_write_time(b, ecb);
        if (eca || ecb) return a.filename().string() > b.filename().string();
        if (ta != tb) return ta > tb; // newest first
        return a.filename().string() > b.filename().string();
    });
    return out;
}

bool SaveDropPaths::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (!ok) {
            ++fails;
            report += std::string("FAIL ") + name + "; ";
        }
    };

    auto& paths = SaveDropPaths::get();
    auto const root = paths.rootDir();
    auto const replay = paths.replayDropDir();
    auto const config = paths.configPath();
    auto const reportFile = paths.reportPath();

    expect(!root.empty(), "root-nonempty");
    expect(replay.filename() == "replay-drop", "replay-dir-name");
    expect(replay.parent_path() == root, "replay-under-root");
    expect(config.filename() == "earlybuffer-config.json", "config-name");
    expect(config.parent_path() == root, "config-under-root");
    expect(reportFile.filename() == "earlybuffer-dev-report.txt", "report-name");
    expect(reportFile.parent_path() == root, "report-under-root");
    expect(SaveDropPaths::isReplayExtension(std::filesystem::path("x.gdr")), "ext-gdr");
    expect(SaveDropPaths::isReplayExtension(std::filesystem::path("x.GDR2")), "ext-gdr2-case");
    expect(SaveDropPaths::isReplayExtension(std::filesystem::path("x.mhr")), "ext-mhr");
    expect(SaveDropPaths::isReplayExtension(std::filesystem::path("x.json")), "ext-json");
    expect(SaveDropPaths::isReplayExtension(std::filesystem::path("x.slc")), "ext-slc");
    expect(!SaveDropPaths::isReplayExtension(std::filesystem::path("x.txt")), "ext-reject-txt");

    // When Mod is live, ensureDirs must succeed (Geode save dir is writable).
    if (Mod::get()) {
        std::string err;
        expect(paths.ensureDirs(err), "ensure-dirs");
        if (!err.empty() && fails > 0) {
            report += err + "; ";
        }
    }

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "SaveDropPaths selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("SaveDropPaths selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_CORE_SAVEDROPPATHS_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_CORE_SAVEDROPPATHS_HPP

#include <filesystem>
#include <string>

// Mobile / non-Win I/O: fixed paths under the mod save dir (no file dialogs).
class SaveDropPaths {

    // Mod::get()->getSaveDir(), or "earlybuffer-save" if Mod is unavailable.
    std::filesystem::path rootDir() const;

    bool ensureDirs(std::string& err) const;

    // Replay candidates in replay-drop, newest mtime first. Missing dir → empty.
    std::vector<std::filesystem::path> listReplayCandidates() const;

    // Path-composition invariants (no required disk I/O).
    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    SaveDropPaths() = default;

    static bool isReplayExtension(std::filesystem::path const& path);
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_CORE_SAVEDROPPATHS_HPP
```
