`src/core/TravelForesight.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef TRAVEL_FORESIGHT_HPP
#define TRAVEL_FORESIGHT_HPP

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <string>

// Dt-/speed-aware look-ahead for orbs and jump pads (miss-assist foresight).
// Pure helpers + layer scan; no namespaces.
class TravelForesight {
public:
    // Calibrated so 1x @ 240 TPS ≈ legacy (limit+8)*5.5 at typical windows.
    static constexpr float kBasePxPerTickAt1x = 5.5f;
    static constexpr float kNominalDt = 1.f / 240.f;
    static constexpr float kAheadMargin = 16.f;
    static constexpr float kAheadMin = 60.f;
    static constexpr float kAheadMax = 320.f;
    static constexpr float kBehindSlop = 10.f;

    // Travel cone length in world X for limit+slack ticks at current simDt / speed.
    // speedMul: portal factor (PlayerObject::m_playerSpeed); clamped.
    static float aheadXFromSpeed(float speedMul, int limit, float simDt, int slack);

    // Reads player speed / mode; slack < 0 → 0.
    static float aheadX(PlayerObject* player, int limit, float simDt, int slack);

    static float yReachForPlayer(PlayerObject* player);

    static bool isOrbLike(GameObjectType type);
    static bool isPadLike(GameObjectType type);
    static bool isOrbOrPadLike(GameObjectType type);

    // Skip spent rings / claimed touch.
    static bool isUsableOrbOrPad(GameObject* obj);

    // True if an orb or pad sits in [px - behindSlop, px + aheadX] within yReach.
    static bool hasOrbOrPadAhead(
        PlayLayer* layer,
        PlayerObject* player,
        int limit,
        float simDt,
        int slack
    );

    // Same scan with an explicit ahead distance (tests / callers that precomputed).
    static bool scanOrbOrPadInCone(
        PlayLayer* layer,
        PlayerObject* player,
        float aheadX,
        float yReach
    );

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    TravelForesight() = default;
};

#endif // TRAVEL_FORESIGHT_HPP

```

`src/core/TriggerClassify.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TriggerClassify.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <fmt/format.h>

#include <cmath>

using namespace geode::prelude;

bool TriggerClassify::isMoveTriggerId(int objectId) {
    return objectId == 901 || objectId == 1611;
}

bool TriggerClassify::isRotateTriggerId(int objectId) {
    return objectId == 1346;
}

bool TriggerClassify::isScaleTriggerId(int objectId) {
    return objectId == 2067;
}

bool TriggerClassify::isSpawnTriggerId(int objectId) {
    return objectId == 1268;
}

bool TriggerClassify::isToggleTriggerId(int objectId) {
    // Classic Toggle — enables/disables target group (solids/hazards on/off).
    return objectId == 1049;
}

bool TriggerClassify::isToggleOrbId(int objectId) {
    // Custom / toggle orb — player hit toggles target group (spawn/despawn).
    return objectId == 1594;
}

bool TriggerClassify::isFollowTriggerId(int objectId) {
    // 1347 Advanced Follow, 1585 Follow Player Y, 1817 Follow.
    return objectId == 1347 || objectId == 1585 || objectId == 1817;
}

bool TriggerClassify::isFollowPlayerTriggerId(int objectId) {
    // Always couples to the live player path.
    return objectId == 1585;
}

bool TriggerClassify::isNonLethalTriggerId(int objectId) {
    if (objectId == 1913 || objectId == 1914 || objectId == 1915
        || objectId == 1916 || objectId == 1917 || objectId == 2015
        || objectId == 2016 || objectId == 2901) {
        return true;
    }
    switch (objectId) {
        case 29:
        case 1006:
        case 1007:
        // 1049 Toggle is collision-relevant — not listed here.
        case 1520:
        case 1818:
        case 3605:
        case 3606:
        case 3607:
        case 3612:
        case 3613:
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
    }
}

bool TriggerClassify::isLethalMotionCandidateId(int objectId) {
    return TriggerClassify::isMoveTriggerId(objectId)
        || TriggerClassify::isRotateTriggerId(objectId)
        || TriggerClassify::isScaleTriggerId(objectId)
        || TriggerClassify::isSpawnTriggerId(objectId)
        || TriggerClassify::isToggleTriggerId(objectId)
        || TriggerClassify::isToggleOrbId(objectId)
        || TriggerClassify::isFollowTriggerId(objectId);
}

bool TriggerClassify::isStatic(TriggerKind kind) {
    return kind == TriggerKind::StaticMove
        || kind == TriggerKind::StaticRotate
        || kind == TriggerKind::StaticScale
        || kind == TriggerKind::StaticSpawn
        || kind == TriggerKind::StaticToggle;
}

bool TriggerClassify::isDynamic(TriggerKind kind) {
    return kind == TriggerKind::DynamicFollow
        || kind == TriggerKind::DynamicOther;
}

bool TriggerClassify::isMotion(TriggerKind kind) {
    return kind == TriggerKind::StaticMove
        || kind == TriggerKind::StaticRotate
        || kind == TriggerKind::StaticScale
        || kind == TriggerKind::DynamicFollow
        || kind == TriggerKind::DynamicOther;
}

char const* TriggerClassify::kindName(TriggerKind kind) {
    switch (kind) {
        case TriggerKind::Ignore: return "Ignore";
        case TriggerKind::StaticMove: return "StaticMove";
        case TriggerKind::StaticRotate: return "StaticRotate";
        case TriggerKind::StaticScale: return "StaticScale";
        case TriggerKind::StaticSpawn: return "StaticSpawn";
        case TriggerKind::StaticToggle: return "StaticToggle";
        case TriggerKind::DynamicFollow: return "DynamicFollow";
        case TriggerKind::DynamicOther: return "DynamicOther";
        default: return "?";
    }
}

bool TriggerClassify::dependsOnLivePlayer(MotionHints const& hints) {
    if (hints.lockToPlayerX || hints.lockToPlayerY) return true;
    if (hints.rotateFollowP1 || hints.rotateFollowP2) return true;
    if (hints.targetPlayer1 || hints.targetPlayer2) return true;
    if (TriggerClassify::isFollowPlayerTriggerId(hints.objectId)) return true;
    // Camera lock on a mover: camera usually tracks the player → player-coupled.
    if (hints.lockToCameraX || hints.lockToCameraY) return true;
    return false;
}

bool TriggerClassify::hasNonPlayerDynamicHints(MotionHints const& hints) {
    // Touch start time depends on when the player hits the trigger — not bakeable
    // as a fixed absolute timeline from attempt 0 without knowing touch tick.
    bool const collisionId = TriggerClassify::isMoveTriggerId(hints.objectId)
        || TriggerClassify::isRotateTriggerId(hints.objectId)
        || TriggerClassify::isScaleTriggerId(hints.objectId)
        || TriggerClassify::isFollowTriggerId(hints.objectId)
        || TriggerClassify::isToggleTriggerId(hints.objectId)
        || TriggerClassify::isSpawnTriggerId(hints.objectId);
    if (hints.touchTriggered && collisionId) return true;
    return false;
}

TriggerKind TriggerClassify::classifyHints(MotionHints const& hints) {
    if (!hints.isEffect && hints.objectId == 0) {
        return TriggerKind::Ignore;
    }

    int const id = hints.objectId;

    if (TriggerClassify::isNonLethalTriggerId(id)) {
        return TriggerKind::Ignore;
    }
    if (!TriggerClassify::isLethalMotionCandidateId(id)) {
        return TriggerKind::Ignore;
    }

    // Toggle orb: on/off at player hit time — never a fixed absolute timeline.
    if (TriggerClassify::isToggleOrbId(id)) {
        return TriggerKind::DynamicOther;
    }

    // Player-coupled → cannot put a single static track in the cache.
    if (TriggerClassify::dependsOnLivePlayer(hints)) {
        return TriggerKind::DynamicFollow;
    }
    // Touch-activated motion (start time = player path).
    if (TriggerClassify::hasNonPlayerDynamicHints(hints)) {
        return TriggerKind::DynamicOther;
    }

    // Group-follow / move-target / "dynamic mode" toward another group:
    // still deterministic if the target group is itself static — StaticMove.
    // (Baker resolves the chain later; classifier only gates player coupling.)
    if (TriggerClassify::isFollowTriggerId(id)
        || hints.useMoveTarget
        || hints.followCpp
        || hints.dynamicMode
        || hints.directionFollowSnap360) {
        if (TriggerClassify::isFollowPlayerTriggerId(id)) {
            return TriggerKind::DynamicFollow;
        }
        // Follow / move-target of another group ID → bakeable chain.
        return TriggerKind::StaticMove;
    }

    if (TriggerClassify::isMoveTriggerId(id)) {
        if (std::fabs(hints.moveOffsetX) < 1e-4f
            && std::fabs(hints.moveOffsetY) < 1e-4f
            && id == 1611) {
            return TriggerKind::Ignore;
        }
        return TriggerKind::StaticMove;
    }
    if (TriggerClassify::isRotateTriggerId(id)) {
        return TriggerKind::StaticRotate;
    }
    if (TriggerClassify::isScaleTriggerId(id)) {
        return TriggerKind::StaticScale;
    }
    if (TriggerClassify::isSpawnTriggerId(id)) {
        return TriggerKind::StaticSpawn;
    }
    if (TriggerClassify::isToggleTriggerId(id)) {
        return TriggerKind::StaticToggle;
    }

    return TriggerKind::Ignore;
}

TriggerClassify::MotionHints TriggerClassify::hintsFromObject(GameObject* obj) {
    MotionHints h;
    if (!obj) return h;

    h.objectId = obj->m_objectID;

    auto* effect = typeinfo_cast<EffectGameObject*>(obj);
    if (!effect) {
        h.isEffect = false;
        return h;
    }

    h.isEffect = true;
    h.lockToPlayerX = effect->m_lockToPlayerX;
    h.lockToPlayerY = effect->m_lockToPlayerY;
    h.lockToCameraX = effect->m_lockToCameraX;
    h.lockToCameraY = effect->m_lockToCameraY;
    h.followCpp = effect->m_followCPP;
    h.rotateFollowP1 = effect->m_rotateFollowP1;
    h.rotateFollowP2 = effect->m_rotateFollowP2;
    h.directionFollowSnap360 = effect->m_isDirectionFollowSnap360;
    h.dynamicMode = effect->m_isDynamicMode;
    h.dynamicBlock = effect->m_isDynamicBlock;
    h.useMoveTarget = effect->m_useMoveTarget;
    h.touchTriggered = effect->m_isTouchTriggered;
    h.spawnTriggered = effect->m_isSpawnTriggered;
    h.targetPlayer1 = effect->m_targetPlayer1;
    h.targetPlayer2 = effect->m_targetPlayer2;
    h.targetGroupId = effect->m_targetGroupID;
    h.centerGroupId = effect->m_centerGroupID;
    h.moveOffsetX = effect->m_moveOffset.x;
    h.moveOffsetY = effect->m_moveOffset.y;
    h.rotationDegrees = effect->m_rotationDegrees;
    h.duration = effect->m_duration;
    return h;
}

TriggerKind TriggerClassify::classify(GameObject* obj) {
    if (!obj) return TriggerKind::Ignore;
    return TriggerClassify::classifyHints(TriggerClassify::hintsFromObject(obj));
}

bool TriggerClassify::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += ", ";
        report += name;
    };

    expect(TriggerClassify::classify(nullptr) == TriggerKind::Ignore, "null");

    MotionHints move{};
    move.isEffect = true;
    move.objectId = 901;
    move.moveOffsetX = 100.f;
    move.spawnTriggered = true;
    expect(
        TriggerClassify::classifyHints(move) == TriggerKind::StaticMove,
        "static-move-901"
    );

    // Group 6 follows group 5 (Advanced Follow) — bakeable, not player.
    MotionHints groupFollow{};
    groupFollow.isEffect = true;
    groupFollow.objectId = 1347;
    groupFollow.targetGroupId = 6;
    groupFollow.centerGroupId = 5;
    groupFollow.useMoveTarget = true;
    expect(
        TriggerClassify::classifyHints(groupFollow) == TriggerKind::StaticMove,
        "group-follow-static"
    );

    // Same follow ID but targets player → dynamic.
    MotionHints playerFollow = groupFollow;
    playerFollow.targetPlayer1 = true;
    expect(
        TriggerClassify::classifyHints(playerFollow) == TriggerKind::DynamicFollow,
        "player-target-dynamic"
    );

    MotionHints followPlayerY{};
    followPlayerY.isEffect = true;
    followPlayerY.objectId = 1585;
    expect(
        TriggerClassify::classifyHints(followPlayerY) == TriggerKind::DynamicFollow,
        "follow-player-y"
    );

    MotionHints lockPlayer{};
    lockPlayer.isEffect = true;
    lockPlayer.objectId = 901;
    lockPlayer.moveOffsetX = 50.f;
    lockPlayer.lockToPlayerX = true;
    expect(
        TriggerClassify::classifyHints(lockPlayer) == TriggerKind::DynamicFollow,
        "lock-player-x"
    );

    MotionHints touchMove{};
    touchMove.isEffect = true;
    touchMove.objectId = 901;
    touchMove.moveOffsetX = 100.f;
    touchMove.touchTriggered = true;
    expect(
        TriggerClassify::classifyHints(touchMove) == TriggerKind::DynamicOther,
        "touch-move-dynamic"
    );

    MotionHints cam{};
    cam.isEffect = true;
    cam.objectId = 1913;
    cam.lockToPlayerX = true;
    expect(
        TriggerClassify::classifyHints(cam) == TriggerKind::Ignore,
        "camera-ignore"
    );

    MotionHints rot{};
    rot.isEffect = true;
    rot.objectId = 1346;
    rot.rotationDegrees = 90.f;
    rot.spawnTriggered = true;
    expect(
        TriggerClassify::classifyHints(rot) == TriggerKind::StaticRotate,
        "static-rotate"
    );

    MotionHints dynModeGroup{};
    dynModeGroup.isEffect = true;
    dynModeGroup.objectId = 901;
    dynModeGroup.moveOffsetX = 10.f;
    dynModeGroup.dynamicMode = true;
    dynModeGroup.targetGroupId = 5;
    expect(
        TriggerClassify::classifyHints(dynModeGroup) == TriggerKind::StaticMove,
        "dynamic-mode-group-static"
    );

    MotionHints pulse{};
    pulse.isEffect = true;
    pulse.objectId = 1006;
    expect(
        TriggerClassify::classifyHints(pulse) == TriggerKind::Ignore,
        "pulse-ignore"
    );

    // Toggle enables/disables groups — must not be Ignore.
    MotionHints toggle{};
    toggle.isEffect = true;
    toggle.objectId = 1049;
    toggle.spawnTriggered = true;
    expect(
        TriggerClassify::classifyHints(toggle) == TriggerKind::StaticToggle,
        "static-toggle"
    );

    MotionHints touchToggle{};
    touchToggle.isEffect = true;
    touchToggle.objectId = 1049;
    touchToggle.touchTriggered = true;
    expect(
        TriggerClassify::classifyHints(touchToggle) == TriggerKind::DynamicOther,
        "touch-toggle-dynamic"
    );

    MotionHints toggleOrb{};
    toggleOrb.isEffect = true;
    toggleOrb.objectId = 1594;
    expect(
        TriggerClassify::classifyHints(toggleOrb) == TriggerKind::DynamicOther,
        "toggle-orb-dynamic"
    );

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "TriggerClassify selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = fmt::format("TriggerClassify selfCheck {} fails: {}", fails, report);
    return false;
}
```

`src/core/TriggerClassify.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_CORE_TRIGGERCLASSIFY_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_CORE_TRIGGERCLASSIFY_HPP

#include <string>

class GameObject;

// How a GameObject / EffectGameObject relates to Trigger World Bake.
// Collision-relevant: move/rotate/scale/spawn/toggle of solids/hazards.
// Camera, pulse, song, shake, etc. → Ignore.
//
// Important: "follow another group/object" is STATIC (deterministic chain).
// Only follow/lock that depends on the live PLAYER is Dynamic*.
// Toggle trigger (1049) is NOT Ignore — enables/disables collideables.
// Toggle orb (1594) is DynamicOther — player click time turns groups on/off.
enum class TriggerKind {
    Ignore = 0,
    StaticMove,
    StaticRotate,
    StaticScale,
    StaticSpawn,
    StaticToggle,
    DynamicFollow,
    DynamicOther
};

// Heuristic classifier for trigger bake (Commit 2).
class TriggerClassify {
public:
    // Flat flag bundle so selfCheck / tests need no live PlayLayer objects.
    struct MotionHints {
        int objectId = 0;
        bool isEffect = false;
        bool lockToPlayerX = false;
        bool lockToPlayerY = false;
        bool lockToCameraX = false;
        bool lockToCameraY = false;
        bool followCpp = false;
        bool rotateFollowP1 = false;
        bool rotateFollowP2 = false;
        bool directionFollowSnap360 = false;
        bool dynamicMode = false;
        bool dynamicBlock = false;
        bool useMoveTarget = false;
        bool touchTriggered = false;
        bool spawnTriggered = false;
        bool targetPlayer1 = false;
        bool targetPlayer2 = false;
        int targetGroupId = 0;
        int centerGroupId = 0;
        float moveOffsetX = 0.f;
        float moveOffsetY = 0.f;
        float rotationDegrees = 0.f;
        float duration = 0.f;
    };

    static TriggerKind classify(GameObject* obj);
    static TriggerKind classifyHints(MotionHints const& hints);

    static bool isStatic(TriggerKind kind);
    static bool isDynamic(TriggerKind kind);
    static bool isMotion(TriggerKind kind);
    static char const* kindName(TriggerKind kind);

    static bool isMoveTriggerId(int objectId);
    static bool isRotateTriggerId(int objectId);
    static bool isScaleTriggerId(int objectId);
    static bool isSpawnTriggerId(int objectId);
    // Toggle group on/off (collision-relevant visibility/active).
    static bool isToggleTriggerId(int objectId);
    // Toggle / custom orb — hit by player toggles a group (spawn/despawn solids).
    static bool isToggleOrbId(int objectId);
    // Follow-family IDs (may be group-follow = static, or player-follow = dynamic).
    static bool isFollowTriggerId(int objectId);
    // Explicit Follow Player Y (always player-coupled).
    static bool isFollowPlayerTriggerId(int objectId);
    static bool isNonLethalTriggerId(int objectId);
    // Collision-relevant candidates (motion + toggle), not camera/cosmetic.
    static bool isLethalMotionCandidateId(int objectId);

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    TriggerClassify() = default;

    // True only when motion depends on the live player (not another group).
    static bool dependsOnLivePlayer(MotionHints const& hints);
    // Player-independent extras that still break a fixed timeline (e.g. touch start).
    static bool hasNonPlayerDynamicHints(MotionHints const& hints);
    static MotionHints hintsFromObject(GameObject* obj);
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_CORE_TRIGGERCLASSIFY_HPP

```

`src/core/TriggerWorldBaker.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TriggerWorldBaker.hpp"
#include "AssistController.hpp"
#include "LevelProfile.hpp"
#include "TriggerClassify.hpp"
#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"
#include "../debug/AssistLog.hpp"
#include "../debug/LagProbe.hpp"
#include "../debug/PerfTrace.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <fmt/format.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>

using namespace geode::prelude;

TriggerWorldBaker& TriggerWorldBaker::get() {
    static TriggerWorldBaker inst;
    return inst;
}

TriggerWorldBaker::LivePose TriggerWorldBaker::poseFromObject(GameObject* obj) {
    LivePose p;
    if (!obj) return p;
    p.x = obj->getPositionX();
    p.y = obj->getPositionY();
    p.rotation = obj->getRotation();
    p.scaleX = obj->getScaleX();
    p.scaleY = obj->getScaleY();
    p.active = obj->isVisible();
    p.objectId = obj->m_objectID;
    return p;
}

TriggerPose TriggerWorldBaker::toKey(int tick, LivePose const& live) {
    TriggerPose k;
    k.tick = tick;
    k.x = live.x;
    k.y = live.y;
    k.rotation = live.rotation;
    k.scaleX = live.scaleX;
    k.scaleY = live.scaleY;
    k.active = live.active;
    return k;
}

void TriggerWorldBaker::pushKey(TriggerTrack& track, int tick, LivePose const& live) {
    if (track.keys.size() >= TriggerWorldStore::kMaxKeysPerTrack) return;
    if (!track.keys.empty() && track.keys.back().tick == tick) {
        track.keys.back() = TriggerWorldBaker::toKey(tick, live);
        return;
    }
    if (!track.keys.empty() && track.keys.back().tick > tick) return;
    track.keys.push_back(TriggerWorldBaker::toKey(tick, live));
}

int TriggerWorldBaker::durationTicks(float durationSec, double tps) {
    if (durationSec <= 0.f) return 0;
    int const ticks = static_cast<int>(std::lround(static_cast<double>(durationSec) * tps));
    return std::max(0, ticks);
}

bool TriggerWorldBaker::isFollowLikeStatic(EffectGameObject* effect, TriggerKind kind) {
    if (!effect) return false;
    if (kind != TriggerKind::StaticMove) return false;
    if (TriggerClassify::isFollowTriggerId(effect->m_objectID)) return true;
    if (effect->m_useMoveTarget || effect->m_followCPP) return true;
    if (effect->m_isDynamicMode || effect->m_isDirectionFollowSnap360) return true;
    return false;
}

cocos2d::CCPoint TriggerWorldBaker::groupCenter(
    int groupId,
    std::vector<GameObject*> const& objects,
    std::unordered_map<int, LivePose> const& live
) {
    double sx = 0.0;
    double sy = 0.0;
    int n = 0;
    for (auto* obj : objects) {
        if (!obj || groupId <= 0) continue;
        if (!obj->belongsToGroup(groupId)) continue;
        auto it = live.find(obj->m_uniqueID);
        if (it == live.end()) continue;
        sx += it->second.x;
        sy += it->second.y;
        ++n;
    }
    if (n <= 0) return { 0.f, 0.f };
    return {
        static_cast<float>(sx / static_cast<double>(n)),
        static_cast<float>(sy / static_cast<double>(n))
    };
}

void TriggerWorldBaker::clearJob() {
    this->m_layer = nullptr;
    this->m_phase = Phase::Idle;
    this->m_childIndex = 0;
    this->m_childCount = 0;
    this->m_effectIndex = 0;
    this->m_objects.clear();
    this->m_effects.clear();
    this->m_live.clear();
    this->m_tracks.clear();
    this->m_bakedEffects = 0;
    this->m_skippedFollow = 0;
    this->m_skippedDynamic = 0;
    this->m_skippedNonSpawn = 0;
    this->m_levelKey.clear();
    this->m_tps = 240.0;
}

void TriggerWorldBaker::cancel() {
    this->m_cancel = true;
    if (this->m_running) {
        this->finishCancel();
        return;
    }
    this->m_progress = 0.f;
    this->m_status.clear();
    this->clearJob();
}

void TriggerWorldBaker::finishCancel() {
    this->m_running = false;
    this->m_progress = 0.f;
    this->m_status = "trigger-world: cancelled";
    this->clearJob();
    AssistLog::debug("TRIGGER-WORLD: bake cancelled");
}

void TriggerWorldBaker::finishOk() {
    this->m_running = false;
    this->m_progress = 1.f;
    this->m_status = TriggerWorldStore::get().statusLine();
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format(
        "TRIGGER-WORLD: baked {} effects → {} tracks ({} ready) @ {:.0f} tps "
        "(skip follow={} dynamic={} non-spawn={})",
        this->m_bakedEffects,
        TriggerWorldStore::get().trackCount(),
        TriggerWorldStore::get().readyTrackCount(),
        this->m_tps,
        this->m_skippedFollow,
        this->m_skippedDynamic,
        this->m_skippedNonSpawn
    ));
    this->clearJob();
}

std::string TriggerWorldBaker::statusLine() const {
    if (this->m_running) {
        return fmt::format(
            "trigger-world: building {:.0f}%",
            this->m_progress * 100.f
        );
    }
    if (!this->m_status.empty()) return this->m_status;
    return TriggerWorldStore::get().statusLine();
}

void TriggerWorldBaker::loadOrBuild(PlayLayer* layer) {
    this->cancel();
    if (!layer || !layer->m_level) {
        TriggerWorldStore::get().clear();
        return;
    }
    if (!StageConfig::triggerBake()) {
        TriggerWorldStore::get().clear();
        this->m_status.clear();
        return;
    }

    {
        LagProbe::Scope const lagScope("eb.triggerBake.load");
        TriggerWorldStore::get().loadForLevel(layer->m_level);
    }

    if (TriggerWorldStore::get().hasTracks()) {
        this->m_status = TriggerWorldStore::get().statusLine();
        AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
            "TRIGGER-WORLD: cache hit ({})",
            this->m_status
        ));
        return;
    }

    this->start(layer);
}

void TriggerWorldBaker::resumeIfEmpty(PlayLayer* layer) {
    if (!layer || !StageConfig::triggerBake()) return;
    if (this->m_running) return;
    auto& store = TriggerWorldStore::get();
    if (!store.loaded() || store.hasTracks()) return;
    AssistLog::debug("TRIGGER-WORLD: resume build after empty cancel");
    this->start(layer);
}

bool TriggerWorldBaker::start(PlayLayer* layer) {
    if (!layer) return false;
    if (!StageConfig::triggerBake()) return false;
    if (this->m_running) return false;

    this->clearJob();
    this->m_cancel = false;
    this->m_running = true;
    this->m_progress = 0.f;
    this->m_status = "trigger-world: building";
    this->m_layer = layer;
    this->m_phase = Phase::Collect;

    // Author tracks in sim TPS (1/m_simDt), never warped wall TPS.
    this->m_tps = AssistController::get().estimatedTps();
    if (this->m_tps < 60.0 || this->m_tps > 480.0) {
        this->m_tps = 240.0;
    }

    if (layer->m_level) {
        this->m_levelKey = LevelProfile::makeKey(layer->m_level);
    }
    if (this->m_levelKey.empty()) {
        this->m_levelKey = TriggerWorldStore::get().data().levelKey;
    }

    this->m_childCount = 0;
    this->m_childIndex = 0;
    if (layer->m_objectLayer) {
        if (auto* children = layer->m_objectLayer->getChildren()) {
            this->m_childCount = static_cast<size_t>(children->count());
            this->m_objects.reserve(this->m_childCount);
            this->m_effects.reserve(256);
        }
    }

    AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
        "TRIGGER-WORLD: bake queued ({} children)",
        this->m_childCount
    ));
    return true;
}

void TriggerWorldBaker::publishPartial() {
    TriggerWorldData data;
    data.levelKey = this->m_levelKey;
    data.tps = this->m_tps;
    data.version = TriggerWorldStore::kFileVersion;
    data.tracks.reserve(this->m_tracks.size());
    for (auto& [id, track] : this->m_tracks) {
        (void)id;
        if (track.keys.empty()) continue;
        TriggerTrack copy = track;
        std::sort(
            copy.keys.begin(),
            copy.keys.end(),
            [](TriggerPose const& a, TriggerPose const& b) {
                return a.tick < b.tick;
            }
        );
        data.tracks.push_back(std::move(copy));
    }
    TriggerWorldStore::get().setData(std::move(data));
}

TriggerTrack* TriggerWorldBaker::ensureTrack(GameObject* obj, TriggerKind kind) {
    if (!obj) return nullptr;
    int const id = obj->m_uniqueID;
    auto it = this->m_tracks.find(id);
    if (it != this->m_tracks.end()) return &it->second;
    if (this->m_tracks.size() >= TriggerWorldStore::kMaxTracks) return nullptr;

    LivePose const pose = TriggerWorldBaker::poseFromObject(obj);
    this->m_live.emplace(id, pose);

    TriggerTrack track;
    track.uniqueId = id;
    track.objectId = obj->m_objectID;
    track.kind = kind;
    track.ready = false;
    TriggerWorldBaker::pushKey(track, 0, pose);
    auto [ins, ok] = this->m_tracks.emplace(id, std::move(track));
    (void)ok;
    return &ins->second;
}

std::vector<GameObject*> TriggerWorldBaker::objectsInGroup(int groupId) const {
    std::vector<GameObject*> out;
    if (groupId <= 0) return out;
    for (auto* obj : this->m_objects) {
        if (!obj) continue;
        if (!obj->belongsToGroup(groupId)) continue;
        out.push_back(obj);
    }
    return out;
}

void TriggerWorldBaker::bakeOneEffect(EffectGameObject* effect) {
    if (!effect) return;

        TriggerKind const kind = TriggerClassify::classify(effect);
        // Follow-player / Dynamic* never enter static JSON (live probe only).
        if (TriggerClassify::isDynamic(kind)) {
            ++this->m_skippedDynamic;
            return;
        }
    if (!TriggerClassify::isStatic(kind)) return;
    if (kind == TriggerKind::StaticSpawn) return;
    if (TriggerWorldBaker::isFollowLikeStatic(effect, kind)) {
        ++this->m_skippedFollow;
        return;
    }

    if (effect->m_isTouchTriggered) return;
    if (!effect->m_isSpawnTriggered) {
        ++this->m_skippedNonSpawn;
        return;
    }

    int const groupId = effect->m_targetGroupID;
    if (groupId <= 0) return;

    auto targets = this->objectsInGroup(groupId);
    if (targets.empty()) return;

    int const startTick = TriggerWorldBaker::durationTicks(
        effect->m_spawnTriggerDelay, this->m_tps
    );
    int const dur = TriggerWorldBaker::durationTicks(effect->m_duration, this->m_tps);

    if (kind == TriggerKind::StaticToggle) {
        for (auto* obj : targets) {
            if (obj == effect && targets.size() > 1) continue;
            auto* track = this->ensureTrack(obj, TriggerKind::StaticToggle);
            if (!track) break;
            auto& pose = this->m_live[obj->m_uniqueID];
            pose.active = effect->m_activateGroup;
            TriggerWorldBaker::pushKey(*track, startTick, pose);
            track->ready = track->keys.size() >= 1;
        }
        ++this->m_bakedEffects;
        return;
    }

    if (kind != TriggerKind::StaticMove
        && kind != TriggerKind::StaticRotate
        && kind != TriggerKind::StaticScale) {
        return;
    }

    cocos2d::CCPoint center{ 0.f, 0.f };
    if (kind == TriggerKind::StaticRotate) {
        int const centerId = effect->m_centerGroupID;
        if (centerId > 0) {
            center = TriggerWorldBaker::groupCenter(
                centerId, this->m_objects, this->m_live
            );
        }
        else {
            for (auto* obj : targets) {
                (void)this->ensureTrack(obj, kind);
            }
            center = TriggerWorldBaker::groupCenter(
                groupId, this->m_objects, this->m_live
            );
        }
    }

    float scaleTargetX = 1.f;
    float scaleTargetY = 1.f;
    bool relativeScale = false;
    if (kind == TriggerKind::StaticScale) {
        auto* xf = typeinfo_cast<TransformTriggerGameObject*>(effect);
        if (!xf) return;
        scaleTargetX = xf->m_objectScaleX;
        scaleTargetY = xf->m_objectScaleY;
        if (xf->m_divideX && std::fabs(scaleTargetX) > 1e-6f) {
            scaleTargetX = 1.f / scaleTargetX;
        }
        if (xf->m_divideY && std::fabs(scaleTargetY) > 1e-6f) {
            scaleTargetY = 1.f / scaleTargetY;
        }
        relativeScale = xf->m_relativeScale;
    }

    struct TargetBake {
        GameObject* obj = nullptr;
        LivePose start{};
        LivePose end{};
    };
    std::vector<TargetBake> bakes;
    bakes.reserve(targets.size());

    for (auto* obj : targets) {
        if (obj == effect && targets.size() > 1) continue;
        auto* track = this->ensureTrack(obj, kind);
        if (!track) break;
        TargetBake tb;
        tb.obj = obj;
        tb.start = this->m_live[obj->m_uniqueID];
        tb.end = tb.start;

        if (kind == TriggerKind::StaticMove) {
            tb.end.x += effect->m_moveOffset.x;
            tb.end.y += effect->m_moveOffset.y;
        }
        else if (kind == TriggerKind::StaticRotate) {
            float const deg = effect->m_rotationDegrees
                + 360.f * static_cast<float>(effect->m_times360);
            float const rad = deg * 0.017453292519943295f;
            float const c = std::cos(rad);
            float const s = std::sin(rad);
            float const dx = tb.start.x - center.x;
            float const dy = tb.start.y - center.y;
            tb.end.x = center.x + dx * c - dy * s;
            tb.end.y = center.y + dx * s + dy * c;
            if (!effect->m_lockObjectRotation) {
                tb.end.rotation = tb.start.rotation + deg;
            }
        }
        else if (kind == TriggerKind::StaticScale) {
            if (relativeScale) {
                tb.end.scaleX = tb.start.scaleX * scaleTargetX;
                tb.end.scaleY = tb.start.scaleY * scaleTargetY;
            }
            else {
                tb.end.scaleX = scaleTargetX;
                tb.end.scaleY = scaleTargetY;
            }
        }
        bakes.push_back(tb);
    }

    int const endTick = startTick + std::max(0, dur);
    int step = 1;
    if (dur > 0) {
        step = std::max(1, dur / 16);
    }

    for (auto& tb : bakes) {
        auto* track = this->ensureTrack(tb.obj, kind);
        if (!track) break;

        TriggerWorldBaker::pushKey(*track, startTick, tb.start);

        if (dur <= 0) {
            this->m_live[tb.obj->m_uniqueID] = tb.end;
            TriggerWorldBaker::pushKey(*track, startTick, tb.end);
            track->ready = true;
            continue;
        }

        for (int t = startTick + step; t < endTick; t += step) {
            if (track->keys.size() >= TriggerWorldStore::kMaxKeysPerTrack) break;
            float const u = static_cast<float>(t - startTick)
                / static_cast<float>(dur);
            LivePose mid = tb.start;
            mid.x = tb.start.x + (tb.end.x - tb.start.x) * u;
            mid.y = tb.start.y + (tb.end.y - tb.start.y) * u;
            mid.rotation = tb.start.rotation
                + (tb.end.rotation - tb.start.rotation) * u;
            mid.scaleX = tb.start.scaleX
                + (tb.end.scaleX - tb.start.scaleX) * u;
            mid.scaleY = tb.start.scaleY
                + (tb.end.scaleY - tb.start.scaleY) * u;
            mid.active = tb.end.active;
            TriggerWorldBaker::pushKey(*track, t, mid);
        }

        this->m_live[tb.obj->m_uniqueID] = tb.end;
        TriggerWorldBaker::pushKey(*track, endTick, tb.end);
        track->ready = true;
    }
    ++this->m_bakedEffects;
}

void TriggerWorldBaker::tickSlice() {
    if (!this->m_running) return;
    if (this->m_cancel) {
        this->finishCancel();
        return;
    }

    PerfTrace::Scope const scope("triggerBake.slice");
    LagProbe::Scope const lagScope("eb.triggerBake.build");

    auto const wall0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    auto budgetHit = [&]() -> bool {
        auto const us = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - wall0
        ).count();
        return us >= kBudgetUs;
    };

    while (!budgetHit()) {
        if (this->m_cancel) {
            this->finishCancel();
            return;
        }

        if (this->m_phase == Phase::Collect) {
            auto* layer = this->m_layer;
            if (!layer || !layer->m_objectLayer) {
                this->m_phase = Phase::Bake;
                continue;
            }
            auto* children = layer->m_objectLayer->getChildren();
            if (!children) {
                this->m_phase = Phase::Bake;
                continue;
            }

            size_t n = 0;
            while (this->m_childIndex < this->m_childCount
                && n < kCollectPerSlice
                && !budgetHit()) {
                auto* obj = typeinfo_cast<GameObject*>(
                    children->objectAtIndex(static_cast<unsigned>(this->m_childIndex))
                );
                ++this->m_childIndex;
                ++n;
                if (!obj) continue;
                if (typeinfo_cast<PlayerObject*>(obj)) continue;
                this->m_objects.push_back(obj);
                if (auto* effect = typeinfo_cast<EffectGameObject*>(obj)) {
                    this->m_effects.push_back(effect);
                }
            }

            float const collectFrac = this->m_childCount > 0
                ? static_cast<float>(this->m_childIndex)
                    / static_cast<float>(this->m_childCount)
                : 1.f;
            this->m_progress = 0.15f * collectFrac;

            if (this->m_childIndex >= this->m_childCount) {
                this->m_phase = Phase::Bake;
                this->m_effectIndex = 0;
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (this->m_phase == Phase::Bake) {
            size_t n = 0;
            while (this->m_effectIndex < this->m_effects.size()
                && n < kEffectsPerSlice
                && !budgetHit()) {
                this->bakeOneEffect(this->m_effects[this->m_effectIndex]);
                ++this->m_effectIndex;
                ++n;
            }

            float const bakeFrac = this->m_effects.empty()
                ? 1.f
                : static_cast<float>(this->m_effectIndex)
                    / static_cast<float>(this->m_effects.size());
            this->m_progress = 0.15f + 0.80f * bakeFrac;

            if (n > 0) {
                this->publishPartial();
            }

            if (this->m_effectIndex >= this->m_effects.size()) {
                this->m_phase = Phase::Commit;
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (this->m_phase == Phase::Commit) {
            this->publishPartial();
            this->m_phase = Phase::Idle;
            this->finishOk();
            return;
        }

        break;
    }
}

```

`src/core/TriggerWorldBaker.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_CORE_TRIGGERWORLDBAKER_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_CORE_TRIGGERWORLDBAKER_HPP

#include "TriggerWorldStore.hpp"

#include <cstddef>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

class PlayLayer;
class GameObject;
class EffectGameObject;

// Builds static TriggerWorldStore tracks from spawn-timed Move/Rotate/Scale/Toggle.
// Commit 7: budgeted tickSlice on enter (no hitch). cancel() drops in-flight work.
class TriggerWorldBaker {
public:
    static constexpr size_t kCollectPerSlice = 256;
    static constexpr size_t kEffectsPerSlice = 8;
    static constexpr int kBudgetUs = 750;

    static TriggerWorldBaker& get();

    // onLevelInit: load cache; queue budgeted build on miss. No-op if bake off.
    void loadOrBuild(PlayLayer* layer);
    // Queue a cache-miss build. Work runs via tickSlice (physics tick).
    bool start(PlayLayer* layer);
    void cancel();
    bool running() const { return this->m_running; }
    float progress() const { return this->m_progress; }
    std::string statusLine() const;

    // Amortized collect/bake/commit. Safe no-op when idle.
    void tickSlice();
    // After death-cancel: resume build if store still empty (reset path).
    void resumeIfEmpty(PlayLayer* layer);

private:
    enum class Phase {
        Idle = 0,
        Collect,
        Bake,
        Commit
    };

    struct LivePose {
        float x = 0.f;
        float y = 0.f;
        float rotation = 0.f;
        float scaleX = 1.f;
        float scaleY = 1.f;
        bool active = true;
        int objectId = 0;
    };

    TriggerWorldBaker() = default;

    bool cancelled() const { return this->m_cancel; }
    void clearJob();
    void finishCancel();
    void finishOk();
    void publishPartial();
    void bakeOneEffect(EffectGameObject* effect);

    TriggerTrack* ensureTrack(GameObject* obj, TriggerKind kind);
    std::vector<GameObject*> objectsInGroup(int groupId) const;

    static LivePose poseFromObject(GameObject* obj);
    static TriggerPose toKey(int tick, LivePose const& live);
    static void pushKey(TriggerTrack& track, int tick, LivePose const& live);
    static int durationTicks(float durationSec, double tps);
    static bool isFollowLikeStatic(EffectGameObject* effect, TriggerKind kind);
    static cocos2d::CCPoint groupCenter(
        int groupId,
        std::vector<GameObject*> const& objects,
        std::unordered_map<int, LivePose> const& live
    );

    bool m_running = false;
    bool m_cancel = false;
    float m_progress = 0.f;
    std::string m_status;
    Phase m_phase = Phase::Idle;

    PlayLayer* m_layer = nullptr;
    double m_tps = 240.0;
    std::string m_levelKey;
    size_t m_childIndex = 0;
    size_t m_childCount = 0;
    size_t m_effectIndex = 0;

    std::vector<GameObject*> m_objects;
    std::vector<EffectGameObject*> m_effects;
    std::unordered_map<int, LivePose> m_live;
    std::unordered_map<int, TriggerTrack> m_tracks;

    size_t m_bakedEffects = 0;
    size_t m_skippedFollow = 0;
    size_t m_skippedDynamic = 0;
    size_t m_skippedNonSpawn = 0;
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_CORE_TRIGGERWORLDBAKER_HPP

```

`src/core/TriggerWorldStore.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TriggerWorldStore.hpp"
#include "AssistClock.hpp"
#include "AssistController.hpp"
#include "LevelProfile.hpp"
#include "../debug/AssistLog.hpp"

#include <Geode/utils/file.hpp>
#include <fmt/format.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace geode::prelude;

TriggerWorldStore& TriggerWorldStore::get() {
    static TriggerWorldStore inst;
    return inst;
}

std::filesystem::path TriggerWorldStore::triggersDir() {
    return Mod::get()->getSaveDir() / "triggers";
}

std::filesystem::path TriggerWorldStore::triggerPath(std::string const& key) {
    return TriggerWorldStore::triggersDir() / (key + ".json");
}

char const* TriggerWorldStore::kindToString(TriggerKind kind) {
    return TriggerClassify::kindName(kind);
}

TriggerKind TriggerWorldStore::kindFromString(std::string const& name) {
    if (name == "StaticMove") return TriggerKind::StaticMove;
    if (name == "StaticRotate") return TriggerKind::StaticRotate;
    if (name == "StaticScale") return TriggerKind::StaticScale;
    if (name == "StaticSpawn") return TriggerKind::StaticSpawn;
    if (name == "StaticToggle") return TriggerKind::StaticToggle;
    if (name == "DynamicFollow") return TriggerKind::DynamicFollow;
    if (name == "DynamicOther") return TriggerKind::DynamicOther;
    return TriggerKind::Ignore;
}

void TriggerWorldStore::clampData(TriggerWorldData& data) {
    if (data.tracks.size() > kMaxTracks) {
        data.tracks.resize(kMaxTracks);
    }
    for (auto& track : data.tracks) {
        if (track.keys.size() > kMaxKeysPerTrack) {
            track.keys.resize(kMaxKeysPerTrack);
        }
    }
}

void TriggerWorldStore::clear() {
    this->m_data = {};
    this->m_loaded = false;
    this->m_dirty = false;
}

void TriggerWorldStore::loadForLevel(GJGameLevel* level) {
    this->m_data = {};
    this->m_loaded = false;
    this->m_dirty = false;
    if (!level) return;

    this->m_data.levelKey = LevelProfile::makeKey(level);
    this->m_data.version = kFileVersion;
    this->m_loaded = true;

    auto res = this->readFile();
    if (res.isOk()) {
        AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
            "TRIGGER-WORLD: loaded {} ({} tracks, {} ready)",
            this->m_data.levelKey,
            this->m_data.tracks.size(),
            this->readyTrackCount()
        ));
        return;
    }
    AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
        "TRIGGER-WORLD: no cache for {} ({})",
        this->m_data.levelKey,
        res.unwrapErr()
    ));
}

void TriggerWorldStore::save() const {
    if (!this->m_loaded || this->m_data.levelKey.empty()) return;
    if (!this->m_dirty) return;

    auto res = this->writeFile();
    if (res.isOk()) {
        this->m_dirty = false;
        AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
            "TRIGGER-WORLD: saved {} ({} tracks)",
            this->m_data.levelKey,
            this->m_data.tracks.size()
        ));
        return;
    }
    AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
        "TRIGGER-WORLD: save failed: {}",
        res.unwrapErr()
    ));
}

void TriggerWorldStore::setData(TriggerWorldData data) {
    TriggerWorldStore::clampData(data);
    if (data.version <= 0) data.version = kFileVersion;
    if (data.tps <= 0.0) data.tps = 240.0;
    this->m_data = std::move(data);
    this->m_loaded = !this->m_data.levelKey.empty();
    this->m_dirty = true;
}

TriggerTrack const* TriggerWorldStore::findTrack(int uniqueId) const {
    for (auto const& track : this->m_data.tracks) {
        if (track.uniqueId == uniqueId) return &track;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

size_t TriggerWorldStore::readyTrackCount() const {
    size_t n = 0;
    for (auto const& track : this->m_data.tracks) {
        if (track.ready && !track.keys.empty()) ++n;
    }
    return n;
}

int TriggerWorldStore::remapLiveTick(int liveAbsTick) const {
    return this->remapLiveTick(liveAbsTick, AssistController::get().simDt());
}

int TriggerWorldStore::remapLiveTick(int liveAbsTick, float liveSimDt) const {
    double tps = this->m_data.tps;
    if (tps <= 0.0) tps = AssistClock::kNominalTps;
    return AssistClock::get().remapTick(tps, liveAbsTick, liveSimDt);
}

bool TriggerWorldStore::samplePoseAtStoreTick(
    int uniqueId, int storeTick, TriggerPose& out
) const {
    auto const* track = this->findTrack(uniqueId);
    if (!track || !track->ready || track->keys.empty()) return false;

    // keys assumed sorted ascending by tick (baker writes them that way).
    auto const& keys = track->keys;
    // Before first key: leave capture baseline (caller skips write).
    if (storeTick < keys.front().tick) return false;
    if (storeTick >= keys.back().tick) {
        out = keys.back();
        return true;
    }

    // Last key with tick <= storeTick (hold). Linear lerp optional later.
    TriggerPose const* best = &keys.front();
    for (auto const& key : keys) {
        if (key.tick > storeTick) break;
        best = &key;
    }
    out = *best;
    return true;
}

bool TriggerWorldStore::samplePose(int uniqueId, int liveAbsTick, TriggerPose& out) const {
    int const storeTick = this->remapLiveTick(liveAbsTick);
    return this->samplePoseAtStoreTick(uniqueId, storeTick, out);
}

void TriggerWorldStore::writePose(GameObject* obj, TriggerPose const& pose) {
    if (!obj) return;
    if (!pose.active) {
        obj->setVisible(false);
        return;
    }
    obj->setVisible(true);
    obj->setPosition({ pose.x, pose.y });
    obj->m_positionX = pose.x;
    obj->m_positionY = pose.y;
    obj->setRotation(pose.rotation);
    obj->setScaleX(pose.scaleX);
    obj->setScaleY(pose.scaleY);
}

int TriggerWorldStore::applyAtTick(PlayLayer* layer, int absTick) {
    if (!layer || !this->m_loaded || this->m_data.tracks.empty()) return 0;
    if (!layer->m_objectLayer) return 0;

    // Build uniqueId → object once per call (caller may prefer ShadowSimulator's
    // capture list for the hot path — see applyTriggerWorldAtTick).
    auto* children = layer->m_objectLayer->getChildren();
    if (!children) return 0;

    int applied = 0;
    for (auto const& track : this->m_data.tracks) {
        if (!track.ready || track.keys.empty()) continue;
        if (!TriggerClassify::isStatic(track.kind)) continue;

        TriggerPose pose{};
        if (!this->samplePose(track.uniqueId, absTick, pose)) continue;

        GameObject* obj = nullptr;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < children->count(); ++i) {
            auto* candidate = typeinfo_cast<GameObject*>(children->objectAtIndex(i));
            if (!candidate) continue;
            if (candidate->m_uniqueID != track.uniqueId) continue;
            obj = candidate;
            break;
        }
        if (!obj) continue;

        TriggerWorldStore::writePose(obj, pose);
        ++applied;
    }
    return applied;
}

std::string TriggerWorldStore::statusLine() const {
    if (!this->m_loaded) return "trigger-world: off";
    if (this->m_data.tracks.empty()) {
        return "trigger-world: empty";
    }
    return fmt::format(
        "trigger-world: {}/{} ready @ {:.0f} tps",
        this->readyTrackCount(),
        this->m_data.tracks.size(),
        this->m_data.tps
    );
}

bool TriggerWorldStore::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += ", ";
        report += name;
    };

    // Null-safe write (apply/restore identity without a live GameObject).
    TriggerPose dummy{};
    dummy.tick = 0;
    dummy.x = 1.f;
    dummy.y = 2.f;
    dummy.rotation = 3.f;
    dummy.scaleX = 1.f;
    dummy.scaleY = 1.f;
    dummy.active = true;
    TriggerWorldStore::writePose(nullptr, dummy);
    expect(true, "writePose-null");

    expect(TriggerClassify::classify(nullptr) == TriggerKind::Ignore, "classify-null");

    auto& store = TriggerWorldStore::get();
    store.clear();

    TriggerWorldData data;
    data.levelKey = "__selfcheck__";
    data.tps = 240.0;
    data.version = kFileVersion;

    TriggerTrack track;
    track.uniqueId = 42;
    track.objectId = 1;
    track.kind = TriggerKind::StaticMove;
    track.ready = true;
    track.keys.push_back(TriggerPose{ 10, 100.f, 200.f, 0.f, 1.f, 1.f, true });
    track.keys.push_back(TriggerPose{ 20, 150.f, 200.f, 45.f, 1.f, 1.f, true });
    data.tracks.push_back(track);

    // Not-ready track must not sample.
    TriggerTrack pending;
    pending.uniqueId = 99;
    pending.objectId = 2;
    pending.kind = TriggerKind::StaticToggle;
    pending.ready = false;
    pending.keys.push_back(TriggerPose{ 0, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 1.f, 1.f, false });
    data.tracks.push_back(pending);

    store.setData(std::move(data));

    TriggerPose out{};
    // Raw store-tick sampling (no live clock).
    expect(!store.samplePoseAtStoreTick(42, 5, out), "before-first");
    expect(
        store.samplePoseAtStoreTick(42, 10, out) && out.x == 100.f && out.y == 200.f,
        "at-first"
    );
    expect(store.samplePoseAtStoreTick(42, 15, out) && out.x == 100.f, "hold-mid");
    expect(
        store.samplePoseAtStoreTick(42, 20, out) && out.x == 150.f && out.rotation == 45.f,
        "at-last"
    );
    expect(store.samplePoseAtStoreTick(42, 99, out) && out.x == 150.f, "past-last-hold");
    expect(!store.samplePoseAtStoreTick(999, 10, out), "missing-id");
    expect(!store.samplePoseAtStoreTick(99, 0, out), "not-ready");

    // Remap: store @ 240tps, live simDt = 1/120 → live 100 → store 200.
    expect(store.remapLiveTick(100, 1.f / 240.f) == 100, "remap-identity");
    expect(store.remapLiveTick(100, 1.f / 120.f) == 200, "remap-2x-live-dt");
    // live 10 @ 2x dt → store 20 → last key pose.
    expect(
        store.samplePoseAtStoreTick(42, store.remapLiveTick(10, 1.f / 120.f), out)
            && out.x == 150.f,
        "remap-then-sample"
    );
    // live 10 @ nominal → store 10 → first key.
    expect(
        store.samplePoseAtStoreTick(42, store.remapLiveTick(10, 1.f / 240.f), out)
            && out.x == 100.f,
        "remap-id-sample"
    );

    expect(store.readyTrackCount() == 1, "ready-count");
    expect(TriggerClassify::isStatic(TriggerKind::StaticToggle), "static-toggle");
    expect(
        std::string(TriggerClassify::kindName(TriggerKind::StaticToggle)) == "StaticToggle",
        "kind-name-toggle"
    );

    store.clear();
    expect(!store.loaded() && !store.hasTracks(), "cleared");

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "TriggerWorldStore selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = fmt::format("TriggerWorldStore selfCheck {} fails: {}", fails, report);
    return false;
}

Result<> TriggerWorldStore::writeFile() const {
    (void)file::createDirectoryAll(TriggerWorldStore::triggersDir());

    matjson::Value root = matjson::Value::object();
    root["version"] = kFileVersion;
    root["key"] = this->m_data.levelKey;
    root["tps"] = this->m_data.tps;

    std::vector<matjson::Value> tracksArr;
    tracksArr.reserve(this->m_data.tracks.size());
    for (auto const& track : this->m_data.tracks) {
        matjson::Value tj = matjson::Value::object();
        tj["uniqueId"] = track.uniqueId;
        tj["objectId"] = track.objectId;
        tj["kind"] = TriggerWorldStore::kindToString(track.kind);
        tj["ready"] = track.ready;

        std::vector<matjson::Value> keysArr;
        keysArr.reserve(track.keys.size());
        for (auto const& pose : track.keys) {
            matjson::Value kj = matjson::Value::object();
            kj["t"] = pose.tick;
            kj["x"] = pose.x;
            kj["y"] = pose.y;
            kj["r"] = pose.rotation;
            kj["sx"] = pose.scaleX;
            kj["sy"] = pose.scaleY;
            kj["a"] = pose.active;
            keysArr.push_back(std::move(kj));
        }
        tj["keys"] = keysArr;
        tracksArr.push_back(std::move(tj));
    }
    root["tracks"] = tracksArr;

    return file::writeToJson(
        TriggerWorldStore::triggerPath(this->m_data.levelKey),
        root
    );
}

Result<> TriggerWorldStore::readFile() {
    auto res = file::readJson(TriggerWorldStore::triggerPath(this->m_data.levelKey));
    if (res.isErr()) return Err(res.unwrapErr());

    auto root = res.unwrap();
    int const ver = static_cast<int>(root["version"].asInt().unwrapOr(0));
    if (ver != kFileVersion) {
        this->m_data.tracks.clear();
        return Err(fmt::format("version {} != {}", ver, kFileVersion));
    }

    if (root.contains("tps")) {
        this->m_data.tps = root["tps"].asDouble().unwrapOr(240.0);
    }
    if (this->m_data.tps <= 0.0) this->m_data.tps = 240.0;

    this->m_data.tracks.clear();
    if (!root.contains("tracks") || !root["tracks"].isArray()) {
        return Ok();
    }

    for (auto const& tj : root["tracks"]) {
        if (this->m_data.tracks.size() >= kMaxTracks) break;

        TriggerTrack track;
        track.uniqueId = static_cast<int>(tj["uniqueId"].asInt().unwrapOr(0));
        track.objectId = static_cast<int>(tj["objectId"].asInt().unwrapOr(0));
        track.kind = TriggerWorldStore::kindFromString(
            tj.contains("kind") ? tj["kind"].asString().unwrapOr("Ignore") : "Ignore"
        );
        track.ready = tj["ready"].asBool().unwrapOr(false);

        if (track.uniqueId == 0) continue;
        // Disk may contain Dynamic* from older experiments — keep but not "ready"
        // for apply until baker decides; still load for inspection.
        if (!tj.contains("keys") || !tj["keys"].isArray()) {
            this->m_data.tracks.push_back(std::move(track));
            continue;
        }

        for (auto const& kj : tj["keys"]) {
            if (track.keys.size() >= kMaxKeysPerTrack) break;
            TriggerPose pose;
            pose.tick = static_cast<int>(kj["t"].asInt().unwrapOr(0));
            pose.x = static_cast<float>(kj["x"].asDouble().unwrapOr(0.0));
            pose.y = static_cast<float>(kj["y"].asDouble().unwrapOr(0.0));
            pose.rotation = static_cast<float>(kj["r"].asDouble().unwrapOr(0.0));
            pose.scaleX = static_cast<float>(kj["sx"].asDouble().unwrapOr(1.0));
            pose.scaleY = static_cast<float>(kj["sy"].asDouble().unwrapOr(1.0));
            pose.active = kj["a"].asBool().unwrapOr(true);
            track.keys.push_back(pose);
        }

        std::stable_sort(track.keys.begin(), track.keys.end(),
            [](TriggerPose const& a, TriggerPose const& b) {
                return a.tick < b.tick;
            }
        );
        this->m_data.tracks.push_back(std::move(track));
    }

    this->m_dirty = false;
    return Ok();
}
```

`src/core/TriggerWorldStore.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_CORE_TRIGGERWORLDSTORE_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_CORE_TRIGGERWORLDSTORE_HPP

#include "TriggerClassify.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <cstddef>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

class GJGameLevel;
class GameObject;
class PlayLayer;

// One sampled pose for a moved/rotated/scaled object at an absolute attempt tick.
struct TriggerPose {
    int tick = 0;
    float x = 0.f;
    float y = 0.f;
    float rotation = 0.f;
    float scaleX = 1.f;
    float scaleY = 1.f;
    bool active = true;
};

// Sparse keyframe track for one GameObject (keyed by m_uniqueID).
struct TriggerTrack {
    int uniqueId = 0;
    int objectId = 0;
    TriggerKind kind = TriggerKind::Ignore;
    bool ready = false;
    std::vector<TriggerPose> keys;
};

struct TriggerWorldData {
    std::string levelKey;
    double tps = 240.0;
    int version = 1;
    std::vector<TriggerTrack> tracks;
};

// Content-keyed cache of static trigger motion.
// Disk: {saveDir}/triggers/{fullKey}.json
// Built by TriggerWorldBaker on cache miss; applied by ShadowSimulator.
class TriggerWorldStore {
public:
    static constexpr int kFileVersion = 1;
    static constexpr size_t kMaxTracks = 2048;
    static constexpr size_t kMaxKeysPerTrack = 8192;

    static TriggerWorldStore& get();

    void clear();
    void loadForLevel(GJGameLevel* level);
    void save() const;

    bool loaded() const { return this->m_loaded; }
    bool hasTracks() const { return !this->m_data.tracks.empty(); }
    bool dirty() const { return this->m_dirty; }
    void markDirty() { this->m_dirty = true; }

    TriggerWorldData const& data() const { return this->m_data; }

    // Replace in-memory data (baker). Marks dirty. Caps track/key counts.
    void setData(TriggerWorldData data);

    TriggerTrack const* findTrack(int uniqueId) const;
    size_t trackCount() const { return this->m_data.tracks.size(); }
    size_t readyTrackCount() const;

    // Map live attempt tick → store/bake tick using data().tps and liveSimDt.
    // Identity when authorTps * liveSimDt ≈ 1.
    int remapLiveTick(int liveAbsTick) const;
    int remapLiveTick(int liveAbsTick, float liveSimDt) const;

    // Sample at live absTick (remaps to store tick first).
    // Hold last; before first key → false = keep baseline.
    bool samplePose(int uniqueId, int liveAbsTick, TriggerPose& out) const;
    // Sample with an already-remapped store tick (tests / bakers).
    bool samplePoseAtStoreTick(int uniqueId, int storeTick, TriggerPose& out) const;

    // Write a sampled pose onto a live GameObject (position/rot/scale/visible).
    static void writePose(GameObject* obj, TriggerPose const& pose);

    // Apply all ready Static* tracks at live absTick (remapped). Walks objectLayer.
    // Returns number of objects written. No-op if store empty / bake off caller.
    int applyAtTick(PlayLayer* layer, int liveAbsTick);

    std::string statusLine() const;

    // Headless: samplePose hold/before/after, writePose(null), kind round-trip.
    // Leaves the singleton cleared (safe at mod load before any level).
    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    TriggerWorldStore() = default;

    geode::Result<> writeFile() const;
    geode::Result<> readFile();

    static std::filesystem::path triggersDir();
    static std::filesystem::path triggerPath(std::string const& key);

    static char const* kindToString(TriggerKind kind);
    static TriggerKind kindFromString(std::string const& name);

    static void clampData(TriggerWorldData& data);

    TriggerWorldData m_data;
    bool m_loaded = false;
    mutable bool m_dirty = false;
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_CORE_TRIGGERWORLDSTORE_HPP

```

`src/debug/AssistLog.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "AssistLog.hpp"
#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <fmt/format.h>

using namespace geode::prelude;

char const* AssistLog::modTag() {
    return "EarlyBuffer";
}

double AssistLog::ticksToFrames60(int ticks, double physicsTps) {
    if (physicsTps <= 0.0) physicsTps = 240.0;
    return static_cast<double>(ticks) * (60.0 / physicsTps);
}

void AssistLog::info(std::string const& message) {
    log::info("[{}] {}", modTag(), message);
}

void AssistLog::debug(std::string const& message) {
    if (!StageConfig::debugLogging()) return;
    log::info("[{}] {}", modTag(), message);
}

void AssistLog::printBanner() {
    auto const stage = StageConfig::fromSettings();
    auto const version = Mod::get()->getVersion().toVString();
    log::info("======================");
    log::info("[{}] {} LOADED", modTag(), version);
    if (!stage.enabled || stage.index >= StageConfig::STAGE_COUNT - 1) {
        log::info("[{}] Starting Mode: OFF", modTag());
    }
    else {
        log::info(
            "[{}] Starting Preset: {} ({} ALL / {} Wave, slack {})",
            modTag(),
            StageConfig::presetName(stage.index),
            stage.ticksAll,
            stage.ticksWave,
            StageConfig::deathSlack()
        );
    }
    log::info(
        "[{}] F6: presets  |  Ctrl+Shift+M: modes  |  Ctrl+Shift+T: trajectory  |  Ctrl+Shift+L: learning",
        modTag()
    );
    log::info(
        "[{}] Assist mode: {} ({})",
        modTag(),
        StageConfig::assistModeName(StageConfig::assistMode()),
        StageConfig::assistModeHint(StageConfig::assistMode())
    );
    if (StageConfig::debugLogging()) {
        log::info("[{}] Trigger-world manual edge matrix:", modTag());
        log::info("[{}]   1) static move corridor — bake ready → Include, pose follows keys", modTag());
        log::info("[{}]   2) follow-player spike — DynamicFollow → Unknown (skip-dynamic on)", modTag());
        log::info("[{}]   3) cache hit 2nd enter — loadOrBuild, no rebuild / no hitch", modTag());
        log::info("[{}]   4) skip-dynamic on — no live probe; targets stay Unknown", modTag());
        log::info("[{}]   5) quit mid-build — cancel, save dirty partial, clear", modTag());
        log::info("[{}]   6) death/reset LagProbe — no eb.triggerBake.build inside death episode", modTag());
        log::info("[{}]      (build only via tickSlice / loadOrBuild; death cancels, reset may resume)", modTag());
    }
    log::info("======================");
}

void AssistLog::printCycle(StageInfo const& stage, double physicsTps) {
    if (!stage.enabled || stage.index >= StageConfig::STAGE_COUNT - 1) {
        log::info("[{}] F6 Cycle -> OFF", modTag());
        return;
    }

    auto const frames60 = ticksToFrames60(stage.ticksAll, physicsTps);
    if (stage.ticksWave != stage.ticksAll) {
        auto const waveFrames = ticksToFrames60(stage.ticksWave, physicsTps);
        log::info(
            "[{}] F6 Cycle -> {}: {} Ticks All | {} Ticks Wave ({:.1f}f @ 60fps, wave {:.1f}f)",
            modTag(),
            StageConfig::presetName(stage.index),
            stage.ticksAll,
            stage.ticksWave,
            frames60,
            waveFrames
        );
    }
    else {
        log::info(
            "[{}] F6 Cycle -> {}: {} Ticks All | {} Ticks Wave ({:.1f}f @ 60fps)",
            modTag(),
            StageConfig::presetName(stage.index),
            stage.ticksAll,
            stage.ticksWave,
            frames60
        );
    }
}

void AssistLog::printSavedPress(
    int delayedTicks,
    int frame0,
    int delayedFrame,
    int limit,
    double physicsTps
) {
    if (!StageConfig::debugLogging()) return;
    auto const frames60 = ticksToFrames60(delayedTicks, physicsTps);
    log::info(
        "[{}] *** SAVED +{} TICKS ({:.2f} frames @ 60fps) PRESS! (Frame0: {} -> Delayed: {}) [Limit: {}] ****",
        modTag(),
        delayedTicks,
        frames60,
        frame0,
        delayedFrame,
        limit
    );
}
```

`src/debug/LagProbe.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "LagProbe.hpp"
#include "AssistLog.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <fmt/format.h>

#include <fstream>

using namespace geode::prelude;

LagProbe& LagProbe::get() {
    static LagProbe inst;
    return inst;
}

LagProbe::Scope::Scope(char const* name, std::string detail) {
    this->m_name = name;
    if (!LagProbe::get().enabled()) return;
    // Only nest when an episode is open (death/reset/checkpoint).
    if (!LagProbe::get().episodeOpen()) return;
    this->m_active = true;
    LagProbe::get().begin(name, std::move(detail));
}

LagProbe::Scope::~Scope() {
    if (!this->m_active) return;
    LagProbe::get().end(this->m_name);
}

bool LagProbe::enabled() const {
    return this->m_enabled;
}

void LagProbe::setEnabled(bool on) {
    if (this->m_enabled == on) return;
    this->m_enabled = on;
    if (on) {
        this->reset();
        this->writeLegend();
        this->flush();
        AssistLog::info(fmt::format("LagProbe ON → {}", logPath()));
        return;
    }
    if (this->m_episodeOpen) this->endEpisode();
    this->flush();
    AssistLog::info("LagProbe OFF");
}

std::string LagProbe::logPath() {
    auto* mod = Mod::get();
    if (!mod) return {};
    return (mod->getSaveDir() / "earlybuffer-lagprobe.log").string();
}

void LagProbe::reset() {
    this->m_episodeOpen = false;
    this->m_episodeName = nullptr;
    this->m_depth = 0;
    this->m_pending.clear();
    this->m_pendingLines = 0;
}

void LagProbe::writeToFile(std::string const& text) {
    if (text.empty()) return;
    auto const path = logPath();
    if (path.empty()) return;
    std::ofstream out(path, std::ios::app);
    if (!out) return;
    out << text;
    if (!text.empty() && text.back() != '\n') out << '\n';
}

void LagProbe::appendLine(std::string const& line) {
    this->m_pending += line;
    this->m_pending.push_back('\n');
    ++this->m_pendingLines;
    // Keep death episodes durable — flush often so a crash still leaves data.
    if (this->m_pendingLines >= 24) {
        this->writeToFile(this->m_pending);
        this->m_pending.clear();
        this->m_pendingLines = 0;
    }
}

void LagProbe::flush() {
    if (!this->m_pending.empty()) {
        this->writeToFile(this->m_pending);
        this->m_pending.clear();
        this->m_pendingLines = 0;
    }
}

void LagProbe::writeLegend() {
    this->appendLine("================================================================");
    this->appendLine("EarlyBuffer LagProbe — death / reset / checkpoint timings");
    this->appendLine(fmt::format("file: {}", logPath()));
    this->appendLine("----------------------------------------------------------------");
    this->appendLine("HOW TO USE");
    this->appendLine("  1. Leave Lag Probe ON. Die at the laggy spot. Restart / continue.");
    this->appendLine("  2. Open this file; jump to the latest EPISODE BEGIN death/resetLevel.");
    this->appendLine("  3. Sort by '= X.XXms' — biggest number = cost driver.");
    this->appendLine("  4. If vanilla.PlayLayer::resetLevel (or loadFromCheckpoint) wins,");
    this->appendLine("     the hitch is GD/other mods. If evacuate*/flush*/learn* wins,");
    this->appendLine("     it is EarlyBuffer — send that EPISODE block.");
    this->appendLine("----------------------------------------------------------------");
    this->appendLine("EPISODE NAMES");
    this->appendLine("  death              PlayLayer::destroyPlayer real-player path");
    this->appendLine("  resetLevel         PlayLayer::resetLevel (attempt restart)");
    this->appendLine("  loadFromCheckpoint practice checkpoint reload");
    this->appendLine("----------------------------------------------------------------");
    this->appendLine("EVENT NAMES (inside episodes)");
    this->appendLine("  eb.onRealDeath              our death bookkeeping (no physics)");
    this->appendLine("  eb.outcomeNote              DivergenceTracker on pending plan");
    this->appendLine("  eb.learnDeath               LevelProfile noteDied / earliness");
    this->appendLine("  eb.maybeAutosave            profile dirty/decay (no disk ideal)");
    this->appendLine("  eb.saveCounterClear         SaveFrameCounter::clear markers");
    this->appendLine("  eb.syncButtons              stuck-jump button sync");
    this->appendLine("  vanilla.destroyPlayer       GD PlayLayer::destroyPlayer rest");
    this->appendLine("  eb.bakeCancel               BakeScheduler::cancel");
    this->appendLine("  eb.evacuateGhosts           pull ghosts out of section vectors");
    this->appendLine("  eb.evacuate.scrub           full/targeted section scrub");
    this->appendLine("  eb.evacuate.tryRemove       index-based erase per ghost");
    this->appendLine("  eb.evacuate.park            park/hide ghost bodies");
    this->appendLine("  eb.resetAttempt             clear buffers / flush self-bake");
    this->appendLine("  eb.flushSegment             (deferred on reset/checkpoint)");
    this->appendLine("  eb.selfBake.idleMerge       amortized pending→BakeMap merge");
    this->appendLine("  eb.selfBake.idleRefine      amortized window refine (few sims/tick)");
    this->appendLine("  eb.selfBake.flushMergeOnly  quit/complete force-merge, no refine");
    this->appendLine("  eb.triggerBake.load         TriggerWorldStore::loadForLevel");
    this->appendLine("  eb.triggerBake.build        TriggerWorldBaker slice / kinematic build");
    this->appendLine("  eb.triggerBake.save         TriggerWorldStore::save (quit/complete)");
    this->appendLine("  eb.trigger.capture          snapshot transforms for bake tracks");
    this->appendLine("  eb.trigger.apply            write baked poses at abs tick (sim)");
    this->appendLine("  eb.trigger.restore          restore transforms after sim / evacuate");
    this->appendLine("  triggerWorld.checkpoint     mark: keep store, attemptTick reset");
    this->appendLine("  eb.saveFeedbackReset        SaveFeedback::reset");
    this->appendLine("  eb.clickGuardReset          ClickIntentGuard::reset");
    this->appendLine("  eb.updateOverlay            status overlay string refresh");
    this->appendLine("  eb.dev.eval                 Dev Lab counterfactual grid eval");
    this->appendLine("  vanilla.PlayLayer::resetLevel   GD attempt rebuild (often huge)");
    this->appendLine("  vanilla.loadFromCheckpoint  GD checkpoint apply");
    this->appendLine("  eb.onCheckpointLoad         our checkpoint-side flush");
    this->appendLine("================================================================");
}

double LagProbe::msSinceEpisode() const {
    if (!this->m_episodeOpen) return 0.0;
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
        std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - this->m_episodeStart
    ).count() / 1000.0;
}

std::string LagProbe::indent() const {
    // depth 0 → two spaces under episode; nested scopes add two each.
    return std::string(static_cast<size_t>(2 + this->m_depth * 2), ' ');
}

void LagProbe::beginEpisode(char const* name, std::string detail) {
    if (!this->m_enabled || !name) return;
    if (this->m_episodeOpen) this->endEpisode();

    this->m_episodeOpen = true;
    this->m_episodeName = name;
    this->m_episodeStart = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    this->m_depth = 0;

    if (detail.empty()) {
        this->appendLine(fmt::format("EPISODE BEGIN {}", name));
    }
    else {
        this->appendLine(fmt::format("EPISODE BEGIN {} | {}", name, detail));
    }
}

void LagProbe::endEpisode() {
    if (!this->m_enabled || !this->m_episodeOpen) return;

    while (this->m_depth > 0) {
        this->end(this->m_stack[this->m_depth - 1].name
            ? this->m_stack[this->m_depth - 1].name
            : "?");
    }

    double const total = this->msSinceEpisode();
    char const* name = this->m_episodeName ? this->m_episodeName : "?";
    this->appendLine(fmt::format(
        "EPISODE END {} total={:.2f}ms",
        name,
        total
    ));
    this->appendLine("----");
    this->m_episodeOpen = false;
    this->m_episodeName = nullptr;
    this->flush();
}

void LagProbe::begin(char const* name, std::string detail) {
    if (!this->m_enabled || !this->m_episodeOpen || !name) return;
    if (this->m_depth >= kMaxDepth) return;

    if (detail.empty()) {
        this->appendLine(fmt::format(
            "+{:.2f}ms {}> {}",
            this->msSinceEpisode(),
            this->indent(),
            name
        ));
    }
    else {
        this->appendLine(fmt::format(
            "+{:.2f}ms {}> {} | {}",
            this->msSinceEpisode(),
            this->indent(),
            name,
            detail
        ));
    }

    this->m_stack[this->m_depth].name = name;
    this->m_stack[this->m_depth].start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    ++this->m_depth;
}

void LagProbe::end(char const* name) {
    if (!this->m_enabled || !this->m_episodeOpen || this->m_depth <= 0) return;

    --this->m_depth;
    auto const& fr = this->m_stack[this->m_depth];
    char const* n = name;
    if (fr.name && fr.name[0]) n = fr.name;

    double const us = static_cast<double>(
        std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - fr.start
        ).count()
    );

    this->appendLine(fmt::format(
        "+{:.2f}ms {}< {} = {:.2f}ms",
        this->msSinceEpisode(),
        this->indent(),
        n ? n : "?",
        us / 1000.0
    ));
}

void LagProbe::mark(char const* name, std::string detail) {
    if (!this->m_enabled || !this->m_episodeOpen || !name) return;
    if (detail.empty()) {
        this->appendLine(fmt::format(
            "+{:.2f}ms {}MARK {}",
            this->msSinceEpisode(),
            this->indent(),
            name
        ));
        return;
    }
    this->appendLine(fmt::format(
        "+{:.2f}ms {}MARK {} | {}",
        this->msSinceEpisode(),
        this->indent(),
        name,
        detail
    ));
}
```
