`src/debug/LagProbe.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_DEBUG_LAGPROBE_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_DEBUG_LAGPROBE_HPP

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

// Episode logger for death → reset / checkpoint hitches.
//
// Unlike PerfTrace (per-physics-tick noise), LagProbe only records discrete
// episodes we care about when hunting "I died here and FPS hitch'd":
//   destroyPlayer → onRealDeath → (later) resetLevel / loadFromCheckpoint
//
// Log file (mod save dir):
//   earlybuffer-lagprobe.log
// Full path example:
//   %LOCALAPPDATA%/GeometryDash/geode/mods/audesign.earlybuffer/earlybuffer-lagprobe.log
//
// Enable: EarlyBuffer setting "Lag Probe" (lag-probe). Default ON.
// Each enable writes a legend of every event name. Reproduce a spike, quit or
// wait for auto-flush, then paste the latest EPISODE block.
//
// Line formats:
//   EPISODE BEGIN <name> | <detail>     wall clock starts
//   +12.34ms  |indent| <event> = 1.23ms | detail
//   +12.34ms  |indent| MARK <event> | detail     (zero-width bookmark)
//   EPISODE END <name> total=45.67ms
//
// How to read a spike:
//   1. Find EPISODE BEGIN death / resetLevel near the hitch.
//   2. The line with the largest "= X.XXms" inside that episode is OUR cost.
//   3. If resetLevel's "vanilla.PlayLayer::resetLevel" dominates, the hitch is
//      GD / other mods — not EarlyBuffer ghosts.
//   4. GAP lines in earlybuffer-perf.log (if Perf Trace on) measure wall time
//      BETWEEN physics ticks (includes death anim + other mods).
class LagProbe {
public:
    class Scope {
    public:
        explicit Scope(char const* name, std::string detail = {});
        ~Scope();
        Scope(Scope const&) = delete;
        Scope& operator=(Scope const&) = delete;

    private:
        char const* m_name = nullptr;
        bool m_active = false;
    };

    static LagProbe& get();

    void setEnabled(bool on);
    bool enabled() const;
    bool episodeOpen() const { return this->m_episodeOpen; }

    static std::string logPath();

    // Open a top-level episode (auto-closes a previous open episode).
    void beginEpisode(char const* name, std::string detail = {});
    void endEpisode();

    // Nested timing (also via Scope). Safe outside episodes → no-op.
    void begin(char const* name, std::string detail = {});
    void end(char const* name);

    // Instant bookmark at current wall offset (no duration).
    void mark(char const* name, std::string detail = {});

    // Force disk write (also on episode end).
    void flush();

    void reset();

private:
    LagProbe() = default;

    void appendLine(std::string const& line);
    void writeToFile(std::string const& text);
    void writeLegend();
    double msSinceEpisode() const;
    std::string indent() const;

    bool m_enabled = false;
    bool m_episodeOpen = false;
    char const* m_episodeName = nullptr;
    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point m_episodeStart{};

    static constexpr int kMaxDepth = 12;
    struct Frame {
        char const* name = nullptr;
        std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point start{};
    };
    Frame m_stack[kMaxDepth]{};
    int m_depth = 0;

    std::string m_pending;
    int m_pendingLines = 0;
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_DEBUG_LAGPROBE_HPP

```

`src/debug/PerfTrace.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "PerfTrace.hpp"
#include "AssistLog.hpp"
#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <fmt/format.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <fstream>

using namespace geode::prelude;

PerfTrace& PerfTrace::get() {
    static PerfTrace inst;
    return inst;
}

PerfTrace::Scope::Scope(char const* name) {
    this->m_name = name;
    if (!PerfTrace::get().enabled()) return;
    this->m_active = true;
    PerfTrace::get().begin(name);
}

PerfTrace::Scope::~Scope() {
    if (!this->m_active) return;
    PerfTrace::get().end(this->m_name);
}

bool PerfTrace::enabled() const {
    return this->m_enabled;
}

void PerfTrace::setEnabled(bool on) {
    if (this->m_enabled == on) return;
    this->m_enabled = on;
    if (on) {
        this->reset();
        this->appendLine(fmt::format(
            "=== PerfTrace ON spike>{}us hotSection>{}us ===",
            static_cast<long long>(kSpikeUs),
            static_cast<long long>(kHotSectionUs)
        ));
        this->flush("enable");
        AssistLog::info(fmt::format("PerfTrace ON → {}", logPath()));
        return;
    }
    this->flush("disable");
    AssistLog::info("PerfTrace OFF");
}

std::string PerfTrace::logPath() {
    auto* mod = Mod::get();
    if (!mod) return {};
    return (mod->getSaveDir() / "earlybuffer-perf.log").string();
}

void PerfTrace::reset() {
    this->m_tickOpen = false;
    this->m_ticksSinceSummary = 0;
    this->m_spikeCount = 0;
    this->m_hasLastBegin = false;
    this->m_stackDepth = 0;
    this->m_ringWrite = 0;
    this->m_ringCount = 0;
    this->m_pending.clear();
    this->m_pendingLines = 0;
    this->m_current = {};
}

void PerfTrace::writeToFile(std::string const& text) {
    if (text.empty()) return;
    auto const path = logPath();
    if (path.empty()) return;
    std::ofstream out(path, std::ios::app);
    if (!out) return;
    out << text;
    if (!text.empty() && text.back() != '\n') out << '\n';
}

void PerfTrace::appendLine(std::string const& line) {
    this->m_pending += line;
    this->m_pending.push_back('\n');
    ++this->m_pendingLines;
    // Bound memory if someone leaves verbose mode running for hours.
    if (this->m_pendingLines >= 400) {
        this->writeToFile(this->m_pending);
        this->m_pending.clear();
        this->m_pendingLines = 0;
    }
}

void PerfTrace::flush(char const* reason) {
    if (!this->m_pending.empty()) {
        this->writeToFile(this->m_pending);
        this->m_pending.clear();
        this->m_pendingLines = 0;
    }
    if (reason && reason[0]) {
        this->writeToFile(fmt::format("--- flush ({}) spikes={} ---", reason, this->m_spikeCount));
    }
}

void PerfTrace::note(char const* event, std::string const& detail) {
    if (!this->m_enabled || !event) return;
    if (detail.empty()) {
        this->appendLine(fmt::format("NOTE {}", event));
        return;
    }
    this->appendLine(fmt::format("NOTE {} | {}", event, detail));
}

void PerfTrace::beginTick(int attemptTick, float dt) {
    if (!this->m_enabled) return;

    auto const now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    int64_t gapUs = 0;
    if (this->m_hasLastBegin) {
        gapUs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
            now - this->m_lastBegin
        ).count();
    }
    this->m_lastBegin = now;
    this->m_tickStart = now;
    this->m_hasLastBegin = true;

    this->m_current = {};
    this->m_current.attemptTick = attemptTick;
    this->m_current.dt = dt;
    this->m_current.gapUs = gapUs;
    this->m_stackDepth = 0;
    this->m_tickOpen = true;

    // Gap much larger than physics dt → render/hitch outside our scopes.
    if (gapUs > 12000) {
        this->appendLine(fmt::format(
            "GAP tick={} gap={:.2f}ms dt={:.4f} (hitch before our work)",
            attemptTick,
            gapUs / 1000.0,
            dt
        ));
    }
}

void PerfTrace::begin(char const* section) {
    if (!this->m_enabled || !section) return;

    if (!this->m_tickOpen) {
        // Input-path plan / one-shots outside physicsTick — log on end as ORPHAN.
        this->m_orphan.name = section;
        this->m_orphan.start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        this->m_orphanOpen = true;
        return;
    }

    if (this->m_stackDepth >= static_cast<int>(std::size(this->m_stack))) return;
    this->m_stack[this->m_stackDepth].name = section;
    this->m_stack[this->m_stackDepth].start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    ++this->m_stackDepth;
}

void PerfTrace::end(char const* section) {
    if (!this->m_enabled || !section) return;

    if (!this->m_tickOpen) {
        if (!this->m_orphanOpen) return;
        this->m_orphanOpen = false;
        int64_t const us = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - this->m_orphan.start
        ).count();
        char const* name = this->m_orphan.name ? this->m_orphan.name : section;
        auto const line = fmt::format("ORPHAN {}={:.2f}ms", name, us / 1000.0);
        this->appendLine(line);
        // Do NOT sync-flush to disk on orphans. Also skip console for routine
        // sub-5ms plan/evacuate noise — AssistLog::info every click hitchs FPS.
        constexpr int64_t kOrphanConsoleUs = 5000;
        if (us >= kOrphanConsoleUs) {
            AssistLog::info(line);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (this->m_stackDepth <= 0) return;

    --this->m_stackDepth;
    auto const& open = this->m_stack[this->m_stackDepth];
    char const* name = section;
    if (open.name && open.name[0]) name = open.name;

    int64_t const us = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
        std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - open.start
    ).count();

    if (this->m_current.sectionCount < kMaxSectionsPerTick) {
        auto& slot = this->m_current.sections[this->m_current.sectionCount++];
        slot.name = name;
        slot.us = us;
    }
}

void PerfTrace::dumpSpike(TickSample const& tick) {
    ++this->m_spikeCount;

    std::string parts;
    for (int i = 0; i < tick.sectionCount; ++i) {
        auto const& s = tick.sections[i];
        if (!s.name) continue;
        parts += fmt::format(" {}={:.2f}ms", s.name, s.us / 1000.0);
    }

    auto const line = fmt::format(
        "SPIKE #{} tick={} total={:.2f}ms gap={:.2f}ms dt={:.4f} |{}",
        this->m_spikeCount,
        tick.attemptTick,
        tick.totalUs / 1000.0,
        tick.gapUs / 1000.0,
        tick.dt,
        parts.empty() ? " (no sections)" : parts
    );
    this->appendLine(line);
    AssistLog::info(line);
    // Batch to disk — sync flush on every spike hitch (saveSound ~4ms + flush).
    if ((this->m_spikeCount % 8) == 0 || this->m_pendingLines >= 80) {
        this->flush("spike");
    }
}

void PerfTrace::dumpPeriodicSummary() {
    if (this->m_ringCount <= 0) return;

    int64_t sumTotal = 0;
    int64_t maxTotal = 0;
    int64_t sumGap = 0;
    int64_t maxGap = 0;
    int n = this->m_ringCount;

    struct Agg {
        char const* name = nullptr;
        int64_t sum = 0;
        int64_t max = 0;
        int hits = 0;
    };
    Agg aggs[kMaxSectionsPerTick]{};
    int aggCount = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        auto const& t = this->m_ring[i];
        sumTotal += t.totalUs;
        maxTotal = std::max(maxTotal, t.totalUs);
        sumGap += t.gapUs;
        maxGap = std::max(maxGap, t.gapUs);

        for (int s = 0; s < t.sectionCount; ++s) {
            auto const& sec = t.sections[s];
            if (!sec.name) continue;
            int found = -1;
            for (int a = 0; a < aggCount; ++a) {
                if (aggs[a].name == sec.name) { found = a; break; }
            }
            if (found < 0) {
                if (aggCount >= kMaxSectionsPerTick) continue;
                found = aggCount++;
                aggs[found].name = sec.name;
            }
            aggs[found].sum += sec.us;
            aggs[found].max = std::max(aggs[found].max, sec.us);
            ++aggs[found].hits;
        }
    }

    std::string parts;
    // Sort-ish: emit hottest max first (simple selection of top entries).
    for (int pass = 0; pass < aggCount && pass < 8; ++pass) {
        int best = -1;
        for (int a = 0; a < aggCount; ++a) {
            if (!aggs[a].name) continue;
            if (best < 0 || aggs[a].max > aggs[best].max) best = a;
        }
        if (best < 0) break;
        parts += fmt::format(
            " {} avg={:.2f}ms max={:.2f}ms n={}",
            aggs[best].name,
            (aggs[best].sum / std::max(1, aggs[best].hits)) / 1000.0,
            aggs[best].max / 1000.0,
            aggs[best].hits
        );
        aggs[best].name = nullptr;
    }

    auto const line = fmt::format(
        "SUMMARY last {} ticks: totalAvg={:.2f}ms totalMax={:.2f}ms gapAvg={:.2f}ms gapMax={:.2f}ms spikes={} |{}",
        n,
        (sumTotal / std::max(1, n)) / 1000.0,
        maxTotal / 1000.0,
        (sumGap / std::max(1, n)) / 1000.0,
        maxGap / 1000.0,
        this->m_spikeCount,
        parts.empty() ? " (none)" : parts
    );
    this->appendLine(line);
    AssistLog::info(line);
    // Summary every ~120 ticks; flush only when buffer is chunky.
    if (this->m_pendingLines >= 40) {
        this->flush("summary");
    }
}

void PerfTrace::endTick() {
    if (!this->m_enabled || !this->m_tickOpen) return;
    this->m_tickOpen = false;

    // Close any leaked scopes.
    while (this->m_stackDepth > 0) {
        this->end(this->m_stack[this->m_stackDepth - 1].name
            ? this->m_stack[this->m_stackDepth - 1].name
            : "?");
    }

    // Wall time of our whole hook (avoids double-counting nested section sums).
    int64_t const wallUs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
        std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - this->m_tickStart
    ).count();
    this->m_current.totalUs = wallUs;

    this->m_ring[this->m_ringWrite] = this->m_current;
    this->m_ringWrite = (this->m_ringWrite + 1) % kRingTicks;
    if (this->m_ringCount < kRingTicks) ++this->m_ringCount;

    bool const spike = this->m_current.totalUs >= kSpikeUs;
    bool hotSection = false;
    if (!spike) {
        for (int i = 0; i < this->m_current.sectionCount; ++i) {
            if (this->m_current.sections[i].us >= kHotSectionUs) {
                hotSection = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if (spike || hotSection) {
        this->dumpSpike(this->m_current);
    }

    ++this->m_ticksSinceSummary;
    if (this->m_ticksSinceSummary >= kRingTicks) {
        this->m_ticksSinceSummary = 0;
        this->dumpPeriodicSummary();
    }
}
```

`src/debug/PerfTrace.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_DEBUG_PERFTRACE_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_DEBUG_PERFTRACE_HPP

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

// Lightweight section profiler for FPS / physics-tick spikes.
// When enabled: times named scopes, keeps a ring of recent ticks, dumps spikes
// to Geode log + save-dir file `earlybuffer-perf.log`.
class PerfTrace {
public:
    static constexpr int kMaxSectionsPerTick = 32;
    static constexpr int kRingTicks = 120;
    // Our work in one physics tick above this → SPIKE dump (microseconds).
    static constexpr int64_t kSpikeUs = 4000; // 4 ms
    // Single section above this → always noted in spike dump.
    static constexpr int64_t kHotSectionUs = 1000; // 1 ms

    class Scope {
    public:
        explicit Scope(char const* name);
        ~Scope();
        Scope(Scope const&) = delete;
        Scope& operator=(Scope const&) = delete;

    private:
        char const* m_name = nullptr;
        bool m_active = false;
    };

    static PerfTrace& get();

    void setEnabled(bool on);
    bool enabled() const;

    // Call once at the start/end of AssistController::onPhysicsTick.
    void beginTick(int attemptTick, float dt);
    void endTick();

    void begin(char const* section);
    void end(char const* section);

    // Free-form event line (always timestamped into the file buffer when enabled).
    void note(char const* event, std::string const& detail = {});

    // Force-write buffered lines + a summary (e.g. on quit / setting toggle).
    void flush(char const* reason);

    void reset();

    // Path of the log file (empty if mod unavailable).
    static std::string logPath();

private:
    struct SectionSample {
        char const* name = nullptr;
        int64_t us = 0;
    };

    struct TickSample {
        int attemptTick = 0;
        float dt = 0.f;
        int64_t gapUs = 0;     // wall time since previous beginTick
        int64_t totalUs = 0;   // sum of sections this tick
        int sectionCount = 0;
        SectionSample sections[kMaxSectionsPerTick]{};
    };

    struct OpenSection {
        char const* name = nullptr;
        std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point start{};
    };

    PerfTrace() = default;

    void appendLine(std::string const& line);
    void dumpSpike(TickSample const& tick);
    void dumpPeriodicSummary();
    void writeToFile(std::string const& text);

    bool m_enabled = false;
    bool m_tickOpen = false;
    int m_ticksSinceSummary = 0;
    int m_spikeCount = 0;

    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point m_lastBegin{};
    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point m_tickStart{};
    bool m_hasLastBegin = false;

    TickSample m_current{};
    OpenSection m_stack[8]{};
    int m_stackDepth = 0;
    // Sections started outside beginTick/endTick (e.g. input-thread plan).
    OpenSection m_orphan{};
    bool m_orphanOpen = false;

    TickSample m_ring[kRingTicks]{};
    int m_ringWrite = 0;
    int m_ringCount = 0;

    std::string m_pending; // coalesced file writes
    int m_pendingLines = 0;
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_DEBUG_PERFTRACE_HPP
```

`src/dev/DevClockContract.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "DevClockContract.hpp"

#include "../core/AssistClock.hpp"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <fmt/format.h>

DevClockContract& DevClockContract::get() {
    static DevClockContract inst;
    return inst;
}

char const* DevClockContract::simPathId(DevSimPathId id) {
    switch (id) {
        case DevSimPathId::Plan: return "ShadowSimulator.plan";
        case DevSimPathId::PlanSequence: return "ShadowSimulator.planSequence";
        case DevSimPathId::VerifyDelay: return "ShadowSimulator.verifyDelay";
        case DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze:
            return "ShadowSimulator.evalDelayFromFreeze";
        case DevSimPathId::ReplayActualFire:
            return "ShadowSimulator.replayActualFire";
        case DevSimPathId::None: break;
    }
    return "none";
}

bool DevClockContract::parseSimPathId(std::string const& s, DevSimPathId& out) {
    if (s == "none" || s.empty()) {
        out = DevSimPathId::None;
        return true;
    }
    if (s == "ShadowSimulator.plan") {
        out = DevSimPathId::Plan;
        return true;
    }
    if (s == "ShadowSimulator.planSequence") {
        out = DevSimPathId::PlanSequence;
        return true;
    }
    if (s == "ShadowSimulator.verifyDelay") {
        out = DevSimPathId::VerifyDelay;
        return true;
    }
    if (s == "ShadowSimulator.evalDelayFromFreeze") {
        out = DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze;
        return true;
    }
    if (s == "ShadowSimulator.replayActualFire") {
        out = DevSimPathId::ReplayActualFire;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

char const* DevClockContract::rejectId(Reject r) {
    switch (r) {
        case Reject::Ok: return "ok";
        case Reject::UnknownSchema: return "unknownSchema";
        case Reject::BadTimeBasis: return "badTimeBasis";
        case Reject::BadSimDt: return "badSimDt";
        case Reject::BadFirstDt: return "badFirstDt";
        case Reject::EffectTickMismatch: return "effectTickMismatch";
    }
    return "unknown";
}

int DevClockContract::effectTick(
    int attemptTick, bool midStep, bool continuous
) const {
    if (attemptTick < 0) attemptTick = 0;
    if (continuous) return attemptTick;
    return midStep ? attemptTick : attemptTick + 1;
}

float DevClockContract::step0Dt(Stamp const& stamp) const {
    float const simDt = stamp.simDt;
    if (simDt <= 0.f) return 0.f;
    if (stamp.midStep
        && stamp.firstDt > 0.f
        && stamp.firstDt <= simDt) {
        return stamp.firstDt;
    }
    return simDt;
}

std::vector<float> DevClockContract::stepSchedule(
    Stamp const& stamp, int delay, int horizonTicks
) const {
    std::vector<float> steps;
    if (delay < 0) delay = 0;
    if (horizonTicks < 0) horizonTicks = 0;
    int const n = delay + horizonTicks;
    if (n <= 0) return steps;
    if (stamp.simDt <= 0.f) return steps;

    steps.resize(static_cast<size_t>(n));
    float const s0 = this->step0Dt(stamp);
    float const rest = stamp.simDt;
    steps[0] = s0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        steps[static_cast<size_t>(i)] = rest;
    }
    return steps;
}

uint64_t DevClockContract::hashSteps(std::vector<float> const& steps) const {
    uint64_t h = 14695981039346656037ull;
    auto mix = [&](uint64_t v) {
        h ^= v;
        h *= 1099511628211ull;
    };
    mix(static_cast<uint64_t>(steps.size()));
    for (float dt : steps) {
        // Quantize to microseconds so float noise does not flip the hash.
        long long const us = static_cast<long long>(
            std::llround(static_cast<double>(dt) * 1.0e6)
        );
        mix(static_cast<uint64_t>(us));
    }
    return h;
}

uint64_t DevClockContract::stepScheduleHash() const {
    // Reference table — must stay in sync with selfCheck cases.
    struct Row {
        bool midStep;
        float firstDt;
        float simDt;
        int delay;
        int horizon;
    };
    Row const rows[] = {
        {false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 0, 4},
        {false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 2, 8},
        {true, 1.f / 480.f, 1.f / 240.f, 0, 4},
        {true, 1.f / 480.f, 1.f / 240.f, 3, 6},
        {true, 0.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1, 2},
        {true, 1.f / 100.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1, 2}, // firstDt > simDt → clamp to simDt
        {false, 1.f / 500.f, 1.f / 240.f, 5, 1},
    };

    uint64_t h = 14695981039346656037ull;
    auto mix = [&](uint64_t v) {
        h ^= v;
        h *= 1099511628211ull;
    };
    mix(static_cast<uint64_t>(DevClockContract::kSchema));
    for (auto const& row : rows) {
        Stamp st;
        st.simDt = row.simDt;
        st.firstDt = row.firstDt;
        st.midStep = row.midStep;
        st.continuous = false;
        st.attemptTick = 10;
        st.effectTick = this->effectTick(10, row.midStep, false);
        st.valid = true;
        auto steps = this->stepSchedule(st, row.delay, row.horizon);
        mix(this->hashSteps(steps));
        mix(static_cast<uint64_t>(st.effectTick));
        mix(row.midStep ? 1ull : 0ull);
        mix(static_cast<uint64_t>(row.delay));
        mix(static_cast<uint64_t>(row.horizon));
    }
    return h;
}

DevClockContract::Stamp DevClockContract::makeStamp(
    int attemptTick,
    bool midStep,
    bool continuous,
    float simDt,
    float firstDt,
    float wallDt,
    float timeWarp,
    DevSimPathId livePath
) const {
    Stamp st;
    st.clockSchema = DevClockContract::kSchema;
    st.timeBasis = DevClockContract::kTimeBasisPhysicsTick;
    st.attemptTick = attemptTick < 0 ? 0 : attemptTick;
    st.midStep = midStep;
    st.continuous = continuous;
    st.simDt = simDt;
    st.firstDt = firstDt;
    st.wallDt = wallDt;
    st.timeWarp = timeWarp > 0.f ? timeWarp : 1.f;
    st.simTps = AssistClock::get().simTpsFromDt(simDt);
    st.speedScaleSuspect = AssistClock::get().speedScaleSuspect(
        st.timeWarp, st.simTps
    );
    st.effectTick = this->effectTick(st.attemptTick, midStep, continuous);
    st.liveSimPathId = livePath;
    st.valid = true;
    return st;
}

DevClockContract::Reject DevClockContract::validate(Stamp const& stamp) const {
    if (stamp.clockSchema != DevClockContract::kSchema) {
        return Reject::UnknownSchema;
    }
    if (stamp.timeBasis != DevClockContract::kTimeBasisPhysicsTick) {
        return Reject::BadTimeBasis;
    }
    if (!(stamp.simDt > 0.f) || !std::isfinite(stamp.simDt)) {
        return Reject::BadSimDt;
    }
    if (stamp.midStep) {
        if (!(stamp.firstDt > 0.f)
            || !(stamp.firstDt <= stamp.simDt)
            || !std::isfinite(stamp.firstDt)) {
            return Reject::BadFirstDt;
        }
    }
    int const expect = this->effectTick(
        stamp.attemptTick, stamp.midStep, stamp.continuous
    );
    if (stamp.effectTick != expect) {
        return Reject::EffectTickMismatch;
    }
    return Reject::Ok;
}

bool DevClockContract::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += ", ";
        report += name;
    };

    DevClockContract& clock = DevClockContract::get();

    expect(clock.effectTick(10, true, false) == 10, "eff-discrete-mid");
    expect(clock.effectTick(10, false, false) == 11, "eff-discrete-between");
    expect(clock.effectTick(10, true, true) == 10, "eff-cont-mid");
    expect(clock.effectTick(10, false, true) == 10, "eff-cont-between");
    expect(clock.effectTick(-3, false, false) == 1, "eff-neg-discrete");
    expect(clock.effectTick(-3, true, true) == 0, "eff-neg-cont");

    // midStep + CBF remainder → step0 = firstDt; rest = simDt.
    {
        Stamp st = clock.makeStamp(
            10, true, false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 480.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f,
            DevSimPathId::Plan
        );
        expect(clock.clockOk(st), "stamp-mid-ok");
        expect(st.effectTick == 10, "stamp-mid-effect");
        auto steps = clock.stepSchedule(st, 2, 4);
        expect(steps.size() == 6, "sched-len-mid");
        if (steps.size() == 6) {
            expect(
                std::fabs(steps[0] - 1.f / 480.f) < 1e-9f, "sched-s0-firstDt"
            );
            expect(
                std::fabs(steps[1] - 1.f / 240.f) < 1e-9f, "sched-s1-simDt"
            );
            expect(
                std::fabs(steps[5] - 1.f / 240.f) < 1e-9f, "sched-tail-simDt"
            );
        }
    }

    // Between frames: firstDt ignored even if smaller — step0 = simDt.
    {
        Stamp st = clock.makeStamp(
            10, false, false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 480.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f,
            DevSimPathId::PlanSequence
        );
        expect(st.effectTick == 11, "stamp-between-effect");
        expect(clock.clockOk(st), "stamp-between-ok");
        auto steps = clock.stepSchedule(st, 0, 3);
        expect(steps.size() == 3, "sched-len-between");
        if (!steps.empty()) {
            expect(
                std::fabs(steps[0] - 1.f / 240.f) < 1e-9f,
                "sched-between-ignores-firstDt"
            );
        }
    }

    // Continuous between-frames: effectTick does not +1.
    {
        Stamp st = clock.makeStamp(
            42, false, true, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f,
            DevSimPathId::None
        );
        expect(st.effectTick == 42, "stamp-cont-between");
        expect(clock.clockOk(st), "stamp-cont-ok");
    }

    // midStep with firstDt out of band → BadFirstDt.
    {
        Stamp st = clock.makeStamp(
            5, true, false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 100.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f,
            DevSimPathId::Plan
        );
        expect(
            clock.validate(st) == Reject::BadFirstDt, "validate-bad-firstDt"
        );
        // stepSchedule still clamps step0 to simDt (safe fallback).
        auto steps = clock.stepSchedule(st, 1, 1);
        expect(steps.size() == 2, "sched-bad-first-len");
        if (!steps.empty()) {
            expect(
                std::fabs(steps[0] - 1.f / 240.f) < 1e-9f,
                "sched-bad-first-clamps"
            );
        }
    }

    // Schema / timeBasis / effectTick mismatch.
    {
        Stamp st = clock.makeStamp(
            8, true, false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f,
            DevSimPathId::Plan
        );
        st.clockSchema = 99;
        expect(
            clock.validate(st) == Reject::UnknownSchema, "validate-schema"
        );
        st = clock.makeStamp(
            8, true, false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f,
            DevSimPathId::Plan
        );
        st.timeBasis = "wallClock";
        expect(
            clock.validate(st) == Reject::BadTimeBasis, "validate-basis"
        );
        st = clock.makeStamp(
            8, true, false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f,
            DevSimPathId::Plan
        );
        st.effectTick = 999;
        expect(
            clock.validate(st) == Reject::EffectTickMismatch,
            "validate-effect-mismatch"
        );
        st = clock.makeStamp(
            8, false, false, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 1.f, DevSimPathId::Plan
        );
        expect(clock.validate(st) == Reject::BadSimDt, "validate-simDt");
    }

    // timeWarp / wallDt must not change the schedule (simDt already stripped).
    {
        Stamp a = clock.makeStamp(
            10, true, false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 480.f, 1.f / 120.f, 2.f,
            DevSimPathId::Plan
        );
        Stamp b = a;
        b.timeWarp = 1.f;
        b.wallDt = 1.f / 240.f;
        b.speedScaleSuspect = true;
        auto sa = clock.stepSchedule(a, 2, 5);
        auto sb = clock.stepSchedule(b, 2, 5);
        expect(sa.size() == sb.size(), "warp-annot-len");
        bool same = sa.size() == sb.size();
        for (size_t i = 0; same && i < sa.size(); ++i) {
            same = std::fabs(sa[i] - sb[i]) < 1e-9f;
        }
        expect(same, "warp-annot-ignored");
    }

    expect(
        std::strcmp(simPathId(DevSimPathId::Plan), "ShadowSimulator.plan") == 0,
        "path-plan"
    );
    expect(
        std::strcmp(
            simPathId(DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze),
            "ShadowSimulator.evalDelayFromFreeze"
        ) == 0,
        "path-eval"
    );
    DevSimPathId parsed = DevSimPathId::None;
    expect(
        parseSimPathId("ShadowSimulator.planSequence", parsed)
            && parsed == DevSimPathId::PlanSequence,
        "path-parse"
    );

    uint64_t const h1 = clock.stepScheduleHash();
    uint64_t const h2 = clock.stepScheduleHash();
    expect(h1 == h2, "sched-hash-stable");
    expect(h1 != 0, "sched-hash-nonzero");

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = fmt::format(
            "DevClockContract selfCheck OK hash={:016x}", h1
        );
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("DevClockContract selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}

```

`src/dev/DevClockContract.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef DEV_CLOCK_CONTRACT_HPP
#define DEV_CLOCK_CONTRACT_HPP

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

// Named live/eval sim entry points (Vertrag C report fields).
enum class DevSimPathId {
    None = 0,
    Plan,
    PlanSequence,
    VerifyDelay,
    EvalDelayFromFreeze,
    ReplayActualFire
};

// Schema-versioned time basis shared by live planning and Dev eval.
// Live and eval must call the same effectTick / stepSchedule — never fork.
class DevClockContract {
public:
    static constexpr int kSchema = 1;
    static constexpr char const* kTimeBasisPhysicsTick = "physicsTick";

    struct Stamp {
        int clockSchema = DevClockContract::kSchema;
        std::string timeBasis = DevClockContract::kTimeBasisPhysicsTick;
        int attemptTick = 0;
        int effectTick = 0;
        float simDt = 0.f;
        float firstDt = 0.f;
        bool midStep = false;
        bool continuous = false;
        float timeWarp = 1.f;
        double simTps = 0.0;
        float wallDt = 0.f; // annotation only; ignored by stepSchedule
        bool speedScaleSuspect = false;
        DevSimPathId liveSimPathId = DevSimPathId::None;
        bool valid = false; // set by makeStamp / capture
    };

    enum class Reject {
        Ok = 0,
        UnknownSchema,
        BadTimeBasis,
        BadSimDt,
        BadFirstDt,
        EffectTickMismatch
    };

    static DevClockContract& get();

    static char const* simPathId(DevSimPathId id);
    static bool parseSimPathId(std::string const& s, DevSimPathId& out);
    static char const* rejectId(Reject r);

    // Same formula as production AssistController::resolveEffectTick.
    // Continuous: always attemptTick. Discrete: midStep → attemptTick, else +1.
    int effectTick(int attemptTick, bool midStep, bool continuous) const;

    // firstDt for step 0 only when midStep and firstDt in (0, simDt]; else simDt.
    float step0Dt(Stamp const& stamp) const;

    // Physics dt list for counterfactual delay d and primary horizon H.
    // Length = delay + horizonTicks. Action at index `delay`.
    // wallDt / timeWarp / simTps / speedScaleSuspect do not affect the list.
    std::vector<float> stepSchedule(
        Stamp const& stamp, int delay, int horizonTicks
    ) const;

    // FNV-1a over quantized step dts (microseconds).
    uint64_t hashSteps(std::vector<float> const& steps) const;
    // Stable hash of the selfCheck reference table (report stepScheduleHash).
    uint64_t stepScheduleHash() const;

    // Build stamp at live decision time. Sets effectTick via this->effectTick.
    Stamp makeStamp(
        int attemptTick,
        bool midStep,
        bool continuous,
        float simDt,
        float firstDt,
        float wallDt,
        float timeWarp,
        DevSimPathId livePath
    ) const;

    Reject validate(Stamp const& stamp) const;
    bool clockOk(Stamp const& stamp) const {
        return this->validate(stamp) == Reject::Ok;
    }

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    DevClockContract() = default;
};

#endif // DEV_CLOCK_CONTRACT_HPP
```

```cpp
#include "DevConfig.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <Geode/loader/SettingV3.hpp>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

#include <string>

using namespace geode::prelude;

bool g_devCacheInit = false;
bool g_devRecordEnable = false;
int g_devRecordCount = 10;
bool g_devRecordIncludePass = true;
bool g_devCountEmptyAttempts = false;
bool g_devFreezeWorld = false;
bool g_devDisableRandom = true;
bool g_devEvalOnDeath = true;
DevConfig::EvalGrid g_devEvalGrid = DevConfig::EvalGrid::Band;

DevConfig::Objective g_devObjective = DevConfig::Objective::SurviveThenEndX;
bool g_devEvalRequireDeps = true;
bool g_devRecordCands = true;
int g_devEvalBudgetUs = 2000;
int g_devEvalTickBudget = 8000;
bool g_devOverlay = false;

static int clampInt(int v, int lo, int hi) {
    return std::max(lo, std::min(hi, v));
}

static int readInt(Mod* mod, char const* id, int fallback) {
    try {
        return static_cast<int>(mod->getSettingValue<int64_t>(id));
    }
    catch (...) {
        return fallback;
    }
}

static bool readBool(Mod* mod, char const* id, bool fallback) {
    try {
        return mod->getSettingValue<bool>(id);
    }
    catch (...) {
        return fallback;
    }
}

static std::string readString(Mod* mod, char const* id, char const* fallback) {
    try {
        return mod->getSettingValue<std::string>(id);
    }
    catch (...) {
        return fallback ? fallback : "";
    }
}

static DevConfig::EvalGrid parseEvalGrid(std::string const& s) {
    if (s == "full") return DevConfig::EvalGrid::Full;
    if (s == "sparse") return DevConfig::EvalGrid::Sparse;
    return DevConfig::EvalGrid::Band;
}

static DevConfig::Objective parseObjective(std::string const& s) {
    if (s == "planner_mirror_v1") return DevConfig::Objective::PlannerMirror;
    if (s == "horizon_clear_v1") return DevConfig::Objective::HorizonClear;
    return DevConfig::Objective::SurviveThenEndX;
}

void DevConfig::refreshCache() {
    auto* mod = Mod::get();
    if (!mod) {
        g_devCacheInit = true;
        return;
    }

    g_devRecordEnable = readBool(mod, "dev-record-enable", false);
    g_devRecordCount = clampInt(readInt(mod, "dev-record-count", 10), 1, 50);
    g_devRecordIncludePass = readBool(mod, "dev-record-include-pass", true);
    g_devCountEmptyAttempts = readBool(mod, "dev-count-empty-attempts", false);
    g_devFreezeWorld = readBool(mod, "dev-freeze-world", false);
    g_devDisableRandom = readBool(mod, "dev-disable-random", true);
    g_devEvalOnDeath = readBool(mod, "dev-eval-on-death", true);
    g_devEvalGrid = parseEvalGrid(readString(mod, "dev-eval-grid", "band"));
    g_devEvalHorizon = clampInt(readInt(mod, "dev-eval-horizon", 48), 1, 320);
    g_devEvalTail = clampInt(readInt(mod, "dev-eval-tail", 48), 0, 320);
    g_devObjective = parseObjective(readString(mod, "dev-objective", "survive_then_endx_v1"));
    g_devEvalRequireDeps = readBool(mod, "dev-eval-require-deps", true);
    g_devRecordCands = readBool(mod, "dev-record-cands", true);
    g_devEvalBudgetUs = clampInt(readInt(mod, "dev-eval-budget-us", 2000), 0, 20000);
    g_devEvalTickBudget = clampInt(readInt(mod, "dev-eval-tick-budget", 8000), 500, 50000);
    g_devOverlay = readBool(mod, "dev-overlay", false);

    g_devCacheInit = true;
}

static void ensureCache() {
    if (!g_devCacheInit) {
        DevConfig::refreshCache();
    }
}

bool DevConfig::recordEnable() {
    ensureCache();

bool DevConfig::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (!ok) {
            ++fails;
            report += std::string("FAIL ") + name + "; ";
        }
    };

    expect(std::strcmp(evalGridId(EvalGrid::Full), "full") == 0, "grid-full-id");
    expect(std::strcmp(evalGridId(EvalGrid::Band), "band") == 0, "grid-band-id");
    expect(std::strcmp(evalGridId(EvalGrid::Sparse), "sparse") == 0, "grid-sparse-id");
    expect(std::strcmp(objectiveId(Objective::SurviveThenEndX), "survive_then_endx_v1") == 0, "obj-survive-id");
    expect(std::strcmp(objectiveId(Objective::PlannerMirror), "planner_mirror_v1") == 0, "obj-mirror-id");
    expect(std::strcmp(objectiveId(Objective::HorizonClear), "horizon_clear_v1") == 0, "obj-horizon-id");

    expect(parseEvalGrid("full") == EvalGrid::Full, "parse-grid-full");
    expect(parseEvalGrid("band") == EvalGrid::Band, "parse-grid-band");
    expect(parseEvalGrid("sparse") == EvalGrid::Sparse, "parse-grid-sparse");
    expect(parseEvalGrid("nope") == EvalGrid::Band, "parse-grid-fallback");
    expect(parseObjective("survive_then_endx_v1") == Objective::SurviveThenEndX, "parse-obj-survive");
    expect(parseObjective("planner_mirror_v1") == Objective::PlannerMirror, "parse-obj-mirror");
    expect(parseObjective("horizon_clear_v1") == Objective::HorizonClear, "parse-obj-horizon");
    expect(parseObjective("nope") == Objective::SurviveThenEndX, "parse-obj-fallback");

    expect(clampInt(0, 1, 50) == 1, "clamp-lo");
    expect(clampInt(99, 1, 50) == 50, "clamp-hi");
    expect(clampInt(10, 1, 50) == 10, "clamp-mid");

    // Cache refresh must leave recording off by default when settings missing / defaults.
    refreshCache();
    expect(recordCount() >= 1 && recordCount() <= 50, "record-count-range");
    expect(evalHorizon() >= 1 && evalHorizon() <= 320, "horizon-range");
    expect(evalTail() >= 0 && evalTail() <= 320, "tail-range");
    expect(evalTickBudget() >= 500, "tick-budget-min");

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "DevConfig selfCheck OK";
    }
    else {
        report = fmt::format("DevConfig {} fails: {}", fails, report);
    }
    return fails == 0;
}
```

```hpp
#ifndef DEV_CONFIG_HPP
#define DEV_CONFIG_HPP

#include <string>

// Cached Dev Lab settings (mod.json keys under title-dev* / dev-*).
// Safe defaults: recording off. refreshCache from StageConfig watchers / load.
class DevConfig {
public:
    enum class EvalGrid {
        Full = 0,
        Band,
        Sparse
    };

    enum class Objective {
        SurviveThenEndX = 0, // survive_then_endx_v1
        PlannerMirror,       // planner_mirror_v1
        HorizonClear         // horizon_clear_v1
    };

    static void refreshCache();

    // --- Session ---
    static bool recordEnable();
    static int recordCount(); // clamped 1..50
    static bool recordIncludePass();
    static bool countEmptyAttempts();
    static bool freezeWorld();
    // When recording: kill explore / verify-AB randomness (default on).
    static bool disableRandom();

    // --- Eval ---
    static bool evalOnDeath();
    static EvalGrid evalGrid();
    static char const* evalGridId(EvalGrid grid);
    static int evalHorizon(); // primary horizon ticks; default 48
    static int evalTail();    // tail ticks after primary; default 48
    static Objective objective();
    static char const* objectiveId(Objective obj);
    static bool evalRequireDeps();
    static bool recordCands();
    static int evalBudgetUs();
    static int evalTickBudget();

    // --- Overlay ---
    static bool overlay();

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    DevConfig() = delete;
};

#endif // DEV_CONFIG_HPP
```

`src/dev/DevCycleRecorder.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "DevCycleRecorder.hpp"
#include "DevConfig.hpp"
#include "DevLiveWitness.hpp"
#include "DevRejectLedger.hpp"
#include "DevStateDiff.hpp"
#include "../core/PlatformLimits.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fmt/format.h>

using namespace geode::prelude;

DevCycleRecorder& DevCycleRecorder::get() {
    static DevCycleRecorder inst;
    return inst;
}

bool DevCycleRecorder::isRecording() const {
    if (!DevConfig::recordEnable()) return false;
    auto& store = DevTraceStore::get();
    return store.isOpen() && store.hasOpenAttempt();
}

bool DevCycleRecorder::canWriteActive() const {
    return this->isRecording() && this->m_activePressId > 0;
}

void DevCycleRecorder::clearActive() {
    this->m_activePressId = 0;
}

DevCycleRecorder::TrackedCycle* DevCycleRecorder::tracked(int64_t pressId) {
    if (pressId <= 0) return nullptr;
    auto it = this->m_cycles.find(pressId);
    if (it == this->m_cycles.end()) return nullptr;
    return &it->second;
}

DevCycleRecorder::TrackedCycle* DevCycleRecorder::ensureActiveTracked() {
    return this->tracked(this->m_activePressId);
}

int64_t DevCycleRecorder::beginPress(
    int playerIndex,
    bool down,
    int effectTick,
    int pressTick,
    DevEventSource source
) {
    this->clearActive();
    if (!this->isRecording()) return 0;

    auto& store = DevTraceStore::get();
    int64_t const pressId = store.allocPressId();
    if (pressId <= 0) return 0;

    DevDecisionEvent ev;
    ev.kind = DevEventKind::PressObserved;
    ev.pressId = pressId;
    ev.cycleId = pressId;
    ev.parentEventId = 0;
    ev.playerIndex = playerIndex;
    ev.down = down;
    ev.source = source;
    ev.effectTick = effectTick;
    ev.pressTick = pressTick;
    auto* written = store.appendEvent(ev);
    if (!written) return 0;

    TrackedCycle cycle;
    cycle.pressId = pressId;
    cycle.lastEventId = written->eventId;
    cycle.playerIndex = playerIndex;
    cycle.down = down;
    cycle.source = source;
    cycle.effectTick = effectTick;
    cycle.pressTick = pressTick;
    this->m_cycles[pressId] = cycle;
    this->m_activePressId = pressId;
    return pressId;
}

DevDecisionEvent* DevCycleRecorder::appendTo(
    TrackedCycle& cycle,
    DevEventKind kind,
    int64_t parentEventId,
    int64_t planId,
    AssistReason reason,
    char const* where
) {
    if (!this->isRecording()) return nullptr;
    if (parentEventId <= 0 && kind != DevEventKind::PressObserved) return nullptr;

    DevDecisionEvent ev;
    ev.kind = kind;
    ev.pressId = cycle.pressId;
    ev.cycleId = cycle.pressId;
    ev.parentEventId = parentEventId;
    ev.planId = planId;
    ev.playerIndex = cycle.playerIndex;
    ev.down = cycle.down;
    ev.source = cycle.source;
    ev.effectTick = cycle.effectTick;
    ev.pressTick = cycle.pressTick;
    if (reason != AssistReason::None || (where && where[0])) {
        ev.assistReason = AssistVerdict::name(reason);
        if (where && where[0]) {
            ev.assistReason = fmt::format(
                "{}@{}", AssistVerdict::name(reason), where
            );
        }
    }
    auto* written = DevTraceStore::get().appendEvent(ev);
    if (!written) return nullptr;
    cycle.lastEventId = written->eventId;
    if (planId > 0) cycle.planId = planId;
    return written;
}

void DevCycleRecorder::noteGatePass(AssistReason reason, char const* where) {
    auto* cycle = this->ensureActiveTracked();
    if (!cycle || !this->canWriteActive()) return;
    if (cycle->hasPlan || cycle->hasArm || cycle->hasGate) return;
    auto* w = this->appendTo(
        *cycle, DevEventKind::GatePass, cycle->lastEventId, 0, reason, where
    );
    if (!w) return;
    // Gate-pass: empty candNotes; attribution is the full reason.
    DevRejectLedger::AttributionInput attrIn;
    attrIn.gatePass = true;
    attrIn.hasPlanFinished = false;
    w->attribution = DevRejectLedger::buildAttribution(attrIn);
    cycle->hasGate = true;
}

void DevCycleRecorder::notePlanFinished(
    SimPlan const& plan,
    int effectTick,
    int limit,
    DevClockContract::Stamp const& clock,
    PlayLayer* layer,
    PlayerObject* player
) {
    (void)limit;
    auto* cycle = this->ensureActiveTracked();
    if (!cycle || !this->canWriteActive()) return;
    if (cycle->hasGate || cycle->hasPlan) return;

    auto* w = this->appendTo(
        *cycle,
        DevEventKind::PlanFinished,
        cycle->lastEventId,
        plan.planId,
        plan.reason != AssistReason::None ? plan.reason : AssistReason::PassUnknown,
        "plan"
    );
    if (!w) return;
    w->effectTick = effectTick;
    w->plannedDelay = plan.delay;
    w->hasClockStamp = clock.valid;
    w->clockStamp = clock;
    if (w->hasClockStamp) {
        w->clockStamp.effectTick = effectTick;
    }

    PlayerObject* player2 = nullptr;
    if (layer && layer->m_player2) {
        player2 = layer->m_player2;
    }
    w->witness = DevLiveWitness::capture(
        layer,
        player,
        player2,
        plan,
        w->hasClockStamp ? w->clockStamp : clock,
        effectTick,
        DevConfig::freezeWorld()
    );
    w->hasWitness = w->witness.valid;

    // Commit 8: suppress claims early when the witness alone is notReproducible.
    if (w->hasWitness) {
        DevClassifyOptions opts;
        opts.requireDeps = DevConfig::evalRequireDeps();
        opts.freezeWorld = DevConfig::freezeWorld();
        opts.expectedEvalPath = DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze;
        DevClassifyResult const gate = DevStateDiff::classifyWitnessGate(
            w->witness, opts
        );
        if (!gate.evalSuppressedReason.empty()) {
            w->hasFidelity = true;
            w->fidelity = gate.fidelity;
            w->claimsAllowed = gate.claimsAllowed;
            w->approx = gate.approx;
            w->evalSuppressedReason = gate.evalSuppressedReason;
            w->diffs = gate.diffs;
        }
    }

    // Commit 12: full per-delay ledger from plan(); attribution filled later with eval.
    w->candNotes = plan.candNotes;
    w->candNotesTruncated = plan.candNotesTruncated;
    {
        DevRejectLedger::AttributionInput attrIn;
        attrIn.hasPlanFinished = true;
        attrIn.plannedDelay = plan.delay;
        attrIn.notReproducible = w->hasFidelity
            && w->fidelity == DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        attrIn.approx = w->hasFidelity && w->approx;
        attrIn.claimsAllowed = w->hasFidelity && w->claimsAllowed;
        DevRejectLedger::Ledger led;
        led.notes = w->candNotes;
        led.truncated = w->candNotesTruncated;
        attrIn.ledger = &led;
        w->attribution = DevRejectLedger::buildAttribution(attrIn);
    }

    cycle->planId = plan.planId;
    cycle->hasPlan = true;
}

void DevCycleRecorder::noteLearningOnPlan(
    int plannedDelay,
    int finalDelay,
    bool floored,
    bool verifyRefused
) {
    auto* cycle = this->ensureActiveTracked();
    if (!cycle || !this->canWriteActive()) return;
    if (!cycle->hasPlan) return;

    auto* attempt = DevTraceStore::get().currentAttempt();
    if (!attempt) return;
    DevDecisionEvent* planEv = nullptr;
    for (auto& ev : attempt->events) {
        if (ev.pressId == cycle->pressId
            && ev.kind == DevEventKind::PlanFinished) {
            planEv = &ev;
        }
    }
    if (!planEv) return;

    bool const nudged = finalDelay != plannedDelay && !floored && !verifyRefused;
    if (nudged || floored || verifyRefused) {
        DevRejectLedger::AttributionInput attrIn;
        attrIn.hasPlanFinished = true;
        attrIn.plannedDelay = plannedDelay;
        attrIn.learningNudged = nudged;
        attrIn.learningFloored = floored;
        attrIn.verifyRefused = verifyRefused;
        attrIn.notReproducible = planEv->hasFidelity
            && planEv->fidelity == DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        attrIn.approx = planEv->hasFidelity && planEv->approx;
        attrIn.claimsAllowed = planEv->hasFidelity && planEv->claimsAllowed;
        DevRejectLedger::Ledger led;
        led.notes = planEv->candNotes;
        led.truncated = planEv->candNotesTruncated;
        attrIn.ledger = &led;
        auto extra = DevRejectLedger::buildAttribution(attrIn);
        // Merge without duplicating codes already present.
        for (auto& a : extra) {
            bool dup = false;
            for (auto const& existing : planEv->attribution) {
                if (existing.code == a.code) {
                    dup = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!dup) planEv->attribution.push_back(std::move(a));
        }
        if (nudged && finalDelay >= 0
            && finalDelay < static_cast<int>(planEv->candNotes.size())) {
            // Planner chosen stays; mark the final delay as learning-displaced
            // only when it was evaluated and not the planner pick.
            auto& note = planEv->candNotes[static_cast<size_t>(finalDelay)];
            if (note.status != DevRejectLedger::Status::Chosen
                && note.rejectCode != DevRejectLedger::RejectCode::LearningDisplaced) {
                if (note.status == DevRejectLedger::Status::Evaluated
                    || note.status == DevRejectLedger::Status::Rejected) {
                    note.rejectCode = DevRejectLedger::RejectCode::LearningDisplaced;
                    note.detail = DevRejectLedger::clampDetail(fmt::format(
                        "learn {}→{}", plannedDelay, finalDelay
                    ));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void DevCycleRecorder::notePassThrough(AssistReason reason, char const* where) {
    auto* cycle = this->ensureActiveTracked();
    if (!cycle || !this->canWriteActive()) return;
    if (cycle->hasArm || cycle->hasPassThrough) return;
    auto* w = this->appendTo(
        *cycle,
        DevEventKind::PassThrough,
        cycle->lastEventId,
        cycle->planId,
        reason,
        where
    );
    if (w) cycle->hasPassThrough = true;
}

int64_t DevCycleRecorder::noteDelayArm(
    AssistReason reason,
    char const* where,
    int plannedDelay,
    int plannedFireTick,
    int planId,
    DevEventSource source
) {
    auto* cycle = this->ensureActiveTracked();
    if (!cycle || !this->canWriteActive()) return 0;
    if (cycle->hasArm) return cycle->pressId;

    if (!cycle->hasPlan && !cycle->hasGate) {
        auto* pw = this->appendTo(
            *cycle,
            DevEventKind::PlanFinished,
            cycle->lastEventId,
            planId,
            reason,
            where ? where : "arm"
        );
        if (pw) {
            pw->plannedDelay = plannedDelay;
            pw->source = source;
            cycle->hasPlan = true;
            cycle->planId = planId;
        }
    }

    cycle->source = source;
    auto* w = this->appendTo(
        *cycle,
        DevEventKind::DelayArm,
        cycle->lastEventId,
        planId > 0 ? planId : cycle->planId,
        reason,
        where
    );
    if (!w) return 0;
    w->plannedDelay = plannedDelay;
    w->plannedFireTick = plannedFireTick;
    w->source = source;
    cycle->hasArm = true;
    return cycle->pressId;
}

void DevCycleRecorder::noteRecheck(
    int64_t pressId,
    int oldFireTick,
    int newFireTick,
    char const* where
) {
    auto* cycle = this->tracked(pressId);
    if (!cycle || !this->isRecording()) return;
    if (cycle->hasFire || cycle->hasOutcome) return;
    if (!cycle->hasArm) return;

    auto* w = this->appendTo(
        *cycle,
        DevEventKind::Recheck,
        cycle->lastEventId,
        cycle->planId,
        AssistReason::None,
        where
    );
    if (!w) return;
    w->plannedFireTick = newFireTick;
    w->actualFireTick = -1;
    w->assistReason = fmt::format(
        "recheck:{}→{}@{}",
        oldFireTick,
        newFireTick,
        where ? where : "recheck"
    );
}

void DevCycleRecorder::noteHus(
    int64_t pressId,
    AssistReason reason,
    char const* where,
    int fireTick
) {
    auto* cycle = this->tracked(pressId);
    if (!cycle || !this->isRecording()) return;
    if (cycle->hasFire || cycle->hasOutcome) return;
    if (!cycle->hasArm) return;

    auto* w = this->appendTo(
        *cycle,
        DevEventKind::Hus,
        cycle->lastEventId,
        cycle->planId,
        reason,
        where
    );
    if (!w) return;
    w->plannedFireTick = fireTick;
}

void DevCycleRecorder::noteFire(int64_t pressId, int actualFireTick) {
    auto* cycle = this->tracked(pressId);
    if (!cycle || !this->isRecording()) return;
    if (cycle->hasFire || cycle->hasOutcome) return;
    if (!cycle->hasArm) return;

    auto* w = this->appendTo(
        *cycle,
        DevEventKind::Fire,
        cycle->lastEventId,
        cycle->planId,
        AssistReason::None,
        "fire"
    );
    if (!w) return;
    w->actualFireTick = actualFireTick;
    w->assistReason = fmt::format("fire@{}", actualFireTick);
    cycle->hasFire = true;
}

void DevCycleRecorder::noteCheckpoint(int attemptTick) {
    if (!this->isRecording()) return;
    DevDecisionEvent ev;
    ev.kind = DevEventKind::Checkpoint;
    ev.pressId = 0;
    ev.cycleId = 0;
    ev.parentEventId = 0;
    ev.effectTick = attemptTick;
    ev.pressTick = attemptTick;
    ev.assistReason = "checkpoint";
    (void)DevTraceStore::get().appendEvent(ev);
}

void DevCycleRecorder::writeOutcomesForOpenCycles(
    std::string const& endReason, bool lived
) {
    if (!this->isRecording()) return;
    for (auto& pair : this->m_cycles) {
        auto& cycle = pair.second;
        if (cycle.hasOutcome) continue;
        if (cycle.lastEventId <= 0) continue;

        // Armed but never injected (death mid-buffer): synthetic fire so
        // outcome parent stays fire|passThrough|gatePass for chain validation.
        if (cycle.hasArm && !cycle.hasFire) {
            auto* fw = this->appendTo(
                cycle,
                DevEventKind::Fire,
                cycle.lastEventId,
                cycle.planId,
                AssistReason::None,
                "cancelled"
            );
            if (fw) {
                fw->actualFireTick = -1;
                fw->assistReason = fmt::format("fire-cancelled@{}", endReason);
                cycle.hasFire = true;
            }
        }

        auto* w = this->appendTo(
            cycle,
            DevEventKind::Outcome,
            cycle.lastEventId,
            cycle.planId,
            AssistReason::None,
            endReason.c_str()
        );
        if (!w) continue;
        w->endReason = endReason;
        w->assistReason = fmt::format(
            "outcome:{}:{}",
            endReason,
            lived ? "lived" : "died"
        );
        cycle.hasOutcome = true;
    }
}

bool DevCycleRecorder::shouldCountAttempt() const {
    if (DevConfig::countEmptyAttempts()) return true;
    for (auto const& pair : this->m_cycles) {
        if (pair.second.pressId > 0) return true;
    }
    auto const* attempt = DevTraceStore::get().currentAttempt();
    if (!attempt) return false;
    return !attempt->events.empty();
}

bool DevCycleRecorder::sealAttemptWithOutcomes(std::string endReason, bool lived) {
    if (!DevConfig::recordEnable()) return false;
    auto& store = DevTraceStore::get();
    if (!store.isOpen() || !store.hasOpenAttempt()) return false;

    this->writeOutcomesForOpenCycles(endReason, lived);
    bool const count = this->shouldCountAttempt();
    this->m_cycles.clear();
    this->m_activePressId = 0;
    return store.sealAttempt(std::move(endReason), count);
}

bool DevCycleRecorder::beginNewAttempt(int startTick) {
    if (!DevConfig::recordEnable()) return false;
    auto& store = DevTraceStore::get();
    if (!store.isOpen()) return false;
    if (store.hasOpenAttempt()) return true;
    this->m_cycles.clear();
    this->m_activePressId = 0;
    return store.beginAttempt(startTick);
}

void DevCycleRecorder::onAttemptReset(int startTick) {
    if (!DevConfig::recordEnable()) return;
    auto& store = DevTraceStore::get();
    if (!store.isOpen()) return;
    if (store.hasOpenAttempt()) {
        (void)this->sealAttemptWithOutcomes("reset", false);
    }
    (void)this->beginNewAttempt(startTick);
}

bool DevCycleRecorder::flushQuit() {
    if (!DevConfig::recordEnable()) return false;
    auto& store = DevTraceStore::get();
    if (!store.isOpen()) return false;
    if (store.hasOpenAttempt()) {
        this->writeOutcomesForOpenCycles("quit", false);
        bool const count = this->shouldCountAttempt();
        this->m_cycles.clear();
        this->m_activePressId = 0;
        (void)store.sealAttempt("quit", count);
    }
    return store.flush();
}

bool DevCycleRecorder::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (!ok) {
            ++fails;
            report += std::string("FAIL ") + name + "; ";
        }
    };

    auto& rec = DevCycleRecorder::get();
    rec.clearActive();
    rec.m_cycles.clear();
    expect(rec.activePressId() == 0, "clear-active");

    // Disk session open is skipped on Android load gold (PlatformLimits).
    if (PlatformLimits::get().allowLoadDiskSelfCheck()) {
        auto& store = DevTraceStore::get();
        bool const opened = store.beginSession("cycle-selfcheck5", 2);
        expect(opened, "open-session");
        if (opened) {
            expect(store.beginAttempt(0), "begin-attempt");
            // Without recordEnable, beginPress no-ops — still exercise store chain.
            expect(rec.beginPress(0, true, 10, 10) == 0 || DevConfig::recordEnable(), "begin-gate");
            store.closeSession();
            auto path = store.tracesDir() / "session-cycle-selfcheck5.json";
            std::error_code ec;
            std::filesystem::remove(path, ec);
        }
    }

    expect(AssistVerdict::name(AssistReason::PassSpam) != nullptr, "verdict-name");

    if (fails == 0) report = "DevCycleRecorder selfCheck OK";
    else report = fmt::format("DevCycleRecorder {} fails: {}", fails, report);
    return fails == 0;
}
```

```hpp
#ifndef DEV_CYCLE_RECORDER_HPP
#define DEV_CYCLE_RECORDER_HPP

#include "DevClockContract.hpp"
#include "DevLiveWitness.hpp"
#include "DevTraceStore.hpp"
#include "../core/AssistVerdict.hpp"
#include "../core/ShadowSimulator.hpp"

class PlayLayer;
class PlayerObject;

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>

// Live press-cycle writer for DevTraceStore.
// Commit 4: through DelayArm. Commit 5: recheck / HUS / fire / outcome + attempt seal.
class DevCycleRecorder {
public:
    static DevCycleRecorder& get();

    bool isRecording() const;

    // Starts a new pressObserved (parent=0). Returns pressId, or 0 if not recording.
    int64_t beginPress(
        int playerIndex,
        bool down,
        int effectTick,
        int pressTick,
        DevEventSource source = DevEventSource::Live
    );

    int64_t activePressId() const { return this->m_activePressId; }

    void noteGatePass(AssistReason reason, char const* where);
    void notePlanFinished(
        SimPlan const& plan,
        int effectTick,
        int limit,
        DevClockContract::Stamp const& clock,
        PlayLayer* layer,
        PlayerObject* player
    );
    // After learning/verify adjusts the armed delay relative to plan.delay.
    void noteLearningOnPlan(
        int plannedDelay,
        int finalDelay,
        bool floored,
        bool verifyRefused
    );
    void notePassThrough(AssistReason reason, char const* where);
    // Returns pressId of the armed cycle (0 if not recording).
    int64_t noteDelayArm(
        AssistReason reason,
        char const* where,
        int plannedDelay,
        int plannedFireTick,
        int planId,
        DevEventSource source = DevEventSource::Live
    );

    void noteRecheck(
        int64_t pressId,
        int oldFireTick,
        int newFireTick,
        char const* where
    );
    void noteHus(
        int64_t pressId,
        AssistReason reason,
        char const* where,
        int fireTick
    );
    void noteFire(int64_t pressId, int actualFireTick);
    void noteCheckpoint(int attemptTick);

    // Append outcome for every open cycle in the current attempt, then seal+flush.
    // countTowardTarget follows DevConfig::countEmptyAttempts / has events.
    bool sealAttemptWithOutcomes(std::string endReason, bool lived);
    // New attempt under an open session (no-op if none / already open).
    bool beginNewAttempt(int startTick);
    // Death→reset path: seal open attempt if any, then begin the next.
    void onAttemptReset(int startTick);
    // Quit / abort: seal as quit, flush, leave session open or closed.
    bool flushQuit();

    void clearActive();

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    DevCycleRecorder() = default;

    struct TrackedCycle {
        int64_t pressId = 0;
        int64_t lastEventId = 0;
        int64_t planId = 0;
        int playerIndex = 0;
        bool down = true;
        DevEventSource source = DevEventSource::Live;
        int effectTick = 0;
        int pressTick = 0;
        bool hasPlan = false;
        bool hasGate = false;
        bool hasArm = false;
        bool hasPassThrough = false;
        bool hasFire = false;
        bool hasOutcome = false;
    };

    bool canWriteActive() const;
    TrackedCycle* tracked(int64_t pressId);
    TrackedCycle* ensureActiveTracked();
    DevDecisionEvent* appendTo(
        TrackedCycle& cycle,
        DevEventKind kind,
        int64_t parentEventId,
        int64_t planId,
        AssistReason reason,
        char const* where
    );
    void writeOutcomesForOpenCycles(std::string const& endReason, bool lived);
    bool shouldCountAttempt() const;

    int64_t m_activePressId = 0;
    std::unordered_map<int64_t, TrackedCycle> m_cycles;
};

#endif // DEV_CYCLE_RECORDER_HPP
```

`src/dev/DevEvalEngine.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "DevEvalEngine.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <fmt/format.h>
#include <unordered_set>

DevEvalEngine::Report DevEvalEngine::finishReport(
    DevLiveWitness const& witness,
    ShadowSimulator::EvalFromFreezeResult const& raw,
    int delay,
    int primaryHorizon,
    int tailTicks,
    DevClassifyOptions opts,
    DevSimPathId expectedPath
) {
    Report rep;
    rep.timeBasis = DevClockContract::kTimeBasisPhysicsTick;
    rep.clockSchema = DevClockContract::kSchema;
    rep.liveSimPathId = DevClockContract::simPathId(witness.clock.liveSimPathId);
    rep.evalSimPathId = DevClockContract::simPathId(raw.evalSimPathId);
    rep.stepScheduleHash = raw.stepScheduleHash;
    rep.clockMismatch = raw.clockMismatch;
    rep.restore = raw.restore;
    rep.ran = raw.ran;

    DevObjective::classifyPrimaryAndTail(
        rep.sample,
        delay,
        primaryHorizon,
        tailTicks,
        raw.died,
        raw.deathTick,
        raw.endX,
        raw.unknown,
        raw.budgetHit,
        raw.aborted,
        raw.ticksRan
    );

    opts.expectedEvalPath = expectedPath;

    if (raw.clockMismatch) {
        rep.fidelity.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        rep.fidelity.claimsAllowed = false;
        rep.fidelity.approx = false;
        rep.fidelity.evalSuppressedReason = "clockMismatch";
        return rep;
    }

    DevClassifyResult gate = DevStateDiff::classifyWitnessGate(witness, opts);
    if (!gate.evalSuppressedReason.empty()) {
        rep.fidelity = gate;
        return rep;
    }

    if (raw.ran && raw.restore.valid) {
        rep.fidelity = DevStateDiff::classify(witness, raw.restore, opts);
    }
    else {
        rep.fidelity.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        rep.fidelity.claimsAllowed = false;
        rep.fidelity.evalSuppressedReason =
            raw.aborted ? "aborted" : "evalDidNotRun";
    }
    return rep;
}

DevEvalEngine::Report DevEvalEngine::evalDelay(
    PlayLayer* layer,
    DevLiveWitness const& witness,
    int delay,
    int horizonTicks,
    bool down,
    DevClassifyOptions const& opts,
    int* tickBudgetLeft
) {
    // horizonTicks here is the schedule horizon after action (primary only).
    auto raw = ShadowSimulator::get().evalDelayFromFreeze(
        layer, witness, delay, horizonTicks, down, tickBudgetLeft
    );
    return finishReport(
        witness,
        raw,
        delay,
        horizonTicks,
        /*tailTicks*/ 0,
        opts,
        DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze
    );
}

DevEvalEngine::Report DevEvalEngine::replayActualFire(
    PlayLayer* layer,
    DevLiveWitness const& witness,
    int actualFireTickAbs,
    int horizonTicks,
    bool down,
    DevClassifyOptions const& opts,
    int* tickBudgetLeft
) {
    auto raw = ShadowSimulator::get().replayActualFire(
        layer, witness, actualFireTickAbs, horizonTicks, down, tickBudgetLeft
    );
    int delay = actualFireTickAbs - witness.clock.effectTick;
    if (delay < 0) delay = 0;
    return finishReport(
        witness,
        raw,
        delay,
        horizonTicks,
        /*tailTicks*/ 0,
        opts,
        DevSimPathId::ReplayActualFire
    );
}

std::vector<int> DevEvalEngine::buildGridDelays(
    DevConfig::EvalGrid grid,
    int limit,
    int plannedDelay,
    int robustK
) {
    if (limit < 0) limit = 0;
    std::unordered_set<int> set;
    auto add = [&](int d) {
        if (d < 0 || d > limit) return;
        set.insert(d);
    };

    switch (grid) {
        case DevConfig::EvalGrid::Full:
            for (int d = 0; d <= limit; ++d) add(d);
            break;
        case DevConfig::EvalGrid::Sparse: {
            add(0);
            add(limit / 2);
            add(limit);
            add(plannedDelay);
            for (int d = plannedDelay - 2; d <= plannedDelay + 2; ++d) add(d);
            break;
        }
        case DevConfig::EvalGrid::Band: {
            add(0);
            add(plannedDelay);
            int const k = std::max(0, robustK);
            for (int d = plannedDelay - k; d <= plannedDelay + k; ++d) add(d);
            // First-wave survivors band is refined later; seed ±k around plan + 0.
            break;
        }
    }

    std::vector<int> out(set.begin(), set.end());
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
    return out;
}

DevEvalEngine::GridReport DevEvalEngine::evalGrid(
    PlayLayer* layer,
    DevLiveWitness const& witness,
    bool down,
    int limit,
    int plannedDelay,
    int robustK,
    int horizonTicks,
    int tailTicks,
    DevConfig::EvalGrid grid,
    DevObjective::Kind objective,
    DevClassifyOptions const& opts,
    float latencyWeight,
    int* tickBudgetLeft
) {
    GridReport gr;
    gr.timeBasis = DevClockContract::kTimeBasisPhysicsTick;
    gr.clockSchema = DevClockContract::kSchema;
    gr.liveSimPathId = DevClockContract::simPathId(witness.clock.liveSimPathId);
    gr.evalSimPathId = DevClockContract::simPathId(
        DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze
    );
    gr.grid = grid;
    gr.horizonTicks = horizonTicks;
    gr.tailTicks = tailTicks;
    gr.limit = limit;
    gr.objectivePartial = (grid != DevConfig::EvalGrid::Full);

    if (!witness.valid || !witness.clock.valid
        || !DevClockContract::get().clockOk(witness.clock)) {
        gr.clockMismatch = true;
        gr.fidelity.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        gr.fidelity.claimsAllowed = false;
        gr.fidelity.evalSuppressedReason = "clockMismatch";
        DevObjective::Meta meta;
        meta.claimsAllowed = false;
        meta.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        meta.clockOk = false;
        meta.gridFull = false;
        meta.objectivePartial = true;
        meta.horizonTicks = horizonTicks;
        meta.tailTicks = tailTicks;
        gr.objective = DevObjective::evaluate(objective, gr.samples, meta);
        return gr;
    }

    auto delays = buildGridDelays(grid, limit, plannedDelay, robustK);
    int const schedHorizon = horizonTicks + std::max(0, tailTicks);
    bool anyRan = false;
    bool tailsComplete = true;

    for (int d : delays) {
        if (ShadowSimulator::get().evalAbortRequested()) break;
        auto raw = ShadowSimulator::get().evalDelayFromFreeze(
            layer, witness, d, schedHorizon, down, tickBudgetLeft
        );
        if (raw.clockMismatch) {
            gr.clockMismatch = true;
            break;
        }
        if (!gr.restore.valid && raw.restore.valid) {
            gr.restore = raw.restore;
        }
        if (raw.stepScheduleHash != 0) {
            gr.stepScheduleHash = raw.stepScheduleHash;
        }

        DevObjective::Sample sample;
        DevObjective::classifyPrimaryAndTail(
            sample,
            d,
            horizonTicks,
            tailTicks,
            raw.died,
            raw.deathTick,
            raw.endX,
            raw.unknown,
            raw.budgetHit,
            raw.aborted,
            raw.ticksRan
        );
        if (sample.survivedPrimary && tailTicks > 0 && !sample.tailComplete) {
            tailsComplete = false;
        }
        if (raw.ran) anyRan = true;
        gr.samples.push_back(sample);

        if (tickBudgetLeft && *tickBudgetLeft <= 0) {
            gr.objectivePartial = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    // Fidelity from restore (shared across delays) or witness gate.
    if (gr.clockMismatch) {
        gr.fidelity.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        gr.fidelity.claimsAllowed = false;
        gr.fidelity.evalSuppressedReason = "clockMismatch";
    }
    else {
        DevClassifyResult gate = DevStateDiff::classifyWitnessGate(witness, opts);
        if (!gate.evalSuppressedReason.empty()) {
            gr.fidelity = gate;
        }
        else if (anyRan && gr.restore.valid) {
            DevClassifyOptions o = opts;
            o.expectedEvalPath = DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze;
            gr.fidelity = DevStateDiff::classify(witness, gr.restore, o);
        }
        else {
            gr.fidelity.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
            gr.fidelity.claimsAllowed = false;
            gr.fidelity.evalSuppressedReason = "evalDidNotRun";
        }
    }

    bool const gridFull = (grid == DevConfig::EvalGrid::Full)
        && static_cast<int>(delays.size()) == (limit + 1)
        && !gr.objectivePartial;
    for (auto const& s : gr.samples) {
        if (s.budgetHit) {
            gr.objectivePartial = true;
        }
    }

    DevObjective::Meta meta;
    meta.fidelity = gr.fidelity.fidelity;
    meta.claimsAllowed = gr.fidelity.claimsAllowed;
    meta.clockOk = !gr.clockMismatch && DevClockContract::get().clockOk(witness.clock);
    meta.gridFull = gridFull && !gr.objectivePartial;
    meta.tailsComplete = tailsComplete;
    meta.horizonTicks = horizonTicks;
    meta.tailTicks = tailTicks;
    meta.latencyWeight = latencyWeight;
    meta.objectivePartial = gr.objectivePartial;

    gr.objective = DevObjective::evaluate(objective, gr.samples, meta);
    return gr;
}

bool DevEvalEngine::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += ", ";
        report += name;
    };

    DevClassifyOptions opts;
    opts.requireDeps = true;
    opts.freezeWorld = false;
    opts.expectedEvalPath = DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze;

    // Clock mismatch → notReproducible / clockMismatch.
    {
        DevLiveWitness w;
        w.valid = true;
        w.player.present = true;
        w.player.x = 1.f;
        w.playerBlobSchema = DevLiveWitness::computePlayerBlobSchema();
        w.clock = DevClockContract::get().makeStamp(
            10, false, false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f,
            DevSimPathId::Plan
        );
        w.clock.effectTick = 999;
        w.clock.valid = true;
        w.worldDeps = {
            static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Player),
            static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Clock),
        };

        Report rep = evalDelay(nullptr, w, 2, 8, true, opts, nullptr);
        expect(rep.clockMismatch, "clock-mismatch-flag");
        expect(
            rep.fidelity.fidelity == DevFidelity::NotReproducible,
            "clock-mismatch-fid"
        );
        expect(
            rep.fidelity.evalSuppressedReason == "clockMismatch",
            "clock-mismatch-reason"
        );
        expect(rep.timeBasis == DevClockContract::kTimeBasisPhysicsTick, "time-basis");
        expect(rep.clockSchema == DevClockContract::kSchema, "clock-schema");
    }

    // Grid delay builders.
    {
        auto full = buildGridDelays(DevConfig::EvalGrid::Full, 4, 2, 1);
        expect(full.size() == 5, "grid-full-n");
        auto band = buildGridDelays(DevConfig::EvalGrid::Band, 10, 5, 2);
        expect(
            std::find(band.begin(), band.end(), 0) != band.end()
                && std::find(band.begin(), band.end(), 5) != band.end()
                && std::find(band.begin(), band.end(), 3) != band.end()
                && std::find(band.begin(), band.end(), 7) != band.end(),
            "grid-band"
        );
        auto sparse = buildGridDelays(DevConfig::EvalGrid::Sparse, 10, 4, 1);
        expect(
            std::find(sparse.begin(), sparse.end(), 0) != sparse.end()
                && std::find(sparse.begin(), sparse.end(), 10) != sparse.end(),
            "grid-sparse"
        );
    }

    // Objective integration via evalGrid with empty layer (no samples run → suppressed).
    {
        DevLiveWitness w;
        w.valid = true;
        w.player.present = true;
        w.playerBlobSchema = DevLiveWitness::computePlayerBlobSchema();
        w.clock = DevClockContract::get().makeStamp(
            3, false, false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f,
            DevSimPathId::Plan
        );
        auto gr = evalGrid(
            nullptr,
            w,
            true,
            3,
            1,
            1,
            8,
            8,
            DevConfig::EvalGrid::Band,
            DevObjective::Kind::SurviveThenEndX,
            opts,
            0.25f,
            nullptr
        );
        expect(gr.objectivePartial, "grid-partial-band");
        expect(
            gr.objective.objectiveId
                == std::string("survive_then_endx_v1"),
            "grid-obj-id"
        );
        // No ghosts → samples empty / not claimsAllowed.
        expect(!gr.objective.hasIdealDelay, "grid-no-ideal");
    }

    // abort clears on eval entry.
    {
        ShadowSimulator::get().abortEval();
        expect(ShadowSimulator::get().evalAbortRequested(), "abort-set");
        DevLiveWitness w;
        w.valid = true;
        w.player.present = true;
        w.playerBlobSchema = DevLiveWitness::computePlayerBlobSchema();
        w.clock = DevClockContract::get().makeStamp(
            1, false, false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f,
            DevSimPathId::Plan
        );
        (void)ShadowSimulator::get().evalDelayFromFreeze(
            nullptr, w, 0, 1, true, nullptr
        );
        expect(!ShadowSimulator::get().evalAbortRequested(), "abort-cleared");
    }

    expect(
        std::strcmp(
            DevClockContract::simPathId(DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze),
            "ShadowSimulator.evalDelayFromFreeze"
        ) == 0,
        "path-const"
    );

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "DevEvalEngine selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("DevEvalEngine selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

```hpp
#ifndef DEV_EVAL_ENGINE_HPP
#define DEV_EVAL_ENGINE_HPP

#include "DevClockContract.hpp"
#include "DevConfig.hpp"
#include "DevEvalRestore.hpp"
#include "DevLiveWitness.hpp"
#include "DevObjective.hpp"
#include "DevStateDiff.hpp"
#include "../core/ShadowSimulator.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

class PlayLayer;

// Clock-bound eval + grid/tail/objectives (Commits 9–10).
class DevEvalEngine {
public:
    struct Report {
        std::string timeBasis;
        int clockSchema = 0;
        std::string liveSimPathId;
        std::string evalSimPathId;
        uint64_t stepScheduleHash = 0;
        bool clockMismatch = false;
        DevClassifyResult fidelity{};
        DevEvalRestore restore{};
        DevObjective::Sample sample{};
        bool ran = false;
    };

    struct GridReport {
        std::string timeBasis;
        int clockSchema = 0;
        std::string liveSimPathId;
        std::string evalSimPathId;
        uint64_t stepScheduleHash = 0;
        bool clockMismatch = false;
        DevClassifyResult fidelity{};
        DevEvalRestore restore{};
        std::vector<DevObjective::Sample> samples;
        DevObjective::Result objective{};
        bool objectivePartial = false;
        DevConfig::EvalGrid grid = DevConfig::EvalGrid::Band;
        int horizonTicks = 48;
        int tailTicks = 48;
        int limit = 0;
    };

    // Counterfactual delay on the witness stamp (evalDelayFromFreeze).
    // Pass horizonTicks = H (primary only) or H+T (combined; use classifyPrimaryAndTail).
    static Report evalDelay(
        PlayLayer* layer,
        DevLiveWitness const& witness,
        int delay,
        int horizonTicks,
        bool down,
        DevClassifyOptions const& opts,
        int* tickBudgetLeft = nullptr
    );

    // Replay absolute actualFireTick on the same stamp.
    static Report replayActualFire(
        PlayLayer* layer,
        DevLiveWitness const& witness,
        int actualFireTickAbs,
        int horizonTicks,
        bool down,
        DevClassifyOptions const& opts,
        int* tickBudgetLeft = nullptr
    );

    // Delays to evaluate for a grid mode.
    static std::vector<int> buildGridDelays(
        DevConfig::EvalGrid grid,
        int limit,
        int plannedDelay,
        int robustK
    );

    // Run grid with primary H + optional tail T, then score with DevObjective.
    static GridReport evalGrid(
        PlayLayer* layer,
        DevLiveWitness const& witness,
        bool down,
        int limit,
        int plannedDelay,
        int robustK,
        int horizonTicks,
        int tailTicks,
        DevConfig::EvalGrid grid,
        DevObjective::Kind objective,
        DevClassifyOptions const& opts,
        float latencyWeight = 0.25f,
        int* tickBudgetLeft = nullptr
    );

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    DevEvalEngine() = delete;

    static Report finishReport(
        DevLiveWitness const& witness,
        ShadowSimulator::EvalFromFreezeResult const& raw,
        int delay,
        int primaryHorizon,
        int tailTicks,
        DevClassifyOptions opts,
        DevSimPathId expectedPath
    );
};

#endif // DEV_EVAL_ENGINE_HPP
```

`src/dev/DevEvalRestore.cpp`:
