```cpp
#include "DevEvalRestore.hpp"

#include <cstring>
#include <fmt/format.h>

DevWitnessStatus DevEvalRestore::categoryStatus(
    DevEvalRestore const& r, DevWitnessCategory c
) {
    for (auto const& e : r.categories) {
        if (e.category == c) return e.status;
    }
    return DevWitnessStatus::Absent;
}

void DevEvalRestore::setCategory(
    DevEvalRestore& r,
    DevWitnessCategory c,
    DevWitnessStatus status,
    uint64_t digest
) {
    for (auto& e : r.categories) {
        if (e.category == c) {
            e.status = status;
            e.digest = digest;
            return;
        }
    }
    DevWitnessCategoryEntry e;
    e.category = c;
    e.status = status;
    e.digest = digest;
    r.categories.push_back(e);
}

DevEvalRestore DevEvalRestore::beginFromWitness(
    DevLiveWitness const& witness,
    DevSimPathId evalPath
) {
    DevEvalRestore r;
    r.valid = true;
    r.playerBlobSchema = witness.playerBlobSchema;
    r.freezeWorld = witness.freezeWorld;
    r.evalSimPathId = evalPath;
    r.clock = witness.clock;
    // Clock is bound by contract — mark restored when stamp validates.
    if (witness.clock.valid && DevClockContract::get().clockOk(r.clock)) {
        setCategory(r, DevWitnessCategory::Clock, DevWitnessStatus::Restored);
    }
    else if (witness.clock.valid) {
        setCategory(r, DevWitnessCategory::Clock, DevWitnessStatus::Partial);
    }
    else {
        setCategory(r, DevWitnessCategory::Clock, DevWitnessStatus::Absent);
    }
    // Everything else starts absent until note*Written.
    setCategory(r, DevWitnessCategory::Player, DevWitnessStatus::Absent);
    setCategory(r, DevWitnessCategory::Dual, DevWitnessStatus::Absent);
    setCategory(r, DevWitnessCategory::Orbs, DevWitnessStatus::Absent);
    setCategory(r, DevWitnessCategory::Triggers, DevWitnessStatus::Absent);
    setCategory(r, DevWitnessCategory::Movers, DevWitnessStatus::Absent);
    setCategory(r, DevWitnessCategory::CollisionFlags, DevWitnessStatus::Absent);
    return r;
}

void DevEvalRestore::notePlayerWritten(
    DevEvalRestore& r, DevPlayerBlob const& blob
) {
    r.player = blob;
    setCategory(
        r,
        DevWitnessCategory::Player,
        blob.present ? DevWitnessStatus::Restored : DevWitnessStatus::Absent
    );
    if (blob.present) {
        noteCollisionFlagsPartial(r);
    }
}

void DevEvalRestore::noteDualWritten(
    DevEvalRestore& r, DevPlayerBlob const& blob
) {
    r.dual = blob;
    setCategory(
        r,
        DevWitnessCategory::Dual,
        blob.present ? DevWitnessStatus::Restored : DevWitnessStatus::Absent
    );
}

void DevEvalRestore::noteOrbsWritten(
    DevEvalRestore& r, std::vector<int> const& ids
) {
    r.orbIds = ids;
    setCategory(
        r,
        DevWitnessCategory::Orbs,
        ids.empty() ? DevWitnessStatus::Partial : DevWitnessStatus::Restored
    );
}

void DevEvalRestore::noteTriggersSpooled(
    DevEvalRestore& r,
    std::string const& storeKey,
    int storeVersion,
    int applyTick
) {
    r.triggerStoreKey = storeKey;
    r.triggerStoreVersion = storeVersion;
    r.triggerApplyTick = applyTick;
    r.triggerSpooled = true;
    setCategory(r, DevWitnessCategory::Triggers, DevWitnessStatus::Restored);
}

void DevEvalRestore::noteMoversDigestOnly(DevEvalRestore& r, uint64_t digest) {
    // Hashes must never become Restored.
    setCategory(
        r, DevWitnessCategory::Movers, DevWitnessStatus::DigestOnly, digest
    );
}

void DevEvalRestore::noteMoversPosesWritten(
    DevEvalRestore& r,
    std::vector<DevObjectPose> const& poses,
    uint64_t digest
) {
    r.moverPoses = poses;
    // Poses are restorable — upgrade beyond DigestOnly. Digest kept for drift.
    setCategory(
        r, DevWitnessCategory::Movers, DevWitnessStatus::Restored, digest
    );
}

void DevEvalRestore::noteCollisionFlagsPartial(DevEvalRestore& r) {
    setCategory(
        r, DevWitnessCategory::CollisionFlags, DevWitnessStatus::Partial
    );
}

bool DevEvalRestore::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += ", ";
        report += name;
    };

    DevLiveWitness w;
    w.valid = true;
    w.playerBlobSchema = DevLiveWitness::computePlayerBlobSchema();
    w.clock = DevClockContract::get().makeStamp(
        10, false, false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f,
        DevSimPathId::Plan
    );
    w.player.present = true;
    w.player.x = 12.f;

    DevEvalRestore r = beginFromWitness(w, DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze);
    expect(r.valid, "begin-valid");
    expect(
        categoryStatus(r, DevWitnessCategory::Clock) == DevWitnessStatus::Restored,
        "begin-clock"
    );
    expect(
        categoryStatus(r, DevWitnessCategory::Player) == DevWitnessStatus::Absent,
        "begin-player-absent"
    );
    expect(r.evalSimPathId == DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze, "begin-path");

    notePlayerWritten(r, w.player);
    expect(
        categoryStatus(r, DevWitnessCategory::Player) == DevWitnessStatus::Restored,
        "note-player"
    );
    expect(r.player.x == 12.f, "note-player-x");
    expect(
        categoryStatus(r, DevWitnessCategory::CollisionFlags)
            == DevWitnessStatus::Partial,
        "note-flags"
    );

    noteMoversDigestOnly(r, 0xdeadull);
    expect(
        categoryStatus(r, DevWitnessCategory::Movers)
            == DevWitnessStatus::DigestOnly,
        "movers-digest"
    );

    DevObjectPose pose{};
    pose.uniqueId = 42;
    pose.x = 1.f;
    pose.y = 2.f;
    noteMoversPosesWritten(r, { pose }, 0xdeadull);
    expect(
        categoryStatus(r, DevWitnessCategory::Movers)
            == DevWitnessStatus::Restored,
        "movers-poses"
    );
    expect(r.moverPoses.size() == 1 && r.moverPoses[0].uniqueId == 42,
        "movers-poses-id");

    noteTriggersSpooled(r, "lvl", 1, 11);
    expect(
        categoryStatus(r, DevWitnessCategory::Triggers)
            == DevWitnessStatus::Restored,
        "triggers-spool"
    );
    expect(r.triggerSpooled, "triggers-flag");

    noteOrbsWritten(r, { 7, 8 });
    expect(
        categoryStatus(r, DevWitnessCategory::Orbs)
            == DevWitnessStatus::Restored,
        "orbs-written"
    );

    noteDualWritten(r, w.player);
    expect(
        categoryStatus(r, DevWitnessCategory::Dual)
            == DevWitnessStatus::Restored,
        "dual-written"
    );

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "DevEvalRestore selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("DevEvalRestore selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

`src/dev/DevEvalRestore.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef DEV_EVAL_RESTORE_HPP
#define DEV_EVAL_RESTORE_HPP

#include "DevClockContract.hpp"
#include "DevLiveWitness.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

// What evaluation actually wrote into the ghost / world before the first sim tick.
// Commit 8: record + bookkeeping. Ghost writes land in Commit 9.
class DevEvalRestore {
public:
    bool valid = false;
    uint64_t playerBlobSchema = 0;
    DevPlayerBlob player{};
    DevPlayerBlob dual{};
    DevClockContract::Stamp clock{};
    std::vector<int> orbIds;
    std::vector<DevObjectPose> moverPoses;
    std::string triggerStoreKey;
    int triggerStoreVersion = 0;
    int triggerApplyTick = -1;
    bool triggerSpooled = false;
    // Per-category status after the restore attempt.
    std::vector<DevWitnessCategoryEntry> categories;
    DevSimPathId evalSimPathId = DevSimPathId::None;
    bool freezeWorld = false;

    DevEvalRestore() = default;

    static DevWitnessStatus categoryStatus(
        DevEvalRestore const& r, DevWitnessCategory c
    );

    // Bind clock stamp from witness (always required for a valid restore attempt).
    // Does not claim player/orbs/movers restored — caller marks those after writes.
    static DevEvalRestore beginFromWitness(
        DevLiveWitness const& witness,
        DevSimPathId evalPath
    );

    static void setCategory(
        DevEvalRestore& r,
        DevWitnessCategory c,
        DevWitnessStatus status,
        uint64_t digest = 0
    );

    // Record that the player (and optional dual) blob was written to the ghost.
    static void notePlayerWritten(DevEvalRestore& r, DevPlayerBlob const& blob);
    static void noteDualWritten(DevEvalRestore& r, DevPlayerBlob const& blob);
    static void noteOrbsWritten(DevEvalRestore& r, std::vector<int> const& ids);
    static void noteTriggersSpooled(
        DevEvalRestore& r,
        std::string const& storeKey,
        int storeVersion,
        int applyTick
    );
    // Movers: hashes stay DigestOnly forever; poses can upgrade to Restored.
    static void noteMoversDigestOnly(DevEvalRestore& r, uint64_t digest);
    static void noteMoversPosesWritten(
        DevEvalRestore& r,
        std::vector<DevObjectPose> const& poses,
        uint64_t digest = 0
    );
    static void noteCollisionFlagsPartial(DevEvalRestore& r);

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);
};

#endif // DEV_EVAL_RESTORE_HPP
```

`src/dev/DevLiveWitness.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "DevLiveWitness.hpp"

#include "../core/ShadowSimulator.hpp"
#include "../core/TriggerWorldStore.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <fmt/format.h>

using namespace geode::prelude;

static uint64_t fnv1aMix(uint64_t h, uint64_t v) {
    h ^= v;
    h *= 1099511628211ull;
    return h;
}

static uint64_t fnv1aBytes(void const* data, size_t n) {
    uint64_t h = 14695981039346656037ull;
    auto const* p = static_cast<unsigned char const*>(data);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        h = fnv1aMix(h, p[i]);
    }
    return h;
}

static uint64_t fnv1aStr(char const* s) {
    if (!s) return fnv1aBytes("", 0);
    return fnv1aBytes(s, std::strlen(s));
}

char const* DevLiveWitness::categoryId(DevWitnessCategory c) {
    switch (c) {
        case DevWitnessCategory::Player: return "player";
        case DevWitnessCategory::Dual: return "dual";
        case DevWitnessCategory::Clock: return "clock";
        case DevWitnessCategory::Orbs: return "orbs";
        case DevWitnessCategory::Triggers: return "triggers";
        case DevWitnessCategory::Movers: return "movers";
        case DevWitnessCategory::CollisionFlags: return "collisionFlags";
    }
    return "player";
}

bool DevLiveWitness::parseCategory(std::string const& s, DevWitnessCategory& out) {
    if (s == "player") { out = DevWitnessCategory::Player; return true; }
    if (s == "dual") { out = DevWitnessCategory::Dual; return true; }
    if (s == "clock") { out = DevWitnessCategory::Clock; return true; }
    if (s == "orbs") { out = DevWitnessCategory::Orbs; return true; }
    if (s == "triggers") { out = DevWitnessCategory::Triggers; return true; }
    if (s == "movers") { out = DevWitnessCategory::Movers; return true; }
    if (s == "collisionFlags") { out = DevWitnessCategory::CollisionFlags; return true; }
    return false;
}

char const* DevLiveWitness::statusId(DevWitnessStatus s) {
    switch (s) {
        case DevWitnessStatus::Absent: return "absent";
        case DevWitnessStatus::DigestOnly: return "digestOnly";
        case DevWitnessStatus::Partial: return "partial";
        case DevWitnessStatus::Restored: return "restored";
    }
    return "absent";
}

bool DevLiveWitness::parseStatus(std::string const& s, DevWitnessStatus& out) {
    if (s == "absent") { out = DevWitnessStatus::Absent; return true; }
    if (s == "digestOnly") { out = DevWitnessStatus::DigestOnly; return true; }
    if (s == "partial") { out = DevWitnessStatus::Partial; return true; }
    if (s == "restored") { out = DevWitnessStatus::Restored; return true; }
    return false;
}

char const* const* DevLiveWitness::playerBlobFieldNames(size_t& count) {
    static char const* const kNames[] = {
        "x", "y", "rotation", "scaleX", "scaleY",
        "yVelocity", "fallSpeed", "gravity", "gravityMod", "speedMultiplier",
        "playerSpeed", "vehicleSize", "platformerXVelocity",
        "isUpsideDown", "isSideways", "isGoingLeft",
        "isShip", "isBall", "isBird", "isSwing", "isDart", "isRobot", "isSpider",
        "isSecondPlayer", "isPlatformer", "isDashing",
        "isOnGround", "isOnGround2", "isOnSlope", "wasOnSlope",
        "jumpBuffered", "wasJumpBuffered", "stateRingJump",
        "hasEverJumped", "hasEverHitRing", "isLocked", "controlsDisabled",
        "maybeIsFalling", "maybeIsBoosted",
    };
    count = sizeof(kNames) / sizeof(kNames[0]);
    return kNames;
}

uint64_t DevLiveWitness::computePlayerBlobSchema() {
    size_t n = 0;
    char const* const* names = DevLiveWitness::playerBlobFieldNames(n);
    uint64_t h = 14695981039346656037ull;
    h = fnv1aMix(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(kPlayerBlobSchemaVersion));
    h = fnv1aMix(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(n));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        h = fnv1aMix(h, fnv1aStr(names[i]));
    }
    return h;
}

void DevLiveWitness::setCategory(
    DevLiveWitness& w,
    DevWitnessCategory c,
    DevWitnessStatus status,
    uint64_t digest
) {
    for (auto& e : w.categories) {
        if (e.category == c) {
            e.status = status;
            e.digest = digest;
            return;
        }
    }
    DevWitnessCategoryEntry e;
    e.category = c;
    e.status = status;
    e.digest = digest;
    w.categories.push_back(e);
}

DevWitnessStatus DevLiveWitness::categoryStatus(
    DevLiveWitness const& w, DevWitnessCategory c
) {
    for (auto const& e : w.categories) {
        if (e.category == c) return e.status;
    }
    return DevWitnessStatus::Absent;
}

bool DevLiveWitness::hasWorldDep(DevLiveWitness const& w, DevWitnessCategory c) {
    return w.worldDeps.count(static_cast<int>(c)) > 0;
}

void DevLiveWitness::fillWorldDeps(
    DevLiveWitness& w, SimPlan const& plan, bool dualActive
) {
    w.worldDeps.clear();
    // player + clock always.
    w.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Player));
    w.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Clock));
    w.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::CollisionFlags));

    if (dualActive) {
        w.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Dual));
    }
    if (plan.usedOrbWindow || plan.requireOrb || plan.foresightOrbPad) {
        w.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Orbs));
    }
    // Triggers dep when store ready or sim already applied this tick.
    auto& tw = TriggerWorldStore::get();
    if (tw.loaded() && tw.hasTracks() && tw.readyTrackCount() > 0) {
        w.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Triggers));
    }
    if (ShadowSimulator::get().triggerWorldAppliedThisTick()) {
        w.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Triggers));
    }
    // Movers: only when freeze-world is on (poses) or we at least have a digest.
    if (w.freezeWorld || w.hasHazardDigest) {
        w.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Movers));
    }
}

void DevLiveWitness::fillPlayerBlob(DevPlayerBlob& blob, PlayerObject* src) {
    blob = {};
    if (!src) return;

    blob.scaleX = src->getScaleX();
    blob.scaleY = src->getScaleY();
    blob.yVelocity = src->m_yVelocity;
    blob.fallSpeed = src->m_fallSpeed;
    blob.gravity = src->m_gravity;
    blob.gravityMod = src->m_gravityMod;
    blob.speedMultiplier = src->m_speedMultiplier;
    blob.playerSpeed = src->m_playerSpeed;
    blob.vehicleSize = src->m_vehicleSize;
    blob.platformerXVelocity = src->m_platformerXVelocity;
    blob.isUpsideDown = src->m_isUpsideDown;
    blob.isSideways = src->m_isSideways;
    blob.isGoingLeft = src->m_isGoingLeft;
    blob.isShip = src->m_isShip;
    blob.isBall = src->m_isBall;
    blob.isBird = src->m_isBird;
    blob.isSwing = src->m_isSwing;
    blob.isDart = src->m_isDart;
    blob.isRobot = src->m_isRobot;
    blob.isSpider = src->m_isSpider;
    blob.isSecondPlayer = src->m_isSecondPlayer;
    blob.isPlatformer = src->m_isPlatformer;
    blob.isDashing = src->m_isDashing;
    blob.isOnGround = src->m_isOnGround;
    blob.isOnGround2 = src->m_isOnGround2;
    blob.isOnSlope = src->m_isOnSlope;
    blob.wasOnSlope = src->m_wasOnSlope;
    blob.jumpBuffered = src->m_jumpBuffered;
    blob.wasJumpBuffered = src->m_wasJumpBuffered;
    blob.stateRingJump = src->m_stateRingJump;
    blob.hasEverJumped = src->m_hasEverJumped;
    blob.hasEverHitRing = src->m_hasEverHitRing;
    blob.isLocked = src->m_isLocked;
    blob.controlsDisabled = src->m_controlsDisabled;
    blob.maybeIsFalling = src->m_maybeIsFalling;
    blob.maybeIsBoosted = src->m_maybeIsBoosted;
}

static bool hazardLikeObject(GameObject* obj) {
    if (!obj) return false;
    switch (obj->m_objectType) {
        case GameObjectType::Hazard:
        case GameObjectType::AnimatedHazard:
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
    }
}

uint64_t DevLiveWitness::hashHazardNeighborhood(
    PlayLayer* layer, PlayerObject* player, float radiusX
) {
    if (!layer || !player || !layer->m_objectLayer || radiusX <= 0.f) return 0;
    auto* children = layer->m_objectLayer->getChildren();
    if (!children) return 0;

    float const px = player->getPositionX();
    float const py = player->getPositionY();
    float const yReach = player->m_isShip || player->m_isDart || player->m_isSwing
        ? 120.f
        : 80.f;

    uint64_t h = 14695981039346656037ull;
    int count = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < children->count(); ++i) {
        auto* obj = typeinfo_cast<GameObject*>(children->objectAtIndex(i));
        if (!hazardLikeObject(obj)) continue;
        float const ox = obj->getPositionX();
        float const oy = obj->getPositionY();
        if (ox < px - 20.f || ox > px + radiusX) continue;
        if (std::fabs(oy - py) > yReach) continue;

        float half = obj->getContentSize().width * std::fabs(obj->getScaleX()) * 0.5f;
        if (half < 8.f) half = 8.f;
        h = fnv1aMix(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(obj->m_uniqueID));
        h = fnv1aMix(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<int>(obj->m_objectType)));
        long long const xUs = static_cast<long long>(std::llround(ox * 100.0));
        long long const yUs = static_cast<long long>(std::llround(oy * 100.0));
        long long const halfUs = static_cast<long long>(std::llround(half * 100.0));
        h = fnv1aMix(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(xUs));
        h = fnv1aMix(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(yUs));
        h = fnv1aMix(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(halfUs));
        ++count;
    }
    h = fnv1aMix(h, static_cast<uint64_t>(count));
    return h;
}

DevLiveWitness DevLiveWitness::capture(
    PlayLayer* layer,
    PlayerObject* player,
    PlayerObject* player2,
    SimPlan const& plan,
    DevClockContract::Stamp const& clock,
    int effectTick,
    bool freezeWorld
) {
    DevLiveWitness w;
    w.freezeWorld = freezeWorld;
    w.playerBlobSchema = DevLiveWitness::computePlayerBlobSchema();
    w.clock = clock;
    w.clock.effectTick = effectTick;

    // --- player ---
    fillPlayerBlob(w.player, player);
    if (w.player.present) {
        setCategory(w, DevWitnessCategory::Player, DevWitnessStatus::Restored);
        // Copied bool/ground flags are in the blob; pointer collision refs absent.
        setCategory(
            w, DevWitnessCategory::CollisionFlags, DevWitnessStatus::Partial
        );
    }
    else {
        setCategory(w, DevWitnessCategory::Player, DevWitnessStatus::Absent);
        setCategory(
            w, DevWitnessCategory::CollisionFlags, DevWitnessStatus::Absent
        );
    }

    // --- dual ---
    bool const dualActive = player2 != nullptr
        && layer
        && layer->m_gameState.m_isDualMode;
    if (dualActive && player2) {
        fillPlayerBlob(w.dual, player2);
        setCategory(
            w,
            DevWitnessCategory::Dual,
            w.dual.present ? DevWitnessStatus::Restored : DevWitnessStatus::Absent
        );
    }
    else {
        setCategory(w, DevWitnessCategory::Dual, DevWitnessStatus::Absent);
    }

    // --- clock ---
    if (clock.valid && DevClockContract::get().clockOk(w.clock)) {
        setCategory(w, DevWitnessCategory::Clock, DevWitnessStatus::Restored);
    }
    else if (clock.valid) {
        setCategory(w, DevWitnessCategory::Clock, DevWitnessStatus::Partial);
    }
    else {
        setCategory(w, DevWitnessCategory::Clock, DevWitnessStatus::Absent);
    }

    // --- orbs: activated object IDs from GJGameState map ---
    w.orbIds.clear();
    if (layer) {
        auto const& ids = layer->m_gameState.m_activatedObjectIDs;
        w.orbIds.reserve(ids.size());
        for (auto const& kv : ids) {
            // Key is typically (uniqueId, …); keep unique first components.
            int const uid = kv.first.first;
            if (uid == 0) continue;
            bool seen = false;
            for (int existing : w.orbIds) {
                if (existing == uid) { seen = true; break; }
            }
            if (!seen) w.orbIds.push_back(uid);
        }
    }
    bool const wantOrbs = plan.usedOrbWindow || plan.requireOrb || plan.foresightOrbPad;
    if (wantOrbs) {
        setCategory(
            w,
            DevWitnessCategory::Orbs,
            w.orbIds.empty() ? DevWitnessStatus::Partial : DevWitnessStatus::Restored
        );
    }
    else if (!w.orbIds.empty()) {
        setCategory(w, DevWitnessCategory::Orbs, DevWitnessStatus::Partial);
    }
    else {
        setCategory(w, DevWitnessCategory::Orbs, DevWitnessStatus::Absent);
    }

    // --- triggers ---
    {
        auto& tw = TriggerWorldStore::get();
        w.triggerStoreKey = tw.data().levelKey;
        w.triggerStoreVersion = tw.data().version;
        w.triggerApplyTick = effectTick;
        w.triggerCanSpool = tw.loaded()
            && tw.hasTracks()
            && tw.readyTrackCount() > 0;
        if (w.triggerCanSpool) {
            setCategory(
                w, DevWitnessCategory::Triggers, DevWitnessStatus::Partial
            );
        }
        else if (ShadowSimulator::get().triggerWorldAppliedThisTick()) {
            setCategory(
                w, DevWitnessCategory::Triggers, DevWitnessStatus::Partial
            );
        }
        else {
            setCategory(
                w, DevWitnessCategory::Triggers, DevWitnessStatus::Absent
            );
        }
    }

    // --- movers / hazard digest ---
    // Hashes are ALWAYS DigestOnly. Poses (freeze-world) can be Restored.
    w.moverPoses.clear();
    if (player && layer) {
        float const radius = 160.f;
        w.hazardDigest = hashHazardNeighborhood(layer, player, radius);
        w.hasHazardDigest = true;

        if (freezeWorld) {
            auto* children = layer->m_objectLayer
                ? layer->m_objectLayer->getChildren()
                : nullptr;
            if (children) {
                float const px = player->getPositionX();
                float const py = player->getPositionY();
                float const yReach =
                    player->m_isShip || player->m_isDart || player->m_isSwing
                        ? 120.f
                        : 80.f;
                auto& tw = TriggerWorldStore::get();
                for (unsigned i = 0; i < children->count(); ++i) {
                    auto* obj = typeinfo_cast<GameObject*>(
                        children->objectAtIndex(i)
                    );
                    if (!obj || obj->m_uniqueID == 0) continue;
                    float const ox = obj->getPositionX();
                    float const oy = obj->getPositionY();
                    if (ox < px - 20.f || ox > px + radius) continue;
                    if (std::fabs(oy - py) > yReach) continue;

                    bool want = hazardLikeObject(obj);
                    if (!want && tw.loaded()) {
                        auto const* track = tw.findTrack(obj->m_uniqueID);
                        want = track && track->ready && !track->keys.empty();
                    }
                    if (!want) continue;

                    DevObjectPose pose;
                    pose.uniqueId = obj->m_uniqueID;
                    pose.x = ox;
                    pose.y = oy;
                    pose.rotation = obj->getRotation();
                    pose.scaleX = obj->getScaleX();
                    pose.scaleY = obj->getScaleY();
                    pose.active = obj->isVisible();
                    w.moverPoses.push_back(pose);
                }
            }
            // Vacuous empty set still Restored: freeze path held, nothing to write.
            setCategory(
                w,
                DevWitnessCategory::Movers,
                DevWitnessStatus::Restored,
                w.hazardDigest
            );
        }
        else {
            setCategory(
                w,
                DevWitnessCategory::Movers,
                DevWitnessStatus::DigestOnly,
                w.hazardDigest
            );
        }
    }
    else {
        setCategory(w, DevWitnessCategory::Movers, DevWitnessStatus::Absent);
    }

    fillWorldDeps(w, plan, dualActive);
    w.valid = true;
    return w;
}

bool DevLiveWitness::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += ", ";
        report += name;
    };

    expect(
        std::strcmp(categoryId(DevWitnessCategory::Player), "player") == 0,
        "cat-player"
    );
    expect(
        std::strcmp(statusId(DevWitnessStatus::DigestOnly), "digestOnly") == 0,
        "status-digest"
    );

    uint64_t const s1 = computePlayerBlobSchema();
    uint64_t const s2 = computePlayerBlobSchema();
    expect(s1 == s2 && s1 != 0, "schema-stable");

    size_t n = 0;
    char const* const* names = playerBlobFieldNames(n);
    expect(n >= 20, "schema-fields");
    expect(names && names[0] && std::strcmp(names[0], "x") == 0, "schema-x");

    // Synthetic witness: missing player → player Absent; hazard digestOnly.
    {
        SimPlan plan;
        plan.requireOrb = true;
        DevClockContract::Stamp clock = DevClockContract::get().makeStamp(
            10, false, false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f,
            DevSimPathId::Plan
        );
        DevLiveWitness w = capture(
            nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, plan, clock, 11, false
        );
        expect(w.valid, "cap-valid");
        expect(
            categoryStatus(w, DevWitnessCategory::Player)
                == DevWitnessStatus::Absent,
            "cap-player-absent"
        );
        expect(
            categoryStatus(w, DevWitnessCategory::Clock)
                == DevWitnessStatus::Restored,
            "cap-clock-ok"
        );
        expect(
            categoryStatus(w, DevWitnessCategory::Movers)
                == DevWitnessStatus::Absent,
            "cap-movers-no-layer"
        );
        expect(hasWorldDep(w, DevWitnessCategory::Player), "dep-player");
        expect(hasWorldDep(w, DevWitnessCategory::Clock), "dep-clock");
        expect(hasWorldDep(w, DevWitnessCategory::Orbs), "dep-orbs-require");
        expect(!hasWorldDep(w, DevWitnessCategory::Dual), "dep-no-dual");
    }

    // worldDeps: foresight orb pad tags orbs; dualActive tags dual.
    {
        DevLiveWitness w;
        w.freezeWorld = false;
        w.hasHazardDigest = true;
        SimPlan plan;
        plan.foresightOrbPad = true;
        fillWorldDeps(w, plan, true);
        expect(hasWorldDep(w, DevWitnessCategory::Orbs), "dep-foresight");
        expect(hasWorldDep(w, DevWitnessCategory::Dual), "dep-dual");
        expect(hasWorldDep(w, DevWitnessCategory::Movers), "dep-movers-digest");
    }

    // Hashes alone stay DigestOnly; freeze-world poses may be Restored.
    {
        DevLiveWitness w;
        setCategory(
            w, DevWitnessCategory::Movers, DevWitnessStatus::DigestOnly, 0xabc
        );
        expect(
            categoryStatus(w, DevWitnessCategory::Movers)
                == DevWitnessStatus::DigestOnly,
            "movers-digest-only"
        );
        expect(
            std::strcmp(statusId(DevWitnessStatus::Restored), "restored") == 0,
            "status-restored-id"
        );

        DevLiveWitness wf;
        wf.freezeWorld = true;
        wf.hasHazardDigest = true;
        wf.hazardDigest = 0xabc;
        DevObjectPose p{};
        p.uniqueId = 9;
        p.x = 3.f;
        wf.moverPoses.push_back(p);
        setCategory(
            wf, DevWitnessCategory::Movers, DevWitnessStatus::Restored, 0xabc
        );
        expect(
            categoryStatus(wf, DevWitnessCategory::Movers)
                == DevWitnessStatus::Restored,
            "movers-poses-restored"
        );
        expect(wf.moverPoses.size() == 1, "movers-poses-n");
    }

    DevWitnessCategory parsed = DevWitnessCategory::Player;
    expect(parseCategory("triggers", parsed)
            && parsed == DevWitnessCategory::Triggers,
        "parse-cat");
    DevWitnessStatus st = DevWitnessStatus::Absent;
    expect(parseStatus("digestOnly", st) && st == DevWitnessStatus::DigestOnly,
        "parse-status");

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = fmt::format(
            "DevLiveWitness selfCheck OK schema={:016x}", s1
        );
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("DevLiveWitness selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

`src/dev/DevLiveWitness.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef DEV_LIVE_WITNESS_HPP
#define DEV_LIVE_WITNESS_HPP

#include "DevClockContract.hpp"

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

class PlayLayer;
class PlayerObject;
struct SimPlan;

// Observation quality per category (Vertrag B).
// At capture time: Restored = complete restorable snapshot held in the witness.
// Commit 8's restore/diff may confirm or demote this.
enum class DevWitnessStatus {
    Absent = 0,
    DigestOnly,
    Partial,
    Restored
};

enum class DevWitnessCategory {
    Player = 0,
    Dual,
    Clock,
    Orbs,
    Triggers,
    Movers,
    CollisionFlags
};

// Nearby object pose for freeze-world restore (Commit 11).
// Hashes stay DigestOnly; these poses can upgrade Movers to Restored.
struct DevObjectPose {
    int uniqueId = 0;
    float x = 0.f;
    float y = 0.f;
    float rotation = 0.f;
    float scaleX = 1.f;
    float scaleY = 1.f;
    bool active = true;
};

inline bool operator==(DevObjectPose const& a, DevObjectPose const& b) {
    return a.uniqueId == b.uniqueId
        && a.x == b.x && a.y == b.y
        && a.rotation == b.rotation
        && a.scaleX == b.scaleX && a.scaleY == b.scaleY
        && a.active == b.active;
}

inline bool operator!=(DevObjectPose const& a, DevObjectPose const& b) {
    return !(a == b);
}

// Serializable physics subset of ShadowSimulator::copyPlayerState.
// Pointer/object-ref fields are intentionally absent (see collisionFlags).
struct DevPlayerBlob {
    bool present = false;
    float x = 0.f;
    float y = 0.f;
    float rotation = 0.f;
    float scaleX = 1.f;
    float scaleY = 1.f;
    float yVelocity = 0.f;
    float fallSpeed = 0.f;
    float gravity = 0.f;
    float gravityMod = 0.f;
    float speedMultiplier = 0.f;
    float playerSpeed = 0.f;
    float vehicleSize = 0.f;
    float platformerXVelocity = 0.f;
    bool isUpsideDown = false;
    bool isSideways = false;
    bool isGoingLeft = false;
    bool isShip = false;
    bool isBall = false;
    bool isBird = false;
    bool isSwing = false;
    bool isDart = false;
    bool isRobot = false;
    bool isSpider = false;
    bool isSecondPlayer = false;
    bool isPlatformer = false;
    bool isDashing = false;
    bool isOnGround = false;
    bool isOnGround2 = false;
    bool isOnSlope = false;
    bool wasOnSlope = false;
    bool jumpBuffered = false;
    bool wasJumpBuffered = false;
    bool stateRingJump = false;
    bool hasEverJumped = false;
    bool hasEverHitRing = false;
    bool isLocked = false;
    bool controlsDisabled = false;
    bool maybeIsFalling = false;
    bool maybeIsBoosted = false;
};

struct DevWitnessCategoryEntry {
    DevWitnessCategory category = DevWitnessCategory::Player;
    DevWitnessStatus status = DevWitnessStatus::Absent;
    uint64_t digest = 0; // hazard/AABB/object-set hashes — always DigestOnly
    bool digestMismatch = false; // reserved for later drift checks
};

// Live observation at plan time. No restore in Commit 7.
class DevLiveWitness {
public:
    // Bump when the serializable field list of DevPlayerBlob changes.
    static constexpr int kPlayerBlobSchemaVersion = 1;

    std::vector<DevWitnessCategoryEntry> categories;
    std::unordered_set<int> worldDeps; // DevWitnessCategory as int
    DevPlayerBlob player{};
    DevPlayerBlob dual{};
    DevClockContract::Stamp clock{};
    std::vector<int> orbIds;
    std::vector<DevObjectPose> moverPoses; // only when freezeWorld
    std::string triggerStoreKey;
    int triggerStoreVersion = 0;
    int triggerApplyTick = -1;
    bool triggerCanSpool = false;
    uint64_t playerBlobSchema = 0;
    uint64_t hazardDigest = 0;
    bool hasHazardDigest = false;
    bool freezeWorld = false;
    bool valid = false;

    static char const* categoryId(DevWitnessCategory c);
    static bool parseCategory(std::string const& s, DevWitnessCategory& out);
    static char const* statusId(DevWitnessStatus s);
    static bool parseStatus(std::string const& s, DevWitnessStatus& out);

    // Ordered field-name catalog → stable schema hash.
    static uint64_t computePlayerBlobSchema();
    static char const* const* playerBlobFieldNames(size_t& count);

    static DevWitnessStatus categoryStatus(
        DevLiveWitness const& w, DevWitnessCategory c
    );
    static bool hasWorldDep(DevLiveWitness const& w, DevWitnessCategory c);

    // Capture from live play. player required for a useful witness.
    static DevLiveWitness capture(
        PlayLayer* layer,
        PlayerObject* player,
        PlayerObject* player2,
        SimPlan const& plan,
        DevClockContract::Stamp const& clock,
        int effectTick,
        bool freezeWorld
    );

    // worldDeps from SimPlan flags + dual presence (not post-death heuristics).
    static void fillWorldDeps(
        DevLiveWitness& w,
        SimPlan const& plan,
        bool dualActive
    );

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

    DevLiveWitness() = default;

private:
    static void fillPlayerBlob(DevPlayerBlob& blob, PlayerObject* src);
    static void setCategory(
        DevLiveWitness& w,
        DevWitnessCategory c,
        DevWitnessStatus status,
        uint64_t digest = 0
    );
    static uint64_t hashHazardNeighborhood(
        PlayLayer* layer, PlayerObject* player, float radiusX
    );
};

#endif // DEV_LIVE_WITNESS_HPP
```

`src/dev/DevObjective.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "DevObjective.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <fmt/format.h>
#include <limits>

char const* DevObjective::kindId(Kind k) {
    switch (k) {
        case Kind::SurviveThenEndX: return "survive_then_endx_v1";
        case Kind::PlannerMirror: return "planner_mirror_v1";
        case Kind::HorizonClear: return "horizon_clear_v1";
    }
    return "survive_then_endx_v1";
}

bool DevObjective::parseKind(std::string const& s, Kind& out) {
    if (s == "survive_then_endx_v1") {
        out = Kind::SurviveThenEndX;
        return true;
    }
    if (s == "planner_mirror_v1") {
        out = Kind::PlannerMirror;
        return true;
    }
    if (s == "horizon_clear_v1") {
        out = Kind::HorizonClear;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

void DevObjective::classifyPrimaryAndTail(
    Sample& s,
    int delay,
    int horizonTicks,
    int tailTicks,
    bool died,
    int deathTick,
    float endX,
    bool unknown,
    bool budgetHit,
    bool aborted,
    int ticksRan
) {
    if (delay < 0) delay = 0;
    if (horizonTicks < 0) horizonTicks = 0;
    if (tailTicks < 0) tailTicks = 0;

    s.delay = delay;
    s.unknown = unknown;
    s.budgetHit = budgetHit;
    s.aborted = aborted;
    s.ticksRan = ticksRan;
    s.endX = endX;
    s.deathTick = died ? deathTick : -1;
    s.tailFailed = false;
    s.tailDeathTick = -1;
    s.tailEndX = 0.f;
    s.tailComplete = false;
    s.survivedPrimary = false;
    s.threatCleared = false;

    if (s.inconclusive()) {
        return;
    }

    int const primaryEnd = delay + horizonTicks; // exclusive end index
    int const totalEnd = primaryEnd + tailTicks;

    if (died) {
        if (deathTick < primaryEnd) {
            // Died during wait or primary horizon.
            s.survivedPrimary = false;
            s.endX = endX;
            return;
        }
        // Survived primary; died in tail.
        s.survivedPrimary = true;
        s.threatCleared = true;
        s.tailFailed = true;
        s.tailDeathTick = deathTick;
        s.tailEndX = endX;
        s.tailComplete = true;
        // endX for primary: we only have death-in-tail endX; keep it.
        return;
    }

    // No death.
    if (ticksRan >= primaryEnd) {
        s.survivedPrimary = true;
        s.threatCleared = true;
        if (tailTicks <= 0) {
            s.tailComplete = true;
            s.tailFailed = false;
            s.tailEndX = endX;
        }
        else if (ticksRan >= totalEnd) {
            s.tailComplete = true;
            s.tailFailed = false;
            s.tailEndX = endX;
        }
        else {
            // Truncated before tail finished (should be budget/abort — already handled).
            s.tailComplete = false;
        }
    }
    else {
        s.survivedPrimary = false;
    }
}

std::optional<int> DevObjective::bestSurvivingDelay(
    std::vector<Sample> const& samples
) {
    bool found = false;
    int bestDelay = -1;
    float bestEndX = -std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity();
    for (auto const& s : samples) {
        if (s.inconclusive() || !s.survivedPrimary) continue;
        if (!found
            || s.endX > bestEndX + 1e-4f
            || (std::fabs(s.endX - bestEndX) <= 1e-4f && s.delay < bestDelay)) {
            found = true;
            bestDelay = s.delay;
            bestEndX = s.endX;
        }
    }
    if (!found) return std::nullopt;
    return bestDelay;
}

void DevObjective::applyClaimsGate(Result& r, Meta const& meta) {
    if (meta.claimsAllowed) return;
    r.hasBestSurviving = false;
    r.bestSurvivingDelay = -1;
    r.hasBestEvaluated = false;
    r.bestEvaluatedDelay = -1;
    r.idealEligible = false;
    r.hasIdealDelay = false;
    r.idealDelay = -1;
    r.idealBlockedReason = "claims_suppressed";
}

void DevObjective::fillIdealGate(
    Result& r,
    Meta const& meta,
    Kind kind,
    bool clearSetNonEmpty
) {
    r.idealEligible = false;
    r.hasIdealDelay = false;
    r.idealDelay = -1;
    r.idealBlockedReason.clear();

    if (kind != Kind::HorizonClear) {
        r.idealBlockedReason = "objective_not_horizon_clear";
        return;
    }
    if (!meta.claimsAllowed) {
        r.idealBlockedReason = "claims_suppressed";
        return;
    }
    if (meta.fidelity != DevFidelity::Reproduced) {
        r.idealBlockedReason = "fidelity";
        return;
    }
    if (!meta.gridFull || meta.objectivePartial) {
        r.idealBlockedReason = "grid_partial";
        return;
    }
    if (!meta.tailsComplete) {
        r.idealBlockedReason = "tail_incomplete";
        return;
    }
    if (!meta.clockOk) {
        r.idealBlockedReason = "clock";
        return;
    }
    if (!clearSetNonEmpty) {
        r.idealBlockedReason = "no_clear_survivor";
        return;
    }
    r.idealEligible = true;
}

bool DevObjective::clearEligible(Sample const& s) {
    return s.survivedPrimary
        && !s.tailFailed
        && s.threatCleared
        && !s.unknown
        && !s.budgetHit
        && !s.aborted
        && s.tailComplete;
}

DevObjective::Result DevObjective::evaluateSurviveThenEndX(
    std::vector<Sample> const& samples, Meta const& meta
) {
    Result r;
    r.kind = Kind::SurviveThenEndX;
    r.objectiveId = kindId(Kind::SurviveThenEndX);
    r.horizonTicks = meta.horizonTicks;
    r.tailTicks = meta.tailTicks;
    r.objectivePartial = meta.objectivePartial;

    auto surv = bestSurvivingDelay(samples);
    if (surv) {
        r.hasBestSurviving = true;
        r.bestSurvivingDelay = *surv;
    }

    // Lexicographic over eligible: survivedPrimary, endX, delay.
    bool found = false;
    int bestDelay = -1;
    bool bestSurv = false;
    float bestEndX = -std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity();
    for (auto const& s : samples) {
        if (s.inconclusive()) continue;
        bool const better = !found
            || (s.survivedPrimary && !bestSurv)
            || (s.survivedPrimary == bestSurv
                && (s.endX > bestEndX + 1e-4f
                    || (std::fabs(s.endX - bestEndX) <= 1e-4f
                        && s.delay < bestDelay)));
        if (!better) continue;
        found = true;
        bestDelay = s.delay;
        bestSurv = s.survivedPrimary;
        bestEndX = s.endX;
    }
    if (found) {
        r.hasBestEvaluated = true;
        r.bestEvaluatedDelay = bestDelay;
    }

    fillIdealGate(r, meta, Kind::SurviveThenEndX, false);
    applyClaimsGate(r, meta);
    return r;
}

DevObjective::Result DevObjective::evaluatePlannerMirror(
    std::vector<Sample> const& samples, Meta const& meta
) {
    Result r;
    r.kind = Kind::PlannerMirror;
    r.objectiveId = kindId(Kind::PlannerMirror);
    r.horizonTicks = meta.horizonTicks;
    r.tailTicks = meta.tailTicks;
    r.objectivePartial = meta.objectivePartial;

    auto surv = bestSurvivingDelay(samples);
    if (surv) {
        r.hasBestSurviving = true;
        r.bestSurvivingDelay = *surv;
    }

    // Survive-bin: survived > later death > earlier death; then endX - λ·delay.
    auto surviveBin = [](Sample const& s) -> int {
        if (s.survivedPrimary) return 2;
        if (!s.inconclusive() && s.deathTick >= 0) return 1;
        return 0;
    };
    auto score = [&](Sample const& s) -> float {
        return s.endX - meta.latencyWeight * static_cast<float>(s.delay);
    };

    bool found = false;
    int bestDelay = -1;
    int bestBin = -1;
    float bestScore = -std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity();
    int bestDeathTick = -1;
    for (auto const& s : samples) {
        if (s.inconclusive()) continue;
        int const bin = surviveBin(s);
        float const sc = score(s);
        bool better = !found || bin > bestBin;
        if (!better && bin == bestBin) {
            if (bin == 1) {
                // Later death is better.
                better = s.deathTick > bestDeathTick
                    || (s.deathTick == bestDeathTick && sc > bestScore + 1e-4f)
                    || (s.deathTick == bestDeathTick
                        && std::fabs(sc - bestScore) <= 1e-4f
                        && s.delay < bestDelay);
            }
            else {
                better = sc > bestScore + 1e-4f
                    || (std::fabs(sc - bestScore) <= 1e-4f && s.delay < bestDelay);
            }
        }
        if (!better) continue;
        found = true;
        bestDelay = s.delay;
        bestBin = bin;
        bestScore = sc;
        bestDeathTick = s.deathTick;
    }
    if (found) {
        r.hasBestEvaluated = true;
        r.bestEvaluatedDelay = bestDelay;
    }

    fillIdealGate(r, meta, Kind::PlannerMirror, false);
    applyClaimsGate(r, meta);
    return r;
}

DevObjective::Result DevObjective::evaluateHorizonClear(
    std::vector<Sample> const& samples, Meta const& meta
) {
    Result r;
    r.kind = Kind::HorizonClear;
    r.objectiveId = kindId(Kind::HorizonClear);
    r.horizonTicks = meta.horizonTicks;
    r.tailTicks = meta.tailTicks;
    r.objectivePartial = meta.objectivePartial;

    auto surv = bestSurvivingDelay(samples);
    if (surv) {
        r.hasBestSurviving = true;
        r.bestSurvivingDelay = *surv;
    }

    // Clear-eligible: max tailEndX, then min delay.
    bool foundClear = false;
    int bestClear = -1;
    float bestTailX = -std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity();
    for (auto const& s : samples) {
        if (!clearEligible(s)) continue;
        if (!foundClear
            || s.tailEndX > bestTailX + 1e-4f
            || (std::fabs(s.tailEndX - bestTailX) <= 1e-4f
                && s.delay < bestClear)) {
            foundClear = true;
            bestClear = s.delay;
            bestTailX = s.tailEndX;
        }
    }
    if (foundClear) {
        r.hasBestEvaluated = true;
        r.bestEvaluatedDelay = bestClear;
    }

    fillIdealGate(r, meta, Kind::HorizonClear, foundClear);
    if (r.idealEligible && foundClear) {
        r.hasIdealDelay = true;
        r.idealDelay = bestClear;
        r.idealBlockedReason.clear();
    }

    applyClaimsGate(r, meta);
    // applyClaimsGate clears ideal; restore blocked reason if suppressed.
    if (!meta.claimsAllowed && r.idealBlockedReason.empty()) {
        r.idealBlockedReason = "claims_suppressed";
    }
    return r;
}

DevObjective::Result DevObjective::evaluate(
    Kind kind,
    std::vector<Sample> const& samples,
    Meta const& meta
) {
    switch (kind) {
        case Kind::PlannerMirror:
            return evaluatePlannerMirror(samples, meta);
        case Kind::HorizonClear:
            return evaluateHorizonClear(samples, meta);
        case Kind::SurviveThenEndX:
            break;
    }
    return evaluateSurviveThenEndX(samples, meta);
}

bool DevObjective::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += ", ";
        report += name;
    };

    expect(
        std::strcmp(kindId(Kind::SurviveThenEndX), "survive_then_endx_v1") == 0,
        "id-survive"
    );
    expect(
        std::strcmp(kindId(Kind::HorizonClear), "horizon_clear_v1") == 0,
        "id-clear"
    );

    // Fixture: two primary survivors; delay 5 has higher endX but tailFailed.
    std::vector<Sample> samples;
    {
        Sample a;
        a.delay = 2;
        a.survivedPrimary = true;
        a.endX = 100.f;
        a.tailFailed = false;
        a.tailComplete = true;
        a.tailEndX = 110.f;
        a.threatCleared = true;
        samples.push_back(a);

        Sample b;
        b.delay = 5;
        b.survivedPrimary = true;
        b.endX = 120.f;
        b.tailFailed = true;
        b.tailDeathTick = 60;
        b.tailComplete = true;
        b.tailEndX = 105.f;
        b.threatCleared = true;
        samples.push_back(b);

        Sample dead;
        dead.delay = 0;
        dead.survivedPrimary = false;
        dead.deathTick = 3;
        dead.endX = 40.f;
        samples.push_back(dead);
    }

    auto surv = bestSurvivingDelay(samples);
    expect(surv && *surv == 5, "best-surv-endx"); // higher endX wins (ignores tail)

    Meta meta;
    meta.claimsAllowed = true;
    meta.fidelity = DevFidelity::PlayerOnlyApproximated;
    meta.clockOk = true;
    meta.gridFull = false;
    meta.tailsComplete = true;
    meta.horizonTicks = 48;
    meta.tailTicks = 48;
    meta.objectivePartial = true;
    meta.latencyWeight = 0.25f;

    {
        auto r = evaluateSurviveThenEndX(samples, meta);
        expect(r.hasBestSurviving && r.bestSurvivingDelay == 5, "stx-surv");
        expect(r.hasBestEvaluated && r.bestEvaluatedDelay == 5, "stx-eval");
        expect(!r.idealEligible && !r.hasIdealDelay, "stx-no-ideal");
        expect(
            r.idealBlockedReason == std::string("objective_not_horizon_clear"),
            "stx-block"
        );
    }

    {
        auto r = evaluateHorizonClear(samples, meta);
        // Only delay 2 is clear-eligible (5 has tailFailed).
        expect(r.hasBestEvaluated && r.bestEvaluatedDelay == 2, "hc-eval");
        expect(r.hasBestSurviving && r.bestSurvivingDelay == 5, "hc-surv");
        expect(!r.idealEligible, "hc-no-ideal-approx");
        expect(r.idealBlockedReason == std::string("fidelity"), "hc-block-fid");
    }

    // Ideal eligible only with reproduced + full grid + tails + clear set.
    {
        Meta m = meta;
        m.fidelity = DevFidelity::Reproduced;
        m.gridFull = true;
        m.objectivePartial = false;
        m.tailsComplete = true;
        m.claimsAllowed = true;
        m.clockOk = true;
        auto r = evaluateHorizonClear(samples, m);
        expect(r.idealEligible, "ideal-eligible");
        expect(r.hasIdealDelay && r.idealDelay == 2, "ideal-delay");
        expect(r.idealBlockedReason.empty(), "ideal-no-block");
    }

    // claims suppressed clears fields.
    {
        Meta m = meta;
        m.claimsAllowed = false;
        m.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        auto r = evaluateSurviveThenEndX(samples, m);
        expect(!r.hasBestSurviving && !r.hasBestEvaluated, "suppress-fields");
        expect(r.idealBlockedReason == std::string("claims_suppressed"), "suppress-reason");
    }

    // classifyPrimaryAndTail
    {
        Sample s;
        classifyPrimaryAndTail(
            s, /*delay*/2, /*H*/4, /*T*/4,
            /*died*/true, /*deathTick*/7, /*endX*/55.f,
            false, false, false, /*ticksRan*/8
        );
        // primaryEnd = 6; death at 7 → survived primary, tail fail
        expect(s.survivedPrimary && s.tailFailed, "tail-class-fail");
        expect(s.tailDeathTick == 7, "tail-death");

        Sample s2;
        classifyPrimaryAndTail(
            s2, 2, 4, 4,
            false, -1, 80.f,
            false, false, false, 10
        );
        expect(s2.survivedPrimary && !s2.tailFailed && s2.tailComplete, "tail-ok");
        expect(s2.tailEndX == 80.f, "tail-endx");

        Sample s3;
        classifyPrimaryAndTail(
            s3, 2, 4, 4,
            true, 3, 20.f,
            false, false, false, 4
        );
        expect(!s3.survivedPrimary, "primary-death");
    }

    // planner_mirror: survivor beats dead
    {
        auto r = evaluatePlannerMirror(samples, meta);
        expect(r.hasBestEvaluated, "pm-eval");
        // Both 2 and 5 survived — higher endX - λd: 120-1.25=118.75 vs 100-0.5=99.5 → 5
        expect(r.bestEvaluatedDelay == 5, "pm-pick");
        expect(!r.idealEligible, "pm-no-ideal");
    }

    // inconclusive ignored
    {
        std::vector<Sample> onlyBad;
        Sample u;
        u.delay = 1;
        u.unknown = true;
        u.survivedPrimary = true;
        u.endX = 999.f;
        onlyBad.push_back(u);
        auto r = evaluateSurviveThenEndX(onlyBad, meta);
        expect(!r.hasBestEvaluated && !r.hasBestSurviving, "inconclusive-skip");
    }

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "DevObjective selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("DevObjective selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

`src/dev/DevObjective.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef DEV_OBJECTIVE_HPP
#define DEV_OBJECTIVE_HPP

#include "DevStateDiff.hpp"

#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

// Pure objective functions over eval samples (Vertrag A). No PlayLayer.
class DevObjective {
public:
    static constexpr int kSchema = 1;

    enum class Kind {
        SurviveThenEndX = 0, // survive_then_endx_v1
        PlannerMirror,       // planner_mirror_v1
        HorizonClear         // horizon_clear_v1
    };

    struct Sample {
        int delay = 0;
        bool survivedPrimary = false;
        int deathTick = -1;
        float endX = 0.f;
        bool unknown = false;
        bool budgetHit = false;
        bool aborted = false;
        bool tailFailed = false;
        int tailDeathTick = -1;
        float tailEndX = 0.f;
        bool tailComplete = false;
        bool threatCleared = false;
        int ticksRan = 0;

        bool inconclusive() const {
            return this->unknown || this->budgetHit || this->aborted;
        }
    };

    struct Meta {
        DevFidelity fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        bool claimsAllowed = false;
        bool clockOk = true;
        bool gridFull = false;      // every d in 0..limit present, none skipped
        bool tailsComplete = false; // every primary survivor has tailComplete
        int horizonTicks = 48;
        int tailTicks = 48;
        float latencyWeight = 0.25f; // planner_mirror_v1
        bool objectivePartial = false;
    };

    struct Result {
        Kind kind = Kind::SurviveThenEndX;
        char const* objectiveId = "survive_then_endx_v1";
        int horizonTicks = 48;
        int tailTicks = 48;
        bool objectivePartial = false;

        bool hasBestSurviving = false;
        int bestSurvivingDelay = -1;

        bool hasBestEvaluated = false;
        int bestEvaluatedDelay = -1;

        bool idealEligible = false;
        bool hasIdealDelay = false;
        int idealDelay = -1;
        std::string idealBlockedReason;
    };

    static char const* kindId(Kind k);
    static bool parseKind(std::string const& s, Kind& out);

    // bestSurvivingDelay: among survivedPrimary && !inconclusive; max endX, then min delay.
    static std::optional<int> bestSurvivingDelay(
        std::vector<Sample> const& samples
    );

    static Result evaluateSurviveThenEndX(
        std::vector<Sample> const& samples, Meta const& meta
    );
    static Result evaluatePlannerMirror(
        std::vector<Sample> const& samples, Meta const& meta
    );
    static Result evaluateHorizonClear(
        std::vector<Sample> const& samples, Meta const& meta
    );

    static Result evaluate(
        Kind kind,
        std::vector<Sample> const& samples,
        Meta const& meta
    );

    // Classify primary/tail from a combined H+T schedule run.
    // deathTick/ticksRan are schedule indices (0-based); action at `delay`.
    static void classifyPrimaryAndTail(
        Sample& s,
        int delay,
        int horizonTicks,
        int tailTicks,
        bool died,
        int deathTick,
        float endX,
        bool unknown,
        bool budgetHit,
        bool aborted,
        int ticksRan
    );

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    DevObjective() = delete;

    static void applyClaimsGate(Result& r, Meta const& meta);
    static void fillIdealGate(
        Result& r,
        Meta const& meta,
        Kind kind,
        bool clearSetNonEmpty
    );
    static bool clearEligible(Sample const& s);
};

#endif // DEV_OBJECTIVE_HPP

```

```cpp
std::string DevRejectLedger::clampDetail(std::string s) {
    if (static_cast<int>(s.size()) > kMaxDetailLen) {
        s.resize(static_cast<size_t>(kMaxDetailLen));
    }
    return s;
}

DevRejectLedger::RejectCode DevRejectLedger::skipCode(EarlyExit early) {
    switch (early) {
        case EarlyExit::Budget: return RejectCode::BudgetNotReached;
        case EarlyExit::PreferBand: return RejectCode::PreferBandEarlyExit;
        case EarlyExit::WaveProximity: return RejectCode::WaveHazardProximity;
        case EarlyExit::WaveFutile: return RejectCode::WaveFutile;
        case EarlyExit::NoThreat: return RejectCode::NotViable;
        case EarlyExit::None: return RejectCode::BudgetNotReached;
    }
    return RejectCode::BudgetNotReached;
}

DevRejectLedger::RejectCode DevRejectLedger::classifyRejected(
    CandSnap const& snap,
    CandSnap const* chosen,
    BuildInput const& in,
    int delay
) {
    if (snap.dualFailed) return RejectCode::DualFailed;
    if (snap.diedBeforeAction) return RejectCode::DiedBeforeAction;
    if (snap.verifyFailed) return RejectCode::VerifyFailed;
    if (snap.robustKFailed) return RejectCode::RobustKFailed;
    if (snap.unknownTrunc && !snap.viable) return RejectCode::UnknownTrunc;

    if (in.earlyExit == EarlyExit::WaveFutile && snap.evaluated) {
        return RejectCode::WaveFutile;
    }

    if (snap.viable) {
        if (in.orbIntent && in.actMin >= 0 && in.actMax >= in.actMin
            && (delay < in.actMin || delay > in.actMax)) {
            return RejectCode::OutsideOrbWindow;
        }
        if (chosen) {
            if (in.legacyPick && delay > chosen->surviveBin
                && snap.surviveBin <= chosen->surviveBin
                && delay > 0) {
                // Legacy kept an earlier/safer pick; mark later survivors.
            }
            if (in.legacyPick && delay != 0 && chosen
                && delay > (in.doPass ? 0 : in.chosenDelay)
                && in.chosenDelay >= 0 && delay > in.chosenDelay) {
                // Later viable lost to earlier legacy pick.
                if (in.doPass || in.chosenDelay < delay) {
                    return RejectCode::LegacyEarlierKept;
                }
            }
            if (snap.surviveBin < chosen->surviveBin) {
                return RejectCode::WorseSurviveBin;
            }
            if (snap.endX + 1e-3f < chosen->endX) {
                return RejectCode::WorseEndX;
            }
            if (in.legacyPick && in.chosenDelay >= 0 && delay > in.chosenDelay) {
                return RejectCode::LegacyEarlierKept;
            }
        }
        return RejectCode::WorseEndX;
    }
    return RejectCode::NotViable;
}

DevRejectLedger::Ledger DevRejectLedger::build(BuildInput const& in) {
    Ledger out;
    if (in.limit < 0) return out;

    int const n = in.limit + 1;
    out.notes.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(n));

    CandSnap const* chosenSnap = nullptr;
    if (in.chosenDelay >= 0 && in.chosenDelay <= in.limit
        && static_cast<int>(in.snaps.size()) > in.chosenDelay
        && in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(in.chosenDelay)].evaluated) {
        chosenSnap = &in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(in.chosenDelay)];
    }

    bool const scoresWanted = in.includeScores;
    if (n > kMaxCandNotes && scoresWanted) {
        out.truncated = true;
    }

    for (int d = 0; d < n; ++d) {
        CandNote note;
        note.delay = d;

        CandSnap snap{};
        if (d < static_cast<int>(in.snaps.size())) {
            snap = in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(d)];
        }

        bool const isChosen = (in.chosenDelay == d)
            || (in.doPass && d == 0 && in.chosenDelay <= 0);

        if (isChosen && (snap.evaluated || d == 0 || in.doPass)) {
            note.status = Status::Chosen;
            note.rejectCode = RejectCode::Chosen;
            note.detail = clampDetail(fmt::format("d={}", d));
        }
        else if (!snap.evaluated) {
            note.status = Status::Skipped;
            note.rejectCode = skipCode(in.earlyExit);
            if (in.earlyExit == EarlyExit::NoThreat) {
                note.detail = clampDetail("no-threat");
            }
            else {
                note.detail = clampDetail(
                    fmt::format("skip={}", rejectCodeId(note.rejectCode))
                );
            }
        }
        else if (!snap.viable) {
            note.status = Status::Rejected;
            note.rejectCode = classifyRejected(snap, chosenSnap, in, d);
            note.detail = clampDetail(fmt::format(
                "{} bin={} endX={:.1f}",
                rejectCodeId(note.rejectCode),
                snap.surviveBin,
                snap.endX
            ));
        }
        else {
            // Viable but not chosen.
            note.status = Status::Evaluated;
            if (in.earlyExit == EarlyExit::WaveFutile) {
                note.rejectCode = RejectCode::WaveFutile;
            }
            else {
                note.rejectCode = classifyRejected(snap, chosenSnap, in, d);
            }
            note.detail = clampDetail(fmt::format(
                "{} bin={} endX={:.1f}",
                rejectCodeId(note.rejectCode),
                snap.surviveBin,
                snap.endX
            ));
        }

        bool const writeScores = scoresWanted
            && (!out.truncated || d < kMaxCandNotes);
        if (writeScores && snap.evaluated) {
            note.hasScores = true;
            note.surviveBin = snap.surviveBin;
            note.endX = snap.endX;
            note.latencyTerm = in.latencyWeight * static_cast<float>(d);
            note.threatCleared = snap.clearsThreat;
            note.score = snap.endX - note.latencyTerm;
        }
        else if (out.truncated && scoresWanted && d >= kMaxCandNotes) {
            // Codes remain; scores omitted.
            note.hasScores = false;
        }

        out.notes.push_back(std::move(note));
    }

    // Ensure exactly one chosen when doPass / chosenDelay set.
    if (in.chosenDelay >= 0 && in.chosenDelay <= in.limit) {
        for (auto& note : out.notes) {
            if (note.delay == in.chosenDelay) {
                note.status = Status::Chosen;
                note.rejectCode = RejectCode::Chosen;
            }
            else if (note.status == Status::Chosen) {
                note.status = Status::Evaluated;
            }
        }
    }
    else if (in.doPass) {
        for (auto& note : out.notes) {
            if (note.delay == 0) {
                note.status = Status::Chosen;
                note.rejectCode = RejectCode::Chosen;
            }
            else if (note.status == Status::Chosen) {
                note.status = Status::Evaluated;
            }
        }
    }

    return out;
}

std::vector<DevRejectLedger::AttributionNote> DevRejectLedger::buildAttribution(
    AttributionInput const& in
) {
    std::vector<AttributionNote> out;

    if (in.gatePass && !in.hasPlanFinished) {
        AttributionNote n;
        n.code = Attribution::GatePass;
        n.detail = "gate-pass";
        out.push_back(std::move(n));
        return out;
    }

    if (in.notReproducible) {
        AttributionNote n;
        n.code = Attribution::NotReproducible;
        out.push_back(std::move(n));
    }
    else if (in.approx) {
        AttributionNote n;
        n.code = Attribution::ApproxOnly;
        out.push_back(std::move(n));
    }

    if (in.claimsAllowed && in.hasBestSurviving) {
        if (in.plannedDelay == in.bestSurvivingDelay) {
            AttributionNote n;
            n.code = Attribution::ChosenMatchesBestSurviving;
            n.detail = clampDetail(fmt::format("d={}", in.plannedDelay));
            out.push_back(std::move(n));
        }
        else {
            AttributionNote n;
            n.code = Attribution::ChosenDiffersBestSurviving;
            char const* rej = "";
            if (in.ledger) {
                for (auto const& cn : in.ledger->notes) {
                    if (cn.delay == in.bestSurvivingDelay) {
                        rej = rejectCodeId(cn.rejectCode);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            n.detail = clampDetail(fmt::format(
                "planned={} bestSurv={} rej={} obj={}",
                in.plannedDelay,
                in.bestSurvivingDelay,
                rej,
                in.objectiveId ? in.objectiveId : ""
            ));
            out.push_back(std::move(n));
        }
    }
    else if (in.hasPlanFinished) {
        AttributionNote n;
        n.code = Attribution::BestSurvivingAbsent;
        out.push_back(std::move(n));
    }

    if (in.learningNudged) {
        AttributionNote n;
        n.code = Attribution::LearningNudged;
        out.push_back(std::move(n));
    }
    if (in.learningFloored) {
        AttributionNote n;
        n.code = Attribution::LearningFloored;
        out.push_back(std::move(n));
    }
    if (in.recheckSlide) {
        AttributionNote n;
        n.code = Attribution::RecheckSlide;
        out.push_back(std::move(n));
    }
    if (in.husDeadline) {
        AttributionNote n;
        n.code = Attribution::HusDeadline;
        out.push_back(std::move(n));
    }
    if (in.verifyRefused) {
        AttributionNote n;
        n.code = Attribution::VerifyRefused;
        out.push_back(std::move(n));
    }
    if (in.limitExcluded) {
        AttributionNote n;
        n.code = Attribution::LimitExcluded;
        out.push_back(std::move(n));
    }

    if (in.ledger) {
        for (auto const& cn : in.ledger->notes) {
            if (cn.rejectCode == RejectCode::DualFailed) {
                AttributionNote n;
                n.code = Attribution::DualFailed;
                n.detail = clampDetail(fmt::format("d={}", cn.delay));
                out.push_back(std::move(n));
                break;
            }
        }
        for (auto const& cn : in.ledger->notes) {
            if (cn.rejectCode == RejectCode::UnknownTrunc) {
                AttributionNote n;
                n.code = Attribution::UnknownTrunc;
                n.detail = clampDetail(fmt::format("d={}", cn.delay));
                out.push_back(std::move(n));
                break;
            }
        }
        if (in.hasBestSurviving) {
            for (auto const& cn : in.ledger->notes) {
                if (cn.delay == in.bestSurvivingDelay
                    && cn.status == Status::Skipped) {
                    AttributionNote n;
                    n.code = Attribution::SkippedByPlanner;
                    n.detail = clampDetail(fmt::format(
                        "d={} {}",
                        cn.delay,
                        rejectCodeId(cn.rejectCode)
                    ));
                    out.push_back(std::move(n));
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return out;
}

bool DevRejectLedger::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += ", ";
        report += name;
    };

    expect(
        std::strcmp(rejectCodeId(RejectCode::Chosen), "chosen") == 0,
        "code-chosen"
    );
    expect(
        std::strcmp(statusId(Status::Skipped), "skipped") == 0,
        "status-skipped"
    );
    expect(
        std::strcmp(
            attributionId(Attribution::GatePass), "gate-pass"
        ) == 0,
        "attr-gate"
    );

    RejectCode parsed = RejectCode::Chosen;
    expect(
        parseRejectCode("robust-k-failed", parsed)
            && parsed == RejectCode::RobustKFailed,
        "parse-code"
    );

    // Full ledger: every delay 0..limit once; chosen marked.
    {
        BuildInput in;
        in.limit = 3;
        in.chosenDelay = 2;
        in.latencyWeight = 0.25f;
        in.includeScores = true;
        in.snaps.resize(4);
        for (int d = 0; d <= 3; ++d) {
            in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(d)].evaluated = true;
            in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(d)].viable = (d != 1);
            in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(d)].surviveBin = d;
            in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(d)].endX = 10.f * static_cast<float>(d);
            in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(d)].clearsThreat = true;
        }
        in.snaps[1].diedBeforeAction = true;
        in.snaps[1].viable = false;

        auto led = build(in);
        expect(static_cast<int>(led.notes.size()) == 4, "notes-n");
        expect(!led.truncated, "not-trunc");
        int chosenCount = 0;
        for (auto const& n : led.notes) {
            if (n.status == Status::Chosen) {
                ++chosenCount;
                expect(n.delay == 2, "chosen-d");
                expect(n.rejectCode == RejectCode::Chosen, "chosen-code");
            }
            if (n.delay == 1) {
                expect(n.status == Status::Rejected, "died-status");
                expect(
                    n.rejectCode == RejectCode::DiedBeforeAction, "died-code"
                );
            }
            if (n.delay == 0) {
                expect(n.hasScores && n.surviveBin == 0, "scores-0");
            }
        }
        expect(chosenCount == 1, "one-chosen");
    }

    // Skipped after wave proximity.
    {
        BuildInput in;
        in.limit = 2;
        in.doPass = true;
        in.chosenDelay = 0;
        in.earlyExit = EarlyExit::WaveProximity;
        in.snaps.resize(3);
        in.snaps[0].evaluated = true;
        in.snaps[0].viable = true;
        in.snaps[0].endX = 5.f;
        auto led = build(in);
        expect(led.notes[0].status == Status::Chosen, "prox-chosen");
        expect(
            led.notes[1].status == Status::Skipped
                && led.notes[1].rejectCode == RejectCode::WaveHazardProximity,
            "prox-skip"
        );
        expect(led.notes[2].status == Status::Skipped, "prox-skip2");
    }

    // Truncation: codes remain past kMaxCandNotes, scores drop.
    {
        BuildInput in;
        in.limit = kMaxCandNotes + 2;
        in.chosenDelay = 0;
        in.doPass = true;
        in.includeScores = true;
        in.snaps.resize(static_cast<size_t>(in.limit) + 1);
        for (int d = 0; d <= in.limit; ++d) {
            in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(d)].evaluated = true;
            in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(d)].viable = true;
            in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(d)].endX = 1.f;
        }
        auto led = build(in);
        expect(led.truncated, "trunc-flag");
        expect(
            static_cast<int>(led.notes.size()) == in.limit + 1, "trunc-n"
        );
        expect(led.notes[0].hasScores, "trunc-score-low");
        expect(
            !led.notes[static_cast<size_t>(kMaxCandNotes)].hasScores,
            "trunc-score-high"
        );
        expect(
            led.notes[static_cast<size_t>(kMaxCandNotes)].rejectCode
                != RejectCode::Chosen
                || led.notes[0].status == Status::Chosen,
            "trunc-codes"
        );
    }

    // Attribution: gate-pass alone.
    {
        AttributionInput a;
        a.gatePass = true;
        a.hasPlanFinished = false;
        auto attrs = buildAttribution(a);
        expect(attrs.size() == 1, "attr-n");
        expect(attrs[0].code == Attribution::GatePass, "attr-gate-code");
    }

    // Attribution: chosen differs best surviving.
    {
        BuildInput in;
        in.limit = 2;
        in.chosenDelay = 0;
        in.doPass = true;
        in.snaps.resize(3);
        for (int d = 0; d <= 2; ++d) {
            in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(d)].evaluated = true;
            in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(d)].viable = true;
            in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(d)].endX = static_cast<float>(d);
            in.snaps[static_cast<size_t>(d)].surviveBin = 1;
        }
        auto led = build(in);

        AttributionInput a;
        a.hasPlanFinished = true;
        a.claimsAllowed = true;
        a.hasBestSurviving = true;
        a.bestSurvivingDelay = 2;
        a.plannedDelay = 0;
        a.objectiveId = "survive_then_endx_v1";
        a.ledger = &led;
        auto attrs = buildAttribution(a);
        bool found = false;
        for (auto const& at : attrs) {
            if (at.code == Attribution::ChosenDiffersBestSurviving) {
                found = true;
                expect(
                    at.detail.find("bestSurv=2") != std::string::npos,
                    "attr-detail"
                );
            }
        }
        expect(found, "attr-differs");
    }

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "DevRejectLedger selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("DevRejectLedger selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

`src/dev/DevRejectLedger.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef DEV_REJECT_LEDGER_HPP
#define DEV_REJECT_LEDGER_HPP

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

// Per-delay reject ledger + attribution (Commit 12 / Vertrag D).
class DevRejectLedger {
public:
    static constexpr int kMaxCandNotes = 64;
    static constexpr int kMaxDetailLen = 120;

    enum class Status {
        Chosen = 0,
        Evaluated,
        Rejected,
        Skipped
    };

    enum class RejectCode {
        Chosen = 0,
        NotViable,
        DiedBeforeAction,
        WorseSurviveBin,
        WorseEndX,
        OutsideOrbWindow,
        RobustKFailed,
        BudgetNotReached,
        PreferBandEarlyExit,
        WaveFutile,
        WaveHazardProximity,
        DualFailed,
        UnknownTrunc,
        LegacyEarlierKept,
        VerifyFailed,
        LearningDisplaced
    };

    enum class Attribution {
        ChosenMatchesBestSurviving = 0,
        ChosenDiffersBestSurviving,
        BestSurvivingAbsent,
        ApproxOnly,
        NotReproducible,
        LearningNudged,
        LearningFloored,
        RecheckSlide,
        HusDeadline,
        VerifyRefused,
        GatePass,
        LimitExcluded,
        DualFailed,
        UnknownTrunc,
        SkippedByPlanner
    };

    struct CandSnap {
        bool evaluated = false;
        bool viable = false;
        bool diedBeforeAction = false;
        bool dualFailed = false;
        bool unknownTrunc = false;
        bool clearsThreat = false;
        bool activatedRing = false;
        bool robustKFailed = false;
        bool verifyFailed = false;
        int surviveBin = 0;
        float endX = 0.f;
    };

    enum class EarlyExit {
        None = 0,
        Budget,
        PreferBand,
        WaveProximity,
        NoThreat,
        WaveFutile
    };

    struct BuildInput {
        int limit = 0;
        int chosenDelay = -1; // Pass→0 when doPass; −1 = no pick
        bool doPass = false;
        float latencyWeight = 0.25f;
        bool orbIntent = false;
        int actMin = -1;
        int actMax = -1;
        bool legacyPick = false;
        EarlyExit earlyExit = EarlyExit::None;
        bool includeScores = true;
        std::vector<CandSnap> snaps; // size should be limit+1
    };

    struct CandNote {
        int delay = 0;
        Status status = Status::Skipped;
        RejectCode rejectCode = RejectCode::NotViable;
        std::string detail;
        bool hasScores = false;
        int surviveBin = 0;
        float endX = 0.f;
        float latencyTerm = 0.f;
        bool threatCleared = false;
        float score = 0.f;
    };

    struct Ledger {
        std::vector<CandNote> notes;
        bool truncated = false; // scores omitted past kMaxCandNotes
    };

    struct AttributionInput {
        bool hasPlanFinished = false;
        bool gatePass = false;
        bool claimsAllowed = false;
        bool approx = false;
        bool notReproducible = false;
        bool hasBestSurviving = false;
        int bestSurvivingDelay = -1;
        int plannedDelay = -1;
        char const* objectiveId = "";
        bool learningNudged = false;
        bool learningFloored = false;
        bool recheckSlide = false;
        bool husDeadline = false;
        bool verifyRefused = false;
        bool limitExcluded = false;
        Ledger const* ledger = nullptr;
    };

    struct AttributionNote {
        Attribution code = Attribution::GatePass;
        std::string detail;
    };

    static char const* statusId(Status s);
    static bool parseStatus(std::string const& s, Status& out);
    static char const* rejectCodeId(RejectCode c);
    static bool parseRejectCode(std::string const& s, RejectCode& out);
    static char const* attributionId(Attribution a);
    static bool parseAttribution(std::string const& s, Attribution& out);

    static std::string clampDetail(std::string s);

    // One note per delay in 0..limit (empty if limit < 0).
    static Ledger build(BuildInput const& in);

    // Attribution codes for a press cycle (may be empty).
    static std::vector<AttributionNote> buildAttribution(AttributionInput const& in);

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    DevRejectLedger() = delete;

    static RejectCode classifyRejected(
        CandSnap const& snap,
        CandSnap const* chosen,
        BuildInput const& in,
        int delay
    );
    static RejectCode skipCode(EarlyExit early);
};

#endif // DEV_REJECT_LEDGER_HPP
```
