`src/dev/DevReport.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "DevReport.hpp"
#include "DevConfig.hpp"
#include "DevSession.hpp"
#include "DevTraceStore.hpp"
#include "../debug/LagProbe.hpp"
#include "../core/ShadowSimulator.hpp"
#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <cstring>
#include <fmt/format.h>

using namespace geode::prelude;

namespace {
DevReport g_lastReport{};
bool g_hasLastReport = false;

char const* fidShort(DevFidelity f, bool approx) {
    switch (f) {
        case DevFidelity::Reproduced: return "reproduced";
        case DevFidelity::PlayerOnlyApproximated: return "approx";
        case DevFidelity::NotReproducible: break;
    }
    (void)approx;
    return "norepro";
}

DevObjective::Kind objectiveKindFromConfig() {
    switch (DevConfig::objective()) {
        case DevConfig::Objective::PlannerMirror:
            return DevObjective::Kind::PlannerMirror;
        case DevConfig::Objective::HorizonClear:
            return DevObjective::Kind::HorizonClear;
        case DevConfig::Objective::SurviveThenEndX:
            break;
    }
    return DevObjective::Kind::SurviveThenEndX;
}

DevDecisionEvent const* findPlanFinished(DevAttempt const& attempt) {
    DevDecisionEvent const* best = nullptr;
    for (auto const& e : attempt.events) {
        if (e.kind != DevEventKind::PlanFinished) continue;
        if (!e.hasWitness || !e.witness.valid) continue;
        best = &e;
    }
    return best;
}

int limitFromPlanEvent(DevDecisionEvent const& e) {
    if (!e.candNotes.empty()) {
        int maxD = 0;
        for (auto const& n : e.candNotes) {
            if (n.delay > maxD) maxD = n.delay;
        }
        return maxD;
    }
    return std::max(0, e.plannedDelay);
}

bool runEvalOnPlanEvent(
    PlayLayer* layer,
    DevDecisionEvent const& planEv,
    DevReport& out,
    std::string& err
) {
    if (!layer) {
        err = "no-playlayer";
        return false;
    }
    if (!ShadowSimulator::get().isAttachedTo(layer)) {
        err = "sim-not-attached";
        return false;
    }
    if (!planEv.hasWitness || !planEv.witness.valid) {
        err = "no-witness";
        return false;
    }

    int limit = limitFromPlanEvent(planEv);
    int const horizon = DevConfig::evalHorizon();
    int const tail = DevConfig::evalTail();
    int tickBudget = DevConfig::evalTickBudget();
    if (tickBudget < 1) tickBudget = 4000;

    DevClassifyOptions opts;
    opts.requireDeps = DevConfig::evalRequireDeps();
    opts.freezeWorld = DevConfig::freezeWorld();
    opts.expectedEvalPath = DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze;

    float latencyWeight = 0.25f;
    if (layer->m_player1) {
        latencyWeight = StageConfig::paramsFor(layer->m_player1).latencyWeight;
    }

    int robustK = StageConfig::robustK();
    if (robustK <= 0) robustK = 1;

    LagProbe::Scope const lag("eb.dev.eval");
    auto grid = DevEvalEngine::evalGrid(
        layer,
        planEv.witness,
        planEv.down,
        limit,
        planEv.plannedDelay,
        robustK,
        horizon,
        tail,
        DevConfig::evalGrid(),
        objectiveKindFromConfig(),
        opts,
        latencyWeight,
        &tickBudget
    );

    std::string rec;
    if (DevSession::get().isRecording()) {
        rec = DevSession::get().statusLine();
    }
    out = DevReport::fromGrid(grid, std::move(rec));
    return out.valid;
}
} // namespace

DevReport DevReport::fromGrid(
    DevEvalEngine::GridReport const& grid,
    std::string recLine
) {
    DevReport r;
    r.recLine = std::move(recLine);
    r.fidelity = grid.fidelity.fidelity;
    r.claimsAllowed = grid.fidelity.claimsAllowed;
    r.approx = grid.fidelity.approx;
    r.objectiveId = grid.objective.objectiveId
        ? grid.objective.objectiveId
        : "survive_then_endx_v1";
    r.horizonTicks = grid.objective.horizonTicks;
    r.tailTicks = grid.objective.tailTicks;

    r.hasBestSurviving = grid.objective.hasBestSurviving;
    r.bestSurvivingDelay = grid.objective.bestSurvivingDelay;
    r.hasBestEvaluated = grid.objective.hasBestEvaluated;
    r.bestEvaluatedDelay = grid.objective.bestEvaluatedDelay;

    r.idealEligible = grid.objective.idealEligible;
    // Contract: idealDelay only when eligible — never invent the field.
    if (grid.objective.idealEligible && grid.objective.hasIdealDelay) {
        r.hasIdealDelay = true;
        r.idealDelay = grid.objective.idealDelay;
    }
    else {
        r.hasIdealDelay = false;
        r.idealDelay = -1;
        r.idealBlockedReason = grid.objective.idealBlockedReason;
    }

    r.overlayLine = formatOverlayLine(r);

    matjson::Value j = matjson::Value::object();
    if (!r.recLine.empty()) j["rec"] = r.recLine;
    j["fidelity"] = DevStateDiff::fidelityId(r.fidelity);
    j["claimsAllowed"] = r.claimsAllowed;
    j["approx"] = r.approx;
    j["objectiveId"] = r.objectiveId;
    j["horizonTicks"] = r.horizonTicks;
    j["tailTicks"] = r.tailTicks;
    if (r.claimsAllowed && r.hasBestSurviving) {
        j["bestSurvivingDelay"] = r.bestSurvivingDelay;
    }
    if (r.claimsAllowed && r.hasBestEvaluated) {
        j["bestEvaluatedDelay"] = r.bestEvaluatedDelay;
    }
    j["idealEligible"] = r.idealEligible;
    if (r.idealEligible && r.hasIdealDelay) {
        j["idealDelay"] = r.idealDelay;
    }
    else if (!r.idealBlockedReason.empty()) {
        j["idealBlockedReason"] = r.idealBlockedReason;
    }
    if (!grid.fidelity.evalSuppressedReason.empty()) {
        j["evalSuppressedReason"] = grid.fidelity.evalSuppressedReason;
    }
    j["overlay"] = r.overlayLine;
    r.jsonLine = j.dump(0);
    r.valid = true;
    return r;
}

std::string DevReport::formatOverlayLine(DevReport const& r) {
    std::string line;
    if (!r.recLine.empty()) {
        line = r.recLine;
    }

    auto append = [&](std::string const& bit) {
        if (bit.empty()) return;
        if (!line.empty()) line += " | ";
        line += bit;
    };

    append(fmt::format("fid={}", fidShort(r.fidelity, r.approx)));

    if (!r.claimsAllowed) {
        append("bestSurv=none");
        append(fmt::format("bestEval=none obj={}", r.objectiveId));
        // Never emit ideal= when claims suppressed / not eligible.
        return line;
    }

    if (r.hasBestSurviving) {
        append(fmt::format("bestSurv={}", r.bestSurvivingDelay));
    }
    else {
        append("bestSurv=none");
    }

    if (r.hasBestEvaluated) {
        append(fmt::format(
            "bestEval={} obj={}", r.bestEvaluatedDelay, r.objectiveId
        ));
    }
    else {
        append(fmt::format("bestEval=none obj={}", r.objectiveId));
    }

    if (r.idealEligible && r.hasIdealDelay) {
        append(fmt::format("ideal={}", r.idealDelay));
    }
    return line;
}

void DevReport::setLast(DevReport report) {
    g_lastReport = std::move(report);
    g_hasLastReport = g_lastReport.valid;
}

DevReport const& DevReport::last() {
    return g_lastReport;
}

bool DevReport::hasLast() {
    return g_hasLastReport && g_lastReport.valid;
}

void DevReport::clearLast() {
    g_lastReport = {};
    g_hasLastReport = false;
}

bool DevReport::evalLastAttempt(std::string& err) {
    err.clear();
    auto* layer = PlayLayer::get();
    if (!layer) {
        err = "Enter a level to run eval.";
        return false;
    }

    auto& store = DevTraceStore::get();
    DevAttempt const* target = nullptr;

    if (store.isOpen()) {
        auto const& attempts = store.session().attempts;
        for (auto it = attempts.rbegin(); it != attempts.rend(); ++it) {
            if (findPlanFinished(*it)) {
                target = &*it;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!target) {
        err = "No attempt with a planFinished witness in the open session.";
        return false;
    }
    auto const* planEv = findPlanFinished(*target);
    if (!planEv) {
        err = "No planFinished witness on attempt.";
        return false;
    }

    DevReport rep;
    if (!runEvalOnPlanEvent(layer, *planEv, rep, err)) {
        if (err.empty()) err = "eval-failed";
        return false;
    }
    setLast(std::move(rep));
    return true;
}

bool DevReport::evalSession(std::string& err, int* outCount) {
    err.clear();
    if (outCount) *outCount = 0;
    auto* layer = PlayLayer::get();
    if (!layer) {
        err = "Enter a level to run eval.";
        return false;
    }
    auto& store = DevTraceStore::get();
    if (!store.isOpen()) {
        err = "No open Dev session.";
        return false;
    }

    int ran = 0;
    DevReport lastOk;
    for (auto const& attempt : store.session().attempts) {
        if (!attempt.sealed && &attempt != &store.session().attempts.back()) {
            continue;
        }
        auto const* planEv = findPlanFinished(attempt);
        if (!planEv) continue;
        DevReport rep;
        std::string localErr;
        if (!runEvalOnPlanEvent(layer, *planEv, rep, localErr)) continue;
        lastOk = std::move(rep);
        ++ran;
    }
    if (ran == 0) {
        err = "No evaluable planFinished events in session.";
        return false;
    }
    setLast(std::move(lastOk));
    if (outCount) *outCount = ran;
    return true;
}

bool DevReport::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += ", ";
        report += name;
    };

    // Synthetic: survive objective → no ideal= in overlay.
    {
        DevReport r;
        r.valid = true;
        r.claimsAllowed = true;
        r.fidelity = DevFidelity::Reproduced;
        r.objectiveId = "survive_then_endx_v1";
        r.hasBestSurviving = true;
        r.bestSurvivingDelay = 2;
        r.hasBestEvaluated = true;
        r.bestEvaluatedDelay = 2;
        r.idealEligible = false;
        r.hasIdealDelay = false;
        r.idealBlockedReason = "objective_not_horizon_clear";
        // Corrupt path must not emit ideal even if hasIdealDelay wrongly set.
        r.hasIdealDelay = true;
        r.idealDelay = 99;
        auto line = formatOverlayLine(r);
        expect(line.find("ideal=") == std::string::npos, "no-ideal-survive");
        expect(line.find("bestSurv=2") != std::string::npos, "bestsurv");
        expect(line.find("obj=survive_then_endx_v1") != std::string::npos, "obj");
        expect(line.find("fid=reproduced") != std::string::npos, "fid");
    }

    // Eligible horizon_clear → ideal= present.
    {
        DevReport r;
        r.claimsAllowed = true;
        r.fidelity = DevFidelity::Reproduced;
        r.objectiveId = "horizon_clear_v1";
        r.hasBestSurviving = true;
        r.bestSurvivingDelay = 1;
        r.hasBestEvaluated = true;
        r.bestEvaluatedDelay = 1;
        r.idealEligible = true;
        r.hasIdealDelay = true;
        r.idealDelay = 1;
        auto line = formatOverlayLine(r);
        expect(line.find("ideal=1") != std::string::npos, "ideal-ok");
    }

    // fromGrid must strip ideal when not eligible even if Result has numbers.
    {
        DevEvalEngine::GridReport gr;
        gr.fidelity.fidelity = DevFidelity::Reproduced;
        gr.fidelity.claimsAllowed = true;
        gr.objective.objectiveId = "survive_then_endx_v1";
        gr.objective.idealEligible = false;
        gr.objective.hasIdealDelay = true; // buggy input — must ignore
        gr.objective.idealDelay = 7;
        gr.objective.idealBlockedReason = "objective_not_horizon_clear";
        gr.objective.hasBestSurviving = true;
        gr.objective.bestSurvivingDelay = 0;
        gr.objective.hasBestEvaluated = true;
        gr.objective.bestEvaluatedDelay = 0;
        auto r = fromGrid(gr, "REC 1/10");
        expect(r.valid, "from-valid");
        expect(!r.hasIdealDelay, "from-no-ideal-flag");
        expect(r.overlayLine.find("ideal=") == std::string::npos, "from-no-ideal");
        expect(r.jsonLine.find("\"idealDelay\"") == std::string::npos, "from-json-no-ideal");
        expect(r.overlayLine.find("REC 1/10") != std::string::npos, "from-rec");
    }

    // Claims off → bestSurv=none, no ideal.
    {
        DevReport r;
        r.claimsAllowed = false;
        r.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        r.objectiveId = "horizon_clear_v1";
        r.idealEligible = true;
        r.hasIdealDelay = true;
        r.idealDelay = 3;
        auto line = formatOverlayLine(r);
        expect(line.find("bestSurv=none") != std::string::npos, "suppress-surv");
        expect(line.find("ideal=") == std::string::npos, "suppress-ideal");
        expect(line.find("fid=norepro") != std::string::npos, "suppress-fid");
    }

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "DevReport selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("DevReport selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

```hpp
#ifndef DEV_REPORT_HPP
#define DEV_REPORT_HPP

#include "DevEvalEngine.hpp"
#include "DevObjective.hpp"
#include "DevStateDiff.hpp"

#include <string>

// Overlay line + last-report store (Commit 14). Field names are literal contract A.
class DevReport {
public:
    std::string recLine; // e.g. REC 3/10 or empty
    DevFidelity fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
    bool claimsAllowed = false;
    bool approx = false;
    std::string objectiveId;
    int horizonTicks = 0;
    int tailTicks = 0;

    bool hasBestSurviving = false;
    int bestSurvivingDelay = -1;
    bool hasBestEvaluated = false;
    int bestEvaluatedDelay = -1;

    bool idealEligible = false;
    bool hasIdealDelay = false;
    int idealDelay = -1;
    std::string idealBlockedReason;

    std::string overlayLine;
    std::string jsonLine;
    bool valid = false;

    // Build from an eval grid result. Never writes ideal= unless idealEligible.

        DevEvalEngine::GridReport const& grid,
        std::string recLine
    );

    static DevReport const& last();
    static bool hasLast();
    static void clearLast();

    // Live eval against TraceStore attempt(s). Needs attached PlayLayer + ghosts.
    static bool evalLastAttempt(std::string& err);
    static bool evalSession(std::string& err, int* outCount = nullptr);

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);
};
```

```cpp
#include "DevSession.hpp"
#include "DevConfig.hpp"
#include "DevCycleRecorder.hpp"
#include "DevTraceStore.hpp"

#include "../core/AssistController.hpp"
#include "../core/LevelProfile.hpp"
#include "../debug/AssistLog.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <cstring>
#include <fmt/format.h>

using namespace geode::prelude;

DevSession& DevSession::get() {
    static DevSession inst;
    return inst;
}

void DevSession::refreshLevelMeta() {
    auto& store = DevTraceStore::get();
    if (!store.isOpen()) return;

    auto* layer = PlayLayer::get();
    std::string key;
    std::string name;
    bool startPos = false;
    bool practice = false;
    if (layer && layer->m_level) {
        key = LevelProfile::makeKey(layer->m_level);
        name = std::string(layer->m_level->m_levelName);
        startPos = layer->m_isTestMode;
        practice = layer->m_isPracticeMode;
    }
    store.setLevelMeta(std::move(key), std::move(name), startPos, practice, "");
}

bool DevSession::start() {
    if (!DevConfig::recordEnable()) {
        AssistLog::info("Dev Lab: record enable off — cannot start session");
        return false;
    }
    if (this->m_state == State::Recording && DevTraceStore::get().isOpen()) {
        AssistLog::info("Dev Lab: session already recording");
        return true;
    }

    auto& store = DevTraceStore::get();
    int const window = DevConfig::recordCount();
    if (!store.beginSession("", window)) {
        this->m_state = State::Idle;
        AssistLog::info("Dev Lab: beginSession failed");
        return false;
    }

    this->refreshLevelMeta();

    int const tick = AssistController::get().attemptTick();
    if (!store.beginAttempt(tick)) {
        store.closeSession();
        this->m_state = State::Idle;
        AssistLog::info("Dev Lab: beginAttempt failed");
        return false;
    }

    DevCycleRecorder::get().clearActive();
    this->m_state = State::Recording;
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format(
        "Dev Lab: recording session {} (rolling last {})",
        store.session().sessionId,
        window
    ));
    return true;
}

void DevSession::stop() {
    auto& store = DevTraceStore::get();
    if (this->m_state != State::Recording && !store.isOpen()) {
        this->m_state = State::Idle;
        return;
    }

    if (store.hasOpenAttempt()) {
        (void)DevCycleRecorder::get().sealAttemptWithOutcomes("manual", false);
        if (store.hasOpenAttempt()) {
            (void)store.sealAttempt("manual", false);
        }
    }
    else {
        (void)store.flush();
    }

    auto const path = store.sessionPath();
    store.closeSession();
    DevCycleRecorder::get().clearActive();
    this->m_state = State::Idle;
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format("Dev Lab: session stopped → {}", path.string()));
}

std::string DevSession::statusLine() const {
    if (this->m_state != State::Recording || !DevTraceStore::get().isOpen()) {
        return "Dev idle";
    }
    auto const& s = DevTraceStore::get().session();
    int const n = s.recordingsTarget > 0 ? s.recordingsTarget : DevConfig::recordCount();
    int const k = s.recordingsDone;
    if (k >= n) {
        return fmt::format("REC {}/{} rolling", n, n);
    }
    return fmt::format("REC {}/{}", k, n);
}

std::filesystem::path DevSession::sessionPath() const {
    if (!DevTraceStore::get().isOpen()) return {};
    return DevTraceStore::get().sessionPath();
}

int DevSession::clearTraces() {
    if (this->m_state == State::Recording || DevTraceStore::get().isOpen()) {
        this->stop();
    }

    auto const dir = DevTraceStore::get().tracesDir();
    if (dir.empty() || !std::filesystem::exists(dir)) return 0;

    int removed = 0;
    std::error_code ec;
    for (auto const& entry : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(dir, ec)) {
        if (ec) break;
        if (!entry.is_regular_file(ec)) continue;
        auto const ext = entry.path().extension().string();
        auto const name = entry.path().filename().string();
        // Only session JSON (and leftover .tmp) under devtraces/.
        if (name.rfind("session-", 0) != 0) continue;
        bool const isJson = (ext == ".json")
            || (name.find(".json.tmp") != std::string::npos);
        if (!isJson) continue;
        std::filesystem::remove(entry.path(), ec);
        if (!ec) ++removed;
        ec.clear();
    }
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format("Dev Lab: cleared {} trace file(s) under {}", removed, dir.string()));
    return removed;
}

bool DevSession::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += ", ";
        report += name;
    };

    auto& sess = DevSession::get();
    auto& store = DevTraceStore::get();

    // Ensure idle start.
    if (store.isOpen()) sess.stop();
    expect(sess.state() == State::Idle, "idle");

    // Rolling trim via TraceStore (independent of recordEnable).
    {
        expect(store.beginSession("session-roll-selfcheck", 2), "roll-begin");
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
            expect(store.beginAttempt(i * 10), "roll-attempt");
            DevDecisionEvent ev;
            ev.pressId = store.allocPressId();
            ev.kind = DevEventKind::PressObserved;
            ev.down = true;
            expect(store.appendEvent(ev) != nullptr, "roll-press");
            expect(store.sealAttempt("death", true), "roll-seal");
        }
        expect(store.session().recordingsDone == 2, "roll-done-2");
        int counted = 0;
        for (auto const& a : store.session().attempts) {
            if (a.sealed && a.counted) ++counted;
        }
        expect(counted == 2, "roll-kept-2");
        // Oldest counted attempts dropped; attemptIds of survivors are 3 and 4.
        expect(
            store.session().attempts.size() >= 2
                && store.session().attempts.front().attemptId >= 3,
            "roll-oldest-gone"
        );
        store.closeSession();
        auto path = store.tracesDir() / "session-session-roll-selfcheck.json";
        std::error_code ec;
        std::filesystem::remove(path, ec);
    }

    expect(
        std::strcmp(sess.statusLine().c_str(), "Dev idle") == 0
            || sess.state() == State::Idle,
        "status-idle"
    );

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "DevSession selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("DevSession selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

```hpp
#ifndef DEV_SESSION_HPP

// Dev Lab session controller (Commit 13).
class DevSession {

    static DevSession& get();

    bool isRecording() const { return this->m_state == State::Recording; }
    bool start();
    void stop();
    std::string statusLine() const;
    std::filesystem::path sessionPath() const;
    int clearTraces();
    void refreshLevelMeta();
    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);
private:
    DevSession() = default;
    State m_state = State::Idle;
};
```

`src/dev/DevStateDiff.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "DevStateDiff.hpp"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <fmt/format.h>

char const* DevStateDiff::fidelityId(DevFidelity f) {
    switch (f) {
        case DevFidelity::Reproduced: return "reproduced";
        case DevFidelity::PlayerOnlyApproximated: return "playerOnlyApproximated";
        case DevFidelity::NotReproducible: return "notReproducible";
    }
    return "notReproducible";
}

bool DevStateDiff::parseFidelity(std::string const& s, DevFidelity& out) {
    if (s == "reproduced") { out = DevFidelity::Reproduced; return true; }
    if (s == "playerOnlyApproximated") {
        out = DevFidelity::PlayerOnlyApproximated;
        return true;
    }
    if (s == "notReproducible") {
        out = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

char const* DevStateDiff::diffKindId(DevDiffKind k) {
    switch (k) {
        case DevDiffKind::Mismatch: return "mismatch";
        case DevDiffKind::Unrestored: return "unrestored";
        case DevDiffKind::DigestOnly: return "digestOnly";
    }
    return "mismatch";
}

void DevStateDiff::pushDiff(
    std::vector<DevDiffEntry>& diffs,
    DevWitnessCategory category,
    char const* field,
    std::string liveValue,
    std::string restoredValue,
    DevDiffKind kind
) {
    DevDiffEntry e;
    e.category = category;
    e.fieldOrObjectId = field ? field : "";
    e.liveValue = std::move(liveValue);
    e.restoredValue = std::move(restoredValue);
    e.kind = kind;
    diffs.push_back(std::move(e));
}

bool DevStateDiff::isHardFailDep(
    DevWitnessCategory c, DevClassifyOptions const& opts
) {
    if (!opts.requireDeps) return false;
    switch (c) {
        case DevWitnessCategory::Dual:
        case DevWitnessCategory::Triggers:
        case DevWitnessCategory::Clock:
            return true;
        case DevWitnessCategory::Movers:
            // Without freeze-world, movers digest/absent is soft → approx.
            return opts.freezeWorld;
        case DevWitnessCategory::Player:
        case DevWitnessCategory::Orbs:
        case DevWitnessCategory::CollisionFlags:
            return false;
    }
    return false;
}

bool DevStateDiff::playerBlobsEqual(
    DevPlayerBlob const& live,
    DevPlayerBlob const& restored,
    DevWitnessCategory category,
    std::vector<DevDiffEntry>* outDiffs
) {
    if (!live.present || !restored.present) {
        if (outDiffs) {
            pushDiff(
                *outDiffs,
                category,
                "present",
                live.present ? "1" : "0",
                restored.present ? "1" : "0",
                DevDiffKind::Mismatch
            );
        }
        return false;
    }

    bool ok = true;
    auto checkF = [&](char const* name, float a, float b) {
        if (std::fabs(a - b) <= 1e-4f) return;
        ok = false;
        if (outDiffs) {
            pushDiff(
                *outDiffs,
                category,
                name,
                fmt::format("{}", a),
                fmt::format("{}", b),
                DevDiffKind::Mismatch
            );
        }
    };
    auto checkB = [&](char const* name, bool a, bool b) {
        if (a == b) return;
        ok = false;
        if (outDiffs) {
            pushDiff(
                *outDiffs,
                category,
                name,
                a ? "1" : "0",
                b ? "1" : "0",
                DevDiffKind::Mismatch
            );
        }
    };

    checkF("x", live.x, restored.x);
    checkF("y", live.y, restored.y);
    checkF("rotation", live.rotation, restored.rotation);
    checkF("scaleX", live.scaleX, restored.scaleX);
    checkF("scaleY", live.scaleY, restored.scaleY);
    checkF("yVelocity", live.yVelocity, restored.yVelocity);
    checkF("fallSpeed", live.fallSpeed, restored.fallSpeed);
    checkF("gravity", live.gravity, restored.gravity);
    checkF("gravityMod", live.gravityMod, restored.gravityMod);
    checkF("speedMultiplier", live.speedMultiplier, restored.speedMultiplier);
    checkF("playerSpeed", live.playerSpeed, restored.playerSpeed);
    checkF("vehicleSize", live.vehicleSize, restored.vehicleSize);
    checkF(
        "platformerXVelocity",
        live.platformerXVelocity,
        restored.platformerXVelocity
    );
    checkB("isUpsideDown", live.isUpsideDown, restored.isUpsideDown);
    checkB("isSideways", live.isSideways, restored.isSideways);
    checkB("isGoingLeft", live.isGoingLeft, restored.isGoingLeft);
    checkB("isShip", live.isShip, restored.isShip);
    checkB("isBall", live.isBall, restored.isBall);
    checkB("isBird", live.isBird, restored.isBird);
    checkB("isSwing", live.isSwing, restored.isSwing);
    checkB("isDart", live.isDart, restored.isDart);
    checkB("isRobot", live.isRobot, restored.isRobot);
    checkB("isSpider", live.isSpider, restored.isSpider);
    checkB("isSecondPlayer", live.isSecondPlayer, restored.isSecondPlayer);
    checkB("isPlatformer", live.isPlatformer, restored.isPlatformer);
    checkB("isDashing", live.isDashing, restored.isDashing);
    checkB("isOnGround", live.isOnGround, restored.isOnGround);
    checkB("isOnGround2", live.isOnGround2, restored.isOnGround2);
    checkB("isOnSlope", live.isOnSlope, restored.isOnSlope);
    checkB("wasOnSlope", live.wasOnSlope, restored.wasOnSlope);
    checkB("jumpBuffered", live.jumpBuffered, restored.jumpBuffered);
    checkB("wasJumpBuffered", live.wasJumpBuffered, restored.wasJumpBuffered);
    checkB("stateRingJump", live.stateRingJump, restored.stateRingJump);
    checkB("hasEverJumped", live.hasEverJumped, restored.hasEverJumped);
    checkB("hasEverHitRing", live.hasEverHitRing, restored.hasEverHitRing);
    checkB("isLocked", live.isLocked, restored.isLocked);
    checkB("controlsDisabled", live.controlsDisabled, restored.controlsDisabled);
    checkB("maybeIsFalling", live.maybeIsFalling, restored.maybeIsFalling);
    checkB("maybeIsBoosted", live.maybeIsBoosted, restored.maybeIsBoosted);
    return ok;
}

DevClassifyResult DevStateDiff::classifyWitnessGate(
    DevLiveWitness const& witness,
    DevClassifyOptions const& opts
) {
    (void)opts;
    DevClassifyResult out;
    out.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
    out.claimsAllowed = false;
    out.approx = false;

    if (!witness.valid) {
        out.evalSuppressedReason = "witnessInvalid";
        return out;
    }
    if (!witness.player.present
        || DevLiveWitness::categoryStatus(witness, DevWitnessCategory::Player)
            == DevWitnessStatus::Absent) {
        out.evalSuppressedReason = "missingPlayer";
        pushDiff(
            out.diffs,
            DevWitnessCategory::Player,
            "blob",
            "absent",
            "",
            DevDiffKind::Unrestored
        );
        return out;
    }
    uint64_t const expectSchema = DevLiveWitness::computePlayerBlobSchema();
    if (witness.playerBlobSchema != 0
        && witness.playerBlobSchema != expectSchema) {
        out.evalSuppressedReason = "playerSchema";
        pushDiff(
            out.diffs,
            DevWitnessCategory::Player,
            "playerBlobSchema",
            fmt::format("{:016x}", witness.playerBlobSchema),
            fmt::format("{:016x}", expectSchema),
            DevDiffKind::Mismatch
        );
        return out;
    }
    if (!witness.clock.valid
        || !DevClockContract::get().clockOk(witness.clock)
        || DevLiveWitness::categoryStatus(witness, DevWitnessCategory::Clock)
            == DevWitnessStatus::Absent) {
        out.evalSuppressedReason = "clock";
        pushDiff(
            out.diffs,
            DevWitnessCategory::Clock,
            "stamp",
            "bad",
            "",
            DevDiffKind::Unrestored
        );
        return out;
    }

    // Witness alone is not enough for claims — need a restore attempt.
    // Gate only suppresses hard failures; otherwise leave room for eval.
    out.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
    out.claimsAllowed = false;
    out.evalSuppressedReason.clear();
    return out;
}

DevClassifyResult DevStateDiff::classify(
    DevLiveWitness const& witness,
    DevEvalRestore const& restore,
    DevClassifyOptions const& opts
) {
    DevClassifyResult out;

    // Witness-level hard fails first.
    DevClassifyResult gate = classifyWitnessGate(witness, opts);
    if (!gate.evalSuppressedReason.empty()) {
        return gate;
    }

    if (!restore.valid) {
        out.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        out.claimsAllowed = false;
        out.evalSuppressedReason = "restoreMissing";
        return out;
    }

    if (restore.playerBlobSchema != 0
        && witness.playerBlobSchema != 0
        && restore.playerBlobSchema != witness.playerBlobSchema) {
        out.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        out.claimsAllowed = false;
        out.evalSuppressedReason = "playerSchema";
        pushDiff(
            out.diffs,
            DevWitnessCategory::Player,
            "playerBlobSchema",
            fmt::format("{:016x}", witness.playerBlobSchema),
            fmt::format("{:016x}", restore.playerBlobSchema),
            DevDiffKind::Mismatch
        );
        return out;
    }

    // Clock contract on restore stamp.
    if (!restore.clock.valid
        || !DevClockContract::get().clockOk(restore.clock)
        || DevEvalRestore::categoryStatus(restore, DevWitnessCategory::Clock)
            != DevWitnessStatus::Restored) {
        out.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        out.claimsAllowed = false;
        out.evalSuppressedReason = "clock";
        pushDiff(
            out.diffs,
            DevWitnessCategory::Clock,
            "stamp",
            "witness",
            "bad-or-unrestored",
            DevDiffKind::Unrestored
        );
        return out;
    }
    // Stamp identity: effectTick / attemptTick / simDt / midStep / continuous.
    if (restore.clock.effectTick != witness.clock.effectTick
        || restore.clock.attemptTick != witness.clock.attemptTick
        || restore.clock.midStep != witness.clock.midStep
        || restore.clock.continuous != witness.clock.continuous
        || std::fabs(restore.clock.simDt - witness.clock.simDt) > 1e-9f) {
        out.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        out.claimsAllowed = false;
        out.evalSuppressedReason = "clockMismatch";
        pushDiff(
            out.diffs,
            DevWitnessCategory::Clock,
            "stampFields",
            "witness",
            "restore",
            DevDiffKind::Mismatch
        );
        return out;
    }

    if (restore.evalSimPathId != opts.expectedEvalPath) {
        out.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        out.claimsAllowed = false;
        out.evalSuppressedReason = "evalSimPath";
        pushDiff(
            out.diffs,
            DevWitnessCategory::Clock,
            "evalSimPathId",
            DevClockContract::simPathId(opts.expectedEvalPath),
            DevClockContract::simPathId(restore.evalSimPathId),
            DevDiffKind::Mismatch
        );
        return out;
    }

    // Player must be restored and match.
    if (DevEvalRestore::categoryStatus(restore, DevWitnessCategory::Player)
        != DevWitnessStatus::Restored) {
        out.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        out.claimsAllowed = false;
        out.evalSuppressedReason = "missingPlayer";
        pushDiff(
            out.diffs,
            DevWitnessCategory::Player,
            "blob",
            "witness",
            "unrestored",
            DevDiffKind::Unrestored
        );
        return out;
    }
    if (!playerBlobsEqual(
            witness.player, restore.player, DevWitnessCategory::Player, &out.diffs
        )) {
        out.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        out.claimsAllowed = false;
        out.evalSuppressedReason = "playerMismatch";
        return out;
    }

    bool allDepsRestored = true;
    bool softFail = false;
    bool hardFail = false;

    for (int depInt : witness.worldDeps) {
        auto const dep = static_cast<DevWitnessCategory>(depInt);
        if (dep == DevWitnessCategory::Player || dep == DevWitnessCategory::Clock) {
            continue; // already verified
        }

        DevWitnessStatus const st = DevEvalRestore::categoryStatus(restore, dep);

        if (dep == DevWitnessCategory::Movers) {
            // Digest/hash alone never counts as Restored.
            // Poses (freeze-world) may be Restored and must match.
            if (st == DevWitnessStatus::Restored) {
                if (witness.moverPoses != restore.moverPoses) {
                    allDepsRestored = false;
                    pushDiff(
                        out.diffs,
                        dep,
                        "poses",
                        fmt::format("n={}", witness.moverPoses.size()),
                        fmt::format("n={}", restore.moverPoses.size()),
                        DevDiffKind::Mismatch
                    );
                    if (isHardFailDep(dep, opts)) hardFail = true;
                    else softFail = true;
                }
            }
            else if (st == DevWitnessStatus::DigestOnly
                || st == DevWitnessStatus::Absent
                || st == DevWitnessStatus::Partial) {
                allDepsRestored = false;
                pushDiff(
                    out.diffs,
                    dep,
                    "movers",
                    DevLiveWitness::statusId(
                        DevLiveWitness::categoryStatus(witness, dep)
                    ),
                    DevLiveWitness::statusId(st),
                    st == DevWitnessStatus::DigestOnly
                        ? DevDiffKind::DigestOnly
                        : DevDiffKind::Unrestored
                );
                if (isHardFailDep(dep, opts)) hardFail = true;
                else softFail = true;
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (dep == DevWitnessCategory::Dual) {
            if (st != DevWitnessStatus::Restored) {
                allDepsRestored = false;
                pushDiff(
                    out.diffs,
                    dep,
                    "blob",
                    "witness",
                    DevLiveWitness::statusId(st),
                    DevDiffKind::Unrestored
                );
                if (isHardFailDep(dep, opts)) hardFail = true;
                else softFail = true;
            }
            else if (!playerBlobsEqual(
                    witness.dual, restore.dual, dep, &out.diffs
                )) {
                allDepsRestored = false;
                hardFail = true; // dual mismatch is fatal for reproduced
                out.evalSuppressedReason = "dualMismatch";
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (dep == DevWitnessCategory::Orbs) {
            if (st != DevWitnessStatus::Restored) {
                allDepsRestored = false;
                pushDiff(
                    out.diffs,
                    dep,
                    "orbIds",
                    fmt::format("{}", witness.orbIds.size()),
                    DevLiveWitness::statusId(st),
                    DevDiffKind::Unrestored
                );
                softFail = true; // orbs are soft under requireDeps
            }
            else if (witness.orbIds != restore.orbIds) {
                allDepsRestored = false;
                softFail = true;
                pushDiff(
                    out.diffs,
                    dep,
                    "orbIds",
                    fmt::format("n={}", witness.orbIds.size()),
                    fmt::format("n={}", restore.orbIds.size()),
                    DevDiffKind::Mismatch
                );
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (dep == DevWitnessCategory::Triggers) {
            if (st != DevWitnessStatus::Restored) {
                allDepsRestored = false;
                pushDiff(
                    out.diffs,
                    dep,
                    "spool",
                    witness.triggerCanSpool ? "canSpool" : "noSpool",
                    DevLiveWitness::statusId(st),
                    DevDiffKind::Unrestored
                );
                if (isHardFailDep(dep, opts)) hardFail = true;
                else softFail = true;
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (dep == DevWitnessCategory::CollisionFlags) {
            // Witness is Partial (pointer refs absent); restore Partial matches.
            if (st == DevWitnessStatus::Absent) {
                allDepsRestored = false;
                softFail = true;
                pushDiff(
                    out.diffs,
                    dep,
                    "flags",
                    "partial",
                    "absent",
                    DevDiffKind::Unrestored
                );
            }
            else if (st != DevWitnessStatus::Restored
                && st != DevWitnessStatus::Partial) {
                allDepsRestored = false;
                softFail = true;
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (st != DevWitnessStatus::Restored) {
            allDepsRestored = false;
            pushDiff(
                out.diffs,
                dep,
                "status",
                "restored",
                DevLiveWitness::statusId(st),
                DevDiffKind::Unrestored
            );
            if (isHardFailDep(dep, opts)) hardFail = true;
            else softFail = true;
        }
    }

    if (hardFail) {
        out.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
        out.claimsAllowed = false;
        if (out.evalSuppressedReason.empty()) {
            out.evalSuppressedReason = "requireDeps";
        }
        return out;
    }

    if (allDepsRestored && out.diffs.empty()) {
        out.fidelity = DevFidelity::Reproduced;
        out.claimsAllowed = true;
        out.approx = false;
        out.evalSuppressedReason.clear();
        return out;
    }

    // Soft gaps with player+clock ok → approximated.
    if (softFail || !allDepsRestored) {
        out.fidelity = DevFidelity::PlayerOnlyApproximated;
        out.claimsAllowed = true;
        out.approx = true;
        out.evalSuppressedReason.clear();
        return out;
    }

    out.fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
    out.claimsAllowed = false;
    if (out.evalSuppressedReason.empty()) {
        out.evalSuppressedReason = "notReproducible";
    }
    return out;
}

bool DevStateDiff::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (ok) return;
        ++fails;
        if (!report.empty()) report += ", ";
        report += name;
    };

    expect(
        std::strcmp(fidelityId(DevFidelity::Reproduced), "reproduced") == 0,
        "fid-id"
    );

    DevClassifyOptions opts;
    opts.requireDeps = true;
    opts.freezeWorld = false;
    opts.expectedEvalPath = DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze;

    // --- Gate: missing player ---
    {
        DevLiveWitness w;
        w.valid = true;
        w.clock = DevClockContract::get().makeStamp(
            5, false, false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f,
            DevSimPathId::Plan
        );
        auto g = classifyWitnessGate(w, opts);
        expect(g.fidelity == DevFidelity::NotReproducible, "gate-fid");
        expect(!g.claimsAllowed, "gate-claims");
        expect(g.evalSuppressedReason == "missingPlayer", "gate-reason");
    }

    // Build a solid witness.
    DevLiveWitness wit;
    wit.valid = true;
    wit.playerBlobSchema = DevLiveWitness::computePlayerBlobSchema();
    wit.player.present = true;
    wit.player.x = 100.f;
    wit.player.y = 50.f;
    wit.player.yVelocity = -1.f;
    wit.clock = DevClockContract::get().makeStamp(
        20, true, false, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f / 480.f, 1.f / 240.f, 1.f,
        DevSimPathId::Plan
    );
    wit.worldDeps = {
        static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Player),
        static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Clock),
        static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::CollisionFlags),
    };
    wit.categories.push_back(
        {DevWitnessCategory::Player, DevWitnessStatus::Restored, 0, false}
    );
    wit.categories.push_back(
        {DevWitnessCategory::Clock, DevWitnessStatus::Restored, 0, false}
    );
    wit.categories.push_back(
        {DevWitnessCategory::CollisionFlags, DevWitnessStatus::Partial, 0, false}
    );

    auto gateOk = classifyWitnessGate(wit, opts);
    expect(gateOk.evalSuppressedReason.empty(), "gate-ok");

    // --- Reproduced: player+clock+flags restored ---
    {
        DevEvalRestore r = DevEvalRestore::beginFromWitness(
            wit, DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze
        );
        DevEvalRestore::notePlayerWritten(r, wit.player);
        auto res = classify(wit, r, opts);
        expect(res.fidelity == DevFidelity::Reproduced, "repr-fid");
        expect(res.claimsAllowed && !res.approx, "repr-claims");
        expect(res.evalSuppressedReason.empty(), "repr-reason");
    }

    // --- Player mismatch ---
    {
        DevEvalRestore r = DevEvalRestore::beginFromWitness(
            wit, DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze
        );
        DevPlayerBlob bad = wit.player;
        bad.x = 999.f;
        DevEvalRestore::notePlayerWritten(r, bad);
        auto res = classify(wit, r, opts);
        expect(res.fidelity == DevFidelity::NotReproducible, "mis-fid");
        expect(!res.claimsAllowed, "mis-claims");
        expect(res.evalSuppressedReason == "playerMismatch", "mis-reason");
    }

    // --- Movers digest soft → playerOnlyApproximated ---
    {
        DevLiveWitness w2 = wit;
        w2.hasHazardDigest = true;
        w2.hazardDigest = 0xabc;
        w2.freezeWorld = false;
        w2.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Movers));
        w2.categories.push_back(
            {DevWitnessCategory::Movers, DevWitnessStatus::DigestOnly, 0xabc, false}
        );

        DevEvalRestore r = DevEvalRestore::beginFromWitness(
            w2, DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze
        );
        DevEvalRestore::notePlayerWritten(r, w2.player);
        DevEvalRestore::noteMoversDigestOnly(r, 0xabc);
        auto res = classify(w2, r, opts);
        expect(
            res.fidelity == DevFidelity::PlayerOnlyApproximated, "approx-fid"
        );
        expect(res.claimsAllowed && res.approx, "approx-claims");
    }

    // --- Dual dep missing + requireDeps → notReproducible ---
    {
        DevLiveWitness w2 = wit;
        w2.dual.present = true;
        w2.dual.x = 1.f;
        w2.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Dual));
        DevEvalRestore r = DevEvalRestore::beginFromWitness(
            w2, DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze
        );
        DevEvalRestore::notePlayerWritten(r, w2.player);
        // dual not written
        auto res = classify(w2, r, opts);
        expect(res.fidelity == DevFidelity::NotReproducible, "dual-hard-fid");
        expect(!res.claimsAllowed, "dual-hard-claims");
        expect(res.evalSuppressedReason == "requireDeps", "dual-hard-reason");
    }

    // --- Dual dep missing + requireDeps off → approx ---
    {
        DevClassifyOptions soft = opts;
        soft.requireDeps = false;
        DevLiveWitness w2 = wit;
        w2.dual.present = true;
        w2.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Dual));
        DevEvalRestore r = DevEvalRestore::beginFromWitness(
            w2, DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze
        );
        DevEvalRestore::notePlayerWritten(r, w2.player);
        auto res = classify(w2, r, soft);
        expect(
            res.fidelity == DevFidelity::PlayerOnlyApproximated, "dual-soft-fid"
        );
        expect(res.claimsAllowed && res.approx, "dual-soft-claims");
    }

    // --- Wrong eval path ---
    {
        DevEvalRestore r = DevEvalRestore::beginFromWitness(
            wit, DevSimPathId::Plan
        );
        DevEvalRestore::notePlayerWritten(r, wit.player);
        auto res = classify(wit, r, opts);
        expect(res.fidelity == DevFidelity::NotReproducible, "path-fid");
        expect(res.evalSuppressedReason == "evalSimPath", "path-reason");
    }

    // --- Freeze-world poses + dual/orbs/triggers → reproduced ---
    {
        DevClassifyOptions freeze = opts;
        freeze.freezeWorld = true;

        DevLiveWitness w2 = wit;
        w2.freezeWorld = true;
        w2.hasHazardDigest = true;
        w2.hazardDigest = 0x111;
        DevObjectPose pose{};
        pose.uniqueId = 5;
        pose.x = 10.f;
        pose.y = 20.f;
        w2.moverPoses = { pose };
        w2.dual.present = true;
        w2.dual.x = 2.f;
        w2.orbIds = { 3 };
        w2.triggerCanSpool = true;
        w2.triggerStoreKey = "k";
        w2.triggerStoreVersion = 1;
        w2.triggerApplyTick = 20;
        w2.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Movers));
        w2.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Dual));
        w2.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Orbs));
        w2.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Triggers));
        w2.categories.push_back(
            {DevWitnessCategory::Movers, DevWitnessStatus::Restored, 0x111, false}
        );
        w2.categories.push_back(
            {DevWitnessCategory::Dual, DevWitnessStatus::Restored, 0, false}
        );
        w2.categories.push_back(
            {DevWitnessCategory::Orbs, DevWitnessStatus::Restored, 0, false}
        );
        w2.categories.push_back(
            {DevWitnessCategory::Triggers, DevWitnessStatus::Partial, 0, false}
        );

        DevEvalRestore r = DevEvalRestore::beginFromWitness(
            w2, DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze
        );
        DevEvalRestore::notePlayerWritten(r, w2.player);
        DevEvalRestore::noteDualWritten(r, w2.dual);
        DevEvalRestore::noteOrbsWritten(r, w2.orbIds);
        DevEvalRestore::noteTriggersSpooled(
            r, w2.triggerStoreKey, w2.triggerStoreVersion, w2.triggerApplyTick
        );
        DevEvalRestore::noteMoversPosesWritten(r, w2.moverPoses, w2.hazardDigest);
        auto res = classify(w2, r, freeze);
        expect(res.fidelity == DevFidelity::Reproduced, "freeze-repr-fid");
        expect(res.claimsAllowed && !res.approx, "freeze-repr-claims");
        expect(res.evalSuppressedReason.empty(), "freeze-repr-reason");
    }

    // --- Freeze-world without poses written → hard fail ---
    {
        DevClassifyOptions freeze = opts;
        freeze.freezeWorld = true;
        DevLiveWitness w2 = wit;
        w2.freezeWorld = true;
        w2.hasHazardDigest = true;
        w2.hazardDigest = 0x222;
        w2.worldDeps.insert(static_cast<int>(DevWitnessCategory::Movers));
        w2.categories.push_back(
            {DevWitnessCategory::Movers, DevWitnessStatus::Restored, 0x222, false}
        );
        DevEvalRestore r = DevEvalRestore::beginFromWitness(
            w2, DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze
        );
        DevEvalRestore::notePlayerWritten(r, w2.player);
        DevEvalRestore::noteMoversDigestOnly(r, 0x222);
        auto res = classify(w2, r, freeze);
        expect(res.fidelity == DevFidelity::NotReproducible, "freeze-hard-fid");
        expect(!res.claimsAllowed, "freeze-hard-claims");
    }

    if (fails == 0) {
        report = "DevStateDiff selfCheck OK";
        return true;
    }
    report = std::string("DevStateDiff selfCheck fails: ") + report;
    return false;
}
```

`src/dev/DevStateDiff.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef DEV_STATE_DIFF_HPP
#define DEV_STATE_DIFF_HPP

#include "DevEvalRestore.hpp"
#include "DevLiveWitness.hpp"

#include <string>
#include <vector>

enum class DevFidelity {
    Reproduced = 0,
    PlayerOnlyApproximated,
    NotReproducible
};

enum class DevDiffKind {
    Mismatch = 0,
    Unrestored,
    DigestOnly
};

struct DevDiffEntry {
    DevWitnessCategory category = DevWitnessCategory::Player;
    std::string fieldOrObjectId;
    std::string liveValue;
    std::string restoredValue;
    DevDiffKind kind = DevDiffKind::Mismatch;
};

struct DevClassifyOptions {
    bool requireDeps = true; // DevConfig::evalRequireDeps
    bool freezeWorld = false;
    DevSimPathId expectedEvalPath = DevSimPathId::EvalDelayFromFreeze;
};

struct DevClassifyResult {
    DevFidelity fidelity = DevFidelity::NotReproducible;
    bool claimsAllowed = false;
    bool approx = false; // true iff PlayerOnlyApproximated
    std::string evalSuppressedReason;
    std::vector<DevDiffEntry> diffs;
};

// Vertrag B: compare witness vs restore, emit fidelity + claimsAllowed.
class DevStateDiff {
public:
    static char const* fidelityId(DevFidelity f);
    static bool parseFidelity(std::string const& s, DevFidelity& out);
    static char const* diffKindId(DevDiffKind k);

    // Field-wise player blob compare; appends mismatch diffs when out != nullptr.
    static bool playerBlobsEqual(
        DevPlayerBlob const& live,
        DevPlayerBlob const& restored,
        DevWitnessCategory category,
        std::vector<DevDiffEntry>* outDiffs
    );

    // Full classify after a restore attempt (Commit 9+ calls this post-write).
    static DevClassifyResult classify(
        DevLiveWitness const& witness,
        DevEvalRestore const& restore,
        DevClassifyOptions const& opts
    );

    // Pre-sim gate: suppress when the witness alone already forces notReproducible
    // (missing player / bad clock / schema). No restore object required.
    static DevClassifyResult classifyWitnessGate(
        DevLiveWitness const& witness,
        DevClassifyOptions const& opts
    );

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    DevStateDiff() = delete;

    static bool isHardFailDep(
        DevWitnessCategory c, DevClassifyOptions const& opts
    );
    static void pushDiff(
        std::vector<DevDiffEntry>& diffs,
        DevWitnessCategory category,
        char const* field,
        std::string liveValue,
        std::string restoredValue,
        DevDiffKind kind
    );
};

#endif // DEV_STATE_DIFF_HPP

```
