```cpp
namespace {

// Cap button width so long filenames don't eat the label column.
constexpr float kActionBtnMaxW = 88.f;
constexpr float kActionBtnScale = 0.4f;

void fitActionButtonSprite(ButtonSprite* spr) {
    if (!spr) return;
    spr->setScale(kActionBtnScale);
    float const sprW = spr->getContentSize().width * spr->getScale();
    if (sprW > kActionBtnMaxW && sprW > 0.f) {
        spr->setScale(kActionBtnMaxW / spr->getContentSize().width);
    }
}

// Mirror BoolSettingNodeV3: shrink button-menu, place control at Anchor::Right with
// half-width offset so the visual right edge sits flush (default center anchor).
// Do NOT touch the button's contentSize/anchorPoint — that desyncs the ButtonSprite.
void layoutActionButton(CCMenu* menu, CCMenuItemSpriteExtra* btn, ButtonSprite* spr) {
    if (!menu || !btn || !spr) return;
    fitActionButtonSprite(spr);
    float const btnW = spr->getContentSize().width * spr->getScale();
    // Same flush as checkboxes (menu already at row Right, ccp(-10,0)).
    menu->setContentWidth(std::max(btnW + 4.f, 24.f));
    CCPoint const offset = ccp(-btnW * 0.5f, 0.f);
    if (btn->getParent() != menu) {
        menu->addChildAtPosition(btn, Anchor::Right, offset);
    }
    else if (auto* opts = typeinfo_cast<AnchorLayoutOptions*>(btn->getLayoutOptions())) {
        opts->setAnchor(Anchor::Right);
        opts->setOffset(offset);
        btn->updateAnchoredPosition(Anchor::Right, offset);
    }
    else {
        btn->removeFromParent();
        menu->addChildAtPosition(btn, Anchor::Right, offset);
    }
    menu->updateLayout();
}

} // namespace

bool ActionButtonSettingNodeV3::init(std::shared_ptr<ActionButtonSettingV3> setting, float width) {
    if (!SettingNodeV3::init(setting, width)) return false;

    auto* menu = this->getButtonMenu();
    auto const initial = dynamicButtonLabel(setting->getKey(), setting->buttonText());
    this->m_shownLabel = initial;
    this->m_buttonSprite = ButtonSprite::create(initial.c_str(), "bigFont.fnt", "GJ_button_01.png", 0.8f);
    this->m_button = CCMenuItemSpriteExtra::create(
        this->m_buttonSprite, this, menu_selector(ActionButtonSettingNodeV3::onButton)
    );
    layoutActionButton(menu, this->m_button, this->m_buttonSprite);

    this->schedule(schedule_selector(ActionButtonSettingNodeV3::onTick), 0.2f);
    this->updateState(nullptr);
    return true;
}

void ActionButtonSettingNodeV3::refreshLabel() {
    auto setting = std::static_pointer_cast<ActionButtonSettingV3>(this->getSetting());
    if (!setting) return;
    if (!this->m_buttonSprite || !this->m_button || !this->getButtonMenu()) return;

    auto const next = dynamicButtonLabel(setting->getKey(), setting->buttonText());
    if (next == this->m_shownLabel) return;

    this->m_shownLabel = next;
    this->m_buttonSprite->setString(next.c_str());
    layoutActionButton(this->getButtonMenu(), this->m_button, this->m_buttonSprite);
}

void ActionButtonSettingNodeV3::updateState(CCNode* invoker) {
    SettingNodeV3::updateState(invoker);
    this->refreshLabel();

    auto setting = this->getSetting();
    bool const enable = setting
        && setting->shouldEnable()
        && actionShouldEnable(setting->getKey());

    if (this->m_button) this->m_button->setEnabled(enable);
    if (!this->m_buttonSprite) return;

    this->m_buttonSprite->setCascadeColorEnabled(true);
    this->m_buttonSprite->setCascadeOpacityEnabled(true);
    this->m_buttonSprite->setOpacity(enable ? 255 : 155);
    this->m_buttonSprite->setColor(enable ? ccWHITE : ccGRAY);
}

void ActionButtonSettingNodeV3::onTick(float) {
    this->refreshLabel();

    auto setting = this->getSetting();
    if (!setting || !this->m_button) return;

    bool const enable = setting->shouldEnable() && actionShouldEnable(setting->getKey());
    this->m_button->setEnabled(enable);
    if (!this->m_buttonSprite) return;

    this->m_buttonSprite->setOpacity(enable ? 255 : 155);
    this->m_buttonSprite->setColor(enable ? ccWHITE : ccGRAY);
}

void ActionButtonSettingNodeV3::onButton(CCObject*) {
    auto setting = this->getSetting();
    if (!setting) return;

    fireSettingAction(setting->getKey());
    this->refreshLabel();
    this->updateState(nullptr);
}

ActionButtonSettingNodeV3* ActionButtonSettingNodeV3::create(
    std::shared_ptr<ActionButtonSettingV3> setting, float width
) {
    auto* ret = new ActionButtonSettingNodeV3();
    if (!ret || !ret->init(setting, width)) {
        CC_SAFE_DELETE(ret);
        return nullptr;
    }
    ret->autorelease();
    return ret;
}

$execute {
    registerActionButtonSettingType();
}
```

```cpp
#include "PauseActionBridge.hpp"
#include "../core/BakeScheduler.hpp"
#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"
#include "../debug/AssistLog.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <Geode/modify/PauseLayer.hpp>
#include <Geode/utils/cocos.hpp>
#include <Geode/ui/BasedButtonSprite.hpp>

using namespace geode::prelude;

// Resolve geode.node-ids PauseLayer menus (live under main-layer, not PauseLayer root).
class PauseMenuAttach {
public:
    static CCNode* hostLayer(PauseLayer* self) {
        if (!self) return nullptr;
        if (auto* main = self->getChildByID("main-layer")) return main;
        return self;
    }

    static CCMenu* rightButtonMenu(PauseLayer* self) {
        if (!self) return nullptr;
        return typeinfo_cast<CCMenu*>(self->getChildByIDRecursive("right-button-menu"));
    }
};

class $modify(EbPauseLayer, PauseLayer) {
    void customSetup() {
        PauseLayer::customSetup();

        // Clean pause: EB opens Geode settings (category pages). Optional status lines only.
        // Bake / Assist action buttons live under EB → Bake / Assist — no side stacks.
        bool const showStatus = StageConfig::showPauseBake();
        bool const showHub = StageConfig::showPauseHub();
        if (!showStatus && !showHub) return;

        // Already installed (idempotent). Still (re)schedule poll — prior early-return skipped it.
        if (this->getChildByIDRecursive("earlybuffer-pause-ui"_spr)) {
            PauseActionBridge::refreshPauseLabels(this);
            this->schedule(schedule_selector(EbPauseLayer::onBakePoll), 0.15f);
            return;
        }

        auto* host = PauseMenuAttach::hostLayer(this);
        if (!host) return;

        auto win = this->getContentSize();
        auto* marker = CCNode::create();
        marker->setID("earlybuffer-pause-ui"_spr);
        host->addChild(marker);

        // Top-right: opens Geode ModSettingsPopup (Main/Bake/Ingame/Assist/…).
        if (showHub) {
            auto* spr = CircleButtonSprite::create(
                CCLabelBMFont::create("EB", "bigFont.fnt"),
                CircleBaseColor::Cyan,
                CircleBaseSize::Small
            );
            if (!spr) {
                spr = CircleButtonSprite::createWithSpriteFrameName(
                    "GJ_optionsBtn_001.png", 0.6f, CircleBaseColor::Cyan, CircleBaseSize::Small
                );
            }
            auto* btn = CCMenuItemExt::createSpriteExtra(spr, [](CCMenuItemSpriteExtra*) {
                PauseActionBridge::openHub();
            });
            btn->setID("earlybuffer-settings-btn"_spr);
            btn->setScale(0.85f);

            if (auto* right = PauseMenuAttach::rightButtonMenu(this)) {
                right->addChild(btn);
                right->updateLayout();
                AssistLog::debug("pause-ui: EB settings on right-button-menu");
            }
            else {
                auto* menu = CCMenu::create();
                menu->setID("earlybuffer-settings-menu"_spr);
                menu->ignoreAnchorPointForPosition(false);
                menu->setAnchorPoint({ 1.f, 1.f });
                menu->setPosition({ win.width - 12.f, win.height - 12.f });
                menu->addChild(btn);
                host->addChild(menu, 1100);
                AssistLog::debug("pause-ui: EB settings fallback top-right menu");
            }
        }

        if (showStatus) {
            auto* title = CCLabelBMFont::create("EarlyBuffer", "goldFont.fnt");
            if (!title) title = CCLabelBMFont::create("EarlyBuffer", "bigFont.fnt");
            title->setID("earlybuffer-bake-title"_spr);
            title->setScale(0.45f);
            title->setAnchorPoint({ 0.f, 1.f });
            title->setPosition({ 14.f, win.height - 52.f });
            host->addChild(title, 999);

            auto* modeLbl = CCLabelBMFont::create("Mode: …", "chatFont.fnt");
            if (!modeLbl) modeLbl = CCLabelBMFont::create("Mode: …", "bigFont.fnt");
            modeLbl->setID("earlybuffer-mode-label"_spr);
            modeLbl->setScale(0.5f);
            modeLbl->setAnchorPoint({ 0.f, 1.f });
            modeLbl->setPosition({ 14.f, win.height - 72.f });
            host->addChild(modeLbl, 999);

            auto* status = CCLabelBMFont::create("…", "chatFont.fnt");
            if (!status) status = CCLabelBMFont::create("…", "bigFont.fnt");
            status->setID("earlybuffer-bake-status"_spr);
            status->setScale(0.45f);
            status->setAnchorPoint({ 0.f, 1.f });
            status->setOpacity(210);
            status->setPosition({ 14.f, win.height - 92.f });
            host->addChild(status, 999);
        }

        PauseActionBridge::refreshPauseLabels(this);
        this->schedule(schedule_selector(EbPauseLayer::onBakePoll), 0.15f);
    }

    void onBakePoll(float) {
        PauseActionBridge::refreshPauseLabels(this);
        PauseActionBridge::refreshOpenSettings();
        BakeScheduler::get().tickSlice();
    }
};
```

```cpp
#include "DevOverlay.hpp"
#include "../dev/DevConfig.hpp"
#include "../dev/DevReport.hpp"
#include "../dev/DevSession.hpp"

bool DevOverlay::shouldShow() {
    if (!DevConfig::overlay()) return false;
    return DevSession::get().isRecording() || DevReport::hasLast();
}

std::string DevOverlay::line() {
    if (!shouldShow()) return {};

    if (DevReport::hasLast()) {
        auto const& r = DevReport::last();
        // Prefer full report line (includes REC when set at eval time).
        // Refresh REC prefix if session is still rolling.
        if (DevSession::get().isRecording()) {
            DevReport copy = r;
            copy.recLine = DevSession::get().statusLine();
            return DevReport::formatOverlayLine(copy);
        }
        return r.overlayLine;
    }

    if (DevSession::get().isRecording()) {
        return DevSession::get().statusLine();
    }
    return {};
}
```

```cpp
#include "InLevelSettingsFilter.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <Geode/loader/SettingV3.hpp>
#include <Geode/ui/ScrollLayer.hpp>
#include <fmt/format.h>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

using namespace geode::prelude;

char const* InLevelSettingsFilter::categoryName(SettingsCategory cat) {
    switch (cat) {
        case SettingsCategory::Main: return "Main";
        case SettingsCategory::Bake: return "Bake";
        case SettingsCategory::Ingame: return "Ingame";
        case SettingsCategory::Assist: return "Assist";
        case SettingsCategory::Visual: return "Visual";
        case SettingsCategory::Modes: return "Modes";
        case SettingsCategory::Keys: return "Keys";
        case SettingsCategory::Dev: return "Dev";
        case SettingsCategory::Count: break;
    }
    return "?";
}

SettingsCategory InLevelSettingsFilter::categoryForKey(std::string const& key) {
    if (key == "title-general" || key == "enabled" || key == "preset"
        || key == "safe-mode" || key == "debug-logging" || key == "perf-trace") {
        return SettingsCategory::Main;
    }
    if (key == "title-bake-actions" || key == "import-bake-replay"
        || key == "cycle-assist-mode" || key == "bake-map-action"
        || key == "brute-bake-action" || key == "cancel-bake-action") {
        return SettingsCategory::Bake;
    }
    if (key == "show-overlay" || key == "show-pause-bake"
        || key == "show-pause-assist" || key == "show-pause-hub") {
        return SettingsCategory::Ingame;
    }
    if (key == "title-assist-actions" || key == "cycle-preset-action"
        || key == "reset-learn-action" || key == "export-config-action"
        || key == "import-config-action") {
        return SettingsCategory::Assist;
    }
    if (key == "show-trajectory"
        || key == "save-feedback-sound"
        || key == "save-feedback-color"
        || key == "save-feedback-counter"
        || key == "save-icon-color") {
        return SettingsCategory::Visual;
    }
    if (key == "title-cube" || key.rfind("cube-", 0) == 0
        || key == "title-ship" || key.rfind("ship-", 0) == 0
        || key == "title-ball" || key.rfind("ball-", 0) == 0
        || key == "title-ufo" || key.rfind("ufo-", 0) == 0
        || key == "title-wave" || key.rfind("wave-", 0) == 0
        || key == "title-robot" || key.rfind("robot-", 0) == 0
        || key == "title-spider" || key.rfind("spider-", 0) == 0
        || key == "title-swing" || key.rfind("swing-", 0) == 0) {
        return SettingsCategory::Modes;
    }
    if (key == "title-keys" || key.rfind("hotkey-", 0) == 0
        || key == "title-internal" || key == "stage-index" || key == "swallow-hopeless") {
        return SettingsCategory::Keys;
    }
    // Dev Lab keys: title-dev* and every setting/action prefixed with "dev-".
    if (key.rfind("title-dev", 0) == 0 || key.rfind("dev-", 0) == 0) {
        return SettingsCategory::Dev;
    }
    return SettingsCategory::Assist;
}

bool InLevelSettingsFilter::keepKey(std::string const& key, SettingsCategory cat) {
    return categoryForKey(key) == cat;
}

bool InLevelSettingsFilter::keepKey(std::string const& key) {
    auto const c = categoryForKey(key);
    return c == SettingsCategory::Main
        || c == SettingsCategory::Ingame
        || c == SettingsCategory::Assist
        || c == SettingsCategory::Visual
        || c == SettingsCategory::Bake;
}

float InLevelSettingsFilter::preservedContentY(
    float posBefore, float heightBefore, float heightAfter
) {
    return posBefore + (heightBefore - heightAfter);
}

namespace {

class FilterWalk {
public:
    static void collect(CCNode* node, std::vector<SettingNodeV3*>& settings, ScrollLayer*& list) {
        if (!node) return;
        if (auto* scroll = typeinfo_cast<ScrollLayer*>(node)) list = scroll;
        if (auto* sett = typeinfo_cast<SettingNodeV3*>(node)) {
            settings.push_back(sett);
            return;
        }
        auto* children = node->getChildren();
        if (!children) return;
        std::vector<CCNode*> kids;
        kids.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(children->count()));
        for (auto* child : CCArrayExt<CCNode*>(children)) kids.push_back(child);
        for (auto* child : kids) collect(child, settings, list);
    }
};

class KeeperNode;

class CategoryBar : public CCMenu {
public:
    bool initBar(KeeperNode* owner, float width) {
        if (!CCMenu::init()) return false;

        this->m_owner = owner;
        this->setID("earlybuffer-settings-category-bar"_spr);
        this->setContentSize({ width, 28.f });
        this->ignoreAnchorPointForPosition(false);
        this->setAnchorPoint({ 0.5f, 0.f });

        auto* leftSpr = CCSprite::createWithSpriteFrameName("GJ_arrow_03_001.png");
        leftSpr->setScale(0.55f);
        auto* left = CCMenuItemSpriteExtra::create(
            leftSpr, this, menu_selector(CategoryBar::onPrev)
        );
        left->setPosition({ 24.f, 14.f });
        this->addChild(left);

        auto* rightSpr = CCSprite::createWithSpriteFrameName("GJ_arrow_03_001.png");
        rightSpr->setScale(0.55f);
        rightSpr->setFlipX(true);
        auto* right = CCMenuItemSpriteExtra::create(
            rightSpr, this, menu_selector(CategoryBar::onNext)
        );
        right->setPosition({ width - 24.f, 14.f });
        this->addChild(right);

        this->m_label = CCLabelBMFont::create("MAIN", "goldFont.fnt");
        this->m_label->setScale(0.45f);
        this->m_label->setPosition({ width * 0.5f, 14.f });
        this->addChild(this->m_label);
        return true;
    }

    void setCategory(SettingsCategory cat) {
        if (!this->m_label) return;
        this->m_label->setString(InLevelSettingsFilter::categoryName(cat));
    }

    void onPrev(CCObject*);
    void onNext(CCObject*);

    static CategoryBar* create(KeeperNode* owner, float width) {
        auto* ret = new CategoryBar();
        if (!ret || !ret->initBar(owner, width)) {
            CC_SAFE_DELETE(ret);
            return nullptr;
        }
        ret->autorelease();
        return ret;
    }

private:
    KeeperNode* m_owner = nullptr;
    CCLabelBMFont* m_label = nullptr;
};

class KeeperNode : public CCNode {
public:
    SettingsCategory m_category = SettingsCategory::Main;
    CategoryBar* m_bar = nullptr;
    ScrollLayer* m_list = nullptr;
    std::vector<Ref<SettingNodeV3>> m_all;
    size_t m_lastChildCount = 0;
    SettingsCategory m_appliedCat = SettingsCategory::Count;

    void setCategory(SettingsCategory cat) {
        auto const n = static_cast<int>(SettingsCategory::Count);
        auto i = static_cast<int>(cat) % n;
        if (i < 0) i += n;

        this->m_category = static_cast<SettingsCategory>(i);
        if (this->m_bar) this->m_bar->setCategory(this->m_category);
        this->refilter(true);
        if (this->m_list) this->m_list->moveToTop();
    }

    void cycle(int delta) {
        this->setCategory(static_cast<SettingsCategory>(
            static_cast<int>(this->m_category) + delta
        ));
    }

    void ensureBar(ScrollLayer* list) {
        if (!list) return;

        this->m_list = list;
        auto* parent = list->getParent();
        if (!parent) return;

        constexpr float kBarH = 28.f;
        if (auto* existing = typeinfo_cast<CategoryBar*>(
                parent->getChildByID("earlybuffer-settings-category-bar"_spr)
            )) {
            this->m_bar = existing;
            this->m_bar->setCategory(this->m_category);
            return;
        }

        auto const listSize = list->getContentSize();
        if (listSize.height <= kBarH + 40.f) return;

        list->setContentSize({ listSize.width, listSize.height - kBarH });
        auto* bar = CategoryBar::create(this, listSize.width);
        if (!bar) return;

        bar->setPosition({
            list->getPositionX() + listSize.width * 0.5f,
            list->getPositionY() + list->getContentSize().height
        });
        bar->setTouchPriority(list->getTouchPriority() - 1);
        parent->addChild(bar);
        this->m_bar = bar;
        this->m_bar->setCategory(this->m_category);
    }

    void absorbFromTree(CCNode* popup) {
        if (!popup) return;

        std::vector<SettingNodeV3*> found;
        ScrollLayer* list = nullptr;
        FilterWalk::collect(popup, found, list);
        if (list) this->m_list = list;

        for (auto* sett : found) {
            if (!sett) continue;
            bool known = false;
            for (auto const& ref : this->m_all) {
                if (ref.data() != sett) continue;
                known = true;
                break;
            }
            if (known) continue;
            this->m_all.push_back(sett);
        }
    }

    static bool nodeKeep(SettingNodeV3* sett, SettingsCategory cat) {
        if (!sett) return false;
        if (auto setting = sett->getSetting()) {
            return InLevelSettingsFilter::keepKey(setting->getKey(), cat);
        }

        // Unresolved custom ("Missing setting 'key'") — still map by key in the label
        // so Bake/Assist pages aren't empty when registration races load.
        auto* label = sett->getNameLabel();
        if (!label) return false;

        std::string const s = label->getString();
        auto match = [&](char const* key) {
            return s.find(key) != std::string::npos
                && InLevelSettingsFilter::keepKey(key, cat);
        };
        return match("import-bake-replay")
            || match("cycle-assist-mode")
            || match("bake-map-action")
            || match("brute-bake-action")
            || match("cancel-bake-action")
            || match("cycle-preset-action")
            || match("reset-learn-action")
            || match("export-config-action")
            || match("import-config-action");
    }

    void refilter(bool force) {
        auto* popup = this->getParent();
        if (!popup) return;

        this->absorbFromTree(popup);
        this->ensureBar(this->m_list);
        if (!this->m_list || !this->m_list->m_contentLayer) return;
        if (this->m_all.empty()) return;

        auto* content = this->m_list->m_contentLayer;
        size_t const childCount = content->getChildrenCount();
        if (!force
            && this->m_appliedCat == this->m_category
            && childCount == this->m_lastChildCount) {
            return;
        }

        float const yBefore = content->getPositionY();
        float const hBefore = content->getContentHeight();

        for (auto& sett : this->m_all) {
            if (!sett) continue;
            sett->removeFromParent();
        }

        bool bg = false;
        for (auto& sett : this->m_all) {
            if (!sett || !nodeKeep(sett, this->m_category)) continue;
            sett->setVisible(true);
            content->addChild(sett);
            sett->setDefaultBGColor(ccc4(0, 0, 0, bg ? 60 : 20));
            bg = !bg;
        }

        content->updateLayout();
        float const hAfter = content->getContentHeight();
        if (force && this->m_appliedCat != this->m_category) {
            this->m_list->moveToTop();
        }
        else {
            content->setPositionY(
                InLevelSettingsFilter::preservedContentY(yBefore, hBefore, hAfter)
            );
        }

        this->m_appliedCat = this->m_category;
        this->m_lastChildCount = content->getChildrenCount();
    }

    bool initKeeper() {
        if (!CCNode::init()) return false;

        this->setID("earlybuffer-inlevel-settings-filter"_spr);
        this->m_changeHandle = SettingNodeValueChangeEvent().listen(
            [this](std::string_view modID, std::string_view, SettingNodeV3*, bool) {
                if (modID != Mod::get()->getID()) return ListenerResult::Propagate;
                Loader::get()->queueInMainThread([self = Ref(this)] {
                    if (!self) return;
                    self->refilter(true);
                });
                return ListenerResult::Propagate;
            }
        );
        this->schedule(schedule_selector(KeeperNode::onTick), 0.05f);
        this->refilter(true);
        return true;
    }

    void onTick(float) {
        this->refilter(false);
    }

    static KeeperNode* create() {
        auto* ret = new KeeperNode();
        if (!ret || !ret->initKeeper()) {
            CC_SAFE_DELETE(ret);
            return nullptr;
        }
        ret->autorelease();
        return ret;
    }

    static KeeperNode* findOpen() {
        auto* scene = CCScene::get();
        if (!scene) return nullptr;
        return typeinfo_cast<KeeperNode*>(
            scene->getChildByIDRecursive("earlybuffer-inlevel-settings-filter"_spr)
        );
    }

private:
    ListenerHandle m_changeHandle{};
};

void CategoryBar::onPrev(CCObject*) {
    if (!this->m_owner) return;
    this->m_owner->cycle(-1);
}

void CategoryBar::onNext(CCObject*) {
    if (!this->m_owner) return;
    this->m_owner->cycle(1);
}

} // namespace

void InLevelSettingsFilter::apply(CCNode* popup, SettingsCategory cat) {
    if (!popup) return;
    std::vector<SettingNodeV3*> settings;
    ScrollLayer* list = nullptr;
    FilterWalk::collect(popup, settings, list);
    if (!list || !list->m_contentLayer || settings.empty()) return;

    auto* content = list->m_contentLayer;
    float const yBefore = content->getPositionY();
    float const hBefore = content->getContentHeight();

    for (auto* sett : settings) {
        if (!sett) continue;
        bool keep = false;
        if (auto setting = sett->getSetting()) {
            keep = keepKey(setting->getKey(), cat);
        }
        if (!keep) sett->removeFromParent();
        else sett->setVisible(true);
    }
    content->updateLayout();
    content->setPositionY(preservedContentY(yBefore, hBefore, content->getContentHeight()));
}

bool InLevelSettingsFilter::selfCheck(std::string& report) {
    report.clear();
    int fails = 0;
    auto expect = [&](bool ok, char const* name) {
        if (!ok) {
            ++fails;
            report += std::string("FAIL ") + name + "; ";
        }
    };

    expect(categoryForKey("enabled") == SettingsCategory::Main, "cat-enabled-main");
    expect(categoryForKey("import-bake-replay") == SettingsCategory::Bake, "cat-import-bake");
    expect(categoryForKey("bake-map-action") == SettingsCategory::Bake, "cat-bake-map");
    expect(categoryForKey("show-pause-hub") == SettingsCategory::Ingame, "cat-hub-ingame");
    expect(categoryForKey("cycle-preset-action") == SettingsCategory::Assist, "cat-cycle-preset");
    expect(categoryForKey("assist-mode") == SettingsCategory::Assist, "cat-assist-mode");
    expect(categoryForKey("assist-pick") == SettingsCategory::Assist, "cat-assist-pick");
    expect(categoryForKey("debug-logging") == SettingsCategory::Main, "cat-debug-main");
    expect(categoryForKey("perf-trace") == SettingsCategory::Main, "cat-perf-main");
    expect(categoryForKey("show-trajectory") == SettingsCategory::Visual, "cat-traj-visual");
    expect(categoryForKey("save-feedback-sound") == SettingsCategory::Visual, "cat-save-sound");
    expect(categoryForKey("save-feedback-color") == SettingsCategory::Visual, "cat-save-color");
    expect(categoryForKey("save-feedback-counter") == SettingsCategory::Visual, "cat-save-counter");
    expect(categoryForKey("save-icon-color") == SettingsCategory::Visual, "cat-save-icon-color");
    expect(categoryForKey("cube-latency") == SettingsCategory::Modes, "cat-cube-modes");
    expect(categoryForKey("hotkey-cycle") == SettingsCategory::Keys, "cat-hotkey-keys");
    expect(categoryForKey("title-dev") == SettingsCategory::Dev, "cat-title-dev");
    expect(categoryForKey("dev-record-enable") == SettingsCategory::Dev, "cat-dev-record");
    expect(categoryForKey("dev-start-record-action") == SettingsCategory::Dev, "cat-dev-start");
    expect(keepKey("dev-record-enable", SettingsCategory::Dev), "keep-dev-on-dev");
    expect(!keepKey("dev-record-enable", SettingsCategory::Assist), "drop-dev-on-assist");
    expect(!keepKey("dev-record-enable"), "legacy-drop-dev");
    expect(keepKey("import-bake-replay", SettingsCategory::Bake), "keep-import-on-bake");
    expect(!keepKey("import-bake-replay", SettingsCategory::Main), "drop-import-on-main");

    expect(static_cast<int>(SettingsCategory::Count) == 8, "cat-count-8");
    expect(std::strcmp(categoryName(SettingsCategory::Bake), "Bake") == 0, "cat-name-bake");
    expect(std::strcmp(categoryName(SettingsCategory::Dev), "Dev") == 0, "cat-name-dev");

    expect(preservedContentY(100.f, 800.f, 400.f) == 500.f, "scroll-shrink");
    expect(preservedContentY(0.f, 100.f, 100.f) == 0.f, "scroll-same");

    if (fails == 0) report = "InLevelSettingsFilter selfCheck OK";
    else report = fmt::format("InLevelSettingsFilter {} fails: {}", fails, report);
    return fails == 0;
}

void InLevelSettingsFilterKeeper::attach(CCNode* popup) {
    if (!popup) return;
    if (popup->getChildByID("earlybuffer-inlevel-settings-filter"_spr)) return;

    auto* keeper = KeeperNode::create();
    if (!keeper) return;
    popup->addChild(keeper);
}

bool InLevelSettingsFilterKeeper::isOpen() {
    return KeeperNode::findOpen() != nullptr;
}

void InLevelSettingsFilterKeeper::refreshOpen() {
    // Action button rows refresh themselves via onTick.
}

namespace {

class SettingsTabWatchdog : public CCNode {
public:
    static bool popupIsOurSettings(CCNode* root) {
        if (!root || !Mod::get()) return false;

        std::string const ourId = Mod::get()->getID();
        std::vector<SettingNodeV3*> settings;
        ScrollLayer* list = nullptr;
        FilterWalk::collect(root, settings, list);
        for (auto* sett : settings) {
            if (!sett) continue;
            if (auto s = sett->getSetting()) {
                if (s->getModID() == ourId) return true;
            }
            auto* label = sett->getNameLabel();
            if (!label) continue;
            std::string const text = label->getString();
            if (text.find("import-bake-replay") != std::string::npos
                || text.find("bake-map-action") != std::string::npos
                || text.find("show-pause-hub") != std::string::npos) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        // Title fallback (Geode sets "Settings for EarlyBuffer").
        std::vector<CCNode*> stack{ root };
        while (!stack.empty()) {
            auto* n = stack.back();
            stack.pop_back();
            if (!n) continue;

            if (auto* lab = typeinfo_cast<CCLabelBMFont*>(n)) {
                std::string const t = lab->getString();
                if (t.find("EarlyBuffer") != std::string::npos
                    && t.find("Settings") != std::string::npos) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            auto* kids = n->getChildren();
            if (!kids) continue;
            for (auto* c : CCArrayExt<CCNode*>(kids)) stack.push_back(c);
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void collectAlerts(CCNode* node, std::vector<FLAlertLayer*>& out) {
        if (!node) return;
        if (auto* alert = typeinfo_cast<FLAlertLayer*>(node)) {
            out.push_back(alert);
        }
        auto* kids = node->getChildren();
        if (!kids) return;
        for (auto* child : CCArrayExt<CCNode*>(kids)) {
            collectAlerts(child, out);
        }
    }

    static CCNode* findUnattachedOurPopup() {
        auto* scene = CCScene::get();
        if (!scene) return nullptr;
        if (scene->getChildByIDRecursive("earlybuffer-inlevel-settings-filter"_spr)) {
            return nullptr;
        }

        // Scan every alert (Geode may nest ModSettings under ModPopup / scene).
        std::vector<FLAlertLayer*> alerts;
        collectAlerts(scene, alerts);
        for (auto* alert : alerts) {
            if (!alert) continue;
            if (alert->getChildByID("earlybuffer-inlevel-settings-filter"_spr)) continue;
            if (!alert->getChildByIDRecursive("search-input")) continue;
            if (popupIsOurSettings(alert)) return alert;
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    void ensureOnScene() {
        auto* scene = CCScene::get();
        if (!scene) return;
        if (this->getParent() == scene) return;

        this->retain();
        this->removeFromParentAndCleanup(false);
        scene->addChild(this);
        this->release();
    }

    void onTick(float) {
        this->ensureOnScene();
        auto* popup = findUnattachedOurPopup();
        if (!popup) return;
        InLevelSettingsFilterKeeper::attach(popup);
    }

    bool initWatchdog() {
        if (!CCNode::init()) return false;
        this->setID("earlybuffer-settings-tab-watchdog"_spr);
        this->schedule(schedule_selector(SettingsTabWatchdog::onTick), 0.1f);
        return true;
    }

    static SettingsTabWatchdog* create() {
        auto* ret = new SettingsTabWatchdog();
        if (!ret || !ret->initWatchdog()) {
            CC_SAFE_DELETE(ret);
            return nullptr;
        }
        ret->autorelease();
        return ret;
    }
};

Ref<SettingsTabWatchdog> g_settingsTabWatchdog;

} // namespace

void InLevelSettingsFilterKeeper::startWatchdog() {
    if (!g_settingsTabWatchdog) {
        g_settingsTabWatchdog = SettingsTabWatchdog::create();
    }
    if (!g_settingsTabWatchdog) return;
    auto* scene = CCScene::get();
    if (!scene) {
        Loader::get()->queueInMainThread([] {
            InLevelSettingsFilterKeeper::startWatchdog();
        });
        return;
    }
    g_settingsTabWatchdog->ensureOnScene();
}
```

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_UI_INLEVELSETTINGSFILTER_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_UI_INLEVELSETTINGSFILTER_HPP

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <string>

// Categories for the Geode ModSettingsPopup page switcher (◀ NAME ▶).
enum class SettingsCategory : int {
    Main = 0,
    Bake,
    Ingame,
    Assist,
    Visual,
    Modes,
    Keys,
    Dev,
    Count
};

// Filters Geode settings rows by SettingsCategory.
// Non-matching rows are reparented out of the list (Geode search style); scroll Y preserved.
class InLevelSettingsFilter {
public:
    static char const* categoryName(SettingsCategory cat);
    static SettingsCategory categoryForKey(std::string const& key);
    static bool keepKey(std::string const& key, SettingsCategory cat);

    // Legacy: Main∪Ingame∪Assist∪Visual.
    static bool keepKey(std::string const& key);

    static void apply(cocos2d::CCNode* popup, SettingsCategory cat);

    static float preservedContentY(float posBefore, float heightBefore, float heightAfter);

    static bool selfCheck(std::string& report);

private:
    InLevelSettingsFilter() = delete;
};

// Attaches to every EarlyBuffer settings popup: category bar + live re-filter + Bake/Assist actions.
class InLevelSettingsFilterKeeper {
public:
    static void attach(cocos2d::CCNode* popup);

    // True if our keeper is on an open settings popup in the scene.
    static bool isOpen();

    // Refresh bake status / button enable on the open popup (no-op if closed).
    static void refreshOpen();

    // Scene watchdog: attach tabs whenever EarlyBuffer settings open (Geode menu or EB).
    static void startWatchdog();

private:
    InLevelSettingsFilterKeeper() = delete;
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_UI_INLEVELSETTINGSFILTER_HPP
```

`src/ui/PauseActionBridge.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "PauseActionBridge.hpp"
#include "InLevelSettingsFilter.hpp"

#include "../core/AssistController.hpp"
#include "../core/BakeMap.hpp"
#include "../core/BakeScheduler.hpp"
#include "../core/ConfigBundle.hpp"
#include "../core/ReplayImport.hpp"
#include "../core/SaveDropPaths.hpp"
#include "../debug/AssistLog.hpp"
#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"
#include "../dev/DevConfig.hpp"
#include "../dev/DevReport.hpp"
#include "../dev/DevSession.hpp"
#include "../dev/DevTraceStore.hpp"
#include "../ui/DevOverlay.hpp"
#include "../ui/StatusOverlay.hpp"
#include "../ui/TrajectoryVisualizer.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <Geode/ui/GeodeUI.hpp>
#include <Geode/utils/file.hpp>
#include <filesystem>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <system_error>

#ifdef GEODE_IS_WINDOWS
# ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#  define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
# endif
# include <windows.h>
# include <commdlg.h>
#endif

using namespace geode::prelude;

// File-local helpers (class, not a namespace) for pickers / label lookup.
class PauseActionBridgeDetail {
public:
    static CCLabelBMFont* findStatusLabel(PauseLayer* self) {
        // Labels live under main-layer (NodeIDs) or PauseLayer root (legacy).
        return typeinfo_cast<CCLabelBMFont*>(
            self->getChildByIDRecursive("earlybuffer-bake-status"_spr)
        );
    }

    static CCLabelBMFont* findModeLabel(PauseLayer* self) {
        return typeinfo_cast<CCLabelBMFont*>(
            self->getChildByIDRecursive("earlybuffer-mode-label"_spr)
        );
    }

#ifdef GEODE_IS_WINDOWS
    static std::optional<std::filesystem::path> pickReplayFileWin32() {
        wchar_t fileBuf[MAX_PATH] = {};
        OPENFILENAMEW ofn{};
        ofn.lStructSize = sizeof(ofn);
        ofn.lpstrFile = fileBuf;
        ofn.nMaxFile = MAX_PATH;
        ofn.lpstrFilter =
            L"Replays (GDR/MHR/SLC)\0*.gdr;*.gdr2;*.mhr;*.json;*.slc\0"
            L"All Files\0*.*\0";
        ofn.nFilterIndex = 1;
        ofn.Flags = OFN_PATHMUSTEXIST | OFN_FILEMUSTEXIST | OFN_NOCHANGEDIR;
        if (!GetOpenFileNameW(&ofn)) return std::nullopt;
        return std::filesystem::path(fileBuf);
    }

    static std::optional<std::filesystem::path> pickSaveJsonWin32(bool saveAs) {
        wchar_t fileBuf[MAX_PATH] = {};
        wcscpy_s(fileBuf, L"earlybuffer-config.json");
        OPENFILENAMEW ofn{};
        ofn.lStructSize = sizeof(ofn);
        ofn.lpstrFile = fileBuf;
        ofn.nMaxFile = MAX_PATH;
        ofn.lpstrFilter = L"JSON\0*.json\0All Files\0*.*\0";
        ofn.nFilterIndex = 1;
        ofn.Flags = OFN_PATHMUSTEXIST | OFN_NOCHANGEDIR
            | (saveAs ? OFN_OVERWRITEPROMPT : OFN_FILEMUSTEXIST);
        if (saveAs) {
            if (!GetSaveFileNameW(&ofn)) return std::nullopt;
        }
        else {
            if (!GetOpenFileNameW(&ofn)) return std::nullopt;
        }
        return std::filesystem::path(fileBuf);
    }
#endif

    static std::string formatExportSuccess(std::filesystem::path const& path) {
        auto const st = ConfigBundle::lastExportStats();
        return fmt::format(
            "Config exported (v{}).\n"
            "keys={}  skipped={}\n\n"
            "{}",
            st.version,
            st.written,
            st.skipped,
            path.string()
        );
    }

    static std::string formatImportSuccess(std::optional<std::filesystem::path> const& path) {
        auto const st = ConfigBundle::lastImportStats();
        if (path) {
            return fmt::format(
                "Config imported.\n"
                "version={}  applied={}  skipped={}\n\n"
                "{}",
                st.version,
                st.applied,
                st.skipped,
                path->string()
            );
        }
        return fmt::format(
            "Config imported.\n"
            "version={}  applied={}  skipped={}",
            st.version,
            st.applied,
            st.skipped
        );
    }

#ifndef GEODE_IS_WINDOWS
    // Non-Win: pick newest replay from SaveDropPaths::replayDropDir().
    // nullopt = user was already alerted (ensureDirs fail / empty folder).
    static std::optional<std::filesystem::path> pickReplayFromDropDir() {
        auto& drops = SaveDropPaths::get();
        std::string err;
        if (!drops.ensureDirs(err)) {
            FLAlertLayer::create(
                "EarlyBuffer",
                err.empty()
                    ? "Could not create the replay drop folder."
                    : err.c_str(),
                "OK"
            )->show();
            return std::nullopt;
        }

        auto const dir = drops.replayDropDir();
        auto const candidates = drops.listReplayCandidates();
        if (candidates.empty()) {
            auto const msg = fmt::format(
                "No replay in the drop folder.\n\n"
                "Copy one file into:\n{}\n\n"
                "Supported: .gdr .gdr2 .mhr .json .slc\n"
                "Empty files are ignored.\n"
                "If several files are present, Import uses the newest.",
                dir.string()
            );
            FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer", msg.c_str(), "OK")->show();
            return std::nullopt;
        }

        auto const& chosen = candidates.front(); // newest mtime
        if (candidates.size() > 1) {
            AssistLog::info(fmt::format(
                "Import: {} file(s) in drop folder — using newest '{}'",
                candidates.size(),
                chosen.filename().string()
            ));
        }
        return chosen;
    }
#endif
};

void PauseActionBridge::refreshPauseLabels(PauseLayer* self) {
    if (!self) return;
    if (auto* mode = PauseActionBridgeDetail::findModeLabel(self)) {
        auto m = StageConfig::assistMode();
        mode->setString(fmt::format(
            "Mode: {} — {}",
            StageConfig::assistModeName(m),
            StageConfig::assistModeHint(m)
        ).c_str());
    }
    if (auto* st = PauseActionBridgeDetail::findStatusLabel(self)) {
        auto& bake = BakeMap::get();
        if (bake.isBaking() || BakeScheduler::get().running()) {
            st->setString(fmt::format(
                "{}\n{:.0f}%  ({}/{})",
                bake.progress().getStatus(),
                bake.progress().fraction() * 100.f,
                bake.progress().done.load(),
                bake.progress().total.load()
            ).c_str());
        }
        else if (DevSession::get().isRecording()) {
            st->setString(DevSession::get().statusLine().c_str());
        }
        else {
            st->setString(bake.pauseStatusLine().c_str());
        }
    }
}

void PauseActionBridge::handleImportedPath(std::filesystem::path const& path) {
    auto loaded = ReplayImport::load(path);
    if (loaded.isErr()) {
        AssistLog::info(fmt::format("Import failed: {}", loaded.unwrapErr()));
        FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer", loaded.unwrapErr().c_str(), "OK")->show();
        return;
    }
    BakeMap::get().setPendingReplay(loaded.unwrap());
    AssistController::get().updateOverlay();
    auto const* r = BakeMap::get().pendingReplay();
    FLAlertLayer::create(
        "EarlyBuffer",
        fmt::format(
            "Imported {}\n{} events @ {:.0f} tps ({})\n\n"
            "Press Bake Map for replay windows.\n"
            "Brute Bake ignores this and searches the level itself.",
            r->sourceName, r->events.size(), r->tps, r->format
        ).c_str(),
        "OK"
    )->show();
    if (auto* pause = CCScene::get()->getChildByType<PauseLayer>(0)) {
        refreshPauseLabels(pause);
    }
}

void PauseActionBridge::importReplay() {
    if (BakeMap::get().isBaking() || BakeScheduler::get().running()) {
        FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer", "Bake in progress — wait or cancel.", "OK")->show();
        return;
    }
#ifdef GEODE_IS_WINDOWS
    auto picked = PauseActionBridgeDetail::pickReplayFileWin32();
    if (!picked) return;
    handleImportedPath(*picked);
#else
    auto picked = PauseActionBridgeDetail::pickReplayFromDropDir();
    if (!picked) return;
    handleImportedPath(*picked);
#endif
}

void PauseActionBridge::startBake(bool brute) {
    auto* pl = PlayLayer::get();
    if (!pl) {
        FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer", "No level loaded.", "OK")->show();
        return;
    }
    if (BakeMap::get().isBaking() || BakeScheduler::get().running()) {
        FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer", "Bake already running.", "OK")->show();
        return;
    }
    if (!brute && !BakeMap::get().pendingReplay()) {
        FLAlertLayer::create(
            "EarlyBuffer",
            "Bake Map needs a replay.\nImport Replay first — or use Brute Bake\n(no macro, explores safe clicks).",
            "OK"
        )->show();
        return;
    }
    auto snap = AssistController::get().ensureStartSnapshot(pl);
    if (snap.isErr()) {
        FLAlertLayer::create(
            "EarlyBuffer",
            "Reset the level once (play from start),\nthen pause and bake again.",
            "OK"
        )->show();
        return;
    }

    int slot = AssistController::get().startSnapshotSlot();
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format("BAKE UI: starting {} (main-thread)", brute ? "BruteForce" : "Replay"));

    bool ok = BakeScheduler::get().start(
        pl, slot, StageConfig::bakeRadius(),
        brute ? BakeMethod::BruteForce : BakeMethod::Replay
    );
    if (!ok) {
        FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer", "Could not start bake.", "OK")->show();
        return;
    }
    AssistController::get().updateOverlay();
    if (auto* pause = CCScene::get()->getChildByType<PauseLayer>(0)) {
        refreshPauseLabels(pause);
    }
}

void PauseActionBridge::cycleAssistMode() {
    StageConfig::cycleAssistMode();
    auto mode = StageConfig::assistMode();
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format(
        "ASSIST MODE: {} — {}",
        StageConfig::assistModeName(mode),
        StageConfig::assistModeHint(mode)
    ));
    AssistController::get().updateOverlay();
    if (auto* pause = CCScene::get()->getChildByType<PauseLayer>(0)) {
        refreshPauseLabels(pause);
    }
}

void PauseActionBridge::cancelBake() {
    if (!BakeMap::get().isBaking() && !BakeScheduler::get().running()) return;
    BakeScheduler::get().cancel();
    AssistLog::info("BAKE: cancel requested");
}

void PauseActionBridge::cyclePreset() {
    auto const stage = StageConfig::cycleNext();
    AssistLog::printCycle(stage, AssistController::get().estimatedTps());
    AssistController::get().updateOverlay();
}

void PauseActionBridge::toggleDebug() {
    StageConfig::toggleDebugLogging();
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format("debug-logging: {}", StageConfig::debugLogging() ? "ON" : "OFF"));
}

void PauseActionBridge::resetLearning() {
    AssistController::get().resetLevelProfile();
    AssistLog::info("LEARN: level profile reset");
}

void PauseActionBridge::toggleAutoTune() {
    StageConfig::toggleAutoTune();
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format("LEARN: smart learning {}", StageConfig::autoTune() ? "ON" : "OFF"));
    AssistController::get().updateOverlay();
}

void PauseActionBridge::toggleTrajectory() {
    StageConfig::toggleShowTrajectory();
    bool const on = StageConfig::showTrajectory();
    TrajectoryVisualizer::get().setEnabled(on);
    if (on) {
        auto* pl = PlayLayer::get();
        if (pl) TrajectoryVisualizer::get().attach(pl);
    }
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format("TRAJ: visualizer {}", on ? "ON" : "OFF"));
    AssistController::get().updateOverlay();
}

void PauseActionBridge::exportConfig() {
    std::optional<std::filesystem::path> path;
#ifdef GEODE_IS_WINDOWS
    path = PauseActionBridgeDetail::pickSaveJsonWin32(true);
    if (!path) return;
#else
    auto& drops = SaveDropPaths::get();
    std::string dirErr;
    if (!drops.ensureDirs(dirErr)) {
        FLAlertLayer::create(
            "EarlyBuffer",
            dirErr.empty() ? "Could not create the save folder." : dirErr.c_str(),
            "OK"
        )->show();
        return;
    }
    path = drops.configPath();
#endif
    auto r = ConfigBundle::exportTo(*path);
    if (r.isErr()) {
        auto err = r.unwrapErr();
        if (err.empty()) err = "Config export failed.";
#ifndef GEODE_IS_WINDOWS
        err = fmt::format("{}\n\n{}", err, path->string());
#endif
        FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer", err.c_str(), "OK")->show();
        return;
    }
    FLAlertLayer::create(
        "EarlyBuffer",
        PauseActionBridgeDetail::formatExportSuccess(*path).c_str(),
        "OK"
    )->show();
}

void PauseActionBridge::importConfig() {
    std::optional<std::filesystem::path> path;
#ifdef GEODE_IS_WINDOWS
    path = PauseActionBridgeDetail::pickSaveJsonWin32(false);
    if (!path) return;
#else
    auto& drops = SaveDropPaths::get();
    std::string dirErr;
    if (!drops.ensureDirs(dirErr)) {
        FLAlertLayer::create(
            "EarlyBuffer",
            dirErr.empty() ? "Could not create the save folder." : dirErr.c_str(),
            "OK"
        )->show();
        return;
    }
    path = drops.configPath();
    std::error_code ec;
    bool const exists = std::filesystem::is_regular_file(*path, ec) && !ec;
    if (!exists) {
        auto const msg = fmt::format(
            "No config file found.\n\n"
            "Place earlybuffer-config.json (full settings export) at:\n{}\n\n"
            "Export Config writes that path. Copy the file with a file manager "
            "/ Files app / share, then Import again.",
            path->string()
        );
        FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer", msg.c_str(), "OK")->show();
        return;
    }
    auto const sz = std::filesystem::file_size(*path, ec);
    if (ec || sz == 0) {
        auto const emptyMsg = fmt::format(
            "Config file is empty or unreadable:\n{}",
            path->string()
        );
        FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer", emptyMsg.c_str(), "OK")->show();
        return;
    }
#endif
    auto r = ConfigBundle::importFrom(*path);
    if (r.isErr()) {
        auto const badMsg = fmt::format(
            "{}\n\nFile:\n{}",
            r.unwrapErr(),
            path->string()
        );
        FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer", badMsg.c_str(), "OK")->show();
        return;
    }

    // Import runs under applying-guard — sync UI that listeners would have skipped.
    StatusOverlay::setVisible(StageConfig::showOverlay());
    {
        bool const traj = StageConfig::showTrajectory();
        TrajectoryVisualizer::get().setEnabled(traj);
        if (traj) {
            if (auto* pl = PlayLayer::get()) {
                TrajectoryVisualizer::get().attach(pl);
            }
        }
        else {
            TrajectoryVisualizer::get().clear();
        }
    }
    AssistController::get().updateOverlay();
    FLAlertLayer::create(
        "EarlyBuffer",
        PauseActionBridgeDetail::formatImportSuccess(path).c_str(),
        "OK"
    )->show();
}

void PauseActionBridge::stubDevAction(char const* name) {
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format(
        "Dev Lab: '{}' is a stub (session/eval/trace not wired yet)",
        name ? name : "?"
    ));
}

void PauseActionBridge::devStartRecord() {
    if (!DevConfig::recordEnable()) {
        AssistLog::info("Dev Lab: enable Dev Record Enable before Start Recording");
        FLAlertLayer::create(
            "EarlyBuffer Dev",
            "Turn on Dev Record Enable first, then Start Recording.",
            "OK"
        )->show();
        return;
    }
    if (!DevSession::get().start()) {
        FLAlertLayer::create(
            "EarlyBuffer Dev",
            "Could not start Dev Lab recording session.",
            "OK"
        )->show();
        return;
    }
    auto const& s = DevTraceStore::get().session();
    auto const startMsg = fmt::format(
        "Recording started (rolling last {}).\nSession {}\nDoes not auto-stop.",
        s.recordingsTarget,
        s.sessionId
    );
    FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer Dev", startMsg.c_str(), "OK")->show();
}

void PauseActionBridge::devStopRecord() {
    if (!DevSession::get().isRecording() && !DevTraceStore::get().isOpen()) {
        AssistLog::info("Dev Lab: no open session to stop");
        FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer Dev", "No session is recording.", "OK")->show();
        return;
    }
    auto const path = DevSession::get().sessionPath();
    DevSession::get().stop();
    auto const stopMsg = path.empty()
        ? std::string("Recording stopped.")
        : fmt::format("Recording stopped.\n{}", path.string());
    FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer Dev", stopMsg.c_str(), "OK")->show();
}

void PauseActionBridge::devEvalLast() {
    std::string err;
    if (!DevReport::evalLastAttempt(err)) {
        AssistLog::info(fmt::format("Dev Lab: Eval Last failed: {}", err));
        FLAlertLayer::create(
            "EarlyBuffer Dev",
            err.empty() ? "Eval Last Attempt failed." : err.c_str(),
            "OK"
        )->show();
        return;
    }
    AssistController::get().updateOverlay();
    auto const& r = DevReport::last();
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format("Dev Lab: Eval Last → {}", r.overlayLine));
    FLAlertLayer::create(
        "EarlyBuffer Dev",
        r.overlayLine.empty() ? "Eval complete." : r.overlayLine.c_str(),
        "OK"
    )->show();
}

void PauseActionBridge::devEvalSession() {
    std::string err;
    int count = 0;
    if (!DevReport::evalSession(err, &count)) {
        AssistLog::info(fmt::format("Dev Lab: Eval Session failed: {}", err));
        FLAlertLayer::create(
            "EarlyBuffer Dev",
            err.empty() ? "Eval Session failed." : err.c_str(),
            "OK"
        )->show();
        return;
    }
    AssistController::get().updateOverlay();
    auto const& r = DevReport::last();
    auto const msg = fmt::format(
        "Evaluated {} attempt(s).\n{}",
        count,
        r.overlayLine
    );
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format("Dev Lab: Eval Session → {}", msg));
    FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer Dev", msg.c_str(), "OK")->show();
}

void PauseActionBridge::devExportSession() {
    auto& store = DevTraceStore::get();
    if (!store.isOpen()) {
        AssistLog::info("Dev Lab: no open session to export");
        FLAlertLayer::create(
            "EarlyBuffer Dev",
            "No open Dev session. Start Recording first.",
            "OK"
        )->show();
        return;
    }
    (void)store.flush();
    auto const path = store.sessionPath();
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format("Dev Lab: session export path {}", path.string()));
    auto const msg = fmt::format(
        "Session JSON:\n{}\nAttempts kept: {}/{} (rolling)",
        path.string(),
        store.session().recordingsDone,
        store.session().recordingsTarget
    );
    FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer Dev", msg.c_str(), "OK")->show();
}

        n
    );
    FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer Dev", msg.c_str(), "OK")->show();

void PauseActionBridge::devCopyReport() {
    if (!DevReport::hasLast()) {
        FLAlertLayer::create(
            "EarlyBuffer Dev",
            "No Dev report yet. Run Eval Last / Eval Session first.",
            "OK"
        )->show();
        return;
    }
    auto const& r = DevReport::last();
    // Clipboard / file = same overlay field string (contract A names only).
    std::string const text = r.overlayLine.empty()
        ? DevReport::formatOverlayLine(r)
        : r.overlayLine;

    bool const clipOk = clipboard::write(text);

    auto& drops = SaveDropPaths::get();
    std::string dirErr;
    bool fileOk = false;
    std::string fileErr;
    auto const path = drops.reportPath();
    if (!drops.ensureDirs(dirErr)) {
        fileErr = dirErr.empty() ? "could not create save folder" : dirErr;
    }
    else {
        auto const written = file::writeString(path, text);
        if (written.isOk()) {
            fileOk = true;
        }
        else {
            fileErr = written.unwrapErr();
            if (fileErr.empty()) fileErr = "write failed";
        }
    }

    AssistLog::info(fmt::format(
        "Dev Lab: copy report clip={} file={} → {}",
        clipOk ? "ok" : "fail",
        fileOk ? path.string() : fileErr,
        text
    ));

    std::string msg;
    if (clipOk && fileOk) {
        msg = fmt::format("Copied / saved to:\n{}\n\n{}", path.string(), text);
    }
    else if (fileOk && !clipOk) {
        msg = fmt::format(
            "Clipboard failed; saved to:\n{}\n\n{}",
            path.string(),
            text
        );
    }
    else if (clipOk && !fileOk) {
        msg = fmt::format(
            "Copied to clipboard.\nFile save failed: {}\n\n{}",
            fileErr,
            text
        );
    }
    else {
        msg = fmt::format(
            "Copy failed (clipboard and file).\nFile: {}\n\n{}",
            fileErr,
            text
        );
    }
    FLAlertLayer::create("EarlyBuffer Dev", msg.c_str(), "OK")->show();
}

void PauseActionBridge::openModSettings() {
    if (InLevelSettingsFilterKeeper::isOpen()) return;
    auto* mod = Mod::get();
    if (!mod) return;
    auto* popup = geode::openSettingsPopup(mod, false);
    if (!popup) {
        AssistLog::info("openModSettings: no settings popup (mod has no settings?)");
        return;
    }
    InLevelSettingsFilterKeeper::attach(popup);
}

void PauseActionBridge::openHub() {
    openModSettings();
}

void PauseActionBridge::refreshOpenSettings() {
    InLevelSettingsFilterKeeper::refreshOpen();
}
```

`src/ui/SaveFeedback.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "SaveFeedback.hpp"
#include "SaveFrameCounter.hpp"
#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"
#include "../debug/AssistLog.hpp"
#include "../debug/PerfTrace.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace geode::prelude;

SaveFeedback& SaveFeedback::get() {
    static SaveFeedback inst;
    return inst;
}

void SaveFeedback::restoreFlash() {
    if (!this->m_flashing || !this->m_flashPlayer) return;
    if (this->m_flashPlayer->m_isDead) return;

    this->m_flashPlayer->setColor(this->m_savedColor1);
    this->m_flashPlayer->setSecondColor(this->m_savedColor2);
    if (this->m_hadGlow) {
        this->m_flashPlayer->m_glowColor = this->m_savedGlow;
    }
}

void SaveFeedback::reset() {
    if (this->m_flashing && this->m_flashPlayer && !this->m_flashPlayer->m_isDead) {
        this->m_flashPlayer->setColor(this->m_savedColor1);
        this->m_flashPlayer->setSecondColor(this->m_savedColor2);
        if (this->m_hadGlow) {
            this->m_flashPlayer->m_glowColor = this->m_savedGlow;
        }
    }
    this->m_flashing = false;
    this->m_flashPlayer = nullptr;
    this->m_flashTicksLeft = 0;
    SaveFrameCounter::get().clear();
}

std::string SaveFeedback::cueFileName(int delayTicks) {
    int const bucket = delayTicks >= 8 ? 8 : std::max(1, delayTicks);
    return fmt::format("{}-tick.mp3", bucket);
}

std::filesystem::path SaveFeedback::cuePathFor(std::string const& file) {
    auto* mod = Mod::get();
    if (!mod) return {};

    auto const id = mod->getID();
    // Geode packs resources/cues/*.mp3 as resources/<mod-id>/<file>
    std::filesystem::path candidates[] = {
        mod->getResourcesDir() / file,
        mod->getResourcesDir() / id / file,
        mod->getResourcesDir() / "cues" / file,
        mod->getPackagePath().parent_path() / "resources" / id / file,
        mod->getPackagePath().parent_path() / "resources" / "cues" / file,
    };
    for (auto const& p : candidates) {
        std::error_code ec;
        if (p.empty()) continue;
        if (!std::filesystem::exists(p, ec)) continue;
        return p;
    }
    return {};
}

void SaveFeedback::playSound(int delayTicks) {
    if (delayTicks <= 0) return;

    auto* eng = FMODAudioEngine::sharedEngine();
    if (!eng) {
        AssistLog::info("save cue: no FMOD engine");
        return;
    }

    auto* mod = Mod::get();
    if (!mod) return;

    auto const file = cueFileName(delayTicks);
    auto const path = cuePathFor(file);
    // Prefer Geode-resolved name (mod-id/file) — works with FMOD's relative lookup.
    auto const sprName = fmt::format("{}/{}", mod->getID(), file);

    if (!path.empty()) {
        eng->playEffect(path.generic_string());
        AssistLog::debug(fmt::format("save cue +{} → {}", delayTicks, path.generic_string()));
        return;
    }

    // Last resort: spr-style relative name even if we couldn't stat the file yet
    // (unzipped path can lag one frame after install).
    eng->playEffect(sprName);
    AssistLog::debug(fmt::format(
        "save cue +{} via spr '{}' (resourcesDir={})",
        delayTicks, sprName, mod->getResourcesDir()
    ));
}

void SaveFeedback::flashIcon(PlayerObject* player) {
    if (!player || player->m_isDead) return;

    // Restore any previous flash first so we don't lose the true base colors.
    if (this->m_flashing && this->m_flashPlayer && this->m_flashPlayer != player) {
        if (!this->m_flashPlayer->m_isDead) {
            this->m_flashPlayer->setColor(this->m_savedColor1);
            this->m_flashPlayer->setSecondColor(this->m_savedColor2);
            if (this->m_hadGlow) {
                this->m_flashPlayer->m_glowColor = this->m_savedGlow;
            }
        }
    }

    if (!this->m_flashing || this->m_flashPlayer != player) {
        this->m_savedColor1 = player->getColor();
        this->m_savedColor2 = player->getSecondColor();
        this->m_hadGlow = player->m_hasGlow;
        this->m_savedGlow = player->m_glowColor;
    }

    auto const rgb = StageConfig::saveFeedbackColor();
    cocos2d::ccColor3B const flash{ rgb.r, rgb.g, rgb.b };
    player->setColor(flash);
    player->setSecondColor(flash);
    if (player->m_hasGlow) {
        player->m_glowColor = flash;
    }

    this->m_flashPlayer = player;
    this->m_flashing = true;
    // ~0.2s at 240tps
    this->m_flashTicksLeft = 48;
}

void SaveFeedback::onSave(PlayLayer* playLayer, PlayerObject* player, int delayTicks) {
    PerfTrace::Scope const scope("onSave");
    if (delayTicks <= 0) return;

    if (StageConfig::saveFeedbackSound()) {
        PerfTrace::Scope const soundScope("saveSound");
        this->playSound(delayTicks);
    }
    if (StageConfig::saveFeedbackIcon() && player) {
        PerfTrace::Scope const iconScope("saveIcon");
        this->flashIcon(player);
    }
    if (!StageConfig::saveFeedbackCounter()) return;
    if (!playLayer || !player) return;

    PerfTrace::Scope const counterScope("saveCounter");
    auto& counter = SaveFrameCounter::get();
    counter.attach(playLayer);
    counter.spawn(playLayer, player->getPosition(), delayTicks);
}

void SaveFeedback::onPhysicsTick() {
    if (!this->m_flashing) return;
    if (--this->m_flashTicksLeft > 0) return;

    this->restoreFlash();
    this->m_flashing = false;
    this->m_flashPlayer = nullptr;
    this->m_flashTicksLeft = 0;
}
```

`src/ui/SaveFeedback.hpp`:

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_UI_SAVEFEEDBACK_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_UI_SAVEFEEDBACK_HPP

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <filesystem>

// Per-save cues: sound (MP3), icon color flash, and/or frame-counter markers.
class SaveFeedback {
public:
    static SaveFeedback& get();

    // Call when assist injects a delayed click (delayTicks = ticks held back).
    void onSave(PlayLayer* playLayer, PlayerObject* player, int delayTicks);

    // Restore icon flash after a few physics ticks.
    void onPhysicsTick();

    void reset();

private:
    SaveFeedback() = default;

    void playSound(int delayTicks);
    void flashIcon(PlayerObject* player);
    void restoreFlash();

    static std::string cueFileName(int delayTicks);
    static std::filesystem::path cuePathFor(std::string const& file);

    PlayerObject* m_flashPlayer = nullptr;
    cocos2d::ccColor3B m_savedColor1{ 255, 255, 255 };
    cocos2d::ccColor3B m_savedColor2{ 255, 255, 255 };
    cocos2d::ccColor3B m_savedGlow{ 255, 255, 255 };
    bool m_hadGlow = false;
    bool m_flashing = false;
    int m_flashTicksLeft = 0;
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_UI_SAVEFEEDBACK_HPP
```

`src/ui/SaveFrameCounter.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "SaveFrameCounter.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <algorithm>
#include <fmt/format.h>
#include <string>

using namespace geode::prelude;

SaveFrameCounter& SaveFrameCounter::get() {
    static SaveFrameCounter inst;
    return inst;
}

int SaveFrameCounter::bucketFrames(int delayTicks) {
    if (delayTicks <= 0) return 1;
    return delayTicks >= 8 ? 8 : delayTicks;
}

ccColor3B SaveFrameCounter::colorForBucket(int bucket) {
    switch (bucket) {
        case 1: return { 0xff, 0x61, 0x4e };
        case 2: return { 0xff, 0xb4, 0x4a };
        case 3: return { 0xff, 0xf6, 0x72 };
        case 4: return { 0xfe, 0xfe, 0xfe };
        case 5: return { 0x83, 0xed, 0x8b };
        case 6: return { 0x70, 0xc3, 0xff };
        case 7: return { 0x77, 0x7e, 0xff };
        case 8:
        default: return { 0xc0, 0x69, 0xfa };
    }
}

ccColor4F SaveFrameCounter::to4F(ccColor3B c, float a) {
    return {
        static_cast<float>(c.r) / 255.f,
        static_cast<float>(c.g) / 255.f,
        static_cast<float>(c.b) / 255.f,
        a
    };
}

void SaveFrameCounter::ensureRoot(PlayLayer* layer) {
    if (!layer) return;
    if (this->m_root && this->m_root->getParent()) return;

    if (this->m_root) {
        this->m_root->release();
        this->m_root = nullptr;
    }

    this->m_root = CCNode::create();
    if (!this->m_root) return;

    this->m_root->setID("earlybuffer-save-counter-root"_spr);
    if (layer->m_objectLayer) {
        layer->m_objectLayer->addChild(this->m_root, 10000);
    }
    else {
        layer->addChild(this->m_root, 10000);
    }
    this->m_root->retain();
}

void SaveFrameCounter::attach(PlayLayer* layer) {
    this->ensureRoot(layer);
}

void SaveFrameCounter::detach(bool layerDying) {
    if (!this->m_root) return;
    if (layerDying) {
        // Drop OUR retain only; stay parented so PlayLayer teardown frees once.
        // Do not removeFromParent here — setNextScene is already destroying the tree.
        this->m_root->release();
        this->m_root = nullptr;
        return;
    }
    // Live quit: strip markers then destroy root while objectLayer is alive.
    this->m_root->removeAllChildrenWithCleanup(true);
    if (this->m_root->getParent()) {
        this->m_root->removeFromParentAndCleanup(true);
    }
    this->m_root->release();
    this->m_root = nullptr;
}

void SaveFrameCounter::clear() {
    if (!this->m_root) return;
    this->m_root->removeAllChildren();
}

void SaveFrameCounter::dropOldestIfOverCap() {
    if (!this->m_root) return;
    auto* kids = this->m_root->getChildren();
    if (!kids) return;

    while (static_cast<int>(kids->count()) >= kMaxMarkers) {
        auto* oldest = static_cast<CCNode*>(kids->objectAtIndex(0));
        if (!oldest) break;
        oldest->removeFromParent();
        kids = this->m_root->getChildren();
        if (!kids) break;
    }
}

void SaveFrameCounter::addOutlinedLabel(
    CCNode* parent,
    char const* text,
    ccColor3B color,
    float x,
    float y
) {
    if (!parent || !text) return;

    char const* fontName = "bigFont.fnt";
    auto* label = CCLabelBMFont::create(text, fontName);
    if (!label) {
        fontName = "chatFont.fnt";
        label = CCLabelBMFont::create(text, fontName);
        if (!label) return;
    }

    ccColor3B const outline = { 0, 0, 0 };
    float const o = kLabelOutlinePx;

    // 8-direction thick black outline in parent space (independent of label scale).
    float const ox[8] = { -o, o, 0.f, 0.f, -o, -o, o, o };
    float const oy[8] = { 0.f, 0.f, -o, o, -o, o, -o, o };
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
        auto* shadow = CCLabelBMFont::create(text, fontName);
        if (!shadow) continue;
        shadow->setScale(kLabelScale);
        shadow->setColor(outline);
        shadow->setOpacity(255);
        shadow->setAnchorPoint({ 1.f, 0.5f });
        shadow->setPosition({ x + ox[i], y + oy[i] });
        parent->addChild(shadow, 0);
    }

    label->setScale(kLabelScale);
    label->setColor(color);
    label->setAnchorPoint({ 1.f, 0.5f });
    label->setPosition({ x, y });
    label->setID("earlybuffer-save-marker-label"_spr);
    parent->addChild(label, 1);
}

CCNode* SaveFrameCounter::makeMarker(CCPoint worldPos, int delayTicks) {
    int const bucket = bucketFrames(delayTicks);
    auto const rgb = colorForBucket(bucket);
    // 1..7 → "+Nt"; 8 or more → "8+t" (physics ticks, not 60fps frames).
    std::string const text = (delayTicks >= 8)
        ? std::string("8+t")
        : fmt::format("+{}t", std::max(delayTicks, 1));

    auto* marker = CCNode::create();
    if (!marker) return nullptr;
    marker->setPosition(worldPos);
    marker->setID("earlybuffer-save-marker"_spr);

    auto* draw = CCDrawNode::create();
    if (!draw) return nullptr;

    draw->setBlendFunc({ GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA });

    ccColor3B const black = { 0, 0, 0 };
    float const outerR = kRingRadius + kOutlinePad;
    float const innerR = std::max(1.f, kRingRadius - kRingBorder);

    // Outer black rim.
    draw->drawCircle(
        CCPointZero,
        outerR,
        to4F(black, 0.f),
        kOutlineBorder,
        to4F(black, 1.f),
        kRingSegments
    );
    // Colored ring body.
    draw->drawCircle(
        CCPointZero,
        kRingRadius,
        to4F(rgb, 0.f),
        kRingBorder,
        to4F(rgb, 0.95f),
        kRingSegments
    );
    // Inner black rim (inside the colored stroke).
    draw->drawCircle(
        CCPointZero,
        innerR,
        to4F(black, 0.f),
        kOutlineBorder,
        to4F(black, 1.f),
        kRingSegments
    );
    // Soft inner tint so the hole reads on dark/busy backgrounds.
    draw->drawCircle(
        CCPointZero,
        std::max(0.5f, innerR - kOutlineBorder),
        to4F(rgb, 0.12f),
        0.f,
        to4F(rgb, 0.f),
        kRingSegments
    );
    marker->addChild(draw);

    addOutlinedLabel(
        marker,
        text.c_str(),
        rgb,
        -(kRingRadius + kLabelGap),
        0.f
    );

    return marker;
}

void SaveFrameCounter::spawn(PlayLayer* layer, CCPoint worldPos, int delayTicks) {
    if (!layer) return;
    if (delayTicks <= 0) return;

    this->ensureRoot(layer);
    if (!this->m_root) return;

    this->dropOldestIfOverCap();

    auto* marker = makeMarker(worldPos, delayTicks);
    if (!marker) return;
    this->m_root->addChild(marker);
}
```

```hpp
#ifndef EARLYBUFFER_UI_SAVEFRAMECOUNTER_HPP
#define EARLYBUFFER_UI_SAVEFRAMECOUNTER_HPP

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>

// World-space +N markers at assisted click positions (N = physics ticks held).
// Markers persist until clear() (death / attempt reset) or detach() (level quit).
class SaveFrameCounter {
public:
    static constexpr int kMaxMarkers = 64;

    static SaveFrameCounter& get();

    void attach(PlayLayer* layer);
    void detach(bool layerDying);
    void clear();

    // delayTicks = physics ticks held back (not 60fps frames). Bucket/label 1..8.
    void spawn(PlayLayer* layer, cocos2d::CCPoint worldPos, int delayTicks);

    // Exposed for selfCheck / tests.
    static int bucketFrames(int delayTicks);
    static cocos2d::ccColor3B colorForBucket(int bucket);

private:
    static constexpr float kRingRadius = 8.f;
    static constexpr float kRingBorder = 1.8f;
    static constexpr float kOutlineBorder = 1.25f;
    static constexpr float kOutlinePad = 1.35f;
    static constexpr float kLabelScale = 0.34f;
    static constexpr float kLabelGap = 5.f;
    static constexpr float kLabelOutlinePx = 1.6f;
    static constexpr unsigned kRingSegments = 32;

    SaveFrameCounter() = default;

    void ensureRoot(PlayLayer* layer);
    void dropOldestIfOverCap();
    static cocos2d::ccColor4F to4F(cocos2d::ccColor3B c, float a);
    static cocos2d::CCNode* makeMarker(cocos2d::CCPoint worldPos, int delayTicks);
    static void addOutlinedLabel(
        cocos2d::CCNode* parent,
        char const* text,
        cocos2d::ccColor3B color,
        float x,
        float y
    );

    cocos2d::CCNode* m_root = nullptr;
};

#endif // EARLYBUFFER_UI_SAVEFRAMECOUNTER_HPP
```

`src/ui/SettingsTabsHook.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "InLevelSettingsFilter.hpp"

#include <Geode/Geode.hpp>
#include <Geode/loader/SettingV3.hpp>
#include <Geode/modify/FLAlertLayer.hpp>

using namespace geode::prelude;

namespace {

bool nodeTreeHasOurSetting(CCNode* root) {
    if (!root || !Mod::get()) return false;
    auto* ourMod = Mod::get();
    std::string const ourId = ourMod->getID();

    std::vector<CCNode*> stack{ root };
    while (!stack.empty()) {
        auto* node = stack.back();
        stack.pop_back();
        if (!node) continue;

        if (auto* sett = typeinfo_cast<SettingNodeV3*>(node)) {
            if (auto s = sett->getSetting()) {
                if (s->getModID() == ourId || s->getMod() == ourMod) return true;
            }
            if (auto* label = sett->getNameLabel()) {
                std::string const text = label->getString();
                if (text.find("import-bake-replay") != std::string::npos
                    || text.find("bake-map-action") != std::string::npos
                    || text.find("show-pause-hub") != std::string::npos) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (auto* lab = typeinfo_cast<CCLabelBMFont*>(node)) {
            std::string const t = lab->getString();
            // Geode title: "Settings for EarlyBuffer" (any case/spacing)
            if (t.find("EarlyBuffer") != std::string::npos
                && (t.find("Settings") != std::string::npos
                    || t.find("SETTINGS") != std::string::npos)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        if (auto* kids = node->getChildren()) {
            for (auto* child : CCArrayExt<CCNode*>(kids)) {
                stack.push_back(child);
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

void tryAttachTabs(FLAlertLayer* layer) {
    if (!layer) return;
    if (layer->getChildByID("earlybuffer-inlevel-settings-filter"_spr)) return;
    if (!layer->getChildByIDRecursive("search-input")) return;
    if (!nodeTreeHasOurSetting(layer)) return;
    InLevelSettingsFilterKeeper::attach(layer);
}

} // namespace

class $modify(EbSettingsFLAlertHook, FLAlertLayer) {
    void show() {
        FLAlertLayer::show();
        // Settings finish building children after show — attach over the next frames.
        auto self = Ref(this);
        Loader::get()->queueInMainThread([self] {
            if (!self) return;
            tryAttachTabs(self.data());
            Loader::get()->queueInMainThread([self] {
                if (!self) return;
                tryAttachTabs(self.data());
                Loader::get()->queueInMainThread([self] {
                    if (self) tryAttachTabs(self.data());
                });
            });
        });
    }
};
```

```cpp
#include "StatusOverlay.hpp"
#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"
#include "../core/PlatformLimits.hpp"

using namespace geode::prelude;


cocos2d::CCLabelBMFont* StatusOverlay::s_label = nullptr;

std::string g_lastText;
bool g_lastVisible = false;


void StatusOverlay::attach(PlayLayer* playLayer) {
    detach();
    if (!playLayer) return;

    s_label = CCLabelBMFont::create("EarlyBuffer", "chatFont.fnt");
    if (!s_label) {
        s_label = CCLabelBMFont::create("EarlyBuffer", "bigFont.fnt");
    }
    if (!s_label) return;

    s_label->setScale(0.42f);
    s_label->setAnchorPoint({ 0.f, 1.f });
    s_label->setOpacity(220);
    s_label->setAlignment(kCCTextAlignmentLeft);
    s_label->setID("earlybuffer-status-overlay"_spr);

    auto const winSize = CCDirector::sharedDirector()->getWinSize();
    auto& limits = PlatformLimits::get();
    float const left = limits.overlayLeftInset();
    float const top = limits.overlayTopInset();
    s_label->setPosition({ left, winSize.height - top });

    g_lastText = "EarlyBuffer";
    g_lastVisible = StageConfig::showOverlay();
    s_label->setVisible(g_lastVisible);

    playLayer->addChild(s_label, 1000);
    s_label->retain();
}

void StatusOverlay::detach(bool layerDying) {
    if (!s_label) {
        g_lastText.clear();
        return;
    }
    if (layerDying) {
        s_label->release();
        s_label = nullptr;
        g_lastText.clear();
        return;
    }
    if (s_label->getParent()) {
        s_label->removeFromParent();
    }
    s_label->release();
    s_label = nullptr;
    g_lastText.clear();
}

void StatusOverlay::update(std::string const& text) {
    if (!s_label) return;
    bool const vis = StageConfig::showOverlay();
    if (vis != g_lastVisible) {
        g_lastVisible = vis;
        s_label->setVisible(vis);
    }
    if (vis && text != g_lastText) {
        g_lastText = text;
        s_label->setString(text.c_str());
    }
}

void StatusOverlay::setVisible(bool visible) {
    if (!s_label) return;
    bool const vis = visible && StageConfig::showOverlay();
    if (vis != g_lastVisible) {
        g_lastVisible = vis;
        s_label->setVisible(vis);
    }
}
```
