`src/ui/TrajectoryVisualizer.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "TrajectoryVisualizer.hpp"
#include "../core/AssistClock.hpp"
#include "../core/AssistController.hpp"
#include "../core/BakeMap.hpp"
#include "../core/ShadowSimulator.hpp"
#include "../config/StageConfig.hpp"
#include "../debug/AssistLog.hpp"
#include "../debug/PerfTrace.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace geode::prelude;

ccColor4F col(float r, float g, float b, float a = 0.95f) {
    return { r, g, b, a };
}

static std::vector<ReplayEvent> makeClickEvents(int delay, bool tapRelease) {
    if (delay < 0) delay = 0;
    std::vector<ReplayEvent> e;
    e.push_back(ReplayEvent{ delay, 1, false, true });
    if (tapRelease) {
        e.push_back(ReplayEvent{ delay + 2, 1, false, false });
    }
    return e;
}

// Drop near-duplicate points so DrawNode work stays cheap.
static std::vector<CCPoint> decimate(std::vector<CCPoint> const& pts, float minDistSq) {
    if (pts.size() < 3) return pts;
    std::vector<CCPoint> out;
    out.reserve(pts.size() / 2 + 2);
    out.push_back(pts.front());
    for (size_t i = 1; i + 1 < pts.size(); ++i) {
        static float dx = pts[i].x - out.back().x;
        static float dy = pts[i].y - out.back().y;
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy >= minDistSq) out.push_back(pts[i]);
    }
    out.push_back(pts.back());
    return out;
}



TrajectoryVisualizer& TrajectoryVisualizer::get() {
    static TrajectoryVisualizer inst;
    return inst;
}

void TrajectoryVisualizer::setEnabled(bool on) {
    m_enabled = on;
    if (!on) {
        m_ticksSinceRebuild = 0;
        clear();
    }
}

void TrajectoryVisualizer::toggle() {
    setEnabled(!m_enabled);
    AssistLog::info(fmt::format("TRAJ: visualizer {}", m_enabled ? "ON" : "OFF"));
}

std::string TrajectoryVisualizer::statusHint() const {
    if (!m_enabled) return {};
    if (!m_hasWindow) return "traj G/R";
    if (m_fromBake) {
        return fmt::format("traj G..R [{:.0f}..{:.0f}]", m_lastWindowEarly, m_lastWindowLate);
    }
    return fmt::format("traj G..R 0..{:.0f}t", m_lastWindowLate);
}

void TrajectoryVisualizer::attach(PlayLayer* layer) {
    ensureNode(layer);
    m_ticksSinceRebuild = 999;
    m_lastRebuildX = -1e9f;
    m_lastDelayEarly = -1;
    m_lastDelayLate = -1;
}

void TrajectoryVisualizer::detach(bool layerDying) {
    m_enabled = false;
    m_ticksSinceRebuild = 0;
    m_hasWindow = false;
    if (!m_node) return;
    if (layerDying) {
        m_node->release();
        m_node = nullptr;
        return;
    }
    if (m_node->getParent()) {
        m_node->removeFromParent();
    }
    m_node->release();
    m_node = nullptr;
}

void TrajectoryVisualizer::clear() {
    if (m_node && m_node->getParent()) m_node->clear();
    m_hasWindow = false;
}

void TrajectoryVisualizer::ensureNode(PlayLayer* layer) {
    if (!layer) return;
    if (m_node && m_node->getParent()) return;
    if (m_node) {
        m_node->release();
        m_node = nullptr;
    }
    m_node = CCDrawNode::create();
    if (!m_node) return;
    m_node->setID("earlybuffer-trajectory"_spr);
    m_node->setBlendFunc({ GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA });
    if (layer->m_objectLayer) {
        layer->m_objectLayer->addChild(m_node, 9999);
    }
    else {
        layer->addChild(m_node, 9999);
    }
    m_node->retain();
}

void TrajectoryVisualizer::drawPath(
    CCDrawNode* node,
    std::vector<CCPoint> const& pts,
    ccColor4F color,
    float width,
    int stride
) {
    if (!node || pts.size() < 2) return;
    if (stride < 1) stride = 1;
    for (size_t i = stride; i < pts.size(); i += static_cast<size_t>(stride)) {
        size_t prev = i - static_cast<size_t>(stride);
        // Fade slightly toward the tip so the near path reads stronger
        float t = static_cast<float>(i) / static_cast<float>(pts.size());
        ccColor4F c = color;
        c.a = color.a * (1.f - 0.45f * t);
        node->drawSegment(pts[prev], pts[i], width, c);
    }
    // Always connect last segment
    if (pts.size() > 2) {
        size_t lastAligned = ((pts.size() - 1) / stride) * stride;
        if (lastAligned + 1 < pts.size()) {
            node->drawSegment(pts[lastAligned], pts.back(), width, color);
        }
    }
}

void TrajectoryVisualizer::drawBand(
    CCDrawNode* node,
    std::vector<CCPoint> const& early,
    std::vector<CCPoint> const& late
) {
    if (!node) return;
    size_t n = std::min(early.size(), late.size());
    if (n < 2) return;

    // Soft cyan band = click window thickness (keep sparse — DrawNode polygons are costly)
    ccColor4F fill = col(0.35f, 0.85f, 1.f, 0.10f);
    int step = std::max(2, static_cast<int>(n) / 16);
    for (size_t i = 0; i + static_cast<size_t>(step) < n; i += static_cast<size_t>(step)) {
        size_t j = i + static_cast<size_t>(step);
        CCPoint a[3] = { early[i], late[i], late[j] };
        node->drawPolygon(a, 3, fill, 0.f, fill);
        CCPoint b[3] = { early[i], late[j], early[j] };
        node->drawPolygon(b, 3, fill, 0.f, fill);
    }
}

void TrajectoryVisualizer::onPhysicsTick(PlayLayer* layer, float) {
    if (!m_enabled || !layer || !m_node) return;
    if (ShadowSimulator::get().isSimulating()) return;
    if (!layer->m_objectLayer) return;
    if (!m_node->getParent()) {
        detach(true);
        return;
    }

    ++m_ticksSinceRebuild;
    // ~15 Hz rebuild (2 sims only) — snappier than full-horizon redraws
    if (m_ticksSinceRebuild < 16) return;
    m_ticksSinceRebuild = 0;
    rebuild(layer);
}

void TrajectoryVisualizer::rebuild(PlayLayer* layer) {
    PerfTrace::Scope const scope("trajRebuild");
    if (!this->m_enabled || !this->m_node || !layer || !layer->m_player1) return;
    if (!this->m_node->getParent()) return;
    if (ShadowSimulator::get().isSimulating()) return;

    auto* player = layer->m_player1;
    if (player->m_isDead) {
        m_node->clear();
        return;
    }

    float dt = AssistController::get().simDt();
    if (dt <= 0.f) dt = static_cast<float>(1.0 / AssistClock::kNominalTps);

    auto model = ShadowSimulator::modelFor(player, StageConfig::ticksAll());
    auto params = StageConfig::paramsFor(player);
    int liveLimit = params.overwrite ? params.ticks : StageConfig::ticksAll();

    auto& bake = BakeMap::get();
    double bakeTps = bake.loaded() && bake.data().tps > 0.0
        ? bake.data().tps
        : AssistClock::kNominalTps;
    int approxFrame = AssistClock::get().remapTick(
        bakeTps, AssistController::get().attemptTick(), dt
    );

    auto const* win = bake.loaded()
        ? bake.findNear(
            player->getPositionX(), approxFrame, true, false,
            StageConfig::kindOf(player)
          )
        : nullptr;

    int delayEarly = 0;
    int delayLate = std::max(0, liveLimit);
    m_fromBake = false;

    if (win) {
        m_fromBake = true;
        delayEarly = std::max(0, win->earliest - approxFrame);
        delayLate = std::max(delayEarly, win->latest - approxFrame);
        m_lastWindowEarly = static_cast<float>(win->earliest);
        m_lastWindowLate = static_cast<float>(win->latest);
        m_hasWindow = true;
    }
    else {
        m_lastWindowEarly = 0.f;
        m_lastWindowLate = static_cast<float>(delayLate);
        m_hasWindow = delayLate > 0;
    }

    float const x = player->getPositionX();
    // Skip resim when nearly still and the window hasn't changed
    if (std::fabs(x - m_lastRebuildX) < 2.f
        && delayEarly == m_lastDelayEarly
        && delayLate == m_lastDelayLate) {
        return;
    }
    m_lastRebuildX = x;
    m_lastDelayEarly = delayEarly;
    m_lastDelayLate = delayLate;

    // Short look-ahead: click + a bit after — not a full plan horizon
    int lookAhead = std::clamp(delayLate + 28, 32, 56);

    int slot = ShadowSimulator::get().captureSnapshot(player);
    if (slot < 0) return;

    auto& sim = ShadowSimulator::get();
    bool const tap = model.tapRelease;

    // Only two sims: earliest vs latest in the window
    auto earlyRaw = sim.samplePath(layer, slot, makeClickEvents(delayEarly, tap), dt, lookAhead);
    auto lateRaw = (delayLate == delayEarly)
        ? earlyRaw
        : sim.samplePath(layer, slot, makeClickEvents(delayLate, tap), dt, lookAhead);

    auto early = decimate(earlyRaw.points, 3.f * 3.f);
    auto late = decimate(lateRaw.points, 3.f * 3.f);

    m_node->clear();

    if (delayLate != delayEarly) {
        drawBand(m_node, early, late);
    }

    // Green = click early · Red = click late
    drawPath(m_node, early, col(0.15f, 1.f, 0.4f, 0.95f), 1.35f, 1);
    if (delayLate != delayEarly) {
        drawPath(m_node, late, col(1.f, 0.28f, 0.22f, 0.75f), 1.0f, 1);
    }

    // Player anchor
    auto p0 = player->getPosition();
    m_node->drawDot(p0, 3.f, col(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f));

    // Click moment from raw samples (frame-accurate, not decimated guess)
    auto clickAt = [&](std::vector<CCPoint> const& raw, int delay, ccColor4F c) {
        if (raw.empty()) return;
        size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(std::clamp(delay, 0, static_cast<int>(raw.size()) - 1));
        auto pt = raw[idx];
        m_node->drawDot(pt, 3.5f, c);
        m_node->drawSegment({ pt.x, pt.y - 8.f }, { pt.x, pt.y + 8.f }, 0.9f, c);
    };
    clickAt(earlyRaw.points, delayEarly, col(0.15f, 1.f, 0.4f, 1.f));
    if (delayLate != delayEarly) {
        clickAt(lateRaw.points, delayLate, col(1.f, 0.28f, 0.22f, 1.f));
    }

    // Death = small X (only when that path dies)
    auto markDeath = [&](ShadowSimulator::PathSample const& s, ccColor4F c) {
        if (!s.died || s.points.empty()) return;
        auto pt = s.points.back();
        float r = 4.5f;
        m_node->drawSegment({ pt.x - r, pt.y - r }, { pt.x + r, pt.y + r }, 1.1f, c);
        m_node->drawSegment({ pt.x - r, pt.y + r }, { pt.x + r, pt.y - r }, 1.1f, c);
    };
    if (earlyRaw.died) markDeath(earlyRaw, col(0.15f, 1.f, 0.4f, 0.7f));
    if (lateRaw.died && delayLate != delayEarly) markDeath(lateRaw, col(1.f, 0.28f, 0.22f, 0.7f));
}
```

`tools/geode_package_check.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify a Geode .geode package contains required platform binaries.

Geode loads {mod_id}{platform_suffix} from the package zip. Installing a
Windows-only package on Android fails with:

  Unable to find platform binary under the name 'audesign.earlybuffer.android64.so'

This tool fails loudly before that install step.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

# Geode platform binary suffixes (ModMetadataImpl: id + GEODE_PLATFORM_EXTENSION).
PLATFORM_SUFFIX: dict[str, str] = {
    "win": ".dll",
    "windows": ".dll",
    "android64": ".android64.so",
    "android32": ".android32.so",
    "mac": ".dylib",
    "macos": ".dylib",
    "ios": ".ios.dylib",
}

DEFAULT_MOD_ID = "audesign.earlybuffer"


def normalize_entry(name: str) -> str:
    """Zip entries may use forward or back slashes; compare basenames only."""
    return name.replace("\\", "/").split("/")[-1]


def read_mod_id_from_package(zf: zipfile.ZipFile) -> str | None:
    names = {normalize_entry(n): n for n in zf.namelist()}
    key = names.get("mod.json")
    if key is None:
        return None
    try:
        data = json.loads(zf.read(key).decode("utf-8"))
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError):
        return None
    mid = data.get("id")
    return mid if isinstance(mid, str) and mid else None


def expected_binary(mod_id: str, platform: str) -> str:
    plat = platform.lower().strip()
    if plat not in PLATFORM_SUFFIX:
        raise ValueError(
            f"unknown platform '{platform}' "
            f"(known: {', '.join(sorted(PLATFORM_SUFFIX))})"
        )
    return mod_id + PLATFORM_SUFFIX[plat]


def list_binaries(zf: zipfile.ZipFile, mod_id: str) -> list[str]:
    """Basenames that look like this mod's platform binaries."""
    found: list[str] = []
    prefixes = (mod_id + ".",)
    # Windows: {id}.dll — no extra platform token between id and extension.
    win_name = mod_id + ".dll"
    for raw in zf.namelist():
        base = normalize_entry(raw)
        if not base or base.endswith("/"):
            continue
        if base == win_name or base.startswith(prefixes):
            # Accept Geode binary extensions only (ignore e.g. id.pdb noise).
            lower = base.lower()
            if (
                lower.endswith(".dll")
                or lower.endswith(".so")
                or lower.endswith(".dylib")
            ):
                found.append(base)
    return sorted(set(found))


def check_package(
    path: Path,
    require: list[str],
    mod_id: str | None,
) -> int:
    if not path.is_file():
        print(f"ERROR: package not found: {path}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "r") as zf:
            bad = zf.testzip()
            if bad is not None:
                print(f"ERROR: corrupt zip entry: {bad}", file=sys.stderr)
                return 2

            entries = zf.namelist()
            if not entries:
                print("ERROR: package zip is empty", file=sys.stderr)
                return 2

            pkg_id = read_mod_id_from_package(zf)
            resolved_id = mod_id or pkg_id or DEFAULT_MOD_ID
            if mod_id and pkg_id and mod_id != pkg_id:
                print(
                    f"ERROR: --mod-id '{mod_id}' does not match "
                    f"mod.json id '{pkg_id}'",
                    file=sys.stderr,
                )
                return 2
            if pkg_id is None:
                print(
                    "WARN: mod.json missing or unreadable; "
                    f"using mod id '{resolved_id}'",
                    file=sys.stderr,
                )

            present = list_binaries(zf, resolved_id)
            print(f"package: {path}")
            print(f"mod id:  {resolved_id}")
            print("binaries found:")
            if present:
                for b in present:
                    print(f"  {b}")
            else:
                print("  (none)")

            missing: list[str] = []
            for plat in require:
                name = expected_binary(resolved_id, plat)
                if name not in present:
                    # Also accept basename match case-insensitively on Windows.
                    if not any(p.lower() == name.lower() for p in present):
                        missing.append(name)

            if missing:
                print("MISSING required platform binaries:")
                for name in missing:
                    print(f"  {name}")
                    # Match Geode loader wording so logs are searchable.
                    print(
                        "  Unable to find platform binary under the name "
                        f"'{name}'"
                    )
                print(
                    "FAIL: do not install this .geode on a platform that "
                    "needs a missing binary (e.g. Android64)."
                )
                sys.stdout.flush()
                return 1

            if require:
                print("OK: all required binaries present")
            return 0
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        print(f"ERROR: not a valid zip/.geode: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    except ValueError as exc:
        print(f"ERROR: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2


def parse_args(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "Check that a .geode zip contains required Geode platform binaries "
            "(prevents Android 'Unable to find platform binary' installs)."
        )
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "package",
        type=Path,
        help="Path to a .geode file (zip)",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--require",
        action="append",
        default=[],
        metavar="PLATFORM",
        help=(
            "Required platform (repeatable): android64, android32, win, mac, ios. "
            "Default if omitted: android64"
        ),
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--mod-id",
        default=None,
        help=f"Mod id (default: from mod.json or {DEFAULT_MOD_ID})",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--list-only",
        action="store_true",
        help="List binaries and exit 0 even if requirements are missing",
    )
    return p.parse_args(argv)


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    require = list(args.require) if args.require else ["android64"]
    # Deduplicate while preserving order.
    seen: set[str] = set()
    require_unique: list[str] = []
    for r in require:
        key = r.lower().strip()
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            require_unique.append(key)

    if args.list_only:
        # Open and list only; empty require → never fail on missing platforms.
        code = check_package(args.package, [], args.mod_id)
        return 0 if code in (0, 1) else code

    return check_package(args.package, require_unique, args.mod_id)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`tools/merge_geode_packages.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Merge Geode .geode packages and refuse to ship without required binaries.

`geode package merge` mutates its FIRST argument. This wrapper:
  1. Copies inputs aside (never destroys the only Windows zip by accident)
  2. Runs `geode package merge` into the output path
  3. Runs tools/geode_package_check.py (default: require android64)

Example (Windows + Android64 ship):

  python tools/merge_geode_packages.py ^
    --output releases/audesign.earlybuffer.geode ^
    build/audesign.earlybuffer.geode ^
    build-android64/audesign.earlybuffer.geode

Phone-only Android64 test package:

  python tools/merge_geode_packages.py ^
    --output releases/audesign.earlybuffer-android64.geode ^
    --allow-missing-win ^
    --require android64 ^
    build-android64/audesign.earlybuffer.geode
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CHECK_SCRIPT = SCRIPT_DIR / "geode_package_check.py"


def die(msg: str, code: int = 2) -> None:
    print(f"ERROR: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(code)


def run(cmd: list[str], cwd: Path | None = None) -> None:
    print("+", " ".join(cmd))
    try:
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, cwd=cwd)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        die(f"command not found: {cmd[0]}")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as exc:
        die(f"command failed ({exc.returncode}): {' '.join(cmd)}", code=exc.returncode or 1)


def parse_args(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "Merge .geode packages via `geode package merge`, then gate with "
            "geode_package_check.py (android64 required by default)."
        )
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "packages",
        nargs="+",
        type=Path,
        help="Input .geode files (first is the merge base; a copy is used)",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--output",
        "-o",
        type=Path,
        required=True,
        help="Output .geode path (created/overwritten)",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--require",
        action="append",
        default=[],
        metavar="PLATFORM",
        help="Platform required after merge (repeatable). Default: android64",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--allow-missing-win",
        action="store_true",
        help="Do not require the Windows .dll (phone-only / android-only ships)",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--zstd",
        action="store_true",
        help="Pass --zstd to geode package merge",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--optimize-pngs",
        action="store_true",
        help="Pass --optimize-pngs to geode package merge",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--geode",
        default="geode",
        help="Geode CLI executable (default: geode)",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--skip-check",
        action="store_true",
        help="Skip package binary check (not recommended)",
    )
    return p.parse_args(argv)


def resolve_requires(args: argparse.Namespace) -> list[str]:
    require = [r.lower().strip() for r in args.require] if args.require else ["android64"]
    if not args.allow_missing_win and "win" not in require and "windows" not in require:
        if len(args.packages) >= 2:
            require = ["win", *require]
    seen: set[str] = set()
    out: list[str] = []
    for r in require:
        if r not in seen:
            seen.add(r)
            out.append(r)
    return out


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    packages = [p.resolve() for p in args.packages]
    output = args.output.resolve()

    if not CHECK_SCRIPT.is_file():
        die(f"missing checker: {CHECK_SCRIPT}")

    for pkg in packages:
        if not pkg.is_file():
            die(f"package not found: {pkg}")

    require = resolve_requires(args)
    print(f"output:   {output}")
    print(f"require:  {', '.join(require)}")
    print("inputs:")
    for pkg in packages:
        print(f"  {pkg}")

    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eb-geode-merge-") as tmp:
        tmp_path = Path(tmp)
        work_pkgs: list[Path] = []
        for i, pkg in enumerate(packages):
            dest = tmp_path / f"pkg{i}-{pkg.name}"
            shutil.copy2(pkg, dest)
            work_pkgs.append(dest)

        if len(work_pkgs) == 1:
            merged = work_pkgs[0]
            print("single package — skip geode package merge")
        else:
            merged = work_pkgs[0]
            cmd = [args.geode, "package", "merge"]
            if args.zstd:
                cmd.append("--zstd")
            if args.optimize_pngs:
                cmd.append("--optimize-pngs")
            cmd.extend(str(p) for p in work_pkgs)
            run(cmd)

        staging = output.with_suffix(output.suffix + ".tmp")
        if staging.exists():
            staging.unlink()
        shutil.copy2(merged, staging)
        staging.replace(output)

    print(f"wrote: {output}")

    if args.skip_check:
        print("WARN: --skip-check set; not verifying binaries")
        return 0

    check_cmd = [
        sys.executable,
        str(CHECK_SCRIPT),
        str(output),
    ]
    for plat in require:
        check_cmd.extend(["--require", plat])
    print("+", " ".join(check_cmd))
    try:
        subprocess.run(check_cmd, check=True)
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as exc:
        print(
            "FAIL: merged package missing required binaries — "
            "do not install or publish this file.",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return exc.returncode or 1

    print("OK: merge + package check passed")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

```

`tools/scan_devlab_assists.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Scan EarlyBuffer Dev Lab session JSON for assist failures."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path


FOCUS_REASON_PREFIXES = ("pass-hopeless", "delayArm", "delay-", "fire", "gatePass", "pass-")


def reason_bucket(reason: str | None) -> str:
    if not reason:
        return "(none)"
    # Keep full reason for counting; caller may also group.
    return reason


def player_fields(ev: dict) -> dict:
    wit = ev.get("witness") or {}
    pl = wit.get("player") or {}
    return {
        "hasEverJumped": pl.get("hasEverJumped"),
        "isOnGround": pl.get("isOnGround"),
        "x": pl.get("x"),
        "y": pl.get("y"),
    }


def clock_fields(ev: dict) -> dict:
    clk = ev.get("clock") or {}
    return {
        "simTps": clk.get("simTps"),
        "speedScaleSuspect": clk.get("speedScaleSuspect"),
        "simDt": clk.get("simDt"),
        "attemptTick": clk.get("attemptTick"),
        "timeWarp": clk.get("timeWarp"),
    }


def fmt_num(v, digits=2):
    if v is None:
        return "-"
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return str(v).lower()
    if isinstance(v, float):
        return f"{v:.{digits}f}"
    return str(v)


def scan_session(path: Path) -> None:
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    print("=" * 88)
    print(f"SESSION {data.get('sessionId')}  file={path.name}")
    print(
        f"  levelName={data.get('levelName')!r}  startPos={data.get('startPos')}  "
        f"practice={data.get('practice')}  attempts={len(data.get('attempts') or [])}  "
        f"recordings={data.get('recordingsDone')}/{data.get('recordingsTarget')}"
    )

    kind_counts: Counter[str] = Counter()
    reason_counts: Counter[str] = Counter()
    reason_on_kinds: Counter[tuple[str, str]] = Counter()

    plan_down_rows: list[dict] = []
    delay_fire_rows: list[dict] = []

    for att in data.get("attempts") or []:
        aid = att.get("attemptId")
        for ev in att.get("events") or []:
            kind = ev.get("kind") or "?"
            reason = ev.get("assistReason")
            kind_counts[kind] += 1
            reason_counts[reason_bucket(reason)] += 1
            if reason:
                reason_on_kinds[(kind, reason)] += 1

            down = bool(ev.get("down"))
            pl = player_fields(ev)
            clk = clock_fields(ev)

            if kind == "planFinished" and down:
                plan_down_rows.append(
                    {
                        "attemptId": aid,
                        "pressId": ev.get("pressId"),
                        "assistReason": reason,
                        "pressTick": ev.get("pressTick"),
                        "plannedDelay": ev.get("plannedDelay"),
                        **clk,
                        **pl,
                    }
                )

            if kind in ("delayArm", "fire") or (
                reason
                and (
                    reason.startswith("delay-")
                    or reason.startswith("fire@")
                )
            ):
                delay_fire_rows.append(
                    {
                        "attemptId": aid,
                        "kind": kind,
                        "down": down,
                        "assistReason": reason,
                        "pressTick": ev.get("pressTick"),
                        "plannedDelay": ev.get("plannedDelay"),
                        "plannedFireTick": ev.get("plannedFireTick"),
                        "actualFireTick": ev.get("actualFireTick"),
                        **clk,
                        **pl,
                    }
                )

    # First DOWN press per attempt that is NOT gatePass
    first_bad_down: list[dict] = []
    for att in data.get("attempts") or []:
        aid = att.get("attemptId")
        # Group by pressId for DOWN presses
        down_press_ids: list[int] = []
        by_press: dict[int, list[dict]] = {}
        for ev in att.get("events") or []:
            if not ev.get("down"):
                continue
            pid = ev.get("pressId")
            if pid is None:
                continue
            if pid not in by_press:
                by_press[pid] = []
                down_press_ids.append(pid)
            by_press[pid].append(ev)
        if not down_press_ids:
            continue
        first_pid = down_press_ids[0]
        evs = by_press[first_pid]
        kinds = {e.get("kind") for e in evs}
        if "gatePass" in kinds:
            continue  # first DOWN was gatePass — skip
        # Prefer planFinished row for summary
        plan = next((e for e in evs if e.get("kind") == "planFinished"), None)
        src = plan or evs[0]
        pl = player_fields(src)
        clk = clock_fields(src)
        first_bad_down.append(
            {
                "attemptId": aid,
                "pressId": first_pid,
                "kinds": ",".join(sorted(k for k in kinds if k)),
                "assistReason": src.get("assistReason"),
                "pressTick": src.get("pressTick"),
                "plannedDelay": src.get("plannedDelay"),
                **clk,
                **pl,
            }
        )

    # Counts
    print("\n  kind counts:")
    for k, n in kind_counts.most_common():
        print(f"    {k:16s} {n}")

    print("\n  assistReason counts (all events with reason):")
    for r, n in reason_counts.most_common():
        if r == "(none)":
            continue
        print(f"    {n:4d}  {r}")
    none_n = reason_counts.get("(none)", 0)
    if none_n:
        print(f"    {none_n:4d}  (none)")

    # Focus buckets
    focus = Counter()
    for r, n in reason_counts.items():
        if r == "(none)":
            continue
        base = r.split("@", 1)[0]
        if base.startswith("fire"):
            focus["fire"] += n
        elif base.startswith("delay"):
            focus["delayArm/delay-*"] += n
        elif base.startswith("pass-hopeless"):
            focus["pass-hopeless"] += n
        elif base.startswith("gatePass") or r == "gatePass":
            focus["gatePass"] += n
        elif base.startswith("pass-"):
            focus[f"pass-other:{base}"] += n
        else:
            focus[f"other:{base}"] += n
    # Also count gatePass kind
    focus["gatePass(kind)"] = kind_counts.get("gatePass", 0)
    focus["delayArm(kind)"] = kind_counts.get("delayArm", 0)
    focus["fire(kind)"] = kind_counts.get("fire", 0)

    print("\n  focus buckets:")
    for k, n in sorted(focus.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0])):
        print(f"    {n:4d}  {k}")

    print("\n  planFinished DOWN presses:")
    print(
        f"    {'att':>3} {'press':>5} {'tick':>5} {'delay':>5} "
        f"{'simTps':>6} {'suspect':>7} {'simDt':>6} "
        f"{'jumped':>6} {'ground':>6} {'x':>10} {'y':>8}  reason"
    )
    for row in plan_down_rows:
        print(
            f"    {row['attemptId']:>3} {fmt_num(row['pressId'],0):>5} "
            f"{fmt_num(row['pressTick'],0):>5} {fmt_num(row['plannedDelay'],0):>5} "
            f"{fmt_num(row['simTps'],1):>6} {fmt_num(row['speedScaleSuspect']):>7} "
            f"{fmt_num(row['simDt'],3):>6} "
            f"{fmt_num(row['hasEverJumped']):>6} {fmt_num(row['isOnGround']):>6} "
            f"{fmt_num(row['x'],1):>10} {fmt_num(row['y'],1):>8}  "
            f"{row['assistReason']}"
        )

    print("\n  first DOWN press per attempt that is NOT gatePass:")
    if not first_bad_down:
        print("    (none — every first DOWN was gatePass)")
    else:
        print(
            f"    {'att':>3} {'press':>5} {'tick':>5} {'delay':>5} "
            f"{'simTps':>6} {'suspect':>7} {'simDt':>6} "
            f"{'jumped':>6} {'ground':>6} {'x':>10} {'y':>8}  reason  kinds"
        )
        for row in first_bad_down:
            print(
                f"    {row['attemptId']:>3} {fmt_num(row['pressId'],0):>5} "
                f"{fmt_num(row['pressTick'],0):>5} {fmt_num(row['plannedDelay'],0):>5} "
                f"{fmt_num(row['simTps'],1):>6} {fmt_num(row['speedScaleSuspect']):>7} "
                f"{fmt_num(row['simDt'],3):>6} "
                f"{fmt_num(row['hasEverJumped']):>6} {fmt_num(row['isOnGround']):>6} "
                f"{fmt_num(row['x'],1):>10} {fmt_num(row['y'],1):>8}  "
                f"{row['assistReason']}  [{row['kinds']}]"
            )

    print("\n  delayArm / fire successes:")
    successes = [
        r
        for r in delay_fire_rows
        if r["kind"] in ("delayArm", "fire")
        or (r.get("assistReason") or "").startswith("fire@")
        or (r.get("assistReason") or "").startswith("delay-")
    ]
    # Deduplicate to delayArm/fire kinds primarily
    shown = [r for r in delay_fire_rows if r["kind"] in ("delayArm", "fire")]
    if not shown:
        print("    (none)")
    else:
        print(
            f"    {'att':>3} {'kind':>8} {'down':>4} {'tick':>5} {'delay':>5} "
            f"{'pFire':>6} {'aFire':>6} {'simTps':>6} {'suspect':>7}  reason"
        )
        for row in shown:
            print(
                f"    {row['attemptId']:>3} {row['kind']:>8} "
                f"{str(row['down']).lower():>4} {fmt_num(row['pressTick'],0):>5} "
                f"{fmt_num(row['plannedDelay'],0):>5} "
                f"{fmt_num(row['plannedFireTick'],0):>6} "
                f"{fmt_num(row['actualFireTick'],0):>6} "
                f"{fmt_num(row['simTps'],1):>6} {fmt_num(row['speedScaleSuspect']):>7}  "
                f"{row['assistReason']}"
            )

    # Quick clock anomaly summary on planFinished downs
    if plan_down_rows:
        tps = Counter(r.get("simTps") for r in plan_down_rows)
        sus = Counter(r.get("speedScaleSuspect") for r in plan_down_rows)
        dts = Counter(r.get("simDt") for r in plan_down_rows)
        print("\n  clock on planFinished DOWN:")
        print(f"    simTps={dict(tps)}  speedScaleSuspect={dict(sus)}  simDt={dict(dts)}")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument(
        "paths",
        nargs="*",
        type=Path,
        default=[
            Path(r"C:\Users\mikaj\AppData\Local\GeometryDash\geode\mods\audesign.earlybuffer\devtraces")
            / name
            for name in (
                "session-1793312888777.json",
                "session-1793312934335.json",
                "session-1793313116877.json",
            )
        ],
    )
    args = ap.parse_args()
    for p in args.paths:
        if not p.exists():
            print(f"MISSING {p}", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        scan_session(p)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```
